        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_cron_access()\n RETURNS event_trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT\n    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev\n    JOIN pg_extension AS ext\n    ON ev.objid = ext.oid\n    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_cron'\n  )\n  THEN\n    grant usage on schema cron to postgres with grant option;\n\n    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on tables to postgres with grant option;\n    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on functions to postgres with grant option;\n    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on sequences to postgres with grant option;\n\n    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all\n        on sequences to postgres with grant option;\n    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all\n        on tables to postgres with grant option;\n    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all\n        on functions to postgres with grant option;\n\n    grant all privileges on all tables in schema cron to postgres with grant option;\n    revoke all on table cron.job from postgres;\n    grant select on table cron.job to postgres with grant option;\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "identity": "grant_pg_graphql_access()",
        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_graphql_access()\n RETURNS event_trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\nbegin\n    if not exists (\n        select 1\n        from pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() ev\n        join pg_catalog.pg_extension e on ev.objid = e.oid\n        where e.extname = 'pg_graphql'\n    ) then\n        return;\n    end if;\n\n    drop function if exists graphql_public.graphql;\n    create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(\n        \"operationName\" text default null,\n        query text default null,\n        variables jsonb default null,\n        extensions jsonb default null\n    )\n        returns jsonb\n        language sql\n    as $$\n        select graphql.resolve(\n            query := query,\n            variables := coalesce(variables, '{}'),\n            \"operationName\" := \"operationName\",\n            extensions := extensions\n        );\n    $$;\n\n    -- Attach the wrapper to the extension so DROP EXTENSION cascades to it,\n    -- which in turn triggers set_graphql_placeholder to reinstall the \"not enabled\" stub.\n    alter extension pg_graphql add function graphql_public.graphql(text, text, jsonb, jsonb);\n\n    grant usage on schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;\n    grant execute on function graphql.resolve to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;\n    grant usage on schema graphql to postgres with grant option;\n    grant usage on schema graphql_public to postgres with grant option;\nend;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION net._http_collect_response(request_id bigint, async boolean DEFAULT true)\n RETURNS net.http_response_result\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n    rec net._http_response;\n    req_exists boolean;\nbegin\n\n    if not async then\n        perform net._await_response(request_id);\n    end if;\n\n    select *\n    into rec\n    from net._http_response\n    where id = request_id;\n\n    if rec is null or rec.error_msg is not null then\n        -- The request is either still processing or the request_id provided does not exist\n\n        -- TODO: request in progress is indistinguishable from request that doesn't exist\n\n        -- No request matching request_id found\n        return (\n            'ERROR',\n            coalesce(rec.error_msg, 'request matching request_id not found'),\n            null\n        )::net.http_response_result;\n\n    end if;\n\n    -- Return a valid, populated http_response_result\n    return (\n        'SUCCESS',\n        'ok',\n        (\n            rec.status_code,\n            rec.headers,\n            rec.content\n        )::net.http_response\n    )::net.http_response_result;\nend;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._archive_supplier_receipt_impl(p_receipt_id uuid, p_is_archived boolean DEFAULT true)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\nBEGIN\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب تسجيل الدخول لأرشفة سند الاستلام.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.supplier_receipts\n  SET\n    is_archived = p_is_archived,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_receipt_id;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سند الاستلام غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    CASE WHEN p_is_archived\n      THEN 'ARCHIVE_SUPPLIER_RECEIPT'\n      ELSE 'RESTORE_SUPPLIER_RECEIPT'\n    END,\n    'supplier_receipts',\n    p_receipt_id,\n    jsonb_build_object('is_archived', p_is_archived)\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'is_archived', p_is_archived\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._build_business_summary_before133(p_summary_type text, p_period_start date, p_period_end date, p_generated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_facts JSONB;\n  v_timezone TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- The inner builder validates the period and the configured timezone.\n  v_result := public._build_business_summary_before_phase6(\n    p_summary_type, p_period_start, p_period_end, p_generated_at\n  );\n  SELECT business_timezone INTO STRICT v_timezone\n  FROM public.business_alert_settings WHERE id = true;\n  v_facts := public.phase6_financial_facts_internal(\n    NULL,\n    p_period_start::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE v_timezone,\n    (p_period_end + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE v_timezone,\n    v_timezone,\n    false\n  );\n  v_result := jsonb_set(v_result, '{sales}', (v_result->'sales') || (v_facts->'sales'));\n  v_result := jsonb_set(v_result, '{balances}', (v_result->'balances') || (v_facts->'balances'));\n  v_result := jsonb_set(v_result, '{expenses}', (v_result->'expenses') || (v_facts->'expenses'));\n  v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object(\n    'cashFlow', v_facts->'cashFlow',\n    'dailyBreakdown', v_facts->'dailyBreakdown'\n  );\n  IF jsonb_typeof(v_result) <> 'object'\n    OR octet_length(v_result::TEXT) > 32768\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Business summary payload is invalid or too large.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._build_business_summary_before_phase6(p_summary_type text, p_period_start date, p_period_end date, p_generated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_timezone TEXT;\n  v_period_start TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_period_end TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_summary_type NOT IN ('daily', 'weekly')\n    OR p_period_start IS NULL OR p_period_end IS NULL\n    OR p_generated_at IS NULL\n    OR (p_summary_type = 'daily' AND p_period_start <> p_period_end)\n    OR (p_summary_type = 'weekly' AND p_period_end <> p_period_start + 6)\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Business summary period.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT business_timezone INTO STRICT v_timezone\n  FROM public.business_alert_settings WHERE id = true;\n  v_period_start := p_period_start::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE AS completed_at\n    FROM public.order_status_history osh\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = osh.order_id\n    WHERE osh.new_status = 'completed'\n      AND osh.created_at >= v_period_start\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._calculate_guest_promotion(p_code text, p_items jsonb, p_customer_phone text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_code TEXT := UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(p_code), ''));\n  v_phone TEXT := CASE\n    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(p_customer_phone), '') IS NULL THEN NULL\n    ELSE public.normalize_customer_phone(p_customer_phone)\n  END;\n  v_promotion public.promotion_codes%ROWTYPE;\n  v_item JSONB;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_package_price BIGINT;\n  v_units_per_package INTEGER;\n  v_subtotal BIGINT := 0;\n  v_discount BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total_redemptions INTEGER := 0;\n  v_phone_redemptions INTEGER := 0;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_code IS NULL OR v_code !~ '^[A-Z0-9_-]{3,32}$' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'اكتب رمز خصم صحيحاً.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_items IS NULL\n    OR jsonb_typeof(p_items) <> 'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_items) > 50\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سلة الطلب غير صالحة لحساب الخصم.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS item(value)\n    GROUP BY item.value->>'product_id'\n    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تكرار المنتج نفسه داخل الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_item IN\n    SELECT item.value\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS item(value)\n    ORDER BY item.value->>'product_id'\n  LOOP\n    BEGIN\n      v_product_id := (v_item->>'product_id')::UUID;\n      v_quantity := (v_item->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n    EXCEPTION\n      WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات أحد طرود الطلب غير صحيحة.';\n    END;\n\n    IF v_product_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(v_quantity, 0) <= 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات أحد طرود الطلب غير صحيحة.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      p.units_per_sale_unit\n    INTO v_package_price, v_units_per_package\n    FROM public.products AS p\n    WHERE p.id = v_product_id\n      AND p.is_active = true;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND\n      OR COALESCE(v_package_price, 0) <= 0\n      OR COALESCE(v_units_per_package, 0) <= 0\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'أحد منتجات السلة غير متاح للبيع.';\n    END IF;\n\n    v_subtotal := v_subtotal + (v_quantity * v_package_price);\n  END LOOP;\n\n  SELECT pc.*\n  INTO v_promotion\n  FROM public.promotion_codes AS pc\n  WHERE pc.code = v_code\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_promotion.is_active THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رمز الخصم غير صحيح أو غير فعال.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_promotion.starts_at IS NOT NULL\n    AND NOW() < v_promotion.starts_at\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رمز الخصم لم يبدأ بعد.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_promotion.expires_at IS NOT NULL\n    AND NOW() >= v_promotion.expires_at\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'انتهت صلاحية رمز الخصم.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_subtotal < v_promotion.minimum_subtotal_in_minor_units THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'الطلب لا يصل إلى الحد الأدنى المطلوب لهذا الخصم.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER\n  INTO v_total_redemptions\n  FROM public.promotion_redemptions AS pr\n  WHERE pr.promotion_code_id = v_promotion.id;\n\n  IF v_promotion.maximum_total_redemptions IS NOT NULL\n    AND v_total_redemptions >= v_promotion.maximum_total_redemptions\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تم استنفاد عدد استخدامات رمز الخصم.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_phone IS NOT NULL THEN\n    IF v_phone !~ '^07[789][0-9]{7}$' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الهاتف الأردني غير صحيح.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER\n    INTO v_phone_redemptions\n    FROM public.promotion_redemptions AS pr\n    WHERE pr.promotion_code_id = v_promotion.id\n      AND pr.customer_phone = v_phone;\n\n    IF v_phone_redemptions >=\n      v_promotion.maximum_redemptions_per_phone\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'تم استخدام رمز الخصم لهذا الرقم من قبل.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_promotion.discount_type = 'fixed' THEN\n    v_discount := LEAST(v_promotion.discount_value, v_subtotal);\n  ELSE\n    v_discount := FLOOR(\n      (v_subtotal::NUMERIC * v_promotion.discount_value::NUMERIC)\n      / 10000\n    )::BIGINT;\n\n    IF v_promotion.maximum_discount_in_minor_units IS NOT NULL THEN\n      v_discount := LEAST(\n        v_discount,\n        v_promotion.maximum_discount_in_minor_units\n      );\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_discount := LEAST(GREATEST(v_discount, 0), v_subtotal);\n  IF v_discount <= 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'قيمة الخصم المحسوبة غير صالحة لهذا الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'promotion_code_id', v_promotion.id,\n    'code', v_promotion.code,\n    'description', v_promotion.description_ar,\n    'subtotal', v_subtotal,\n    'discount', v_discount,\n    'total', v_subtotal - v_discount,\n    'message', 'تم تطبيق رمز الخصم بنجاح.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._cancel_empty_cash_shift_before_return_events(p_shift_id uuid, p_reason text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_shift public.cash_shifts%ROWTYPE;\n  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_reason), '');\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager'],\n    'إلغاء وردية فُتحت بالخطأ'\n  );\n\n  IF v_reason IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_reason) < 2 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'اكتب سبب إلغاء الوردية.';\n  END IF;\n  IF CHAR_LENGTH(v_reason) > 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سبب إلغاء الوردية أطول من المسموح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_shift\n  FROM public.cash_shifts\n  WHERE id = p_shift_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الوردية المحددة غير موجودة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_shift.status <> 'open' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يمكن إلغاء وردية مفتوحة فقط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.orders\n    WHERE cash_shift_id = p_shift_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.customer_payments\n    WHERE cash_shift_id = p_shift_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_payments\n    WHERE cash_shift_id = p_shift_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.operational_expenses\n    WHERE shift_id = p_shift_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_returns\n    WHERE cash_shift_id = p_shift_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'لا يمكن إلغاء الوردية لأنها تحتوي حركة مالية. صحح العملية ثم أغلق الوردية طبيعيًا.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.cash_shifts\n  SET\n    status = 'cancelled',\n    cancelled_by = v_user_id,\n    cancelled_at = NOW(),\n    cancellation_reason = v_reason,\n    expected_cash_in_minor_units = opening_cash_in_minor_units,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_shift_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'CANCEL_EMPTY_CASH_SHIFT',\n    'cash_shifts',\n    p_shift_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'shift_number', v_shift.shift_number,\n      'opening_cash_in_minor_units',\n        v_shift.opening_cash_in_minor_units,\n      'reason', v_reason,\n      'verified_empty', true\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN public.get_cash_shift_display_summary(p_shift_id)\n    || jsonb_build_object(\n      'success', true,\n      'message',\n        'تم إلغاء الوردية الفارغة وحفظ السبب في سجل التدقيق.'\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._cancel_order_impl_before_phase4_lock(p_order_id uuid, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_number TEXT;\n  v_warehouse_id UUID;\n  v_old_status TEXT;\n  v_item RECORD;\n  v_user_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := auth.uid();\n\n  -- Fetch order details\n  SELECT order_number, warehouse_id, status\n  INTO v_order_number, v_warehouse_id, v_old_status\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود في قاعدة البيانات.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_old_status = 'completed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إلغاء طلب مكتمل ومخصوم من المخزون بالفعل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_old_status = 'cancelled' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب ملغى بالفعل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Release reserved stock for each order item if warehouse_id is set\n  IF v_warehouse_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    FOR v_item IN\n      SELECT product_id, quantity\n      FROM public.order_items\n      WHERE order_id = p_order_id\n    LOOP\n      UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n      SET reserved_quantity = GREATEST(0, reserved_quantity - v_item.quantity),\n          updated_at = NOW()\n      WHERE warehouse_id = v_warehouse_id AND product_id = v_item.product_id;\n    END LOOP;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Update order status to cancelled\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET status = 'cancelled',\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n\n  -- Record status history\n  INSERT INTO public.order_status_history (\n    order_id,\n    old_status,\n    new_status,\n    changed_by,\n    notes\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_order_id,\n    v_old_status,\n    'cancelled',\n    v_user_id,\n    COALESCE(p_notes, 'إلغاء الطلب وتحرير الكمية المحجوزة بالمخزون')\n  );\n\n  -- Record audit log\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'cancel_order',\n    'orders',\n    p_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'order_number', v_order_number,\n      'old_status', v_old_status,\n      'new_status', 'cancelled'\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'order_id', p_order_id,\n    'order_number', v_order_number,\n    'status', 'cancelled',\n    'message', 'تم إلغاء الطلب وتحرير المخزون المحجوز بنجاح.'\n  );\n\nEXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'فشلت عملية إلغاء الطلب: %', SQLERRM;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._cancel_purchase_receipt_v2_before_phase4_lock(p_purchase_receipt_id uuid, p_reason text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_reason), '');\n  v_receipt public.purchase_receipts%ROWTYPE;\n  v_reversal_operation_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_inventory_result JSONB;\n  v_payment_total BIGINT;\n  v_po_status TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'warehouse_keeper'],\n    'إلغاء سند استلام أمر شراء'\n  );\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_receipt_payment_shifts_internal(\n    NULL, p_purchase_receipt_id\n  );\n  IF v_reason IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سبب إلغاء سند الاستلام مطلوب.';\n  END IF;\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_receipts receipt\n    WHERE receipt.id = p_purchase_receipt_id\n      AND receipt.phase2_finalized_at IS NOT NULL\n  ) THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY(\n      SELECT DISTINCT item.product_id\n      FROM public.purchase_receipt_items item\n      WHERE item.purchase_receipt_id = p_purchase_receipt_id\n      ORDER BY item.product_id\n    ));\n  END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO v_receipt\n  FROM public.purchase_receipts receipt\n  WHERE receipt.id = p_purchase_receipt_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_receipt.phase2_finalized_at IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سند الاستلام Phase 2 غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_receipt.status = 'cancelled' THEN\n    SELECT operation.result_snapshot INTO v_result FROM public.business_operations operation\n    WHERE operation.operation_type = 'purchase_receipt_cancellation_v2'\n      AND operation.result_snapshot->>'original_operation_id' = v_receipt.operation_id::TEXT\n      AND operation.result_snapshot->>'supplier_balance_contract_version' = '133'\n    ORDER BY operation.completed_at, operation.id LIMIT 1;\n    IF FOUND THEN RETURN v_result; END IF;\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'هذا السند ملغى أو معكوس مسبقاً.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_receipt.status <> 'completed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'هذا السند ملغى أو معكوس مسبقاً.';\n  END IF;\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.supplier_payments payment\n    WHERE payment.purchase_receipt_id = v_receipt.id\n      AND NOT payment.is_reversed\n      AND payment.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_receipt.operation_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_LATER_PAYMENT_CANCELLATION_UNSUPPORTED: لا يمكن إلغاء سند لديه دفعات لاحقة دون سياسة رد أو ائتمان معتمدة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.purchase_orders purchase_order\n  WHERE purchase_order.id = v_receipt.purchase_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM item.id\n  FROM public.purchase_order_items item\n  JOIN public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines line\n    ON line.purchase_order_item_id = item.id\n  WHERE line.purchase_receipt_id = v_receipt.id\n  ORDER BY item.id\n  FOR UPDATE OF item;\n\n  -- PO-wide payments remain genuine advances after cancelling a receipt.\n  -- Only payments owned by this exact receipt are reversed by cancellation.\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(payment.amount_in_minor_units), 0) INTO v_payment_total\n  FROM public.supplier_payments payment\n  WHERE payment.purchase_receipt_id = v_receipt.id AND NOT payment.is_reversed;\n\n  -- Capture the complete immutable cancellation result BEFORE its first\n  -- insertion. business_operations history is never updated or weakened.\n  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_order_items item\n    LEFT JOIN public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines line\n      ON line.purchase_order_item_id=item.id AND line.purchase_receipt_id=v_receipt.id\n    WHERE item.purchase_order_id=v_receipt.purchase_order_id\n      AND item.received_quantity-COALESCE(line.received_base_unit_quantity,0)>0\n  ) THEN 'partially_received' ELSE 'approved' END INTO v_po_status;\n  v_result := jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'receipt_id', v_receipt.id,\n    'receipt_number', v_receipt.receipt_number,\n    'original_operation_id', v_receipt.operation_id,\n    'reversal_operation_id', v_reversal_operation_id,\n    'payments_marked_reversed_in_minor_units', v_payment_total,\n    'purchase_order_status', v_po_status,\n    'supplier_balance_contract_version', 133,\n    'reversed_base_units', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(movement.quantity),0)::INTEGER\n      FROM public.inventory_movements movement WHERE movement.operation_id=v_receipt.operation_id\n        AND movement.movement_type='purchase_receipt')\n  );\n  INSERT INTO public.business_operations (\n    id, operation_type, initiated_by, result_snapshot, completed_at\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_reversal_operation_id, 'purchase_receipt_cancellation_v2',\n    v_user_id, v_result, NOW()\n  );\n\n  v_inventory_result := public.phase2_reverse_inventory_and_wac_internal(\n    v_receipt.operation_id, v_reversal_operation_id, v_receipt.warehouse_id,\n    'purchase_receipt', v_receipt.id, v_user_id, v_reason\n  );\n\n  UPDATE public.purchase_order_items item\n  SET\n    received_quantity = item.received_quantity - line.received_base_unit_quantity,\n    received_parcel_quantity = item.received_parcel_quantity\n      - COALESCE(line.received_parcel_quantity, 0),\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  FROM public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines line\n  WHERE line.purchase_receipt_id = v_receipt.id\n    AND item.id = line.purchase_order_item_id;\n\n  SELECT CASE\n    WHEN EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_order_items item\n      WHERE item.purchase_order_id = v_receipt.purchase_order_id\n        AND item.received_quantity > 0\n    ) THEN 'partially_received'\n    ELSE 'approved'\n  END INTO v_po_status;\n  UPDATE public.purchase_orders\n  SET status = v_po_status, received_at = NULL,\n    amount_paid_in_minor_units = amount_paid_in_minor_units - v_payment_total,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = v_receipt.purchase_order_id;\n\n  UPDATE public.suppliers\n  SET current_balance_in_minor_units = current_balance_in_minor_units\n      - v_receipt.supplier_invoice_payable_total_snapshot_in_minor_units + v_payment_total,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = v_receipt.supplier_id;\n\n  -- v_payment_total was captured under the original document/shift locks.\n  UPDATE public.supplier_payments\n  SET is_reversed = true, reversed_at = NOW(), reversed_by = v_user_id,\n    reversal_reason = v_reason\n  WHERE purchase_receipt_id = v_receipt.id AND NOT is_reversed;\n  UPDATE public.supplier_financial_invoice_identities\n  SET is_active = false, cancelled_at = NOW()\n  WHERE purchase_receipt_id = v_receipt.id AND is_active;\n  UPDATE public.purchase_receipts\n  SET status = 'cancelled', phase2_cancelled_at = NOW(),\n    phase2_cancelled_by = v_user_id,\n    phase2_cancellation_reason = v_reason\n  WHERE id = v_receipt.id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id, 'CANCEL_PURCHASE_RECEIPT_V2', 'purchase_receipts',\n    v_receipt.id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'original_operation_id', v_receipt.operation_id,\n      'reversal_operation_id', v_reversal_operation_id,\n      'supplier_outstanding_reversed_in_minor_units',\n        v_receipt.supplier_invoice_payable_total_snapshot_in_minor_units - v_payment_total,\n      'payments_marked_reversed_in_minor_units', v_payment_total,\n      'purchase_order_status', v_po_status,\n      'inventory', v_inventory_result\n    )\n  );\n  IF v_inventory_result->>'reversed_base_units' IS DISTINCT FROM v_result->>'reversed_base_units'\n    OR v_po_status IS DISTINCT FROM v_result->>'purchase_order_status'\n  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_CANCELLATION_RESULT_MISMATCH'; END IF;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._cancel_supplier_receipt_impl(p_supplier_receipt_id uuid, p_reason text DEFAULT 'إلغاء سند استلام البضائع'::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_receipt RECORD;\n  v_item RECORD;\n  v_old_on_hand INTEGER;\n  v_reserved_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_new_on_hand INTEGER;\n  v_inventory_units_reversed INTEGER := 0;\n  v_payments_amount_reversed BIGINT := 0;\n  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_reason), '');\nBEGIN\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب تسجيل الدخول لإلغاء سند استلام.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_reason IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سبب إلغاء سند الاستلام مطلوب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT *\n  INTO v_receipt\n  FROM public.supplier_receipts\n  WHERE id = p_supplier_receipt_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سند الاستلام غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_receipt.status <> 'completed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'هذا السند ملغى أو معكوس مسبقاً.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Validate every line before mutating anything. Reversal must never consume\n  -- stock that was already sold or reserved for customer orders.\n  FOR v_item IN\n    SELECT sri.*, p.name_ar AS product_name\n    FROM public.supplier_receipt_items sri\n    JOIN public.products p ON p.id = sri.product_id\n    WHERE sri.supplier_receipt_id = p_supplier_receipt_id\n    ORDER BY sri.product_id\n  LOOP\n    SELECT on_hand_quantity, reserved_quantity\n    INTO v_old_on_hand, v_reserved_quantity\n    FROM public.inventory_balances\n    WHERE warehouse_id = v_receipt.warehouse_id\n      AND product_id = v_item.product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    IF v_old_on_hand IS NULL\n      OR (v_old_on_hand - v_item.total_base_units) < v_reserved_quantity\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION\n        'لا يمكن إلغاء السند لأن كمية المنتج % تم بيعها أو حجزها لطلبات زبائن.',\n        v_item.product_name;\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  FOR v_item IN\n    SELECT *\n    FROM public.supplier_receipt_items\n    WHERE supplier_receipt_id = p_supplier_receipt_id\n    ORDER BY product_id\n  LOOP\n    SELECT on_hand_quantity, reserved_quantity\n    INTO v_old_on_hand, v_reserved_quantity\n    FROM public.inventory_balances\n    WHERE warehouse_id = v_receipt.warehouse_id\n      AND product_id = v_item.product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    v_new_on_hand := v_old_on_hand - v_item.total_base_units;\n    v_inventory_units_reversed :=\n      v_inventory_units_reversed + v_item.total_base_units;\n\n    UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n    SET\n      on_hand_quantity = v_new_on_hand,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE warehouse_id = v_receipt.warehouse_id\n      AND product_id = v_item.product_id;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements (\n      warehouse_id,\n      product_id,\n      movement_type,\n      quantity,\n      balance_before,\n      balance_after,\n      reference_type,\n      reference_id,\n      notes,\n      created_by\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_receipt.warehouse_id,\n      v_item.product_id,\n      'return_out',\n      -v_item.total_base_units,\n      v_old_on_hand,\n      v_new_on_hand,\n      'supplier_receipt_cancellation',\n      p_supplier_receipt_id,\n      'عكس سند استلام ' || v_receipt.receipt_number || ': ' || v_reason,\n      v_user_id\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n\n  -- Lock linked payments before subtracting the independently active unpaid portion.\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.supplier_payments\n  WHERE supplier_receipt_id = p_supplier_receipt_id AND NOT is_reversed\n  ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units), 0)\n  INTO v_payments_amount_reversed\n  FROM public.supplier_payments\n  WHERE supplier_receipt_id = p_supplier_receipt_id\n    AND is_reversed = false;\n\n  UPDATE public.suppliers\n  SET\n    current_balance_in_minor_units = current_balance_in_minor_units\n      - (v_receipt.total_in_minor_units - v_payments_amount_reversed),\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = v_receipt.supplier_id;\n\n  UPDATE public.supplier_payments\n  SET\n    is_reversed = true,\n    reversed_at = NOW(),\n    reversed_by = v_user_id,\n    reversal_reason = v_reason\n  WHERE supplier_receipt_id = p_supplier_receipt_id\n    AND is_reversed = false;\n\n  UPDATE public.supplier_receipts\n  SET\n    status = 'cancelled',\n    is_archived = true,\n    amount_paid_in_minor_units = 0,\n    amount_due_in_minor_units = 0,\n    payment_status = 'paid',\n    notes = CONCAT_WS(\n      E'\\n',\n      NULLIF(notes, ''),\n      '[إلغاء ' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || '] ' || v_reason\n    ),\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_supplier_receipt_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'CANCEL_SUPPLIER_RECEIPT',\n    'supplier_receipts',\n    p_supplier_receipt_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'receipt_number', v_receipt.receipt_number,\n      'reason', v_reason,\n      'original_paid_in_minor_units', v_receipt.amount_paid_in_minor_units,\n      'original_due_in_minor_units', v_receipt.amount_due_in_minor_units,\n      'payments_amount_reversed', v_payments_amount_reversed,\n      'inventory_units_reversed', v_inventory_units_reversed\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'receipt_id', p_supplier_receipt_id,\n    'receipt_number', v_receipt.receipt_number,\n    'inventory_units_reversed', v_inventory_units_reversed,\n    'payments_amount_reversed', v_payments_amount_reversed\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

SELECT ib.on_hand_quantity, ib.reserved_quantity\n    INTO v_on_hand, v_reserved\n    FROM public.inventory_balances ib\n    WHERE ib.warehouse_id = v_receipt.warehouse_id\n      AND ib.product_id = im.reference_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_supplier_receipt_id\n        AND im.created_at >= v_receipt.received_at\n    ) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION\n        'لا يمكن إلغاء سند الاستلام مباشرة للمنتج % بعد         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._complete_order_impl_before_phase4_lock(p_order_id uuid, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_number TEXT;\n  v_warehouse_id UUID;\n  v_old_status TEXT;\n  v_item RECORD;\n  v_on_hand INT;\n  v_reserved INT;\n  v_new_on_hand INT;\n  v_new_reserved INT;\n  v_user_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := auth.uid();\n\n  -- Fetch order details with lock\n  SELECT order_number, warehouse_id, status\n  INTO v_order_number, v_warehouse_id, v_old_status\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود في قاعدة البيانات.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_old_status = 'completed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب مكتمل ومخصوم من المخزون بالفعل، ولا يمكن إكماله مرة أخرى.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_old_status = 'cancelled' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إكمال طلب ملغى.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_warehouse_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المستودع الخاص بالطلب غير محدد.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Process inventory deduction for each order item\n  FOR v_item IN\n    SELECT product_id, quantity\n    FROM public.order_items\n    WHERE order_id = p_order_id\n  LOOP\n    SELECT on_hand_quantity, reserved_quantity\n    INTO v_on_hand, v_reserved\n    FROM public.inventory_balances\n    WHERE warehouse_id = v_warehouse_id AND product_id = v_item.product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'لم يتم العثور على رصيد المخزون للمنتج برقم (%) في المستودع.', v_item.product_id;\n    END IF;\n\n    v_new_on_hand := v_on_hand - v_item.quantity;\n    v_new_reserved := GREATEST(0, v_reserved - v_item.quantity);\n\n    IF v_new_on_hand < 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'الكمية الفعلية بالمخزون غير كافية لخصم الطلب. المتوفر الفعلي: %', v_on_hand;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- Update balance row\n    UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n    SET on_hand_quantity = v_new_on_hand,\n        reserved_quantity = v_new_reserved,\n        updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE warehouse_id = v_warehouse_id AND product_id = v_item.product_id;\n\n    -- Record sales deduction movement\n    INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements (\n      warehouse_id,\n      product_id,\n      movement_type,\n      quantity,\n      balance_before,\n      balance_after,\n      reference_type,\n      reference_id,\n      notes,\n      created_by\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_warehouse_id,\n      v_item.product_id,\n      'sales_deduction',\n      -v_item.quantity,\n      v_on_hand,\n      v_new_on_hand,\n      'order',\n      p_order_id,\n      'خصم مبيعات نهائي للطلب رقم ' || v_order_number,\n      v_user_id\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n\n  -- Update order status to completed and payment_status to paid\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET status = 'completed',\n      payment_status = 'paid',\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n\n  -- Record status history\n  INSERT INTO public.order_status_history (\n    order_id,\n    old_status,\n    new_status,\n    changed_by,\n    notes\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_order_id,\n    v_old_status,\n    'completed',\n    v_user_id,\n    COALESCE(p_notes, 'تسليم الطلب وإكمال الخصم النهائي من المخزون وتحصيل المبلغ')\n  );\n\n  -- Record audit log\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'complete_order',\n    'orders',\n    p_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'order_number', v_order_number,\n      'old_status', v_old_status,\n      'new_status', 'completed'\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'order_id', p_order_id,\n    'order_number', v_order_number,\n    'status', 'completed',\n    'message', 'تم إكمال الطلب وخصم الكميات من المخزون وتحديث الحسابات بنجاح.'\n  );\n\nEXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'فشلت عملية إكمال الطلب: %', SQLERRM;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._complete_website_order_with_settlement_before_phase4_lock(p_order_id uuid, p_payment_method text, p_amount_collected_in_minor_units bigint SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_payment_method TEXT := LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(p_payment_method), ''));\n  v_delivery_fee BIGINT;\n  v_total BIGINT;\n  v_collected BIGINT;\n  v_remaining BIGINT;\n  v_shift_id UUID;\n  v_shift_number TEXT;\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_payment_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'تسليم الطلب وتسجيل التحصيل والذمة'\n  );\n\n  IF v_payment_method = 'cash_on_delivery' THEN\n    v_payment_method := 'cash';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_payment_method NOT IN ('cash', 'cliq', 'debt') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طريقة التحصيل يجب أن تكون كاش أو CliQ أو على الحساب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT *\n  INTO v_order\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_order.source = 'pos' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طلبات البيع المباشر تُحصّل من شاشة نقطة البيع.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_order.status NOT IN ('ready', 'out_for_delivery') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تسليم الطلب من حالته الحالية (%).', v_order.status;\n  END IF;\n  IF v_order.branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إتمام الطلب دون فرع محدد.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_delivery_fee := COALESCE(\n    p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units,\n    v_order.delivery_fee_in_minor_units,\n    0\n  );\n  IF v_delivery_fee < 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'أجرة التوصيل لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_total := v_order.subtotal_in_minor_units\n    - v_order.discount_in_minor_units\n    + v_delivery_fee;\n  IF v_total < 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'إجمالي الطلب بعد الخصم والتوصيل غير صحيح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_collected := CASE\n    WHEN v_payment_method = 'debt' THEN 0\n    ELSE COALESCE(p_amount_collected_in_minor_units, v_total)\n  END;\n  IF v_collected < 0 OR v_collected > v_total THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المبلغ المقبوض يجب أن يكون بين صفر وإجمالي الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_collected = 0 THEN\n    v_payment_method := 'debt';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_payment_method = 'cliq'\n    AND v_collected > 0\n    AND NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), '') IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم مرجع CliQ مطلوب عند تسجيل التحويل.';\n  END IF;\n  IF CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(TRIM(p_reference_number), '')) > 120 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم مرجع الدفع أطول من الحد المسموح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_remaining := v_total - v_collected;\n  IF v_remaining > 0 AND v_order.customer_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب ربط الطلب بعميل مسجل قبل تسجيل ذمة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT id, shift_number\n  INTO v_shift_id, v_shift_number\n  FROM public.cash_shifts\n  WHERE branch_id = v_order.branch_id\n    AND status = 'open'\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF v_collected > 0 AND v_shift_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'افتح وردية الصندوق أولًا قبل تسجيل المبلغ المقبوض.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET\n    delivery_fee_in_minor_units = v_delivery_fee,\n    total_in_minor_units = v_total,\n    payment_method = CASE\n      WHEN v_remaining > 0 THEN 'debt'\n      WHEN v_payment_method = 'cash' THEN 'cash_on_delivery'\n      ELSE 'cliq'\n    END,\n    amount_paid_in_minor_units = 0,\n    payment_reference_number = CASE\n      WHEN v_payment_method = 'cliq' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), '')\n      ELSE NULL\n    END,\n    payment_confirmed_at = CASE WHEN v_collected > 0 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,\n    payment_confirmed_by = CASE WHEN v_collected > 0 THEN v_user_id ELSE NULL END,\n    cash_shift_id = v_shift_id,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n\n  v_result := public.complete_order(\n    p_order_id,\n    COALESCE(\n      NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), ''),\n      CASE\n        WHEN v_remaining = 0 THEN 'تم التسليم وقبض كامل المبلغ'\n        WHEN v_collected = 0 THEN 'تم التسليم وكامل المبلغ على حساب العميل'\n        ELSE 'تم التسليم وتسجيل دفعة جزئية والباقي ذمة'\n      END\n    )\n  );\n\n  IF v_remaining > 0 AND v_collected > 0 THEN\n    v_payment_result := public.record_customer_order_payment(\n      p_order_id,\n      v_collected,\n      v_payment_method,\n      NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), ''),\n      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), ''), 'دفعة مستلمة عند تسليم الطلب')\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'COMPLETE_WEBSITE_ORDER_WITH_SETTLEMENT',\n    'orders',\n    p_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'order_number', v_order.order_number,\n      'delivery_fee_in_minor_units', v_delivery_fee,\n      'total_in_minor_units', v_total,\n      'collected_in_minor_units', v_collected,\n      'remaining_in_minor_units', v_remaining,\n      'collection_method', v_payment_method,\n      'customer_payment_number', v_payment_result->>'payment_number',\n      'cash_shift_id', v_shift_id,\n      'cash_shift_number', v_shift_number\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object(\n    'payment_method', CASE WHEN v_remaining > 0 THEN 'debt' ELSE v_payment_method END,\n    'payment_status', CASE\n      WHEN v_remaining = 0 THEN 'paid'\n      WHEN v_collected > 0 THEN 'partially_paid'\n      ELSE 'unpaid'\n    END,\n    'total_in_minor_units', v_total,\n    'amount_paid_in_minor_units', v_collected,\n    'remaining_in_minor_units', v_remaining,\n    'customer_payment_number', v_payment_result->>'payment_number',\n    'cash_shift_id', v_shift_id,\n    'cash_shift_number', v_shift_number,\n    'message', CASE\n      WHEN v_remaining = 0 THEN 'تم التسليم وقبض كامل المبلغ وخصم المخزون.'\n      WHEN v_collected = 0 THEN 'تم التسليم وخصم المخزون وتسجيل كامل المبلغ ذمة على العميل.'\n      ELSE 'تم التسليم وتسجيل الدفعة والباقي ذمة على العميل.'\n    END\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._confirm_order_impl(p_order_id uuid, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_number TEXT;\n  v_old_status TEXT;\n  v_user_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := auth.uid();\n\n  -- Fetch order details with row lock\n  SELECT order_number, status\n  INTO v_order_number, v_old_status\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود في قاعدة البيانات.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_old_status = 'cancelled' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تأكيد طلب ملغى.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_old_status = 'completed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب مكتمل بالفعل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Update order status to confirmed\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET status = 'confirmed',\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n\n  -- Record status transition\n  INSERT INTO public.order_status_history (\n    order_id,\n    old_status,\n    new_status,\n    changed_by,\n    notes\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_order_id,\n    v_old_status,\n    'confirmed',\n    v_user_id,\n    COALESCE(p_notes, 'تأكيد الطلب وبدء تحضيره (المخزون محجوز)')\n  );\n\n  -- Record audit log\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'confirm_order',\n    'orders',\n    p_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'order_number', v_order_number,\n      'old_status', v_old_status,\n      'new_status', 'confirmed'\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'order_id', p_order_id,\n    'order_number', v_order_number,\n    'status', 'confirmed',\n    'message', 'تم تأكيد الطلب بنجاح ويبقى المخزون محجوزاً.'\n  );\n\nEXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'فشلت عملية تأكيد الطلب: %', SQLERRM;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

 IF v_existing_receipt IS NOT NULL THEN\n      RETURN v_existing_receipt;\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.suppliers\n    WHERE id = p_supplier_id AND is_active = p_payment_method = 'deferred' AND p_amount_paid_in_minor_units > 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الاستلام الآجل لا يقبل دفعة فورية.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NULLIF(TRIM(p_supplier_invoice_number), '') IS NOT jsonb_array_elements(p_items)\n  LOOP\n    v_product_id := NULLIF(v_item->>'product_id', '')::UUID;\n    v_pkg_qty := COALESCE((v_item->>'package_quantity')::INTEGER, 0);\n    v_units_per_pkg :=\n      COALESCE((v_item->>'units_per_package')::INTEGER, 0);\n    v_pkg_price :=\n      COALESCE((v_item->>'package_price_in_minor_units')::BIGINT, 0);\n    v_item_discount :=\n      COALESCE((v_item->>'discount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT, 0);\n    v_selling_price :=\n      COALESCE((v_item->>'selling_price_in_minor_units')::BIGINT, 0);\n\n    IF NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.products\n      WHERE id = v_product_id AND is_active = true\n    ) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'أحد المنتجات غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_pkg_qty <= 0 OR v_units_per_pkg <= 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'عدد الطرود ومحتوى الطرد يجب أن يكونا أكبر من صفر.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_pkg_price < 0 OR v_item_discount < 0 OR v_selling_price < 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'أسعار (v_pkg_qty * v_pkg_price) - v_item_discount;\n    v_subtotal := v_subtotal + v_line_total;\n    v_item_count := v_item_count + 1;\n    v_total_inventory_added :=\n      v_total_inventory_added + (v_pkg_qty * v_units_per_pkg);\n  END LOOP;\n\n  IF p_discount_in_minor_units > v_subtotal THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'خصم السند يتجاوز مجموع الأصناف.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_total :=\n    v_subtotal\n    - p_discount_in_minor_units\n    + p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units\n    + p_tax_in_minor_units;\n\n  IF p_amount_paid_in_minor_units > v_total THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المبلغ المدفوع يتجاوز إجمالي 'partially_paid'\n    ELSE 'unpaid'\n  END;\n\n  v_receipt_number :=\n    'GRN-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY') || '-' ||\n    LPAD(NEXTVAL('public.supplier_receipt_seq')::TEXT, 6, '0');\n\n  INSERT INTO public.supplier_receipts (\n    receipt_number,\n    supplier_id,\n    warehouse_id,\n    branch_id,\n    supplier_invoice_number,\n    supplier_invoice_date,\n    received_at,\n    received_by,\n    subtotal_in_minor_units,\n    discount_in_minor_units,\n    delivery_fee_in_minor_units,\n    tax_in_minor_units,\n    total_in_minor_units,\n    amount_paid_in_minor_units,\n    amount_due_in_minor_units,\n    payment_status,\n    payment_method,\n    payment_reference,\n    notes,\n    internal_notes,\n    status,\n    idempotency_key\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_receipt_number,\n    p_supplier_id,\n    p_warehouse_id,\n    p_branch_id,\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_supplier_invoice_number), ''),\n    p_supplier_invoice_date,\n    COALESCE(p_received_at, NOW()),\n    v_user_id,\n COALESCE((v_item->>'update_product_defaults')::BOOLEAN, false);\n\n    SELECT\n      p.unit_id,\n      p.purchase_unit_id,\n      p.cost_price_in_minor_units,\n      p.sale_price_in_minor_units\n    INTO\n      v_base_unit_id,\n      v_purchase_unit_id,\n      v_current_cost,\n      v_current_sale_price\n    FROM public.products p\n    WHERE p.id = v_product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    v_purchase_unit_id := COALESCE(\n      NULLIF(v_item->>'purchase_unit_id', '')::UUID,\n      v_purchase_unit_id,\n      v_base_unit_id\n    );\n\n    IF v_purchase_unit_id IS NOT NULL\n      AND NOT v_purchase_unit_name\n    FROM public.units\n    WHERE id = v_purchase_unit_id;\n\n    SELECT name_ar\n    INTO v_base_unit_name\n    FROM public.units\n    WHERE id = v_base_unit_id;\n\n    v_purchase_unit_name := COALESCE(\n      v_purchase_unit_name,\n      NULLIF(v_item->>'purchase_unit_name', ''),\n      'طرد'\n    );\n    v_base_unit_name := COALESCE(\n      v_base_unit_name,\n      NULLIF(v_item->>'base_unit_name', ''),\n      'حبة'\n    );\n\n    IF v_item ? END IF;\n\n    v_base_unit_cost := ROUND(\n      v_line_total::NUMERIC / v_total_base_units\n    )::BIGINT;\n\n    v_batch_number := NULLIF(TRIM(v_item->>'batch_number'), '');\n    v_production_date public.supplier_receipt_items (\n      supplier_receipt_id,\n      product_id,\n      purchase_unit_id,\n      base_unit_id,\n      purchase_unit_name,\n      base_unit_name,\n      package_quantity,\n      units_per_package,\n      total_base_units,\n      package_price_in_minor_units,\n      base_unit_cost_in_minor_units,\n      selling_price_in_minor_units,\n      discount_in_minor_units,\n      line_total_in_minor_units,\n      batch_number,\n      production_date,\n      expiry_date,\n      notes\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_receipt_id,\n      v_product_id,\n v_base_unit_cost,\n      v_selling_price,\n      v_item_discount,\n      v_line_total,\n      v_batch_number,\n      v_production_date,\n      v_expiry_date,\n      v_item_notes\n    );\n\n    INSERT 0\n    )\n    ON CONFLICT (warehouse_id, product_id) DO NOTHING;\n\n    SELECT on_hand_quantity\n    INTO v_old_on_hand\n    FROM public.inventory_balances\n    WHERE warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n (v_total_existing_stock::NUMERIC * v_current_cost::NUMERIC)\n          + (v_total_base_units::NUMERIC * v_base_unit_cost::NUMERIC)\n        ) / (v_total_existing_stock + v_total_base_units)\n      )::BIGINT\n    END;\n\n    UPDATE public.products\n    SET\n      cost_price_in_minor_units = v_new_wac_cost,\n      purchase_unit_id = CASE\n        WHEN v_update_product_defaults THEN      END,\n      default_purchase_price_in_minor_units = CASE\n        WHEN v_update_product_defaults THEN v_pkg_price\n        ELSE default_purchase_price_in_minor_units\n      END,\n      sale_price_in_minor_units = CASE\n        WHEN v_update_product_defaults THEN v_selling_price\n        ELSE sale_price_in_minor_units\n      END,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE id = v_product_id;\n\n    v_new_on_hand := v_old_on_hand + v_total_base_units;\n\n    UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n    SET\n      on_hand_quantity = v_new_on_hand,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE  balance_before,\n      balance_after,\n      reference_type,\n      reference_id,\n      notes,\n      created_by\n    ) VALUES (\n      p_warehouse_id,\n      v_product_id,\n      'purchase_receipt',\n      v_total_base_units,\n      v_old_on_hand,\n      v_new_on_hand,\n      'supplier_receipt',\n      v_receipt_id,\n      'استلام مباشر من المورد - سند ' || v_receipt_number,\n payment_method,\n      reference_number,\n      payment_date,\n      notes,\n      created_by\n    ) VALUES (\n      p_supplier_id,\n      v_receipt_id,\n      p_amount_paid_in_minor_units,\n );\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'CREATE_DIRECT_SUPPLIER_RECEIPT',\n    'supplier_receipts',\n    v_receipt_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'receipt_number', v_receipt_number,\n      'supplier_id', p_supplier_id,\n      'warehouse_id', p_warehouse_id,\n      'total',         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._create_pos_sale_base_units_before_phase3_lock(p_warehouse_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_customer_name text, LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_warehouse_id UUID := p_warehouse_id;\n  v_branch_id UUID := v_product_name TEXT;\n  v_product_sku TEXT;\n  v_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_unit_price BIGINT;\n  v_line_total BIGINT;\n  v_subtotal BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total BIGINT;\n  v_paid BIGINT;\n  v_change BIGINT;\n jsonb_array_elements(p_items)\n  ) <> (\n    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item.value->>'product_id')\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS item(value)\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تكرار المنتج نفسه أكثر من مرة في سلة البيع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NULLIF(TRIM(p_idempotency_key), '') IS NOT NULL THEN\n    -- Serialize retries carrying the same key so two concurrent taps cannot\n    -- v_existing_order.order_number,\n        'customerName', COALESCE(\n          v_existing_order.customer_name_snapshot,\n          'زبون نقدي'\n        ),\n        'subtotalInMinorUnits',\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._create_purchase_order_impl(p_supplier_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_expected_delivery_date timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_discount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_supplier_invoice_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_internal_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_items jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID;\n  v_po_id UUID;\n  v_po_number TEXT;\n  v_item JSONB;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_ordered_qty INT;\n  v_unit_price BIGINT;\n  v_item_discount BIGINT;\n  v_line_total BIGINT;\n  v_subtotal BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total BIGINT := 0;\n  v_item_count INT := 0;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := auth.uid();\n\n  -- 1. Validate Supplier\n  IF p_supplier_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id = p_supplier_id AND is_active = true) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المورد المحدد غير موجود أو غير مفعل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 2. Validate Items Array\n  IF p_items IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب إضافة منتج واحد على الأقل في أمر الشراء.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 3. operation.result_snapshot->>'order_id' AS order_key,\n      operation.result_snapshot,operation.request_identity_snapshot\n    FROM public.business_operations operation\n    WHERE first_completion ON first_completion.order_id=customer_order.id\n    LEFT JOIN public.business_operations creation ON creation.id=customer_order.operation_id\n    LEFT JOIN completions completion ON completion.order_key=customer_order.id::TEXT\n    WHERE customer_order.branch_id=v_shift.branch_id\n      AND customer_order.status IN('completed','returned')\n      AND 1) * v_page_size;\n\n  RETURN (\n    WITH customer_directory AS (\n      SELECT\n        c.id,\n        c.full_name,\n        c.phone,\n        c.email,\n        c.whatsapp,\n        c.governorate,\n        c.notes,\n        c.customer_type,\n        c.is_active,\n        c.is_vip,\n        c.is_blocked,\n        c.is_deleted,\n        c.credit_limit_in_minor_units,\n        c.created_at,\n        c.updated_at,\n        COALESCE(address.governorate, c.governorate, '') AS address_governorate,\n        COALESCE(order_stats.total_orders_count, 0)::INTEGER AS total_orders_count,\n        COALESCE(order_stats.total_spending_in_minor_units, 0)::BIGINT AS total_spending_in_minor_units,\n        COALESCE(receivable_stats.current_balance_in_minor_units, 0)::BIGINT AS current_balance_in_minor_units\n      FROM public.customers c\n      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n        SELECT ca.governorate\n        FROM public.customer_addresses ca\n        WHERE ca.customer_id = c.id\n        ORDER BY ca.is_default DESC, ca.created_at DESC\n        LIMIT 1\n      ) address ON true\n      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n        SELECT\n          COUNT(*) FILTER (\n            WHERE COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos'\n          )::INTEGER AS total_orders_count,\n          COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units) FILTER (\n            WHERE COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos'\n              AND o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')\n          ), 0)::BIGINT AS total_spending_in_minor_units\n        FROM public.orders o\n        WHERE o.customer_id = c.id\n      ) order_stats ON true\n      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(\n          o.total_in_minor_units - o.amount_paid_in_minor_units,\n          0\n        )), 0)::BIGINT AS current_balance_in_minor_units\n        FROM public.orders o\n        WHERE o.customer_id = c.id\n          AND o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')\n          AND o.amount_paid_in_minor_units < o.total_in_minor_units\n          AND (\n            COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos'\n            OR o.payment_method = 'debt'\n          )\n      ) receivable_stats ON true\n      WHERE c.is_deleted = false\n        AND (\n          v_search IS NULL\n          OR c.full_name ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(c.phone, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(c.email, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n        )\n        AND (\n          v_status = 'all'\n          OR (v_status = 'vip' AND c.is_vip = true)\n          OR (v_status = 'active' AND c.is_active = true AND c.is_blocked = false)\n          OR (v_status = 'inactive' AND c.is_active = false AND c.is_blocked = false)\n          OR (v_status = 'blocked' AND c.is_blocked = true)\n        )\n    ),\n    paged_customers AS (\n      SELECT *\n      FROM customer_directory\n      ORDER BY\n        CASE WHEN v_sort = 'highest_spending' THEN total_spending_in_minor_units END DESC,\n        CASE WHEN v_sort = 'most_orders' THEN total_orders_count END DESC,\n        CASE WHEN v_sort = 'latest' THEN created_at END DESC,\n        id DESC\n      OFFSET v_offset\n      LIMIT v_page_size\n    )\n    SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n      'customers', COALESCE(\n        (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(pc)) FROM paged_customers pc),\n        '[]'::JSONB\n      ),\n      'total_count', (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM customer_directory)\n    )\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._get_home_dashboard_before133()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_shared219 JSONB;\n  v_business_date DATE := (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;\n  v_today_start TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_tomorrow_start TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_month_start TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_month JSONB;\n  v_week JSONB;\n  v_today JSONB;\n  v_today_sales BIGINT := 0;\n  v_today_completed_orders INTEGER := 0;\n  v_month_sales BIGINT := 0;\n  v_month_profit BIGINT := 0;\n  v_open_orders INTEGER := 0;\n  v_new_orders INTEGER := 0;\n  v_customer_receivables BIGINT := 0;\n  v_supplier_payables BIGINT := 0;\n  v_inventory_value BIGINT := 0;\n  v_active_products INTEGER := 0;\n  v_active_customers INTEGER := 0;\n  v_low_stock INTEGER := 0;\n  v_out_of_stock INTEGER := 0;\n  v_configuration_issues INTEGER := 0;\n  v_can_view_profit BOOLEAN := false;\n  v_latest_orders JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_stock_alerts JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_order_statuses JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_seven_day_sales JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY[\n      'owner',\n      'admin',\n      'manager',\n      'accountant',\n      'sales',\n      'warehouse_keeper',\n      'delivery_driver'\n    ],\n    'عرض الصفحة الرئيسية'\n  );\n\n  v_today_start :=\n    v_business_date::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n  v_tomorrow_start :=\n    (v_business_date + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n  v_month_start :=\n    date_trunc(\n      'month',\n      v_business_date::TIMESTAMP\n    ) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n\n  SELECT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.user_roles ur\n    JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id\n    WHERE ur.user_id = auth.uid()\n      AND r.code IN ('owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant')\n  )\n  INTO v_can_view_profit;\n\n  -- The131 equations are unchanged. Only the home reader skips periodic\n  -- evidence revalidation; reports and summaries remain strict.\n  BEGIN\n    IF v_today_start - INTERVAL '6 days' >= v_month_start THEN\n      v_month := public.phase6_financial_facts_internal(\n      NULL, v_month_start, v_tomorrow_start, 'Asia/Amman', false);\n    ELSE\n      v_shared219:=public.home219_shared_period_facts_internal(NULL,v_month_start,v_tomorrow_start,v_today_start - INTERVAL '6 days',v_tomorrow_start,'Asia/Amman');\n      v_month:=v_shared219->'month';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_today_start - INTERVAL '6 days' >= v_month_start THEN\n      -- Daily values are period-local by date. Reuse them only when the\n      -- complete seven-day interval is contained in the monthly interval.\n      SELECT jsonb_build_object('dailyBreakdown', jsonb_agg(day ORDER BY day->>'date'))\n      INTO v_week FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_month->'dailyBreakdown') day\n      WHERE (day->>'date')::DATE >= v_business_date - 6;\n    ELSE\n      -- Month boundary: never drop days from the previous month.\n      v_week:=v_shared219->'week';\n    END IF;\n  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n    -- Preserve the complete pre131 unavailable response, including its old\n    -- financial numbers. Expensive legacy calculations run ONLY on fallback.\n    RETURN public._get_home_dashboard_before_phase6()\n      || jsonb_build_object('financialFactsStatus', 'unavailable');\n  END;\n  SELECT day INTO v_today FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_week->'dailyBreakdown') day\n  WHERE (day->>'date')::DATE = v_business_date;\n  v_today_sales := COALESCE((v_today->>'grossSalesInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0);\n  v_today_completed_orders := COALESCE((v_today->>'completedOrderCount')::INTEGER, 0);\n  v_month_sales := (v_month #>> '{sales,grossSalesInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT;\n  v_month_profit := (v_month #>> '{sales,netProfitInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT;\n  v_customer_receivables := (v_month #>> '{balances,customerDueInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT;\n\n  SELECT\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n      WHERE status IN (\n        'new',\n        'confirmed',\n        'preparing',\n        'ready',\n        'out_for_delivery'\n      )\n    )::INTEGER,\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'new')::INTEGER\n  INTO\n    v_open_orders,\n    v_new_orders\n  FROM public.orders;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(s.current_balance_in_minor_units, 0)), 0)\n  INTO v_supplier_payables\n  FROM public.suppliers s\n  WHERE s.is_active = true;\n\n  SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(\n    ib.on_hand_quantity::NUMERIC\n      * COALESCE(p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact, p.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC)\n  ), 0), 0)::BIGINT\n  INTO v_inventory_value\n  FROM public.inventory_balances ib\n  JOIN public.products p ON p.id = ib.product_id\n  WHERE p.is_active = true;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER\n  INTO v_active_products\n  FROM public.products\n  WHERE is_active = true;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER\n  INTO v_active_customers\n  FROM public.customers\n  WHERE is_active = true\n    AND is_deleted = false;\n\n  WITH product_stock AS (\n    SELECT\n      p.id,\n      p.min_stock_level,\n      p.sale_unit_id,\n      p.units_per_sale_unit,\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(\n        SUM(ib.on_hand_quantity - ib.reserved_quantity),\n        0\n      )::INTEGER AS available_quantity\n    FROM public.products p\n    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances ib\n      ON ib.product_id = p.id\n    WHERE p.is_active = true\n    GROUP BY\n      p.id,\n      p.min_stock_level,\n      p.sale_unit_id,\n      p.units_per_sale_unit,\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units\n  )\n  SELECT\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n      WHERE sale_unit_id IS NOT NULL\n        AND units_per_sale_unit > 1\n        AND default_sale_price_in_minor_units > 0\n        AND available_quantity < units_per_sale_unit\n    )::INTEGER,\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n      WHERE sale_unit_id IS NOT NULL\n        AND units_per_sale_unit > 1\n        AND default_sale_price_in_minor_units > 0\n        AND available_quantity >= units_per_sale_unit\n        AND available_quantity <= GREATEST(\n          min_stock_level,\n          units_per_sale_unit\n        )\n    )::INTEGER,\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n      WHERE sale_unit_id IS NULL\n        OR units_per_sale_unit <= 1\n        OR default_sale_price_in_minor_units <= 0\n    )::INTEGER\n  INTO\n    v_out_of_stock,\n    v_low_stock,\n    v_configuration_issues\n  FROM product_stock;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(JSONB_AGG(order_row), '[]'::JSONB)\n  INTO v_latest_orders\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      o.id,\n      o.order_number AS \"orderNumber\",\n      COALESCE(c.full_name, 'زبون مباشر') AS \"customerName\",\n      o.status,\n      o.payment_status AS \"paymentStatus\",\n      o.total_in_minor_units AS         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._get_operational_business_report_before133(p_branch_id uuid, p_date_from date, p_date_to date)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_report JSONB;\n  v_facts JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  -- The inner reader authorizes the caller and validates the period first.\n  v_report := public._get_operational_business_report_before_phase6(p_branch_id, p_date_from, p_date_to);\n  v_facts := public.phase6_financial_facts_internal(\n    p_branch_id,\n    p_date_from::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman',\n    (p_date_to + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman',\n    'Asia/Amman',\n    false\n  );\n  v_report := jsonb_set(v_report, '{sales}', (v_report->'sales') || (v_facts->'sales'));\n  v_report := jsonb_set(v_report, '{balances}', (v_report->'balances') || (v_facts->'balances'));\n  v_report := jsonb_set(v_report, '{expenses}', (v_report->'expenses') || (v_facts->'expenses'));\n  RETURN v_report || jsonb_build_object('cashFlow', v_facts->'cashFlow');\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._get_operational_business_report_before_phase6(p_branch_id uuid, p_date_from date, p_date_to date)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_report JSONB;\n  v_period_start TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_period_end TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_discounted_gross_profit BIGINT := 0;\n  v_discount_impact BIGINT := 0;\n  v_top_products JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_expense_count INTEGER := 0;\n  v_active_expenses BIGINT := 0;\n  v_active_cash_expenses BIGINT := 0;\n  v_active_cliq_expenses BIGINT := 0;\n  v_base_expenses BIGINT := 0;\n  v_expense_categories JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'عرض التقارير المالية والتشغيلية'\n  );\n\n  v_report := public._get_operational_business_report_v2(\n    p_branch_id,\n    p_date_from,\n    p_date_to\n  );\n  v_period_start := p_date_from::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n  v_period_end := (p_date_to + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n\n  -- Allocate every order-level discount proportionally across its lines in\n  -- integer minor units. The final remainder is assigned by a deterministic\n  -- line order, so allocated discounts always total the recorded discount.\n  WITH completion_events AS (\n    SELECT DISTINCT ON (osh.order_id)\n      osh.order_id\n    FROM public.order_status_history osh\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = osh.order_id\n    WHERE osh.new_status = 'completed'\n      AND o.branch_id = p_branch_id\n      AND osh.created_at >= v_period_start\n      AND osh.created_at < v_period_end\n    ORDER BY osh.order_id, osh.created_at\n  ),\n  completed_orders AS (\n    SELECT o.id, COALESCE(o.discount_in_minor_units, 0)::BIGINT AS order_discount\n    FROM completion_events ce\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = ce.order_id\n    WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'returned')\n  ),\n  item_basis AS (\n    SELECT\n      co.id AS order_id,\n      co.order_discount,\n      oi.id AS order_item_id,\n      COALESCE(oi.product_name_snapshot, 'منتج') AS product_name,\n      COALESCE(oi.sku_snapshot, '') AS sku,\n      public.phase35_report_package_count_internal(oi.id, oi.commercial_line_kind, oi.sale_package_quantity, oi.units_per_sale_package)::BIGINT AS package_quantity,\n      COALESCE(oi.line_total_in_minor_units, 0)::BIGINT AS line_total,\n      COALESCE(oi.cogs_in_minor_units, 0)::BIGINT AS cogs,\n      SUM(COALESCE(oi.line_total_in_minor_units, 0)) OVER (\n        PARTITION BY co.id\n      )::BIGINT AS lines_subtotal,\n      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n        PARTITION BY co.id\n        ORDER BY oi.created_at NULLS LAST, oi.id\n      ) AS allocation_rank\n    FROM completed_orders co\n    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = co.id\n  ),\n  base_allocations AS (\n    SELECT\n      *,\n      CASE\n        WHEN order_discount > 0 AND lines_subtotal > 0 THEN\n          (order_discount * line_total) / lines_subtotal\n        ELSE 0\n      END::BIGINT AS base_discount\n    FROM item_basis\n  ),\n  discounted_items AS (\n    SELECT\n      *,\n      (\n        base_discount + CASE\n          WHEN allocation_rank <= (\n            order_discount - SUM(base_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id)\n          ) THEN 1\n          ELSE 0\n        END\n      )::BIGINT AS allocated_discount\n    FROM base_allocations\n  ),\n  item_totals AS (\n    SELECT\n      COALESCE(SUM(line_total - allocated_discount - cogs), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS gross_profit,\n      COALESCE(SUM(allocated_discount), 0)::BIGINT AS allocated_discounts\n    FROM discounted_items\n  ),\n  top_products AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(product_payload ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_name), '[]'::JSONB)\n      AS payload\n    FROM (\n      SELECT\n        product_name,\n        sku,\n        SUM(package_quantity)::BIGINT AS package_count,\n        SUM(line_total - allocated_discount)::BIGINT AS revenue,\n        SUM(line_total - allocated_discount - cogs)::BIGINT AS profit,\n        jsonb_build_object(\n          'productName', product_name,\n          'sku', sku,\n          'packageCount', SUM(package_quantity),\n          'revenueInMinorUnits', SUM(line_total - allocated_discount),\n          'profitInMinorUnits', SUM(line_total - allocated_discount - cogs)\n        ) AS product_payload\n      FROM discounted_items\n      GROUP BY product_name, sku\n      ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_name\n      LIMIT 10\n    ) ranked_products\n  )\n  SELECT\n    item_totals.gross_profit,\n    item_totals.allocated_discounts,\n    top_products.payload\n  INTO v_discounted_gross_profit, v_discount_impact, v_top_products\n  FROM item_totals\n  CROSS JOIN top_products;\n\n  WITH active_expenses AS (\n    SELECT category, amount_in_minor_units, payment_method\n    FROM public.operational_expenses\n    WHERE branch_id = p_branch_id\n      AND created_at >= v_period_start\n      AND created_at < v_period_end\n      AND COALESCE(is_reversed, false) = false\n  ), totals AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS expense_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS total_expenses,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'cash'), 0)::BIGINT AS cash_expenses,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'cliq'), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq_expenses\n    FROM active_expenses\n  ), categories AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'category', category,\n        'count', expense_count,\n        'amountInMinorUnits', amount\n      ) ORDER BY amount DESC, category\n    ), '[]'::JSONB) AS payload\n    FROM (\n      SELECT\n        category,\n        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS expense_count,\n        SUM(amount_in_minor_units)::BIGINT AS amount\n      FROM active_expenses\n      GROUP BY category\n    ) grouped_categories\n  )\n  SELECT\n    totals.expense_count,\n    totals.total_expenses,\n    totals.cash_expenses,\n    totals.cliq_expenses,\n    categories.payload\n  INTO\n    v_expense_count,\n    v_active_expenses,\n    v_active_cash_expenses,\n    v_active_cliq_expenses,\n    v_expense_categories\n  FROM totals\n  CROSS JOIN categories;\n\n  -- A valid order has item totals covering its recorded discount. If legacy\n  -- data is malformed, do not allow a report to invent a negative line value.\n  IF v_discount_impact <> COALESCE(\n    (v_report #>> '{sales,discountInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT,\n    0\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'تعذر توزيع خصومات التقرير بدقة؛ راجع سلامة إجماليات أصناف الطلبات.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_base_expenses := COALESCE(\n    (v_report #>> '{expenses,totalInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT,\n    0\n  );\n  v_report := jsonb_set(\n    v_report,\n    '{expenses}',\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'count', v_expense_count,\n      'totalInMinorUnits', v_active_expenses,\n      'cashInMinorUnits', v_active_cash_expenses,\n      'cliqInMinorUnits', v_active_cliq_expenses,\n      'categories', v_expense_categories\n    ),\n    true\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_set(\n    jsonb_set(\n      jsonb_set(\n        v_report,\n        '{sales,grossProfitInMinorUnits}',\n        to_jsonb(v_discounted_gross_profit),\n        true\n      ),\n      '{sales,netProfitInMinorUnits}',\n      to_jsonb(\n        COALESCE((v_report #>> '{sales,netProfitInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT, 0)\n        - v_discount_impact\n        + (v_base_expenses - v_active_expenses)\n      ),\n      true\n    ),\n    '{topProducts}',\n    v_top_products,\n    true\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",
