        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._get_operational_business_report_v1(p_branch_id uuid, p_date_from date, p_date_to date)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_period_start TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_period_end TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_report JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'عرض التقارير المالية والتشغيلية'\n  );\n\n  IF p_branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الفرع مطلوب لإنشاء التقرير.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_date_from IS NULL OR p_date_to IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تاريخ بداية ونهاية التقرير مطلوبان.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_date_to < p_date_from THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تاريخ نهاية التقرير يجب ألا يسبق تاريخ البداية.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_date_to - p_date_from > 366 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الفترة القصوى للتقرير هي 367 يوماً.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.branches WHERE id = p_branch_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الفرع المطلوب غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_period_start := p_date_from::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n  v_period_end := (p_date_to + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n\n  WITH completion_events AS (\n    SELECT DISTINCT ON (osh.order_id)\n      osh.order_id,\n      osh.created_at AS completed_at\n    FROM public.order_status_history osh\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = osh.order_id\n    WHERE osh.new_status = 'completed'\n      AND o.branch_id = p_branch_id\n      AND osh.created_at >= v_period_start\n      AND osh.created_at < v_period_end\n    ORDER BY osh.order_id, osh.created_at\n  ),\n  completed_orders AS (\n    SELECT o.*, ce.completed_at\n    FROM completion_events ce\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = ce.order_id\n    WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'returned')\n  ),\n  order_sales AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS order_count,\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(source, '') = 'pos')::INTEGER\n        AS pos_order_count,\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(source, '') <> 'pos')::INTEGER\n        AS website_order_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(subtotal_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS subtotal,\n      COALESCE(SUM(discount_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS discounts,\n      COALESCE(SUM(delivery_fee_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS delivery_fees,\n      COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS gross_sales,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_paid_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS collected,\n      COALESCE(SUM(\n        GREATEST(total_in_minor_units - amount_paid_in_minor_units, 0)\n      ), 0)::BIGINT AS outstanding\n    FROM completed_orders\n  ),\n  item_sales AS (\n    SELECT\n      COALESCE(SUM(oi.cogs_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS cogs,\n      COALESCE(SUM(oi.profit_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS gross_profit,\n      COALESCE(SUM(\n        public.phase35_report_package_count_internal(oi.id, oi.commercial_line_kind, oi.sale_package_quantity, oi.units_per_sale_package)\n      ), 0)::BIGINT AS package_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(public.phase35_report_base_unit_count_internal(oi.id, oi.commercial_line_kind, oi.quantity)), 0)::BIGINT AS base_unit_count,\n      COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id)::INTEGER AS unique_product_count\n    FROM completed_orders co\n    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = co.id\n  ),\n  period_returns AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS return_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(sr.refund_amount_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS refund_amount,\n      COALESCE((\n        SELECT SUM(oi.cogs_in_minor_units)\n        FROM public.sales_returns restocked_return\n        JOIN public.order_items oi\n          ON oi.order_id = restocked_return.order_id\n        WHERE restocked_return.branch_id = p_branch_id\n          AND restocked_return.stock_disposition = 'restock'\n          AND restocked_return.created_at >= v_period_start\n          AND restocked_return.created_at < v_period_end\n      ), 0)::BIGINT AS recovered_cogs\n    FROM public.sales_returns sr\n    WHERE sr.branch_id = p_branch_id\n      AND sr.created_at >= v_period_start\n      AND sr.created_at < v_period_end\n  ),\n  period_expenses AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS expense_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS total_expenses,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units)\n        FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'cash'), 0)::BIGINT AS cash_expenses,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units)\n        FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'cliq'), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq_expenses\n    FROM public.operational_expenses\n    WHERE branch_id = p_branch_id\n      AND created_at >= v_period_start\n      AND created_at < v_period_end\n  ),\n  period_purchases AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS receipt_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS total_purchases,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_paid_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS amount_paid,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_due_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS amount_due\n    FROM public.supplier_receipts\n    WHERE branch_id = p_branch_id\n      AND status = 'completed'\n      AND received_at >= v_period_start\n      AND received_at < v_period_end\n  ),\n  current_receivables AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (\n        WHERE GREATEST(total_in_minor_units - amount_paid_in_minor_units, 0) > 0\n      )::INTEGER AS order_count,\n      COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (\n        WHERE GREATEST(total_in_minor_units - amount_paid_in_minor_units, 0) > 0\n      )::INTEGER AS customer_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(\n        GREATEST(total_in_minor_units - amount_paid_in_minor_units, 0)\n      ), 0)::BIGINT AS amount_due\n    FROM public.orders\n    WHERE branch_id = p_branch_id\n      AND status = 'completed'\n      AND payment_status IN ('unpaid', 'partially_paid')\n  ),\n  current_payables AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE current_balance_in_minor_units > 0)::INTEGER\n        AS supplier_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(current_balance_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS amount_due\n    FROM public.suppliers\n    WHERE COALESCE(is_active, true) = true\n  ),\n  current_inventory AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ib.on_hand_quantity > 0)::INTEGER AS stocked_products,\n      COALESCE(SUM(ib.on_hand_quantity), 0)::BIGINT AS base_units_on_hand,\n      COALESCE(SUM(ib.reserved_quantity), 0)::BIGINT AS base_units_reserved,\n      COALESCE(SUM(\n        ib.on_hand_quantity::NUMERIC * COALESCE(p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact, p.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC)\n      ), 0)::BIGINT AS inventory_value,\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (\n        WHERE p.is_active = true\n          AND ib.available_quantity <= p.min_stock_level\n      )::INTEGER AS low_stock_products\n    FROM public.inventory_balances ib\n    JOIN public.warehouses w ON w.id = ib.warehouse_id\n    JOIN public.products p ON p.id = ib.product_id\n    WHERE w.branch_id = p_branch_id\n  ),\n  payment_methods AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'method', payment_method,\n        'orderCount', order_count,\n        'amountInMinorUnits', amount\n      ) ORDER BY amount DESC\n    ), '[]'::JSONB) AS payload\n    FROM (\n      SELECT\n        COALESCE(payment_method, 'unknown') AS payment_method,\n        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS order_count,\n        COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS amount\n      FROM completed_orders\n      GROUP BY COALESCE(payment_method, 'unknown')\n    ) rows_by_method\n  ),\n  expense_categories AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'category', category,\n        'count', expense_count,\n        'amountInMinorUnits', amount\n      ) ORDER BY amount DESC\n    ), '[]'::JSONB) AS payload\n    FROM (\n      SELECT\n        category,\n        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS expense_count,\n        COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS amount\n      FROM public.operational_expenses\n      WHERE branch_id = p_branch_id\n        AND created_at >= v_period_start\n        AND created_at < v_period_end\n      GROUP BY category\n    ) rows_by_category\n  ),\n  top_products AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(product_payload ORDER BY revenue DESC), '[]'::JSONB)\n      AS payload\n    FROM (\n      SELECT\n        COALESCE(oi.product_name_snapshot, 'منتج') AS product_name,\n        COALESCE(oi.sku_snapshot, '') AS sku,\n        COALESCE(SUM(\n          public.phase35_report_package_count_internal(oi.id, oi.commercial_line_kind, oi.sale_package_quantity, oi.units_per_sale_package)\n        ), 0)::BIGINT AS package_count,\n        COALESCE(SUM(oi.line_total_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS revenue,\n        COALESCE(SUM(oi.profit_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS profit,\n        jsonb_build_object(\n          'productName', COALESCE(oi.product_name_snapshot, 'منتج'),\n          'sku', COALESCE(oi.sku_snapshot, ''),\n          'packageCount', COALESCE(SUM(\n            public.phase35_report_package_count_internal(oi.id, oi.commercial_line_kind, oi.sale_package_quantity, oi.units_per_sale_package)\n          ), 0),\n          'revenueInMinorUnits', COALESCE(SUM(oi.line_total_in_minor_units), 0),\n          'profitInMinorUnits', COALESCE(SUM(oi.profit_in_minor_units), 0)\n        ) AS product_payload\n      FROM completed_orders co\n      JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = co.id\n      GROUP BY oi.product_name_snapshot, oi.sku_snapshot\n      ORDER BY revenue DESC\n      LIMIT 10\n    ) ranked_products\n  )\n  SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'generatedAt', NOW(),\n    'period', jsonb_build_object(\n      'dateFrom', p_date_from,\n      'dateTo', p_date_to,\n      'branchId', p_branch_id,\n      'branchName', (SELECT name_ar FROM public.branches WHERE id = p_branch_id)\n    ),\n    'sales', jsonb_build_object(\n      'orderCount', os.order_count,\n      'posOrderCount', os.pos_order_count,\n      'websiteOrderCount', os.website_order_count,\n      'packageCount', items.package_count,\n      'baseUnitCount', items.base_unit_count,\n      'uniqueProductCount', items.unique_product_count,\n      'subtotalInMinorUnits', os.subtotal,\n      'discountInMinorUnits', os.discounts,\n      'deliveryFeesInMinorUnits', os.delivery_fees,\n      'grossSalesInMinorUnits', os.gross_sales,\n      'refundsInMinorUnits', returns.refund_amount,\n      'netSalesInMinorUnits', os.gross_sales - returns.refund_amount,\n      'cogsInMinorUnits', items.cogs,\n      'grossProfitInMinorUnits', items.gross_profit,\n      'netProfitInMinorUnits',\n        items.gross_profit\n        - returns.refund_amount\n        + returns.recovered_cogs\n        - expenses.total_expenses,\n      'collectedInMinorUnits', os.collected,\n      'outstandingInMinorUnits', os.outstanding,\n      'returnCount', returns.return_count\n    ),\n    'expenses', jsonb_build_object(\n      'count', expenses.expense_count,\n      'totalInMinorUnits', expenses.total_expenses,\n      'cashInMinorUnits', expenses.cash_expenses,\n      'cliqInMinorUnits', expenses.cliq_expenses,\n      'categories', expense_categories.payload\n    ),\n    'purchases', jsonb_build_object(\n      'receiptCount', purchases.receipt_count,\n      'totalInMinorUnits', purchases.total_purchases,\n      'paidInMinorUnits', purchases.amount_paid,\n      'dueInMinorUnits', purchases.amount_due\n    ),\n    'balances', jsonb_build_object(\n      'customerOrderCount', receivables.order_count,\n      'customerCount', receivables.customer_count,\n      'customerDueInMinorUnits', receivables.amount_due,\n      'supplierCount', payables.supplier_count,\n      'supplierDueInMinorUnits', payables.amount_due\n    ),\n    'inventory', jsonb_build_object(\n      'stockedProducts', inventory.stocked_products,\n      'baseUnitsOnHand', inventory.base_units_on_hand,\n      'baseUnitsReserved', inventory.base_units_reserved,\n      'valueInMinorUnits', inventory.inventory_value,\n      'lowStockProducts', inventory.low_stock_products\n    ),\n    'paymentMethods', payment_methods.payload,\n    'topProducts', top_products.payload\n  )\n  INTO v_report\n  FROM order_sales os\n  CROSS JOIN item_sales items\n  CROSS JOIN period_returns returns\n  CROSS JOIN period_expenses expenses\n  CROSS JOIN period_purchases purchases\n  CROSS JOIN current_receivables receivables\n  CROSS JOIN current_payables payables\n  CROSS JOIN current_inventory inventory\n  CROSS JOIN payment_methods\n  CROSS JOIN expense_categories\n  CROSS JOIN top_products;\n\n  RETURN v_report;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

    WHEN o.source = 'pos' THEN 'سند قبض مرتبط ببيع POS؛ البيع نفسه يجب أن يبقى BLOCKED.'\n        WHEN o.status <> 'completed' THEN 'سند القبض لا يرتبط بطلب مكتمل قائم.'\n        ELSE NULL\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._receive_purchase_order_impl(p_purchase_order_id uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_supplier_delivery_note text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_items jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID;\n  v_po public.purchase_orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_target_warehouse_id UUID;\n  v_receipt_id UUID;\n  v_receipt_number TEXT;\n  v_item JSONB;\n  v_po_item_id UUID;\n  v_recv_qty INT;\n  v_unit_cost BIGINT;\n  v_po_item public.purchase_order_items%ROWTYPE;\n  v_remaining_qty INT;\n  v_current_on_hand INT := 0;\n  v_total_on_hand_all_wh INT := 0;\n  v_new_on_hand INT := 0;\n  v_current_cost BIGINT := 0;\n  v_new_weighted_cost BIGINT := 0;\n  v_all_completed BOOLEAN := true;\n  v_receipt_item_count INT := 0;\n  v_check_item RECORD;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := auth.uid();\n\n  -- Lock PO row\n  SELECT * INTO v_po\n  FROM public.purchase_orders\n  WHERE id = p_purchase_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'أمر الشراء المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_po.status NOT IN ('approved', 'partially_received') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب أن يكون أمر الشراء معتمداً أو مستلماً جزئياً لاستلام البضائع. الحالة الحالية: %', v_po.status;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_target_warehouse_id := COALESCE(p_warehouse_id, v_po.warehouse_id);\n  IF v_target_warehouse_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يرجى تحديد المستودع المستلم للبضائع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF 'GRN-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY') || '-' || LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(1000 + RANDOM() * 9000) AS TEXT), 4, '0');\n  WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_receipts WHERE receipt_number = v_receipt_number) LOOP\n    v_receipt_number := 'GRN-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY') || '-' || LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(1000 + RANDOM() * 9000) AS TEXT), 4, '0');\n  END LOOP;\n\n  -- Create Purchase Receipt Header\n  INSERT INTO public.purchase_receipts (\n    receipt_number,\n    purchase_order_id,\n    supplier_id,\n    warehouse_id,\n    received_by,\n    received_at,\n    supplier_delivery_note,\n    notes\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_receipt_number,\n    p_purchase_order_id,\n    v_po.supplier_id,\n    v_target_warehouse_id,\n    v_user_id,\n    NOW(),\n    p_supplier_delivery_note,\n    p_notes\n  )\n  RETURNING id INTO v_receipt_id;\n\n  -- Loop through received items\n  FOR v_item IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)\n  LOOP\n    v_po_item_id := (v_item->>'purchase_order_item_id')::UUID;\n    -- Preserve the previous malformed UUID rejection. Product resolution\n    -- remains authoritative through the locked purchase-order item below.\n    PERFORM (v_item->>'product_id')::UUID;\n    v_recv_qty := COALESCE((v_item->>'received_quantity')::INT, 0);\n    v_unit_cost := COALESCE((v_item->>'unit_cost_in_minor_units')::BIGINT, 0);\n\n    IF v_recv_qty <= 0 THEN\n      CONTINUE; -- skip zero quantity items\n    END IF;\n\n    -- Lock & Fetch PO Item\n    SELECT * INTO v_po_item\n    FROM public.purchase_order_items\n    WHERE id = v_po_item_id AND purchase_order_id = p_purchase_order_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'عنصر أمر الشراء غير موجود.';\n    END IF;\n\n    v_remaining_qty := v_po_item.ordered_quantity - v_po_item.received_quantity;\n    IF v_recv_qty > v_remaining_qty THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'الكمية المستلمة (%s) تتجاوز الكمية المتبقية (%s) للمنتج.', v_recv_qty, v_remaining_qty;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- 1. Insert Receipt Item\n    INSERT INTO public.purchase_receipt_items (\n      purchase_receipt_id,\n      purchase_order_item_id,\n      product_id,\n      received_quantity,\n      unit_cost_in_minor_units\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_receipt_id,\n      v_po_item_id,\n      v_po_item.product_id,\n      v_recv_qty,\n      v_unit_cost\n    );\n\n    -- 2. Update PO Item received_quantity\n    UPDATE public.purchase_order_items\n    SET received_quantity = received_quantity + v_recv_qty,\n        updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE id = v_po_item_id;\n\n    -- 3. Update Inventory Balance\n    SELECT COALESCE(on_hand_quantity, 0) INTO v_current_on_hand\n    FROM public.inventory_balances\n    WHERE warehouse_id = v_target_warehouse_id AND product_id = v_po_item.product_id;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      v_current_on_hand := 0;\n      INSERT INTO public.inventory_balances (\n        warehouse_id,\n        product_id,\n        on_hand_quantity,\n        reserved_quantity\n      ) VALUES (\n        v_target_warehouse_id,\n        v_po_item.product_id,\n        v_recv_qty,\n        0\n      );\n      v_new_on_hand := v_recv_qty;\n    ELSE\n      v_new_on_hand := v_current_on_hand + v_recv_qty;\n      UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n      SET on_hand_quantity = v_new_on_hand,\n          updated_at = NOW()\n      WHERE warehouse_id = v_target_warehouse_id AND product_id = v_po_item.product_id;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- 4. Record Inventory Movement\n    INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements (\n      warehouse_id,\n      product_id,\n      movement_type,\n      quantity,\n      balance_before,\n      balance_after,\n      reference_type,\n      reference_id,\n      notes,\n      created_by\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_target_warehouse_id,\n      v_po_item.product_id,\n      'purchase_receipt',\n      v_recv_qty,\n      v_current_on_hand,\n      v_new_on_hand,\n      'purchase_receipt',\n      v_receipt_id,\n      'استلام مشتريات سند رقم ' || v_receipt_number || ' - طلب شراء ' || v_po.purchase_order_number,\n      v_user_id\n    );\n\n    -- 5. Calculate Weighted Average Cost & Update Product Cost\n    SELECT COALESCE(cost_price_in_minor_units, 0) INTO v_current_cost\n    FROM public.products\n    WHERE id = v_po_item.product_id;\n\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(on_hand_quantity), 0) INTO v_total_on_hand_all_wh\n    FROM public.inventory_balances\n    WHERE product_id = v_po_item.product_id;\n\n    -- Note: v_total_on_hand_all_wh already includes v_recv_qty\n    IF (v_total_on_hand_all_wh) > 0 AND v_unit_cost > 0 THEN\n      v_new_weighted_cost := (( (v_total_on_hand_all_wh - v_recv_qty) * v_current_cost ) + ( v_recv_qty * v_unit_cost )) / v_total_on_hand_all_wh;\n\n      UPDATE public.products\n      SET cost_price_in_minor_units = v_new_weighted_cost,\n          updated_at = NOW()\n      WHERE id = v_po_item.product_id;\n    END IF;\n\n    v_receipt_item_count := v_receipt_item_count + 1;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  -- Determine if PO is fully received\n  FOR v_check_item IN SELECT ordered_quantity, received_quantity FROM public.purchase_order_items WHERE purchase_order_id = p_purchase_order_id\n  LOOP\n    IF v_check_item.received_quantity < v_check_item.ordered_quantity THEN\n      v_all_completed := false;\n      EXIT;\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  UPDATE public.purchase_orders\n  SET status = CASE WHEN v_all_completed THEN 'received' ELSE 'partially_received' END,\n      received_at = CASE WHEN v_all_completed THEN NOW() ELSE received_at END,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_purchase_order_id;\n\n  -- Audit Log\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'استلام بضائع أمر شراء',\n    'purchase_receipts',\n    v_receipt_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'receipt_number', v_receipt_number,\n      'purchase_order_id', p_purchase_order_id,\n      'is_fully_received', v_all_completed,\n      'items_received_count', v_receipt_item_count\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'receipt_id', v_receipt_id,\n    'receipt_number', v_receipt_number,\n    'is_fully_received', v_all_completed,\n    'new_status', CASE WHEN v_all_completed THEN 'received' ELSE 'partially_received' END,\n    'message', 'تم استلام البضائع وزيادة المخزون وتحديث متوسط التكلفة بنجاح'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

v_new_paid;\n  v_new_payment_status := CASE\n    WHEN v_new_due = 0 THEN 'paid'\n    ELSE 'partially_paid'\n  END;\n\n  UPDATE public.supplier_receipts\n  SET\n    amount_paid_in_minor_units = v_new_paid,\n    amount_due_in_minor_units = v_new_due,\n    payment_status = v_new_payment_status,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_receipt_id;\n\n  UPDATE public.suppliers\n  SET\n    current_balance_in_minor_units =\n      current_balance_in_minor_units -         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._reverse_cash_shift_with_operations_before_phase4_lock(p_shift_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID;\n  v_existing public.cash_shift_reversals%ROWTYPE;\n  v_reversal_id UUID;\n  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_reason), '');\n  v_key TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_idempotency_key), '');\n  v_preview JSONB;\n  v_operation JSONB;\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_payment public.customer_payments%ROWTYPE;\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_expense public.operational_expenses%ROWTYPE;\n  v_new_paid BIGINT;\n  v_audit_id UUID;\n  v_primitive_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := public.assert_reversal_owner('إلغاء الوردية وعكس جميع عملياتها');\n  IF p_shift_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الوردية المطلوبة غير محددة.'; END IF;\n  IF v_reason IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سبب عكس الوردية مطلوب ويجب أن يكون بين 3 و500 حرف.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_key IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مفتاح منع التكرار لعكس الوردية غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '3s', true);\n  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout', '30s', true);\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('cash-shift-full-reversal:' || p_shift_id::TEXT, 0));\n\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id=p_shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الوردية المحددة غير موجودة.'; END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing\n  FROM public.cash_shift_reversals\n  WHERE requested_by=v_user_id AND idempotency_key=v_key\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing.shift_id <> p_shift_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مفتاح منع التكرار مستخدم لوردية أخرى.'; END IF;\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'idempotent',true,'reversalId',v_existing.id,'status',v_existing.status,'actualEffect',v_existing.actual_effect);\n  END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.cash_shift_reversals WHERE shift_id=p_shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'تم عكس هذه الوردية مسبقًا تحت المرجع %.', v_existing.id; END IF;\n\n  -- Canonical global lock order: shift, orders, customer payments, supplier\n  -- payments, expenses, returns, inventory balances, receipt/PO, suppliers.\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders WHERE cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.customer_payments WHERE cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.supplier_payments WHERE cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.operational_expenses WHERE shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.sales_returns WHERE cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM 1\n  FROM public.inventory_balances ib\n  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT o.warehouse_id, oi.product_id FROM public.orders o JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id) keys\n    ON keys.warehouse_id=ib.warehouse_id AND keys.product_id=ib.product_id\n  ORDER BY ib.warehouse_id, ib.product_id FOR UPDATE OF ib;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.supplier_receipts sr JOIN public.supplier_payments sp ON sp.supplier_receipt_id=sr.id WHERE sp.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY sr.id FOR UPDATE OF sr;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.purchase_orders po JOIN public.supplier_payments sp ON sp.purchase_order_id=po.id WHERE sp.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY po.id FOR UPDATE OF po;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers s JOIN public.supplier_payments sp ON sp.supplier_id=s.id WHERE sp.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY s.id FOR UPDATE OF s;\n\n  v_preview := public._preview_cash_shift_full_reversal(p_shift_id);\n  IF COALESCE((v_preview->>'canExecute')::BOOLEAN, false) IS NOT TRUE THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عكس الوردية محجوب: %', COALESCE(v_preview->'operations','[]'::JSONB);\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.cash_shift_reversals(shift_id,requested_by,reason,idempotency_key,expected_effect)\n  VALUES(p_shift_id,v_user_id,v_reason,v_key,v_preview->'summary') RETURNING id INTO v_reversal_id;\n\n  FOR v_operation IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_preview->'operations') LOOP\n    v_primitive_id := NULL;\n    IF v_operation->>'status' = 'ALREADY_REVERSED' THEN\n      IF v_operation->>'operationType'='pos_sale' THEN SELECT id INTO v_primitive_id FROM public.pos_sale_reversals WHERE order_id=(v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID;\n      ELSIF v_operation->>'operationType'='supplier_payment' THEN SELECT id INTO v_primitive_id FROM public.supplier_payment_reversals WHERE supplier_payment_id=(v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID;\n      END IF;\n      INSERT INTO public.cash_shift_reversal_operations(reversal_id,shift_id,operation_type,original_record_id,status,primitive_reversal_reference,expected_effect,actual_effect)\n      VALUES(v_reversal_id,p_shift_id,v_operation->>'operationType',(v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID,'already_reversed',v_primitive_id,v_operation->'expectedEffect',v_operation->'expectedEffect');\n      CONTINUE;\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_operation->>'operationType'='pos_sale' THEN\n      v_result := public.reverse_pos_sale((v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID,v_reason,'shift:'||v_reversal_id::TEXT||':pos:'||(v_operation->>'originalRecordId'));\n      v_primitive_id := (v_result->>'reversal_id')::UUID;\n    ELSIF v_operation->>'operationType'='supplier_payment' THEN\n      v_result := public.reverse_supplier_payment((v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID,v_reason,'shift:'||v_reversal_id::TEXT||':supplier:'||(v_operation->>'originalRecordId'));\n      v_primitive_id :=         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._reverse_supplier_payment_before_phase4_lock(p_supplier_payment_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE  WHERE requested_by = v_user_id\n    AND idempotency_key = v_key\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing.supplier_payment_id <> p_supplier_payment_id THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'مفتاح منع id = v_payment.supplier_id;\n\n    v_effect := jsonb_build_object(\n      'reference_type', 'supplier_receipt',\n      'reference_id', v_receipt.id,\n      'supplier_balance_restored_in_minor_units',         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._set_advanced_monitoring_check(p_key text, p_category text, p_source text, p_status text, p_severity text, p_issue_count integer, p_summary text, p_details jsonb, p_checked_at timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF p_key !~ '^[a-z0-9:_-]{3,120}$'\n    OR p_category NOT IN ('database','inventory','accounting','orders','shifts','automation','performance','security','runtime','backup','infrastructure','deployment')\n    OR p_source NOT IN ('database','external')\n    OR p_status NOT IN ('healthy','warning','critical','unknown')\n    OR p_severity NOT IN ('low','medium','high','critical')\n    OR p_issue_count < 0 OR p_checked_at IS NULL\n    OR NULLIF(TRIM(p_summary),'') IS NULL OR length(p_summary)>240\n    OR jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(p_details,'{}'::JSONB)) <> 'object'\n    OR octet_length(COALESCE(p_details,'{}'::JSONB)::TEXT)>4096\n  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid monitoring check.'; END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.advanced_monitoring_checks(\n    check_key,category,source,status,severity,issue_count,summary,details,\n    checked_at,changed_at,updated_at\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_key,p_category,p_source,p_status,p_severity,p_issue_count,p_summary,\n    COALESCE(p_details,'{}'::JSONB),p_checked_at,p_checked_at,p_checked_at\n  ) ON CONFLICT (check_key) DO UPDATE SET\n    category=EXCLUDED.category, source=EXCLUDED.source,\n    status=EXCLUDED.status, severity=EXCLUDED.severity,\n    issue_count=EXCLUDED.issue_count, summary=EXCLUDED.summary,\n    details=EXCLUDED.details, checked_at=EXCLUDED.checked_at,\n    changed_at=CASE\n      WHEN advanced_monitoring_checks.status IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.status\n        OR advanced_monitoring_checks.issue_count IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.issue_count\n      THEN EXCLUDED.checked_at ELSE advanced_monitoring_checks.changed_at END,\n    updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

'طريقة الدفع غير مدعومة. اختر كاش عند الاستلام أو CliQ.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_delivery_zone NOT IN ('inside_ramtha', 'outside_ramtha') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'اختر منطقة التوصيل: داخل الرمثا أو الرمثا. اختر خارج الرمثا أو صحح المدينة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_settings\n  FROM public.storefront_settings\n  WHERE id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::UUID;\n\n  v_result := public.submit_guest_customer_order_core(\n    p_idempotency_key, p_customer_full_name, p_customer_phone,\n    p_governorate, p_city, p_area, p_street, p_building,\n    p_address_notes, p_google_maps_url, p_latitude, p_longitude,\n    p_customer_notes, p_items, p_promotion_code\n  );\n\n  IF NOT COALESCE((v_result->>'success')::BOOLEAN, false) THEN\n    RETURN v_result;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_is_replay := COALESCE((v_result->>'idempotent_replay')::BOOLEAN, false);\n  v_order_id := (v_result->>'order_id')::UUID;\n\n  SELECT\n    payment_method,\n    delivery_zone,\n    delivery_fee_in_minor_units,\n    total_in_minor_units,\n    tracking_token\n  INTO\n    v_existing_payment_method,\n    v_existing_delivery_zone,\n    v_existing_delivery_fee,\n    v_existing_total,\n    v_tracking_token\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = v_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF v_is_replay THEN\n    IF v_existing_payment_method IS DISTINCT FROM v_payment_method THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'تغيرت طريقة الدفع لطلب محفوظ مسبقًا. أعد إرسال الطلب.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_existing_delivery_zone IS NOT NULL\n      AND v_existing_delivery_zone IS DISTINCT FROM v_delivery_zone\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'تغيرت منطقة التوصيل لطلب محفوظ مسبقًا. أعد إرسال الطلب.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_existing_delivery_zone IS NULL THEN\n      UPDATE public.orders\n      SET delivery_zone = v_delivery_zone,\n          updated_at = NOW()\n      WHERE id = v_order_id;\n      v_existing_delivery_zone := v_delivery_zone;\n    END IF;\n\n    RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object(\n      'total', v_existing_total,\n      'delivery_fee', v_existing_delivery_fee,\n      'delivery_zone', v_existing_delivery_zone,\n      'payment_method', v_payment_method,\n      'payment_status', 'unpaid',\n      'tracking_token', v_tracking_token,\n      'tracking_path', '/#track=' || v_tracking_token::TEXT\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT COALESCE(v_settings.orders_enabled, false) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلبات متوقفة مؤقتًا من إدارة المتجر. تواصل معنا عبر واتساب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF (v_result->>'subtotal')::BIGINT < v_settings.minimum_order_in_minor_units THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'قيمة الطلب أقل من الحد الأدنى المطلوب وهو % د.أ.',\n      to_char(v_settings.minimum_order_in_minor_units / 1000.0, 'FM999999990.000');\n  END IF;\n\n  v_delivery_fee := CASE v_delivery_zone\n    WHEN 'inside_ramtha' THEN\n      v_settings.inside_ramtha_delivery_fee_in_minor_units\n    ELSE\n      v_settings.outside_ramtha_delivery_fee_in_minor_units\n  END;\n  v_total := (v_result->>'total')::BIGINT + v_delivery_fee;\n\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET delivery_zone = v_delivery_zone,\n      delivery_fee_in_minor_units = v_delivery_fee,\n      total_in_minor_units = v_total,\n      payment_method = v_payment_method,\n      payment_status = 'unpaid',\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = v_order_id;\n\n  RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object(\n    'total', v_total,\n    'delivery_fee', v_delivery_fee,\n    'delivery_zone', v_delivery_zone,\n    'payment_method', v_payment_method,\n    'payment_status', 'unpaid',\n    'tracking_token', v_tracking_token,\n    'tracking_path', '/#track=' || v_tracking_token::TEXT\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._transfer_inventory_between_warehouses_phase2_legacy(p_product_id uuid, p_source_warehouse_id uuid, p_destination_warehouse_id uuid, p_quantity integer, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_transfer_date timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_source_warehouse_name TEXT;\n  v_destination_warehouse_name TEXT;\n  v_source_before INTEGER;\n  v_source_reserved INTEGER;\n  v_source_after INTEGER;\n  v_destination_before INTEGER;\n  v_destination_after INTEGER;\n  v_out_movement_id UUID;\n  v_in_movement_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'warehouse_keeper'],\n    'نقل المخزون بين المستودعات'\n  );\n\n  IF p_product_id IS NULL\n     OR p_source_warehouse_id IS NULL\n     OR p_destination_warehouse_id IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المنتج والمستودع المصدر والمستودع الهدف مطلوبة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_quantity IS NULL OR p_quantity <= 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الكمية المنقولة يجب أن تكون عددًا صحيحًا أكبر من صفر.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_source_warehouse_id = p_destination_warehouse_id THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن نقل المخزون إلى المستودع نفسه.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM 1\n  FROM public.products\n  WHERE id = p_product_id\n    AND is_active = true;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المنتج المحدد غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT name_ar\n  INTO v_source_warehouse_name\n  FROM public.warehouses\n  WHERE id = p_source_warehouse_id\n    AND is_active = true;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المستودع المصدر غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT name_ar\n  INTO v_destination_warehouse_name\n  FROM public.warehouses\n  WHERE id = p_destination_warehouse_id\n    AND is_active = true;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المستودع الهدف غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- One stable operation key prevents opposing transfers of the same product\n  -- between this warehouse pair from deadlocking or overspending stock.\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(\n    hashtextextended(\n      p_product_id::TEXT || ':' ||\n      LEAST(p_source_warehouse_id::TEXT, p_destination_warehouse_id::TEXT) || ':' ||\n      GREATEST(p_source_warehouse_id::TEXT, p_destination_warehouse_id::TEXT),\n      0\n    )\n  );\n\n  SELECT on_hand_quantity, reserved_quantity\n  INTO v_source_before, v_source_reserved\n  FROM public.inventory_balances\n  WHERE warehouse_id = p_source_warehouse_id\n    AND product_id = p_product_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يوجد رصيد لهذا المنتج في المستودع المصدر.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF (v_source_before - p_quantity) < v_source_reserved THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'لا يمكن نقل % قطعة؛ المتاح للنقل في المستودع المصدر هو % قطعة بعد حجز الطلبات.',\n      p_quantity,\n      v_source_before - v_source_reserved;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_source_after := v_source_before - p_quantity;\n  UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n  SET on_hand_quantity = v_source_after, updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE warehouse_id = p_source_warehouse_id\n    AND product_id = p_product_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.inventory_balances (\n    warehouse_id,\n    product_id,\n    on_hand_quantity,\n    reserved_quantity\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_destination_warehouse_id,\n    p_product_id,\n    p_quantity,\n    0\n  ) ON CONFLICT (warehouse_id, product_id)\n  DO UPDATE\n  SET\n    on_hand_quantity = public.inventory_balances.on_hand_quantity + EXCLUDED.on_hand_quantity,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  RETURNING on_hand_quantity - p_quantity, on_hand_quantity\n  INTO v_destination_before, v_destination_after;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements (\n    warehouse_id, product_id, movement_type, quantity, balance_before,\n    balance_after, reference_type, notes, created_by\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_source_warehouse_id, p_product_id, 'transfer_out', -p_quantity,\n    v_source_before, v_source_after, 'warehouse_transfer',\n    COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_notes), ''), 'نقل مخزون إلى ' || v_destination_warehouse_name),\n    v_user_id\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_out_movement_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements (\n    warehouse_id, product_id, movement_type, quantity, balance_before,\n    balance_after, reference_type, notes, created_by\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_destination_warehouse_id, p_product_id, 'transfer_in', p_quantity,\n    v_destination_before, v_destination_after, 'warehouse_transfer',\n    COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_notes), ''), 'نقل مخزون من ' || v_source_warehouse_name),\n    v_user_id\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_in_movement_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'TRANSFER_INVENTORY',\n    'inventory_balances',\n    p_product_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'source_warehouse_id', p_source_warehouse_id,\n      'destination_warehouse_id', p_destination_warehouse_id,\n      'quantity', p_quantity,\n      'source_before', v_source_before,\n      'source_after', v_source_after,\n      'destination_before', v_destination_before,\n      'destination_after', v_destination_after,\n      'out_movement_id', v_out_movement_id,\n      'in_movement_id', v_in_movement_id\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'productId', p_product_id,\n    'quantityTransferred', p_quantity,\n    'sourceNewQuantity', v_source_after,\n    'destinationNewQuantity', v_destination_after,\n    'movementOutId', v_out_movement_id,\n    'movementInId', v_in_movement_id,\n    'message', 'تم نقل المخزون من ' || v_source_warehouse_name || ' إلى ' || v_destination_warehouse_name || ' بنجاح.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._transition_business_alert_incident(p_incident_key text, p_event_type text, p_entity_id uuid, p_is_active boolean, p_observed_at timestamp with time zone, p_payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_emit_recovery boolean DEFAULT true)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_incident public.business_alert_incidents%ROWTYPE;\n  v_occurrence INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_incident_key IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(p_incident_key), '') IS NULL\n    OR length(p_incident_key) > 240 OR p_entity_id IS NULL OR p_observed_at IS NULL\n    OR p_event_type NOT IN (\n      'order_unprocessed', 'order_near_expiry',\n      'shift_close_reminder', 'shift_close_overdue',\n      'purchase_order_overdue', 'expense_daily_threshold',\n      'business_integrity_warning'\n    )\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Business alert incident transition.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_incident FROM public.business_alert_incidents\n  WHERE incident_key = p_incident_key FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF p_is_active THEN\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      v_occurrence := 1;\n      INSERT INTO public.business_alert_incidents(\n        incident_key, alert_type, entity_id, state, occurrence,\n        opened_at, last_seen_at, resolved_at, updated_at\n      ) VALUES (\n        p_incident_key, p_event_type, p_entity_id, 'open', v_occurrence,\n        p_observed_at, p_observed_at, NULL, p_observed_at\n      );\n    ELSIF v_incident.state = 'resolved' THEN\n      v_occurrence := v_incident.occurrence + 1;\n      UPDATE public.business_alert_incidents\n      SET alert_type=p_event_type, entity_id=p_entity_id, state='open',\n          occurrence=v_occurrence, opened_at=p_observed_at,\n          last_seen_at=p_observed_at, resolved_at=NULL, updated_at=p_observed_at\n      WHERE incident_key=p_incident_key;\n    ELSE\n      UPDATE public.business_alert_incidents\n      SET last_seen_at=p_observed_at, updated_at=p_observed_at\n      WHERE incident_key=p_incident_key;\n      RETURN 'unchanged';\n    END IF;\n    PERFORM public.enqueue_automation_event(\n      'business:'||p_incident_key||':open:'||v_occurrence::TEXT,\n      p_event_type, p_entity_id,\n      COALESCE(p_payload,'{}'::JSONB)||jsonb_build_object(\n        'incidentKey',p_incident_key,'state','open',\n        'occurrence',v_occurrence,'observedAt',p_observed_at)\n    );\n    RETURN 'opened';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_incident.state <> 'open' THEN RETURN 'unchanged'; END IF;\n  UPDATE public.business_alert_incidents\n  SET state='resolved', last_seen_at=p_observed_at, resolved_at=p_observed_at,\n      updated_at=p_observed_at WHERE incident_key=p_incident_key;\n  IF p_emit_recovery THEN\n    PERFORM public.enqueue_automation_event(\n      'business:'||p_incident_key||':resolved:'||v_incident.occurrence::TEXT,\n      'business_alert_recovery', p_entity_id,\n      COALESCE(p_payload,'{}'::JSONB)||jsonb_build_object(\n        'incidentKey',p_incident_key,'resolvedAlertType',p_event_type,\n        'state','resolved','occurrence',v_incident.occurrence,\n        'observedAt',p_observed_at)\n    );\n  END IF;\n  RETURN 'resolved';\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._update_order_status_impl(p_order_id uuid, p_new_status text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_number TEXT;\n  v_old_status TEXT;\n  v_user_id UUID;\n  v_valid_transition BOOLEAN := false;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := auth.uid();\n\n  -- Normalize target status if needed\n  IF p_new_status = 'processing' THEN\n    p_new_status := 'preparing';\n  ELSIF p_new_status = 'delivered' THEN\n    p_new_status := 'completed';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Lock and fetch current order\n  SELECT order_number, status\n  INTO v_order_number, v_old_status\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود في قاعدة البيانات.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Delegate special atomic transitions\n  IF p_new_status = 'confirmed' AND v_old_status = 'new' THEN\n    RETURN public.confirm_order(p_order_id, p_notes);\n  ELSIF p_new_status = 'completed' THEN\n    RETURN public.complete_order(p_order_id, p_notes);\n  ELSIF p_new_status = 'cancelled' THEN\n    RETURN public.cancel_order(p_order_id, p_notes);\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Validate permitted status transitions\n  IF v_old_status = 'new' AND p_new_status IN ('confirmed', 'preparing', 'cancelled') THEN\n    v_valid_transition := true;\n  ELSIF v_old_status = 'confirmed' AND p_new_status IN ('preparing', 'cancelled') THEN\n    v_valid_transition := true;\n  ELSIF v_old_status = 'preparing' AND p_new_status IN ('ready', 'out_for_delivery', 'cancelled') THEN\n    v_valid_transition := true;\n  ELSIF v_old_status = 'ready' AND p_new_status IN ('out_for_delivery', 'completed', 'cancelled') THEN\n    v_valid_transition := true;\n  ELSIF v_old_status = 'out_for_delivery' AND p_new_status IN ('completed', 'cancelled') THEN\n    v_valid_transition := true;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT v_valid_transition THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'انتقال حالة الطلب غير مسموح به من (%) إلى (%).', v_old_status, p_new_status;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Update status\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET status = p_new_status,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n\n  -- Record order status history\n  INSERT INTO public.order_status_history (\n    order_id,\n    old_status,\n    new_status,\n    changed_by,\n    notes\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_order_id,\n    v_old_status,\n    p_new_status,\n    v_user_id,\n    COALESCE(p_notes, 'تغيير حالة الطلب إلى ' || p_new_status)\n  );\n\n  -- Record audit log\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'update_order_status',\n    'orders',\n    p_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'order_number', v_order_number,\n      'old_status', v_old_status,\n      'new_status', p_new_status,\n      'notes', p_notes\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'order_id', p_order_id,\n    'order_number', v_order_number,\n    'old_status', v_old_status,\n    'status', p_new_status,\n    'message', 'تم تحديث حالة الطلب بنجاح إلى ' || p_new_status\n  );\n\nEXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'فشلت عملية تحديث حالة الطلب: %', SQLERRM;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._update_purchase_order_status_impl(p_purchase_order_id uuid, p_new_status text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID;\n  v_po public.purchase_orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_total_received INT := 0;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := auth.uid();\n\n  -- Lock PO row\n  SELECT * INTO v_po\n  FROM public.purchase_orders\n  WHERE id = p_purchase_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طلب الشراء المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_po.status = p_new_status THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'الحالة الحالية هي بالفعل الحالة المطلوبة.');\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Calculate total received quantity across all items\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(received_quantity), 0) INTO v_total_received\n  FROM public.purchase_order_items\n  WHERE purchase_order_id = p_purchase_order_id;\n\n  -- Validate Transitions\n  IF v_po.status = 'draft' AND p_new_status NOT IN ('sent', 'cancelled') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طلب الشراء المسودة يمكن تحويله إلى مرسل أو ملغى فقط.';\n  ELSIF v_po.status = 'sent' AND p_new_status NOT IN ('approved', 'cancelled') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طلب الشراء المرسل يمكن تحويله إلى معتمد أو ملغى فقط.';\n  ELSIF v_po.status = 'approved' AND p_new_status NOT IN ('partially_received', 'received', 'cancelled') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طلب الشراء المعتمد يمكن استلامه جزئياً/كلياً أو إلغاؤه.';\n  ELSIF v_po.status = 'approved' AND p_new_status = 'cancelled' AND v_total_received > 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إلغاء طلب شراء معتمد تم استلام جزء من بضائعه بالفعل.';\n  ELSIF v_po.status = 'partially_received' AND p_new_status NOT IN         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.accept_order_for_preparation(p_order_id uuid, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_status TEXT;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'قبول الطلب وبدء التجهيز'\n  );\n\n  SELECT status\n  INTO v_status\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_status = 'new' THEN\n    PERFORM public.confirm_order(\n      p_order_id,\n      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), ''), 'قبول الطلب وحجز المخزون')\n    );\n    v_status := 'confirmed';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_status = 'confirmed' THEN\n    v_result := public.update_order_status(\n      p_order_id,\n      'preparing',\n      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), ''), 'تم قبول الطلب وبدأ التجهيز')\n    );\n  ELSIF v_status = 'preparing' THEN\n    v_result := jsonb_build_object(\n      'success', true,\n      'order_id', p_order_id,\n      'status', 'preparing'\n    );\n  ELSE\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن قبول الطلب وبدء تجهيزه من الحالة الحالية (%).', v_status;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object(\n    'message', 'تم قبول الطلب وحجز المخزون وبدء التجهيز.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_customer_address(p_customer_id uuid, p_governorate text, p_city text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_area text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_street text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_building text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_floor text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_apartment text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_latitude double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_longitude double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_is_default boolean DEFAULT false)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_address_id UUID;\n  v_formatted_address TEXT;\n  v_maps_url TEXT;\n  v_has_coordinates BOOLEAN :=\n    p_latitude IS NOT NULL AND p_longitude IS NOT NULL;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'إضافة عنوان عميل'\n  );\n\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.customers\n    WHERE id = p_customer_id\n      AND is_deleted = false\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'العميل غير موجود أو محذوف.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NULLIF(TRIM(p_governorate), '') IS NULL\n    OR NULLIF(TRIM(p_area), '') IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المحافظة والمنطقة مطلوبتان.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF (p_latitude IS NULL) <> (p_longitude IS NULL) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب إدخال خط العرض وخط الطول معاً.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_has_coordinates\n    AND (\n      p_latitude NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90\n      OR p_longitude NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180\n    )\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'إحداثيات الموقع غير صحيحة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_formatted_address := CONCAT_WS(\n    ' - ',\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_governorate), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_city), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_area), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_street), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_building), '')\n  );\n  v_maps_url := CASE WHEN v_has_coordinates\n    THEN 'https://www.google.com/maps?q=' ||\n      p_latitude::TEXT || ',' || p_longitude::TEXT\n    ELSE NULL\n  END;\n\n  IF p_is_default THEN\n    UPDATE public.customer_addresses\n    SET is_default = false\n    WHERE customer_id = p_customer_id;\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.customer_addresses (\n    customer_id,\n    governorate,\n    city,\n    area,\n    street,\n    building,\n    floor,\n    apartment,\n    notes,\n    latitude,\n    longitude,\n    formatted_address,\n    google_maps_url,\n    location_source,\n    location_confirmed,\n    is_default\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_customer_id,\n    TRIM(p_governorate),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_city), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_area), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_street), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_building), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_floor), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_apartment), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), ''),\n    p_latitude,\n    p_longitude,\n    v_formatted_address,\n    v_maps_url,\n    CASE WHEN v_has_coordinates THEN 'gps' ELSE 'manual' END,\n    v_has_coordinates,\n    p_is_default\n  )\n  RETURNING id INTO v_address_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'ADD_CUSTOMER_ADDRESS',\n    'customer_addresses',\n    v_address_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'customer_id', p_customer_id,\n      'formatted_address', v_formatted_address,\n      'location_confirmed', v_has_coordinates\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'address_id', v_address_id\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.adjust_inventory_stock(p_warehouse_id uuid, p_product_id uuid, p_actual_quantity integer, p_reason text, p_adjustment_type text DEFAULT 'stock_count'::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_product_name TEXT;\n  v_unit_cost NUMERIC(24,6);\n  v_previous_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_reserved_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_quantity_change INTEGER;\n  v_movement_type TEXT;\n  v_movement_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'warehouse_keeper'],\n    'جرد وتسوية المخزون'\n  );\n\n  IF p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR p_product_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المنتج والمستودع مطلوبان.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_actual_quantity IS NULL OR p_actual_quantity < 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الكمية الفعلية يجب أن تكون عدداً صحيحاً لا يقل عن صفر.';\n  END IF;\n  IF NULLIF(TRIM(p_reason), '') IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سبب الجرد أو التسوية مطلوب.';\n  END IF;\n  IF COALESCE(p_adjustment_type, 'stock_count') NOT IN (\n    'stock_count',\n    'damage',\n    'expired',\n    'manual'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'نوع تسوية المخزون غير معتمد.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Same sorted advisory/balance/product lock order as receiving and returns.\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY[p_product_id]);\n  SELECT p.name_ar, COALESCE(p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,p.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC)\n  INTO v_product_name,v_unit_cost\n  FROM public.products p\n  WHERE p.id = p_product_id\n    AND p.is_active = true;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المنتج المحدد غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT on_hand_quantity, reserved_quantity\n  INTO v_previous_quantity, v_reserved_quantity\n  FROM public.inventory_balances\n  WHERE warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n    AND product_id = p_product_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يوجد رصيد لهذا المنتج في المستودع المحدد.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_actual_quantity < v_reserved_quantity THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'لا يمكن جعل المخزون الفعلي (%) أقل من الكمية المحجوزة (%).',\n      p_actual_quantity,\n      v_reserved_quantity;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_quantity_change := p_actual_quantity - v_previous_quantity;\n  v_movement_type :=\n    CASE WHEN v_quantity_change >= 0\n      THEN 'adjustment_add'\n      ELSE 'adjustment_subtract'\n    END;\n\n  UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n  SET\n    on_hand_quantity = p_actual_quantity,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n    AND product_id = p_product_id;\n\n  IF v_quantity_change <> 0 THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements (\n      warehouse_id,\n      product_id,\n      movement_type,\n      quantity,\n      balance_before,\n      balance_after,\n      reference_type,\n      reference_id,\n      notes,\n      created_by\n    ) VALUES (\n      p_warehouse_id,\n      p_product_id,\n      v_movement_type,\n      v_quantity_change,\n      v_previous_quantity,\n      p_actual_quantity,\n      COALESCE(p_adjustment_type, 'stock_count'),\n      NULL,\n      TRIM(p_reason),\n      v_user_id\n    )\n    RETURNING id INTO v_movement_id;\n    IF v_quantity_change<0 AND p_adjustment_type IN ('damage','expired') THEN\n      IF v_unit_cost IS NULL OR v_unit_cost<0 THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'DAMAGE_COST_MISSING: تكلفة حركة التلف غير متاحة.';\n      END IF;\n      INSERT INTO public.inventory_damage_events(product_id,warehouse_id,branch_id,origin,movement_id,\n        quantity,unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,reason_code,reason,occurred_at,created_by)\n      SELECT p_product_id,p_warehouse_id,w.branch_id,'shop',v_movement_id,\n        -v_quantity_change,v_unit_cost,CASE\n          WHEN p_adjustment_type='expired' OR p_reason LIKE 'انتهت الصلاحية%' THEN 'expired'\n          WHEN p_reason LIKE 'انكسر بالمحل%' THEN 'shop_breakage'\n          WHEN p_reason LIKE 'تلف تخزين%' THEN 'storage_damage' ELSE 'other' END,\n        TRIM(p_reason),m.created_at,v_user_id\n      FROM public.warehouses w JOIN public.inventory_movements m ON m.id=v_movement_id\n      WHERE w.id=p_warehouse_id;\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'ADJUST_INVENTORY_STOCK',\n    'inventory_balances',\n    p_product_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'warehouse_id', p_warehouse_id,\n      'product_name', v_product_name,\n      'previous_quantity', v_previous_quantity,\n      'actual_quantity', p_actual_quantity,\n      'quantity_change', v_quantity_change,\n      'adjustment_type', COALESCE(p_adjustment_type, 'stock_count'),\n      'reason', TRIM(p_reason),\n      'movement_id', v_movement_id\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'productId', p_product_id,\n    'productName', v_product_name,\n    'warehouseId', p_warehouse_id,\n    'previousQuantity', v_previous_quantity,\n    'actualQuantity', p_actual_quantity,\n    'quantityChange', v_quantity_change,\n    'availableQuantity', p_actual_quantity - v_reserved_quantity,\n    'movementId', v_movement_id,\n    'message', 'تم حفظ الجرد وتسوية المخزون في Supabase بنجاح.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_inventory_opening_setup(p_warehouse_id uuid, p_rows jsonb, p_notes text, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_warehouse public.warehouses%ROWTYPE;\n  v_existing_session public.inventory_opening_sessions%ROWTYPE;\n  v_session_id UUID;\n  v_session_number TEXT;\n  v_row JSONB;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_product_name TEXT;\n  v_cost_price_in_minor_units BIGINT;\n  v_purchase_package_name TEXT;\n  v_base_unit_name TEXT;\n  v_units_per_package INTEGER;\n  v_package_count INTEGER;\n  v_loose_units INTEGER;\n  v_actual_quantity_big BIGINT;\n  v_actual_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_previous_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_reserved_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_quantity_change INTEGER;\n  v_movement_id UUID;\n  v_item_count INTEGER := 0;\n  v_total_previous INTEGER := 0;\n  v_total_actual INTEGER := 0;\n  v_total_change INTEGER := 0;\n  v_notes TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), '');\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'warehouse_keeper'],\n    'اعتماد تهيئة المخزون الافتتاحي'\n  );\n\n  IF p_warehouse_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المستودع مطلوب.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_notes IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_notes) < 5 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'اكتب ملاحظة واضحة لجلسة المخزون الافتتاحي.';\n  END IF;\n  IF CHAR_LENGTH(v_notes) > 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ملاحظة جلسة المخزون الافتتاحي أطول من المسموح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF NULLIF(TRIM(p_idempotency_key), '') IS NULL\n    OR CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(p_idempotency_key)) < 16\n    OR CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(p_idempotency_key)) > 100\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مفتاح منع التكرار غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_rows IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات أصناف المخزون الافتتاحي غير صحيحة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF jsonb_array_length(p_rows) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'اختر صنفاً واحداً على الأقل وبحد أقصى 500 صنف.';\n  END IF;\n  IF (\n    SELECT COUNT(*)\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)\n  ) <> (\n    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT row_data->>'productId')\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) row_data\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تكرار الصنف داخل جلسة التهيئة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Serialize concurrent retries that carry the same idempotency key.\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(\n    hashtextextended(TRIM(p_idempotency_key), 0)\n  );\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing_session\n  FROM public.inventory_opening_sessions\n  WHERE idempotency_key = TRIM(p_idempotency_key);\n\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n      'success', true,\n      'idempotentReplay', true,\n      'sessionId', v_existing_session.id,\n      'sessionNumber', v_existing_session.session_number,\n      'itemCount', v_existing_session.item_count,\n      'totalActualQuantity', v_existing_session.total_actual_quantity,\n      'message', 'تم اعتماد جلسة المخزون الافتتاحي سابقاً دون تكرار الحركات.'\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_warehouse\n  FROM public.warehouses\n  WHERE id = p_warehouse_id\n    AND is_active = true\n  FOR SHARE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المستودع المحدد غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_session_id := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_session_number :=\n    'IOS-' || TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' ||\n    LPAD(nextval('public.inventory_opening_session_number_seq')::TEXT, 6, '0');\n\n  INSERT INTO public.inventory_opening_sessions (\n    id,\n    session_number,\n    idempotency_key,\n    branch_id,\n    warehouse_id,\n    notes,\n    created_by\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_session_id,\n    v_session_number,\n    TRIM(p_idempotency_key),\n    v_warehouse.branch_id,\n    p_warehouse_id,\n    v_notes,\n    v_user_id\n  );\n\n  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)\n  LOOP\n    IF jsonb_typeof(v_row) <> 'object'\n      OR COALESCE(v_row->>'productId', '') = ''\n      OR COALESCE(v_row->>'packageCount', '') !~ '^\\d+$'\n      OR COALESCE(v_row->>'looseUnits', '') !~ '^\\d+$'\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات أحد الأصناف غير صحيحة.';\n    END IF;\n\n    v_product_id := (v_row->>'productId')::UUID;\n    v_package_count := (v_row->>'packageCount')::INTEGER;\n    v_loose_units := (v_row->>'looseUnits')::INTEGER;\n\n    SELECT\n      p.name_ar,\n      p.cost_price_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(pu.name_ar, bu.name_ar, 'طرد'),\n      COALESCE(bu.name_ar, 'قطعة'),\n      GREATEST(1, COALESCE(p.units_per_purchase_unit, 1))\n    INTO\n      v_product_name,\n      v_cost_price_in_minor_units,\n      v_purchase_package_name,\n      v_base_unit_name,\n      v_units_per_package\n    FROM public.products p\n    LEFT JOIN public.units bu ON bu.id = p.unit_id\n    LEFT JOIN public.units pu ON pu.id = p.purchase_unit_id\n    WHERE p.id = v_product_id\n      AND p.is_active = true\n    FOR SHARE OF p;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'أحد الأصناف غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_loose_units >= v_units_per_package THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION\n        'الحبات المتبقية للصنف (%) يجب أن تكون أقل من محتوى الطرد (%).',\n        v_product_name,\n        v_units_per_package;\n    END IF;\n\n    v_actual_quantity_big :=\n      v_package_count::BIGINT * v_units_per_package + v_loose_units;\n    IF v_actual_quantity_big > 2147483647 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'كمية الصنف (%) أكبر من الحد المسموح.', v_product_name;\n    END IF;\n    v_actual_quantity := v_actual_quantity_big::INTEGER;\n\n    IF v_actual_quantity > 0 AND v_cost_price_in_minor_units         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_order_parcel_composition_total()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_instance_id UUID;\n  v_instance_ids UUID[];\n  v_expected INTEGER;\n  v_actual BIGINT;\n  v_finalized_at TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_family_product_id UUID;\n  v_invalid_components BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'order_parcel_instances' THEN\n    v_instance_ids := ARRAY[NEW.id]::UUID[];\n  ELSIF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN\n    v_instance_ids := ARRAY[NEW.parcel_instance_id]::UUID[];\n  ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN\n    v_instance_ids := ARRAY[OLD.parcel_instance_id]::UUID[];\n  ELSE\n    v_instance_ids := ARRAY[\n      OLD.parcel_instance_id,\n      NEW.parcel_instance_id\n    ]::UUID[];\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_instance_id IN\n    SELECT DISTINCT affected.id\n    FROM UNNEST(v_instance_ids) AS affected(id)\n    WHERE affected.id IS NOT NULL\n  LOOP\n    SELECT units_per_parcel_snapshot, finalized_at, family_product_id\n    INTO v_expected, v_finalized_at, v_family_product_id\n    FROM public.order_parcel_instances\n    WHERE id = v_instance_id;\n\n    IF v_expected IS NULL THEN\n      CONTINUE;\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_finalized_at IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'order_parcel_instance_finalized_at_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'A configurable Parcel must be finalized before transaction commit.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT\n      COALESCE(SUM(component.base_quantity), 0),\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (\n        WHERE product.id IS NULL\n          OR product.is_flavor_master\n          OR COALESCE(product.flavor_master_product_id, product.id)\n            IS DISTINCT FROM v_family_product_id\n      )\n    INTO v_actual, v_invalid_components\n    FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n    LEFT JOIN public.products product ON product.id = component.product_id\n    WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = v_instance_id;\n\n    IF v_actual IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected::BIGINT THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'order_parcel_composition_total_check',\n        MESSAGE = FORMAT(\n          'Parcel composition total (%s) must equal its pack-size snapshot (%s).',\n          v_actual,\n          v_expected\n        );\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_invalid_components <> 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'order_parcel_component_family_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'Every Parcel component must belong to its immutable Family snapshot.';\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  RETURN NULL;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

operation.id = v_operation_id;\n\n  IF v_operation_type = 'supplier_receipt_v2' THEN\n    SELECT * INTO v_header FROM public.supplier_receipts receipt\n    WHERE receipt.operation_id = v_operation_id;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;\n\n    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_line_count\n    FROM public.supplier_receipt_commercial_lines line\n    WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id;\n    IF v_line_count = 0 OR EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.supplier_receipt_commercial_lines line\n      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n        SELECT\n          COALESCE(SUM(item.total_base_units), 0) AS quantity_total,\n          COALESCE(SUM(item.merchandise_net_cost_in_minor_units), 0) AS merchandise_total,\n          COALESCE(SUM(item.allocated_cost_in_minor_units), 0) AS acquisition_total\n        FROM public.supplier_receipt_items item\n        WHERE item.commercial_line_id = line.id\n      ) items ON true\n      WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id\n        AND (items.quantity_total <> line.received_base_unit_quantity\n          OR items.merchandise_total <> line.line_total_snapshot_in_minor_units\n          OR items.acquisition_total <> line.final_acquisition_amount_in_minor_units)\n    ) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'supplier_receipt_phase2_line_component_reconciliation_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_COMPONENT_RECONCILIATION_FAILED';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line.gross_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)\n        FROM public.supplier_receipt_commercial_lines line\n        WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id)\n          <> v_header.merchandise_gross_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line.discount_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)\n          FROM public.supplier_receipt_commercial_lines line\n          WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id)\n          <> v_header.line_discount_total_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line.allocated_header_discount_in_minor_units), 0)\n          FROM public.supplier_receipt_commercial_lines line\n          WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id)\n          <> v_header.header_discount_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line.allocated_supplier_freight_in_minor_units), 0)\n          FROM public.supplier_receipt_commercial_lines line\n          WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id)\n          <> v_header.supplier_freight_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line.final_acquisition_amount_in_minor_units), 0)\n          FROM public.supplier_receipt_commercial_lines line\n          WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id)\n          <> v_header.inventory_acquisition_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      OR (SELECT v_header.inventory_acquisition_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'supplier_receipt_phase2_financial_reconciliation_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_FINANCIAL_RECONCILIATION_FAILED';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_header.status = 'completed' THEN\n      SELECT COALESCE(SUM(payment.amount_in_minor_units), 0)\n      INTO     IF v_payment_total <> v_header.amount_paid_at_receipt_snapshot_in_minor_units THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n          CONSTRAINT = 'supplier_receipt_phase2_payment_reconciliation_check',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_FAILED';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF v_operation_type = 'purchase_order_receipt_v2' THEN\n    SELECT * INTO v_header FROM public.purchase_receipts receipt\n    WHERE receipt.operation_id = v_operation_id;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;\n\n    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_line_count\n    FROM public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines line\n    WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id;\n    IF v_line_count = 0 OR EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines line\n      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n        SELECT\n          COALESCE(SUM(item.received_quantity), 0) AS quantity_total,\n          COALESCE(SUM(item.merchandise_net_cost_in_minor_units), 0) AS merchandise_total,\n          COALESCE(SUM(item.allocated_cost_in_minor_units), 0) AS acquisition_total\n        FROM public.purchase_receipt_items item\n        WHERE item.commercial_line_id = line.id\n      ) items ON true\n      WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id\n        AND (items.quantity_total <> line.received_base_unit_quantity\n          OR items.merchandise_total <> line.line_net_merchandise_snapshot_in_minor_units\n          OR items.acquisition_total <> line.final_acquisition_amount_in_minor_units)\n    ) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'purchase_receipt_phase2_line_component_reconciliation_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_PURCHASE_RECEIPT_COMPONENT_RECONCILIATION_FAILED';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line.gross_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)\n        FROM public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines line\n        WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id)\n          <> v_header.merchandise_gross_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line.line_discount_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)\n          FROM public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines line\n          WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id)\n          <>        WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id)\n          <> v_header.header_discount_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line.allocated_supplier_freight_in_minor_units), 0)\n          FROM public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines line\n          WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id)\n          <> v_header.supplier_freight_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line.final_acquisition_amount_in_minor_units), 0)\n          FROM public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines line\n          WHERE line.operation_id = v_operation_id)\n          <> v_header.inventory_acquisition_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      OR (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(snapshot.allocated_acquisition_cost_in_minor_units), 0)\n          FROM public.phase2_receipt_wac_snapshots snapshot\n          WHERE snapshot.operation_id = v_operation_id)\n          <> v_header.inventory_acquisition_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'purchase_receipt_phase2_financial_reconciliation_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_PURCHASE_RECEIPT_FINANCIAL_RECONCILIATION_FAILED';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_header.status = v_header.id\n        AND payment.operation_id = v_operation_id\n        AND NOT payment.is_reversed;\n      IF v_payment_total <> v_header.amount_paid_at_receipt_snapshot_in_minor_units THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n          CONSTRAINT = 'purchase_receipt_phase2_payment_reconciliation_check',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_PURCHASE_RECEIPT_PAYMENT_RECONCILIATION_FAILED';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    RETURN NULL;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(movement.quantity), 0)\n  INTO v_movement_total\n  FROM public.inventory_movements movement\n  WHERE public.phase2_receipt_wac_snapshots snapshot\n    WHERE snapshot.operation_id = v_operation_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_inventory_movement_reconciliation_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_MOVEMENT_RECONCILIATION_FAILED';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NULL;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.attach_supplier_payment_to_open_shift()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_branch_id UUID;\n  v_shift_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.payment_method IS NULL\n    OR NEW.payment_method NOT IN ('cash', 'cliq')\n    OR NEW.cash_shift_id IS NOT NULL\n  THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    (SELECT branch_id FROM public.purchase_orders\n     WHERE id = NEW.purchase_order_id),\n    (SELECT branch_id FROM public.supplier_receipts\n     WHERE id = NEW.supplier_receipt_id)\n  ) INTO v_branch_id;\n\n  IF v_branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تعذر تحديد فرع دفعة المورد.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT id INTO v_shift_id\n  FROM public.cash_shifts\n  WHERE branch_id = v_branch_id\n    AND status = 'open'\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF v_shift_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'افتح وردية الصندوق أولًا قبل تسجيل دفعة مورد كاش أو CliQ.';\n  END IF;\n\n  NEW.cash_shift_id := v_shift_id;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authorize_admin_ai_assistant_request()\n RETURNS timestamp with time zone\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ := NOW();\n  v_requests_in_window INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب تسجيل الدخول لاستخدام مساعد الإدارة الذكي.'\n      USING ERRCODE = '28000';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'استخدام مساعد الإدارة الذكي'\n  );\n\n  -- Serialise checks per user so parallel browser requests cannot bypass the limit.\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_user_id::TEXT, 0));\n\n  DELETE FROM public.admin_ai_assistant_usage_events\n  WHERE created_at < v_now - INTERVAL '2 days';\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER\n    INTO v_requests_in_window\n  FROM public.admin_ai_assistant_usage_events\n  WHERE user_id = v_user_id\n    AND created_at >= v_now - INTERVAL '15 minutes';\n\n  IF v_requests_in_window >= 20 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تم بلوغ الحد المؤقت للمساعد. حاول بعد بضع دقائق.'\n      USING ERRCODE = '42901';\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.admin_ai_assistant_usage_events (user_id, created_at)\n  VALUES (v_user_id, v_now);\n\n  RETURN v_now;\nEND;\n$function$\n",
