        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authorize_guest_order_gateway(p_idempotency_key uuid, p_ip_hash text, p_session_hash text, p_phone_hash text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\n SET lock_timeout TO '3s'\n SET statement_timeout TO '5s'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_existing public.guest_order_gateway_requests%ROWTYPE;\n  v_lock_key TEXT;\n  v_ip_burst INTEGER;\n  v_ip_short INTEGER;\n  v_session_short INTEGER;\n  v_phone_short INTEGER;\n  v_decision TEXT := 'allowed';\n  v_reason TEXT := 'allowed';\n  v_retry_after INTEGER := 0;\n  v_existing_window INTERVAL;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_idempotency_key IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid gateway request.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF COALESCE(p_ip_hash, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n    OR COALESCE(p_session_hash, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n    OR COALESCE(p_phone_hash, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid gateway identifiers.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Every signal is locked in one deterministic order. This keeps the limit\n  -- atomic under concurrency without retaining raw network or customer data.\n  FOR v_lock_key IN\n    SELECT lock_key\n    FROM unnest(ARRAY[\n      'guest-order:idempotency:' || p_idempotency_key::TEXT,\n      'guest-order:ip:' || p_ip_hash,\n      'guest-order:phone:' || p_phone_hash,\n      'guest-order:session:' || p_session_hash\n    ]) AS lock_key\n    ORDER BY lock_key\n  LOOP\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_lock_key, 0));\n  END LOOP;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing\n  FROM public.guest_order_gateway_requests\n  WHERE idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing.ip_hash <> p_ip_hash\n      OR v_existing.session_hash <> p_session_hash\n      OR v_existing.phone_hash <> p_phone_hash\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Gateway retry context does not match.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_existing.decision = 'allowed' THEN\n      RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n        'allowed', true,\n        'reason', v_existing.reason,\n        'retry_after_seconds', 0,\n        'idempotent_replay', true\n      );\n    END IF;\n\n    v_existing_window := CASE v_existing.reason\n      WHEN 'ip_burst' THEN INTERVAL '1 minute'\n      WHEN 'ip_short_window' THEN INTERVAL '15 minutes'\n      ELSE INTERVAL '10 minutes'\n    END;\n\n    IF v_existing.created_at >= NOW() - v_existing_window THEN\n      RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n        'allowed', false,\n        'reason', v_existing.reason,\n        'retry_after_seconds', GREATEST(\n          1,\n          CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (\n            v_existing.created_at + v_existing_window - NOW()\n          )))::INTEGER\n        ),\n        'idempotent_replay', true\n      );\n    END IF;\n\n    -- A denied operation may be retried with the same business idempotency key\n    -- after its limit window. Successful operations remain immutable replays.\n    DELETE FROM public.guest_order_gateway_requests\n    WHERE id = v_existing.id;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n      WHERE ip_hash = p_ip_hash\n        AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute'\n    )::INTEGER,\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n      WHERE ip_hash = p_ip_hash\n        AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'\n    )::INTEGER,\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n      WHERE session_hash = p_session_hash\n        AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'\n    )::INTEGER,\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n      WHERE phone_hash = p_phone_hash\n        AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'\n    )::INTEGER\n  INTO v_ip_burst, v_ip_short, v_session_short, v_phone_short\n  FROM public.guest_order_gateway_requests\n  WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'\n    AND (\n      ip_hash = p_ip_hash\n      OR session_hash = p_session_hash\n      OR phone_hash = p_phone_hash\n    );\n\n  -- Limits intentionally allow a normal second order and several customers\n  -- behind one household/store network, while stopping identifier rotation.\n  IF v_ip_burst >= 6 THEN\n    v_decision := 'rate_limited';\n    v_reason := 'ip_burst';\n    v_retry_after := 60;\n  ELSIF v_ip_short >= 20 THEN\n    v_decision := 'rate_limited';\n    v_reason := 'ip_short_window';\n    v_retry_after := 900;\n  ELSIF v_session_short >= 4 THEN\n    v_decision := 'rate_limited';\n    v_reason := 'session_short_window';\n    v_retry_after := 600;\n  ELSIF v_phone_short >= 3 THEN\n    v_decision := 'rate_limited';\n    v_reason := 'phone_short_window';\n    v_retry_after := 600;\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.guest_order_gateway_requests (\n    idempotency_key,\n    ip_hash,\n    session_hash,\n    phone_hash,\n    decision,\n    reason,\n    outcome\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_idempotency_key,\n    p_ip_hash,\n    p_session_hash,\n    p_phone_hash,\n    v_decision,\n    v_reason,\n    CASE WHEN v_decision = 'allowed' THEN 'pending' ELSE 'rate_limited' END\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'allowed', v_decision = 'allowed',\n    'reason', v_reason,\n    'retry_after_seconds', v_retry_after,\n    'idempotent_replay', false\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.build_public_order_tracking_payload(p_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_timeline JSONB;\n  v_item_count INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT o.*\n  INTO v_order\n  FROM public.orders o\n  WHERE o.id = p_order_id\n    AND o.source = 'website';\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n      'success', false,\n      'message', 'لم نعثر على طلب مطابق.'\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER\n  INTO v_item_count\n  FROM public.order_items\n  WHERE order_id = v_order.id;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    jsonb_agg(\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'status', history.status,\n        'created_at', history.created_at\n      )\n      ORDER BY history.created_at\n    ),\n    '[]'::jsonb\n  )\n  INTO v_timeline\n  FROM (\n    SELECT osh.new_status AS status, osh.created_at\n    FROM public.order_status_history osh\n    WHERE osh.order_id = v_order.id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'new'::TEXT, v_order.created_at\n    WHERE NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.order_status_history osh\n      WHERE osh.order_id = v_order.id\n        AND osh.new_status = 'new'\n    )\n  ) history;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'order_number', v_order.order_number,\n    'status', v_order.status,\n    'payment_method', v_order.payment_method,\n    'payment_status', v_order.payment_status,\n    'total', v_order.total_in_minor_units,\n    'item_count', v_item_count,\n    'created_at', v_order.created_at,\n    'updated_at', v_order.updated_at,\n    'delivery_started_at', v_order.delivery_started_at,\n    'estimated_arrival_at', v_order.estimated_arrival_at,\n    'delivery_completed_at', v_order.delivery_completed_at,\n    'driver_phone', v_order.delivery_driver_phone,\n    'tracking_token', v_order.tracking_token,\n    'tracking_path', '/#track=' || v_order.tracking_token::TEXT,\n    'timeline', v_timeline\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cancel_customer_order_v2(p_order_id uuid, p_idempotency_key text, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_key TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), '');\n  v_actor_hash TEXT;\n  v_request JSONB;\n  v_fingerprint TEXT;\n  v_replay JSONB;\n  v_operation_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'], 'إلغاء طلب عميل V2'\n  );\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL OR v_key IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_IDEMPOTENCY_INPUT_INVALID: Cancellation identity is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n  v_actor_hash := public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal(\n    'erp_user', v_user_id, NULL, NULL\n  );\n  v_request := JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'contract_version', 'phase3-customer-cancellation-v1',\n    'actor_scope_hash', v_actor_hash, 'order_id', LOWER(p_order_id::TEXT),\n    'reason', NULLIF(BTRIM(p_reason), '')\n  );\n  v_fingerprint := public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(v_request);\n  v_replay := public.phase3_resolve_operation_replay_internal(\n    'phase3_customer_cancellation_v1', v_key, 'erp_user',\n    v_actor_hash, v_fingerprint\n  );\n  IF v_replay->>'decision' = 'REPLAY' THEN\n    RETURN v_replay->'result_snapshot';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN public.phase3_release_customer_reservations_internal(\n    p_order_id, v_operation_id, 'phase3_customer_cancellation_v1', v_key,\n    v_fingerprint, v_request, 'erp_user', v_actor_hash, v_user_id,\n    'cancelled', COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_reason), ''), 'إلغاء طلب عميل V2')\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

v_request:=jsonb_build_object('action',p_kind,'cheque',p_cheque_id,'version',p_expected_version,'reason',v_reason);\n  v_replay:=public.cheque_replay_internal(p_key,v_request);IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_replay;END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_before FROM public.deferred_cheques WHERE id=p_cheque_id;\n  IF v_before.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('go-live-collection-customer:'||v_before.customer_id::TEXT,0));\n  END IF;\n  v_supplier:=COALESCE(v_before.endorsed_supplier_id,v_before.supplier_id);\n  IF v_supplier IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=v_supplier FOR UPDATE;END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_c FROM public.deferred_cheques WHERE id=p_cheque_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF amount_in_minor_units,original_debt_at,origin_kind,reason,created_by)\n  SELECT v_c.id,a.id,a.party_kind,a.party_id,p_kind,\n    CASE WHEN p_kind='cancelled' THEN 'إلغاء تسجيل شيك رقم ' ELSE 'شيك راجع         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cheque_customer_claim_lane_internal(p_claim_id uuid)\n RETURNS integer\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  WITH RECURSIVE provenance AS (\n    SELECT c.id,c.origin_kind,a.origin_id,ARRAY[c.id] path\n    FROM public.cheque_compensation_claims c JOIN public.deferred_cheque_allocations a ON a.id=c.source_allocation_id\n    WHERE c.id=p_claim_id AND c.party_kind='customer'\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT c.id,c.origin_kind,a.origin_id,p.path||c.id\n    FROM provenance p JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims c ON c.id=p.origin_id\n    JOIN public.deferred_cheque_allocations a ON a.id=c.source_allocation_id\n    WHERE p.origin_kind='compensation' AND NOT c.id=ANY(p.path)\n  ) SELECT CASE WHEN origin_kind IN ('opening','opening_cheque') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END\n    FROM provenance ORDER BY cardinality(path) DESC LIMIT 1;\n$function$\n",

Capture the same report consumers see, inside this transaction.\n  v_snapshot := public._get_cash_shift_closing_report_before_snapshot(p_shift_id)\n    || jsonb_build_object(\n      'snapshotStatus', 'immutable',\n      'snapshotVersion', 1\n    );\n  IF COALESCE(v_snapshot->>'success', 'false') <> 'true' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تعذر إنشاء لقطة تقرير الإغلاق؛ تم إلغاء إغلاق الوردية بأمان.';\n  END IF;\n  v_section := public.owner_withdrawal_closing_section_internal(p_shift_id);\n  IF jsonb_array_length(v_section->'items') > 0 THEN\n    v_section := v_section || jsonb_build_object('netMovementAfterWithdrawalsInMinorUnits',\n      (v_snapshot #>> '{reconciliation,netMovementInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT\n        - (v_section->>'netInMinorUnits')::BIGINT);\n    v_snapshot := v_snapshot || jsonb_build_object('ownerWithdrawals', v_section);\n  END IF;\n  v_section:=public.cheque_shift_settlement_section_internal(p_shift_id);\n  IF jsonb_array_length(v_section->'items')>0 THEN\n    v_snapshot:=v_snapshot||jsonb_build_object('chequeCompensationSettlements',v_section);\n  END IF;\n  UPDATE public.cash_shifts\n  SET closing_report_snapshot = v_snapshot,\n      closing_report_snapshotted_at = NOW(),\n      closing_report_snapshot_version = 1,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_shift_id\n    AND status = 'closed'\n    AND closing_report_snapshot IS NULL;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تعذر تثبيت لقطة تقرير الإغلاق؛ تم إلغاء العملية بأمان.';\n  END IF;\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n  ) VALUES (\n    auth.uid(),\n    'CAPTURE_CASH_SHIFT_CLOSING_REPORT_SNAPSHOT',\n    'cash_shifts',\n    p_shift_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'snapshot_version', 1,\n      'snapshot_bytes', octet_length(v_snapshot::TEXT),\n      'captured_at', NOW()\n    )\n  );\n  RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object(\n    'closingReportSnapshotCaptured', true\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.collect_customer_balance_v1(p_customer_id uuid, p_amount_in_minor_units bigint, p_payment_method text, p_branch_id uuid, p_reference_number text, p_notes text, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID:=auth.uid();v_key TEXT:=NULLIF(BTRIM(p_idempotency_key),'');\n  v_existing public.customer_collection_operations%ROWTYPE;v_operation public.customer_collection_operations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_plan JSONB;v_locked_plan JSONB;v_part JSONB;v_opening BIGINT;v_orders BIGINT;v_comp BIGINT;\n  v_shift_id UUID;v_payment JSONB;v_id UUID;v_cheque_id UUID;\n  v_notes TEXT:=NULLIF(BTRIM(p_notes),'');v_reference TEXT:=NULLIF(BTRIM(p_reference_number),'');v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_payment_method='cheque' THEN\n    PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','accountant','cashier','sales'],'استلام شيك عميل');\n    SELECT id INTO v_cheque_id FROM public.deferred_cheques WHERE customer_id=p_customer_id\n      AND direction='incoming' AND origin='operational' AND status='pending' AND created_by=v_user_id\n      AND registration_txid=txid_current() AND collection_operation_id IS NULL\n      AND amount_in_minor_units=p_amount_in_minor_units AND v_key='cheque-collect-'||id::TEXT;\n    IF v_cheque_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CHEQUE_REQUIRES_UNIFIED_COLLECTION: سجّل بيانات الشيك كاملة أولاً.';END IF;\n  ELSE\n    PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','accountant','cashier','sales'],'تحصيل من الزبون');\n  END IF;\n  IF v_key IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 120 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مفتاح منع تكرار التحصيل غير صالح.';END IF;\n  IF p_payment_method IS NULL OR p_payment_method NOT IN ('cash','cliq','bank_transfer','cheque') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'طريقة الدفع غير معتمدة.';END IF;\n  IF COALESCE(p_amount_in_minor_units,0)<=0 OR p_amount_in_minor_units>999999999999 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ التحصيل يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر.';END IF;\n  IF v_notes IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_notes)>300 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الملاحظة أطول من 300 حرف.';END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('go-live-collection:'||v_key,0));\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.customer_collection_operations WHERE idempotency_key=v_key;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing.customer_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id OR v_existing.amount_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM p_amount_in_minor_units\n      OR v_existing.payment_method IS DISTINCT FROM p_payment_method THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'GO_LIVE_COLLECTION_KEY_CONFLICT: مفتاح التحصيل استُخدم لعملية مختلفة.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN public.go_live_collection_result_internal(v_existing.id)||jsonb_build_object('idempotentReplay',true);\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.customers WHERE id=p_customer_id AND NOT is_deleted) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'العميل غير موجود.';END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('go-live-collection-customer:'||p_customer_id::TEXT,0));\n  v_plan:=public.go_live_plan_customer_collection_internal(p_customer_id,p_amount_in_minor_units);\n  -- Plan every order lock BEFORE any shift/row lock. Same Phase4 key as all\n  -- order writers. Cash shifts then orders are acquired in stable UUID order.\n  FOR v_id IN SELECT DISTINCT(value->>'id')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'parts')\n    WHERE value->>'kind'='order' AND(value->>'allocateInMinorUnits')::BIGINT>0 ORDER BY 1\n  LOOP PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('phase4-order|'||v_id::TEXT,0));END LOOP;\n  IF p_payment_method IN ('cash','cliq') THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts s WHERE s.status='open' AND(\n      s.branch_id=p_branch_id OR s.branch_id IN(SELECT o.branch_id FROM public.orders o\n        JOIN jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'parts')p ON o.id=(p.value->>'id')::UUID\n        WHERE p.value->>'kind'='order' AND(p.value->>'allocateInMinorUnits')::BIGINT>0)) ORDER BY s.id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders o JOIN jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'parts')p ON o.id=(p.value->>'id')::UUID\n    WHERE p.value->>'kind'='order' AND(p.value->>'allocateInMinorUnits')::BIGINT>0 ORDER BY o.id FOR UPDATE OF o;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.customer_opening_balances WHERE customer_id=p_customer_id AND NOT is_reversed ORDER BY occurred_at,entry_number FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.cheque_compensation_claims WHERE party_kind='customer' AND party_id=p_customer_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  v_locked_plan:=public.go_live_plan_customer_collection_internal(p_customer_id,p_amount_in_minor_units);\n  IF v_locked_plan IS DISTINCT FROM v_plan THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='CHEQUE_COLLECTION_PLAN_CHANGED: تغيرت خطة الدين قبل الأقفال؛ أعد المعاينة.';END IF;\n  IF p_amount_in_minor_units>(v_plan->>'totalOutstandingInMinorUnits')::BIGINT THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'GO_LIVE_COLLECTION_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: المبلغ أكبر من مجموع دين العميل (% د.أ).',\n      ((v_plan->>'totalOutstandingInMinorUnits')::NUMERIC/1000)::TEXT;\n  END IF;\n  v_opening:=(v_plan->>'openingAllocatedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT;v_orders:=(v_plan->>'ordersAllocatedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT;\n  v_comp:=(v_plan->>'compensationAllocatedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT;\n  IF v_opening+v_comp>0 AND p_payment_method IN ('cash','cliq') THEN\n    IF p_branch_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.branches WHERE id=p_branch_id AND is_active) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'حدد فرع الوردية لتحصيل الدين كاش أو CliQ.';\n    END IF;\n    SELECT id INTO v_shift_id FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE branch_id=p_branch_id AND status='open' FOR SHARE;\n    IF v_shift_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'افتح وردية الصندوق أولًا قبل تسجيل سند قبض كاش أو CliQ.';END IF;\n  END IF;\n  INSERT INTO public.customer_collection_operations(operation_number,customer_id,amount_in_minor_units,\n    opening_amount_in_minor_units,orders_amount_in_minor_units,compensation_amount_in_minor_units,payment_method,\n    reference_number,notes,branch_id,cash_shift_id,idempotency_key,created_by)\n  VALUES('COL-'||LPAD(nextval('public.customer_collection_operation_number_seq')::TEXT,6,'0'),p_customer_id,\n    p_amount_in_minor_units,v_opening,v_orders,v_comp,p_payment_method,v_reference,v_notes,\n    CASE WHEN v_shift_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p_branch_id END,v_shift_id,v_key,v_user_id) RETURNING * INTO v_operation;\n  FOR v_part IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'parts') WHERE(value->>'allocateInMinorUnits')::BIGINT>0\n  LOOP\n    IF v_part->>'kind'='opening' THEN\n      INSERT INTO public.customer_collection_opening_allocations(operation_id,opening_balance_id,amount_in_minor_units)\n      VALUES(v_operation.id,(v_part->>'id')::UUID,(v_part->>'allocateInMinorUnits')::BIGINT);\n    ELSIF v_part->>'kind'='compensation' THEN\n      INSERT INTO public.customer_collection_cheque_allocations(operation_id,claim_id,amount_in_minor_units)\n      VALUES(v_operation.id,(v_part->>'id')::UUID,(v_part->>'allocateInMinorUnits')::BIGINT);\n    ELSE\n      v_payment:=public.record_customer_order_payment_once((v_part->>'id')::UUID,(v_part->>'allocateInMinorUnits')::BIGINT,\n        p_payment_method,v_reference,COALESCE(v_notes||' — ','')||'تحصيل موحد '||v_operation.operation_number,\n        'golive-col-'||md5(v_key||':'||(v_part->>'id')));\n      INSERT INTO public.customer_collection_order_payments(operation_id,customer_payment_id,order_id,amount_in_minor_units)\n      VALUES(v_operation.id,(v_payment->>'payment_id')::UUID,(v_part->>'id')::UUID,(v_part->>'allocateInMinorUnits')::BIGINT);\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  v_result:=public.go_live_collection_result_internal(v_operation.id);\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id,action,entity_name,entity_id,details)\n  VALUES(v_user_id,'CUSTOMER_UNIFIED_COLLECTION','customer_collection_operations',v_operation.id,\n    jsonb_build_object('operation_number',v_operation.operation_number,'customer_id',p_customer_id,\n      'amount_in_minor_units',p_amount_in_minor_units,'payment_method',p_payment_method,\n      'opening_amount_in_minor_units',v_opening,'orders_amount_in_minor_units',v_orders,\n      'compensation_amount_in_minor_units',v_comp,'cash_shift_id',v_shift_id,'parts',v_result->'parts'));\n  RETURN v_result||jsonb_build_object('idempotentReplay',false);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_automation_delivery(p_event_id uuid, p_channel text, p_success boolean, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF lower(trim(coalesce(p_channel,'')))='telegram' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='OWNER_TELEGRAM_EDGE_CONSUMER_REQUIRED';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN public.owner217_complete_delivery_internal(p_event_id,p_channel,p_success,p_error);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_order(p_order_id uuid, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY[\n      'owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales', 'warehouse_keeper',\n      'delivery_driver'\n    ],\n    'إكمال الطلبات وخصم المخزون'\n  );\n  PERFORM public.phase3_assert_legacy_customer_lifecycle_allowed_internal(p_order_id);\n  RETURN public._complete_order_impl(p_order_id, p_notes);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_owner_telegram_delivery_v1(p_run_id uuid, p_event_id uuid, p_success boolean, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.owner_telegram_dispatch_settings\n    WHERE id AND enabled AND run_id=p_run_id AND lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_TELEGRAM_LEASE_LOST'; END IF;\n  IF p_success IS NULL OR p_error IS NOT NULL AND p_error NOT IN\n    ('OWNER_TELEGRAM_DELIVERY_FAILED','OWNER_BUSINESS_EVENT_NOT_ALLOWED') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_TELEGRAM_COMPLETION_CODE_REQUIRED';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.automation_event_deliveries\n    WHERE event_id=p_event_id AND channel='telegram' AND status='processing'\n      AND lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_TELEGRAM_EVENT_LEASE_LOST'; END IF;\n  RETURN public.owner217_complete_delivery_internal(p_event_id,'telegram',p_success,\n    CASE WHEN p_success THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(p_error,'OWNER_TELEGRAM_DELIVERY_FAILED') END);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_website_order_with_payment(p_order_id uuid, p_payment_method text, p_reference_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_order RECORD;\n  v_payment_method TEXT := LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(p_payment_method), ''));\n  v_shift_id UUID;\n  v_shift_number TEXT;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'تأكيد قبض وتسليم طلب الموقع'\n  );\n\n  IF v_payment_method = 'cash_on_delivery' THEN\n    v_payment_method := 'cash';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_payment_method NOT IN ('cash', 'cliq') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طريقة التحصيل يجب أن تكون كاش أو CliQ.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_payment_method = 'cliq'\n    AND NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), '') IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم مرجع عملية CliQ مطلوب قبل تأكيد القبض.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(TRIM(p_reference_number), '')) > 120 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم مرجع الدفع أطول من الحد المسموح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT\n    id,\n    order_number,\n    branch_id,\n    source,\n    status,\n    payment_method,\n    total_in_minor_units\n  INTO v_order\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_order.source = 'pos' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طلبات البيع المباشر تُحصّل من شاشة نقطة البيع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_order.status NOT IN ('ready', 'out_for_delivery') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'لا يمكن تأكيد قبض الطلب في حالته الحالية (%).',\n      v_order.status;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_order.branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تحصيل الطلب دون فرع محدد.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Serialize collection with shift closing. Either this collection belongs to\n  -- the current shift, or the operator must open a new shift after closing.\n  SELECT id, shift_number\n  INTO v_shift_id, v_shift_number\n  FROM public.cash_shifts\n  WHERE branch_id = v_order.branch_id\n    AND status = 'open'\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'افتح وردية الصندوق أولاً قبل تأكيد قبض وتسليم الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET\n    payment_method = CASE\n      WHEN v_payment_method = 'cash' THEN 'cash_on_delivery'\n      ELSE 'cliq'\n    END,\n    payment_reference_number = CASE\n      WHEN v_payment_method = 'cliq'\n        THEN NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), '')\n      ELSE NULL\n    END,\n    payment_confirmed_at = NOW(),\n    payment_confirmed_by = v_user_id,\n    cash_shift_id = v_shift_id,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n\n  -- Reuse the canonical inventory/status implementation. Any failure rolls\n  -- back the collection and shift link in this same transaction.\n  v_result := public.complete_order(\n    p_order_id,\n    COALESCE(\n      NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), ''),\n      CASE\n        WHEN v_payment_method = 'cliq'\n          THEN 'تم التسليم وتأكيد استلام تحويل CliQ'\n        ELSE 'تم التسليم وتأكيد استلام الكاش'\n      END\n    )\n  );\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'CONFIRM_WEBSITE_ORDER_PAYMENT',\n    'orders',\n    p_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'order_number', v_order.order_number,\n      'payment_method', v_payment_method,\n      'payment_reference_number',\n        CASE WHEN v_payment_method = 'cliq'\n          THEN NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), '') ELSE NULL END,\n      'amount_in_minor_units', v_order.total_in_minor_units,\n      'cash_shift_id', v_shift_id,\n      'cash_shift_number', v_shift_number\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object(\n    'payment_method',\n      CASE WHEN v_payment_method = 'cash'\n        THEN 'cash_on_delivery' ELSE 'cliq' END,\n    'payment_status', 'paid',\n    'payment_reference_number',\n      CASE WHEN v_payment_method = 'cliq'\n        THEN NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), '') ELSE NULL END,\n    'cash_shift_id', v_shift_id,\n    'cash_shift_number', v_shift_number,\n    'message', 'تم تأكيد القبض والتسليم وخصم المخزون وربط العملية بالوردية.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_website_order_with_settlement(p_order_id uuid, p_payment_method text, p_amount_collected_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_reference_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'تسليم الطلب وتسجيل التحصيل والذمة'\n  );\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_customer_order_context_internal(\n    p_order_id,\n    LOWER(COALESCE(p_payment_method, '')) NOT IN ('debt', ''),\n    true\n  );\n  RETURN public._complete_website_order_with_settlement_before_phase4_lock(\n    p_order_id, p_payment_method, p_amount_collected_in_minor_units,\n    p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units, p_reference_number, p_notes\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.correct_product_cost_v1(p_product_id uuid, p_unit_cost_in_minor_units numeric, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_reason TEXT := BTRIM(COALESCE(p_reason, ''));\n  v_key TEXT := BTRIM(COALESCE(p_idempotency_key, ''));\n  v_exact NUMERIC(24, 6);\n  v_legacy BIGINT;\n  v_fingerprint TEXT;\n  v_existing public.product_cost_corrections%ROWTYPE;\n  v_product public.products%ROWTYPE;\n  v_correction_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'تصحيح تكلفة المنتج');\n\n  IF char_length(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRODUCT_COST_CORRECTION_KEY_INVALID: مفتاح العملية غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF char_length(v_reason) NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRODUCT_COST_CORRECTION_REASON_REQUIRED: اكتب سبب التصحيح (5 إلى 500 حرف).';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_unit_cost_in_minor_units IS NULL OR p_unit_cost_in_minor_units < 0\n    OR p_unit_cost_in_minor_units > 1000000000000 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRODUCT_COST_CORRECTION_VALUE_INVALID: تكلفة الحبة يجب أن تكون صفراً أو أكثر.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_exact := ROUND(p_unit_cost_in_minor_units, 6);\n  v_legacy := ROUND(v_exact)::BIGINT;\n  v_fingerprint := md5(p_product_id::TEXT || '|' || v_exact::TEXT || '|' || v_reason);\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing\n  FROM public.product_cost_corrections correction\n  WHERE correction.idempotency_key = v_key;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing.request_fingerprint <> v_fingerprint THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRODUCT_COST_CORRECTION_KEY_CONFLICT: استُخدم مفتاح العملية لتصحيح مختلف.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n      'success', true,\n      'idempotentReplay', true,\n      'correctionId', v_existing.id,\n      'productId', v_existing.product_id,\n      'priorExactInMinorUnits', v_existing.prior_exact_in_minor_units::TEXT,\n      'priorCostPriceInMinorUnits', v_existing.prior_cost_price_in_minor_units,\n      'newExactInMinorUnits', v_existing.new_exact_in_minor_units::TEXT,\n      'newCostPriceInMinorUnits', v_existing.new_cost_price_in_minor_units,\n      'updatedAt', (SELECT product.updated_at FROM public.products product WHERE product.id = v_existing.product_id)\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_product\n  FROM public.products product\n  WHERE product.id = p_product_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المنتج المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_product.is_flavor_master THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRODUCT_COST_CORRECTION_FLAVOR_MASTER: المنتج الأساسي للنكهات بلا مخزون؛ صحّح تكلفة النكهة نفسها.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.products\n  SET\n    wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact = v_exact,\n    cost_price_in_minor_units = v_legacy,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_product_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.product_cost_corrections (\n    product_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint,\n    prior_exact_in_minor_units, prior_cost_price_in_minor_units,\n    new_exact_in_minor_units, new_cost_price_in_minor_units,\n    reason, created_by\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_product_id, v_key, v_fingerprint,\n    v_product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact, v_product.cost_price_in_minor_units,\n    v_exact, v_legacy,\n    v_reason, auth.uid()\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_correction_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n  VALUES (\n    auth.uid(),\n    'CORRECT_PRODUCT_COST',\n    'products',\n    p_product_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'correction_id', v_correction_id,\n      'reason', v_reason,\n      'prior_exact_in_minor_units', v_product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,\n      'prior_cost_price_in_minor_units', v_product.cost_price_in_minor_units,\n      'new_exact_in_minor_units', v_exact,\n      'new_cost_price_in_minor_units', v_legacy\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'idempotentReplay', false,\n    'correctionId', v_correction_id,\n    'productId', p_product_id,\n    'priorExactInMinorUnits', v_product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact::TEXT,\n    'priorCostPriceInMinorUnits', v_product.cost_price_in_minor_units,\n    'newExactInMinorUnits', v_exact::TEXT,\n    'newCostPriceInMinorUnits', v_legacy,\n    'updatedAt', (SELECT product.updated_at FROM public.products product WHERE product.id = p_product_id)\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.correction207_assert_role_internal(p_action text)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF p_action IN ('pos_sale','supplier_payment') THEN\n    RETURN public.assert_reversal_owner('تصحيح مستند مالي');\n  ELSIF p_action='customer_payment' THEN\n    PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','accountant'],'عكس سند قبض عميل');\n  ELSIF p_action='purchase_receipt' THEN\n    PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','warehouse_keeper'],'إلغاء سند استلام أمر شراء');\n  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_ACTION_INVALID: إجراء التصحيح غير معتمد.';\n  END IF;\n  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_AUTH_REQUIRED'; END IF;\n  RETURN auth.uid();\nEND; $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_customer_order_base_units_legacy(p_customer_full_name text, p_customer_phone text, p_customer_email text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_governorate text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_city text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_area text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_street text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_building text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_floor text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_apartment text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_address_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_latitude double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_longitude double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_formatted_address text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_google_maps_url text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_location_source text DEFAULT 'manual'::text, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_items jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_discount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_customer_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_internal_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_source text DEFAULT 'website'::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_customer_id UUID;\n  v_customer_is_blocked BOOLEAN;\n  v_customer_is_active BOOLEAN;\n  v_customer_reused BOOLEAN := false;\n  v_customer_phone TEXT :=\n    public.normalize_customer_phone(p_customer_phone);\n  v_address_id UUID;\n  v_branch_id UUID := p_branch_id;\n  v_warehouse_id UUID := p_warehouse_id;\n  v_order_id UUID;\n  v_order_number TEXT;\n  v_item JSONB;\n  v_prod_id UUID;\n  v_qty INT;\n  v_prod_name TEXT;\n  v_prod_sku TEXT;\n  v_unit_price BIGINT;\n  v_is_active BOOLEAN;\n  v_on_hand INT;\n  v_reserved INT;\n  v_available INT;\n  v_line_total BIGINT;\n  v_subtotal BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total BIGINT;\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_formatted_address TEXT;\n  v_google_maps_url TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF NULLIF(TRIM(p_customer_full_name), '') IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'اسم العميل مطلوب ولا يمكن أن يكون فارغاً.';\n  END IF;\n  IF NULLIF(v_customer_phone, '') IS NULL\n    OR v_customer_phone !~ '^[0-9]{9,15}$'\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم هاتف العميل غير صحيح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_items IS NULL\n    OR jsonb_typeof(p_items) <> 'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سلة الطلب فارغة، يجب تقديم صنف واحد على الأقل.';\n  END IF;\n  IF COALESCE(p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units, 0) < 0\n    OR COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0) < 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رسوم التوصيل والخصم لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF COALESCE(p_location_source, 'manual')\n    NOT IN ('gps', 'map_pin', 'manual')\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مصدر موقع التوصيل غير معتمد.';\n  END IF;\n  IF (p_latitude IS NULL) <> (p_longitude IS NULL) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب إدخال خط العرض وخط الطول معاً.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_latitude IS NOT NULL\n    AND (\n      p_latitude NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90\n      OR p_longitude NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180\n    )\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'إحداثيات موقع التوصيل غير صحيحة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    SELECT id\n    INTO v_branch_id\n    FROM public.branches\n    WHERE is_active = true\n    ORDER BY created_at ASC\n    LIMIT 1;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_warehouse_id IS NULL THEN\n    SELECT id\n    INTO v_warehouse_id\n    FROM public.warehouses\n    WHERE is_active = true\n    ORDER BY created_at ASC\n    LIMIT 1;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_warehouse_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لم يتم العثور على مستودع فعال لمعالجة الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- One transaction at a time may resolve a specific customer phone.\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(v_customer_phone)::BIGINT);\n\n  SELECT id, is_blocked, is_active\n  INTO\n    v_customer_id,\n    v_customer_is_blocked,\n    v_customer_is_active\n  FROM public.customers\n  WHERE public.normalize_customer_phone(phone) = v_customer_phone\n    AND is_deleted = false\n  LIMIT 1\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF v_customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    IF v_customer_is_blocked OR NOT v_customer_is_active THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION\n        'لا يمكن إنشاء طلب لهذا العميل لأن ملفه موقوف أو محظور.';\n    END IF;\n\n    v_customer_reused := true;\n\n    UPDATE public.customers\n    SET\n      full_name = TRIM(p_customer_full_name),\n      phone = v_customer_phone,\n      email = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_customer_email), ''), email),\n      governorate = COALESCE(\n        NULLIF(TRIM(p_governorate), ''),\n        governorate\n      ),\n      updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE id = v_customer_id;\n  ELSE\n    INSERT INTO public.customers (\n      full_name,\n      phone,\n      email,\n      governorate,\n      customer_type,\n      is_active,\n      is_blocked,\n      is_deleted\n    ) VALUES (\n      TRIM(p_customer_full_name),\n      v_customer_phone,\n      NULLIF(TRIM(p_customer_email), ''),\n      NULLIF(TRIM(p_governorate), ''),\n      'retail',\n      true,\n      false,\n      false\n    )\n    RETURNING id INTO v_customer_id;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- The latest website delivery address becomes the single default address.\n  UPDATE public.customer_addresses\n  SET is_default = false\n  WHERE customer_id = v_customer_id\n    AND is_default = true;\n\n  v_formatted_address := COALESCE(\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_formatted_address), ''),\n    NULLIF(\n      CONCAT_WS(\n        ' - ',\n        NULLIF(TRIM(p_governorate), ''),\n        NULLIF(TRIM(p_city), ''),\n        NULLIF(TRIM(p_area), ''),\n        NULLIF(TRIM(p_street), ''),\n        NULLIF(TRIM(p_building), '')\n      ),\n      ''\n    )\n  );\n  v_google_maps_url := COALESCE(\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_google_maps_url), ''),\n    CASE\n      WHEN p_latitude IS NOT NULL AND p_longitude IS NOT NULL\n      THEN\n        'https://www.google.com/maps?q='\n        || p_latitude::TEXT\n        || ','\n        || p_longitude::TEXT\n      ELSE NULL\n    END\n  );\n\n  INSERT INTO public.customer_addresses (\n    customer_id,\n    governorate,\n    city,\n    area,\n    street,\n    building,\n    floor,\n    apartment,\n    notes,\n    latitude,\n    longitude,\n    formatted_address,\n    google_maps_url,\n    location_source,\n    location_confirmed,\n    is_default\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_customer_id,\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_governorate), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_city), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_area), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_street), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_building), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_floor), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_apartment), ''),\n    NULLIF(TRIM(p_address_notes), ''),\n    p_latitude,\n    p_longitude,\n    v_formatted_address,\n    v_google_maps_url,\n    COALESCE(p_location_source, 'manual'),\n    p_latitude IS NOT NULL AND p_longitude IS NOT NULL,\n    true\n  )\n  RETURNING id INTO v_address_id;\n\n  -- Prices and availability are canonical and locked server-side.\n  FOR v_item IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)\n  LOOP\n    BEGIN\n      v_prod_id := (v_item->>'product_id')::UUID;\n      v_qty := (v_item->>'quantity')::INT;\n    EXCEPTION\n      WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات صنف الطلب غير صحيحة.';\n    END;\n\n    IF v_prod_id IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'معرف المنتج مفقود في عناصر الطلب.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_qty IS NULL OR v_qty <= 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'كمية المنتج يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT name_ar, sku, sale_price_in_minor_units, is_active\n    INTO v_prod_name, v_prod_sku, v_unit_price, v_is_active\n    FROM public.products\n    WHERE id = v_prod_id;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION\n        'المنتج المحدد برقم (%) غير موجود في النظام.',\n        v_prod_id;\n    END IF;\n    IF NOT v_is_active THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION\n        'المنتج (%) غير نشط حالياً ولا يمكن طلبه.',\n        v_prod_name;\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT on_hand_quantity, reserved_quantity\n    INTO v_on_hand, v_reserved\n    FROM public.inventory_balances\n    WHERE warehouse_id = v_warehouse_id\n      AND product_id = v_prod_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION\n        'المنتج (%) غير مسجل له رصيد في المستودع المحدد.',\n        v_prod_name;\n    END IF;\n\n    v_available := v_on_hand - v_reserved;\n    IF v_available < v_qty THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION\n        'الكمية المتاحة للمنتج (%) غير كافية. المتاح: %، المطلوب: %.',\n        v_prod_name,\n        v_available,\n        v_qty;\n    END IF;\n\n    v_line_total := v_unit_price * v_qty;\n    v_subtotal := v_subtotal + v_line_total;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  v_total :=\n    v_subtotal\n    + COALESCE(p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units, 0)\n    - COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0);\n\n  IF v_total < 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'قيمة الخصم أكبر من إجمالي الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  LOOP\n    v_order_number :=\n      'ORD-'\n      || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD')\n      || '-'\n      || LPAD(\n        (FLOOR(RANDOM() * 89999 + 10000))::TEXT,\n        5,\n        '0'\n      );\n    EXIT WHEN NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_draft_purchase_order(p_purchase_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_purchase_order_number TEXT;\n  v_status TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager'],\n    'حذف أوامر الشراء'\n  );\n\n  SELECT purchase_order_number, status\n  INTO v_purchase_order_number, v_status\n  FROM public.purchase_orders\n  WHERE id = p_purchase_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'أمر الشراء المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_status <> 'draft' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يمكن حذف أمر الشراء عندما تكون حالته مسودة فقط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  DELETE FROM public.purchase_orders\n  WHERE id = p_purchase_order_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'DELETE_DRAFT_PURCHASE_ORDER',\n    'purchase_orders',\n    p_purchase_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'purchase_order_number', v_purchase_order_number\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'purchase_order_id', p_purchase_order_id,\n    'purchase_order_number', v_purchase_order_number\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.endorse_customer_cheque_v1(p_cheque_id uuid, p_supplier_id uuid, p_expected_version integer, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_c public.deferred_cheques%ROWTYPE;v_plan JSONB;v_request JSONB;v_replay JSONB;v_payment UUID;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','manager'],'تجيير شيك لمورد');\n  v_request:=jsonb_build_object('action','endorse','cheque',p_cheque_id,'supplier',p_supplier_id,'version',p_expected_version);\n  v_replay:=public.cheque_replay_internal(p_idempotency_key,v_request);IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_replay;END IF;\n  -- Supplier before cheque; no order/payment/shift locks are discovered later.\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=p_supplier_id AND is_active FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'المورد غير موجود أو غير نشط.';END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_c FROM public.deferred_cheques WHERE id=p_cheque_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF v_c.version IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_version OR v_c.direction<>'incoming' OR v_c.status<>'pending' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CHEQUE_INVALID_TRANSITION: التجيير لوارد قيد الانتظار فقط؛ حدّث التفاصيل.';\n  END IF;\n  v_plan:=public.cheque_supplier_plan_internal(p_supplier_id,v_c.amount_in_minor_units);\n  INSERT INTO public.cheque_party_keys(party_kind,party_id,bank_key,cheque_number,cheque_id)\n  VALUES('supplier',p_supplier_id,v_c.bank_key,v_c.cheque_number,v_c.id);\n  v_payment:=public.cheque_pay_supplier_internal(v_c.id,p_supplier_id,v_plan);\n  UPDATE public.deferred_cheques SET status='endorsed',endorsed_supplier_id=p_supplier_id,supplier_payment_id=v_payment,\n    version=version+1,changed_by=auth.uid(),changed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=v_c.id;\n  RETURN public.cheque_finish_event_internal(v_c.id,'endorsed',v_c.status,NULL,p_idempotency_key,v_request);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_product_flavor_inheritance()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_master public.products%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.flavor_master_product_id IS NULL THEN\n    IF NEW.is_flavor_master AND NEW.flavor_name_ar IS NOT NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'المنتج الأساسي لا يحمل اسم نكهة.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.flavor_master_product_id = NEW.id THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن ربط المنتج بنفسه كمنتج أساسي.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_master\n  FROM public.products\n  WHERE id = NEW.flavor_master_product_id;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المنتج الأساسي للنكهة غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_master.flavor_master_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إنشاء نكهة داخل نكهة أخرى.';\n  END IF;\n\n  NEW.flavor_name_ar := BTRIM(NEW.flavor_name_ar);\n  NEW.is_flavor_master := false;\n  NEW.category_id := v_master.category_id;\n  NEW.brand_id := v_master.brand_id;\n  NEW.unit_id := v_master.unit_id;\n  NEW.purchase_unit_id := v_master.purchase_unit_id;\n  NEW.units_per_purchase_unit := v_master.units_per_purchase_unit;\n  NEW.default_purchase_price_in_minor_units :=\n    v_master.default_purchase_price_in_minor_units;\n  NEW.sale_unit_id := v_master.sale_unit_id;\n  NEW.units_per_sale_unit := v_master.units_per_sale_unit;\n  NEW.parcel_only := v_master.parcel_only;\n  NEW.default_sale_price_in_minor_units :=\n    v_master.default_sale_price_in_minor_units;\n  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN\n    NEW.cost_price_in_minor_units := v_master.cost_price_in_minor_units;\n  END IF;\n  NEW.sale_price_in_minor_units := v_master.sale_price_in_minor_units;\n  NEW.wholesale_price_in_minor_units :=\n    v_master.wholesale_price_in_minor_units;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_product_identifier_integrity()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_sku TEXT := UPPER(BTRIM(NEW.sku));\n  v_barcode TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(NEW.barcode), '');\n  v_barcode_normalized TEXT;\n  v_lock_key TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_sku IS NULL OR v_sku = '' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'رمز الصنف SKU مطلوب.',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'products_sku_canonical_check';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF COALESCE(NEW.is_flavor_master, false) AND v_barcode IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'المنتج الأساسي للنكهات للتجميع فقط ولا يحمل باركود بيع.',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'products_flavor_master_no_barcode_check';\n  END IF;\n\n  NEW.sku := v_sku;\n  NEW.barcode := v_barcode;\n  v_barcode_normalized := LOWER(v_barcode);\n\n  -- Serialize every normalized identifier before checking the shared SKU /\n  -- barcode namespace. Sorted acquisition prevents inverse-pair deadlocks.\n  FOR v_lock_key IN\n    SELECT DISTINCT identifier\n    FROM (\n      VALUES (LOWER(v_sku)), (v_barcode_normalized)\n    ) AS identifiers(identifier)\n    WHERE identifier IS NOT NULL\n    ORDER BY identifier\n  LOOP\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(\n      hashtextextended('product_identifier:' || v_lock_key, 0)\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.products product\n    WHERE product.id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id\n      AND UPPER(BTRIM(product.sku)) = v_sku\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23505',\n      MESSAGE = 'رمز الصنف SKU مستخدم بالفعل لمنتج آخر.',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'products_sku_normalized_key';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_barcode_normalized IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.products product\n    WHERE product.id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id\n      AND LOWER(BTRIM(product.barcode)) = v_barcode_normalized\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23505',\n      MESSAGE = 'الباركود مستخدم بالفعل لمنتج آخر.',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'products_barcode_normalized_key';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.products product\n    WHERE product.id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id\n      AND NULLIF(BTRIM(product.barcode), '') IS NOT NULL\n      AND LOWER(BTRIM(product.barcode)) = LOWER(v_sku)\n  ) OR (\n    v_barcode_normalized IS NOT NULL\n    AND EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.products product\n      WHERE product.id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id\n        AND LOWER(BTRIM(product.sku)) = v_barcode_normalized\n    )\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23505',\n      MESSAGE = 'لا يمكن استخدام نفس الرقم كـSKU لمنتج وباركود لمنتج آخر.',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'product_identifier_cross_collision';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_automation_event(p_event_key text, p_event_type text, p_entity_id uuid, p_payload jsonb)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_event_id UUID;v_event_key TEXT:=NULLIF(TRIM(p_event_key),'');v_payload JSONB:=COALESCE(p_payload,'{}'::JSONB);\nBEGIN\n  IF v_event_key IS NULL OR length(v_event_key)>300 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid automation event key.';END IF;\n  IF p_event_type NOT IN('new_order','low_stock','out_of_stock','shift_closed','order_unprocessed','order_near_expiry','order_expired',\n    'shift_close_reminder','shift_close_overdue','purchase_order_overdue','expense_daily_threshold','business_alert_recovery',\n    'business_daily_summary','business_weekly_summary','business_integrity_warning','cheque_due','cheque_returned') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid automation event type.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_entity_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Automation event entity is required.';END IF;\n  IF jsonb_typeof(v_payload)<>'object' OR octet_length(v_payload::TEXT)>32768 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid automation event payload.';END IF;\n  INSERT INTO public.automation_events(event_key,event_type,entity_id,payload) VALUES(v_event_key,p_event_type,p_entity_id,v_payload)\n  ON CONFLICT(event_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id INTO v_event_id;\n  IF v_event_id IS NULL THEN SELECT id INTO v_event_id FROM public.automation_events WHERE event_key=v_event_key;END IF;\n  RETURN v_event_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_business_summary(p_summary_type text, p_period_start date, p_period_end date, p_scheduled_for timestamp with time zone, p_generated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_run_id UUID;\n  v_event_id UUID;\n  v_event_key TEXT;\n  v_event_type TEXT;\n  v_payload JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_summary_type NOT IN ('daily', 'weekly') OR p_scheduled_for IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Business summary enqueue request.';\n  END IF;\n  v_event_key := 'business_summary:' || p_summary_type || ':'\n    || p_period_start::TEXT || ':' || p_period_end::TEXT;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_event_key, 0));\n\n  SELECT id, event_id INTO v_run_id, v_event_id\n  FROM public.business_summary_runs\n  WHERE summary_type = p_summary_type\n    AND period_start = p_period_start AND period_end = p_period_end;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n      'success', true, 'created', false,\n      'runId', v_run_id, 'eventId', v_event_id\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  v_run_id := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_payload := public.build_business_summary(\n    p_summary_type, p_period_start, p_period_end, p_generated_at\n  );\n  v_event_type := CASE p_summary_type\n    WHEN 'daily' THEN 'business_daily_summary'\n    ELSE 'business_weekly_summary'\n  END;\n  v_event_id := public.enqueue_automation_event(\n    v_event_key, v_event_type, v_run_id, v_payload\n  );\n\n  INSERT INTO public.business_summary_runs(\n    id, summary_type, period_start, period_end, scheduled_for,\n    run_status, event_id, generated_at\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_run_id, p_summary_type, p_period_start, p_period_end,\n    p_scheduled_for, 'queued', v_event_id, p_generated_at\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true, 'created', true,\n    'runId', v_run_id, 'eventId', v_event_id\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_closed_shift_automation_event()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_difference BIGINT := COALESCE(NEW.cash_discrepancy_in_minor_units, 0);\nBEGIN\n  IF OLD.status = 'open' AND NEW.status = 'closed' THEN\n    PERFORM public.enqueue_automation_event(\n      'shift_closed:' || NEW.id::TEXT,\n      'shift_closed',\n      NEW.id,\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'shiftId', NEW.id,\n        'shiftNumber', NEW.shift_number,\n        'expectedCashInMinorUnits', NEW.expected_cash_in_minor_units,\n        'actualCashInMinorUnits', NEW.actual_cash_in_minor_units,\n        'cashDiscrepancyInMinorUnits', v_difference,\n        'cashDiscrepancyAbsoluteInMinorUnits', ABS(v_difference),\n        'cashDiscrepancyDetected', v_difference <> 0,\n        'cashDiscrepancyDirection', CASE\n          WHEN v_difference > 0 THEN 'surplus'\n          WHEN v_difference < 0 THEN 'shortage'\n          ELSE 'balanced'\n        END,\n        -- Preserve the legacy payload field for deployed consumers while\n        -- changing its meaning to the approved any-non-zero rule.\n        'cashDiscrepancyThresholdInMinorUnits', NULL,\n        'cashDiscrepancyThresholdExceeded', v_difference <> 0,\n        'closedAt', NEW.closed_at\n      )\n    );\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_expired_order_business_alert()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_enabled BOOLEAN;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT order_expired_enabled INTO v_enabled\n  FROM public.business_alert_settings\n  WHERE id = true;\n\n  IF COALESCE(v_enabled, false)\n    AND NEW.source = 'website'\n    AND NEW.status = 'expired'\n    AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'expired'\n  THEN\n    PERFORM public.enqueue_automation_event(\n      'order_expired:' || NEW.id::TEXT,\n      'order_expired',\n      NEW.id,\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'orderId', NEW.id,\n        'orderNumber', NEW.order_number,\n        'expiredAt', NEW.expired_at,\n        'reason', NEW.expired_reason,\n        'source', NEW.source\n      )\n    );\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_order_automation_event()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.source <> 'website'\n    OR NEW.status <> 'new'\n    OR NEW.delivery_zone IS NULL\n    OR (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.delivery_zone IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.delivery_zone)\n  THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.enqueue_automation_event(\n    'new_order:' || NEW.id::TEXT,\n    'new_order',\n    NEW.id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'orderId', NEW.id,\n      'orderNumber', NEW.order_number,\n      'deliveryZone', NEW.delivery_zone,\n      'deliveryFeeInMinorUnits', NEW.delivery_fee_in_minor_units,\n      'totalInMinorUnits', NEW.total_in_minor_units,\n      'paymentMethod', NEW.payment_method,\n      'source', NEW.source,\n      'createdAt', NEW.created_at\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_order_push_webhook(p_payload jsonb)\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'vault', 'net', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_secret TEXT;\n  v_url TEXT;\n  v_request_id BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT decrypted_secret\n  INTO v_secret\n  FROM vault.decrypted_secrets\n  WHERE name = 'order_push_webhook_secret'\n  ORDER BY created_at DESC\n  LIMIT 1;\n\n  IF NULLIF(v_secret, '') IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سر إشعارات الطلبات غير مهيأ.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT decrypted_secret\n  INTO v_url\n  FROM vault.decrypted_secrets\n  WHERE name = 'order_push_webhook_url'\n  ORDER BY created_at DESC\n  LIMIT 1;\n\n  IF NULLIF(TRIM(v_url), '') IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رابط إشعارات الطلبات غير مهيأ.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT net.http_post(\n    url := v_url,\n    body := p_payload,\n    headers := jsonb_build_object(\n      'Content-Type', 'application/json',\n      'x-order-push-secret', v_secret\n    ),\n    timeout_milliseconds := 5000\n  )\n  INTO v_request_id;\n\n  RETURN v_request_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_owner_telegram_dispatch_v1()\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'vault', 'net', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_url TEXT;v_secret TEXT;v_request BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.owner_telegram_dispatch_settings WHERE id AND enabled) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;\n  -- Owner enters these through Vault UI. No secret is provisioned by migration.\n  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name='owner_telegram_dispatch_url')<>1\n    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name='owner_telegram_dispatch_secret')<>1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_TELEGRAM_VAULT_SETTINGS_REQUIRED';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT decrypted_secret INTO v_url FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name='owner_telegram_dispatch_url';\n  SELECT decrypted_secret INTO v_secret FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name='owner_telegram_dispatch_secret';\n  IF v_url IS DISTINCT FROM 'https://kzevmysfydaslxcerogt.supabase.co/functions/v1/owner-telegram-dispatch'\n    OR length(coalesce(v_secret,''))<32 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_TELEGRAM_VAULT_SETTINGS_INVALID'; END IF;\n  SELECT net.http_post(url:=v_url,body:='{\"mode\":\"dispatch\"}'::jsonb,\n    headers:=jsonb_build_object('Content-Type','application/json','x-owner-telegram-secret',v_secret),\n    timeout_milliseconds:=5000) INTO v_request;\n  RETURN v_request;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_stock_automation_event()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_product_name TEXT;\n  v_warehouse_name TEXT;\n  v_should_enqueue BOOLEAN := false;\nBEGIN\n  IF sales_lite1.enabled() THEN RETURN NEW;END IF;\n  IF NEW.status = 'active' THEN\n    v_should_enqueue := TG_OP = 'INSERT'\n      OR OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active'\n      OR OLD.severity IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.severity;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT v_should_enqueue THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT p.name_ar INTO v_product_name\n  FROM public.products p\n  WHERE p.id = NEW.product_id;\n\n  SELECT w.name_ar INTO v_warehouse_name\n  FROM public.warehouses w\n  WHERE w.id = NEW.warehouse_id;\n\n  PERFORM public.enqueue_automation_event(\n    'stock_alert:' || NEW.id::TEXT || ':' || NEW.severity || ':'\n      || floor(extract(epoch FROM NEW.last_updated_at))::BIGINT::TEXT,\n    CASE\n      WHEN NEW.severity = 'out_of_stock' THEN 'out_of_stock'\n      ELSE 'low_stock'\n    END,\n    NEW.id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'stockAlertId', NEW.id,\n      'productId', NEW.product_id,\n      'productName', COALESCE(v_product_name, 'صنف'),\n      'warehouseId', NEW.warehouse_id,\n      'warehouseName', COALESCE(v_warehouse_name, 'المستودع'),\n      'availableQuantity', NEW.available_quantity,\n      'thresholdQuantity', NEW.threshold_quantity,\n      'severity', NEW.severity,\n      'updatedAt', NEW.last_updated_at\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.execute_aftercare_supplier_v1(p_action text, p_idempotency_key text, p_payload jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE actor UUID; k TEXT:=btrim(p_idempotency_key); reason TEXT; allowed TEXT[];\n request JSONB; financial JSONB; financial_replay JSONB; fingerprint TEXT; existing public.business_operations%ROWTYPE;\n op UUID:=gen_random_uuid(); original UUID; order_id UUID; supplier UUID; source_kind TEXT; source_id UUID;\n source JSONB; preview JSONB; blocked TEXT; issued JSONB; row RECORD; case_id UUID; case_ids UUID[]:='{}'::UUID[];\n manifest JSONB; result JSONB; at TIMESTAMPTZ; quantity INTEGER; cost NUMERIC(24,6); unit_name TEXT;\nBEGIN\n actor:=public.sr208_assert_role_internal('customer_return');\n IF p_action NOT IN ('replacement_supplier','reclassify_replacement','reclassify_return') OR p_action IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_ACTION_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF k IS NULL OR length(k) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_KEY_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_INVALID'; END IF;\n reason:=NULLIF(btrim(p_payload->>'reason'),'');\n IF reason IS NULL OR length(reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_REASON_INVALID'; END IF;\n allowed:=CASE WHEN p_action='replacement_supplier' THEN ARRAY['orderId','items','reason','notes','supplierId']\n  ELSE ARRAY['sourceId','supplierId','reason','previewFingerprint'] END;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_payload) x WHERE NOT x=ANY(allowed)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_FIELD_INVALID'; END IF;\n supplier:=(p_payload->>'supplierId')::UUID;\n IF supplier IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF p_action='replacement_supplier' THEN\n  order_id:=(p_payload->>'orderId')::UUID;\n  financial:=public.phase43_canonicalize_replacement_request_internal(order_id,p_payload->'items',reason,p_payload->>'notes');\n  financial_replay:=public.phase43_resolve_replacement_replay_internal(public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(k),\n   public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal('erp_user',actor,NULL,NULL),public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(financial));\n  request:=jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'financialRequest',financial,'supplierId',supplier);\n ELSE\n  source_kind:=CASE WHEN p_action='reclassify_replacement' THEN 'replacement' ELSE 'return' END;\n  source_id:=(p_payload->>'sourceId')::UUID;\n  IF source_id IS NULL OR p_payload->>'previewFingerprint' IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE211_PREVIEW_REQUIRED'; END IF;\n  request:=jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'sourceId',source_id,'supplierId',supplier,'reason',reason,'previewFingerprint',p_payload->>'previewFingerprint');\n END IF;\n fingerprint:=encode(extensions.digest(request::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('supplier-replacement208|'||actor::TEXT||'|'||k,0));\n SELECT * INTO existing FROM public.business_operations WHERE operation_type='supplier_replacement208' AND initiated_by=actor AND idempotency_key=k;\n IF FOUND THEN\n  IF existing.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n  PERFORM public.sr208_assert_operation_internal(existing.id);\n  IF p_action='replacement_supplier' AND(financial_replay->>'decision' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REPLAY'\n   OR financial_replay->>'operation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM existing.result_snapshot->>'replacementOperationId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE211_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;\n  SELECT array_agg(x::UUID ORDER BY x::UUID) INTO case_ids FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(existing.result_snapshot->'caseIds') x;\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'contractVersion',208,'action',p_action,'idempotencyKey',k,'operationId',existing.id,'idempotent',true,\n   'cases',(SELECT jsonb_agg(public.sr208_case_dto_internal(id,true) ORDER BY id) FROM unnest(case_ids) id));\n END IF;\n IF p_action='replacement_supplier' AND financial_replay->>'decision'='REPLAY' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE211_STANDALONE_IDENTITY'; END IF;\n IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=supplier AND is_active) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF p_action='replacement_supplier' THEN\n  issued:=public.settle_sales_replacement_v1(order_id,k,p_payload->'items',reason,p_payload->>'notes');\n  original:=(issued->>'operationId')::UUID;\n  IF original IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE211_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;\n ELSE\n  source:=public.sr211_source_internal(source_kind,source_id);\n  order_id:=(source->>'orderId')::UUID;\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_customer_order_context_internal(order_id,false,false);\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY[(source->>'productId')::UUID]);\n  preview:=public.preview_aftercare_supplier_v1(source_kind,source_id,supplier);\n  IF preview->>'previewFingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload->>'previewFingerprint' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE211_PREVIEW_CHANGED'; END IF;\n  blocked:=preview->>'blockedReason';IF blocked IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '%',blocked; END IF;\n  original:=(source->>'operationId')::UUID;\n END IF;\n -- Canonical issuer owns inventory locks first; never block on a supplier\n -- already held by receipt cancellation in the opposite hierarchy.\n BEGIN\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=supplier AND is_active FOR SHARE NOWAIT;\n EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PARENT_BUSY_RETRY'; END;\n IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n FOR row IN SELECT 'replacement'::TEXT kind,f.replacement_item_id id FROM public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects f\n  WHERE p_action='replacement_supplier' AND f.operation_id=original\n  UNION ALL SELECT source_kind,source_id WHERE p_action<>'replacement_supplier'\n  ORDER BY 1,2\n LOOP\n  source:=public.sr211_source_internal(row.kind,row.id);\n  blocked:=public.sr211_blocked_internal(row.kind,row.id);IF blocked IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '%',blocked; END IF;\n  quantity:=(source->>'quantity')::INTEGER;cost:=(source->>'unitCost')::NUMERIC;at:=clock_timestamp();\n  SELECT COALESCE(u.name_ar,'باكيت') INTO unit_name FROM public.products p LEFT JOIN public.units u ON u.id=p.unit_id WHERE p.id=(source->>'productId')::UUID;\n  INSERT INTO public.supplier_replacement_cases(operation_id,supplier_id,product_id,warehouse_id,branch_id,origin,damage_event_id,\n   quantity,commercial_quantity,units_per_commercial_unit,unit_name,base_unit_name,unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,occurred_at,created_by)\n  VALUES(op,supplier,(source->>'productId')::UUID,(source->>'warehouseId')::UUID,(source->>'branchId')::UUID,\n   CASE WHEN row.kind='replacement' THEN 'customer_replacement' ELSE 'customer_return' END,CASE WHEN row.kind='return' THEN row.id END,\n   quantity,quantity,1,unit_name,unit_name,cost,at,actor) RETURNING id INTO case_id;\n  INSERT INTO public.aftercare_supplier_links(case_id,replacement_item_id,damage_event_id,original_operation_id,source_fingerprint)\n   VALUES(case_id,CASE WHEN row.kind='replacement' THEN row.id END,CASE WHEN row.kind='return' THEN row.id END,\n    (source->>'operationId')::UUID,encode(extensions.digest(source::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'));\n  PERFORM public.sr208_append_event_internal(op,case_id,'send',quantity,quantity,-round(quantity*cost)::BIGINT,0,reason,at);\n  case_ids:=array_append(case_ids,case_id);\n END LOOP;\n IF cardinality(case_ids)=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE211_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;\n manifest:=public.sr208_operation_manifest_internal(op);\n result:=jsonb_build_object('evidenceFingerprint',encode(extensions.digest(manifest::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'),\n  'aftercare211Fingerprint',encode(extensions.digest(public.sr211_links_manifest_internal(op)::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'),\n  'caseIds',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'id' ORDER BY x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'cases') x),\n  'eventIds',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'id' ORDER BY x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'events') x));\n -- The shared envelope contains commitments/IDs only. Replacement COGS stays\n -- in its existing protected issuance evidence, never copied into this tail.\n IF p_action='replacement_supplier' THEN result:=result||jsonb_build_object('replacementOperationId',original,\n  'replacementResultFingerprint',encode(extensions.digest(issued::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex')); END IF;\n INSERT INTO public.business_operations(id,operation_type,idempotency_key,request_fingerprint,request_identity_version,request_identity_snapshot,initiated_by,result_snapshot,completed_at)\n VALUES(op,'supplier_replacement208',k,fingerprint,208,request,actor,result,clock_timestamp());\n PERFORM public.sr208_assert_operation_internal(op);\n INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id,action,entity_name,entity_id,details)\n VALUES(actor,'AFTERCARE_SUPPLIER_DISPOSITION','business_operations',op,jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'order_id',order_id,'case_ids',case_ids));\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'contractVersion',208,'action',p_action,'idempotencyKey',k,'operationId',op,'idempotent',false,\n  'cases',(SELECT jsonb_agg(public.sr208_case_dto_internal(id,true) ORDER BY id) FROM unnest(case_ids) id));\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.execute_document_correction_once(p_action text, p_record_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text, p_preview_fingerprint text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  actor UUID; k TEXT:=NULLIF(btrim(p_idempotency_key),''); reason TEXT:=NULLIF(btrim(p_reason),'');\n  request_hash TEXT; existing public.business_operations%ROWTYPE; preview JSONB; result JSONB;\n  o public.orders%ROWTYPE; cp public.customer_payments%ROWTYPE; locked_cp public.customer_payments%ROWTYPE;\n  shift_id UUID; product_ids UUID[];\nBEGIN\n  actor:=public.correction207_assert_role_internal(p_action);\n  PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout','3s',true);\n  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout','30s',true);\n  IF p_record_id IS NULL OR reason IS NULL OR char_length(reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_REASON_INVALID: اكتب سبباً من3 إلى500 حرف.'; END IF;\n  IF k IS NULL OR char_length(k) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_KEY_INVALID'; END IF;\n  IF p_preview_fingerprint IS NULL OR p_preview_fingerprint!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_PREVIEW_REQUIRED'; END IF;\n  request_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'recordId',p_record_id,'reason',reason,'preview',p_preview_fingerprint)::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('document-correction207-key:'||actor::TEXT||':'||k,0));\n  SELECT * INTO existing FROM public.business_operations WHERE operation_type='document_correction207' AND initiated_by=actor AND idempotency_key=k;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF existing.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM request_hash THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n    RETURN existing.result_snapshot||jsonb_build_object('idempotent',true);\n  END IF;\n  -- Acquire the canonical writer's lock hierarchy BEFORE comparing displayed\n  -- facts. Its own relationship validation/locks and all triggers still run.\n  IF p_action='pos_sale' THEN\n    SELECT * INTO o FROM public.orders WHERE id=p_record_id;shift_id:=o.cash_shift_id;\n    IF shift_id IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('cash-shift-full-reversal:'||shift_id::TEXT,0)); END IF;\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('pos-sale-reversal:'||p_record_id::TEXT,0));\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id=shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders WHERE id=p_record_id FOR UPDATE;\n    SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT product_id ORDER BY product_id) INTO product_ids FROM public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(p_record_id);\n    IF cardinality(product_ids)>0 THEN PERFORM public.phase3_lock_inventory_products_internal(product_ids); END IF;\n  ELSIF p_action='customer_payment' THEN\n    SELECT * INTO cp FROM public.customer_payments WHERE id=p_record_id;\n    IF cp.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('phase4-order|'||cp.order_id::TEXT,0)); END IF;\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id=cp.cash_shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders WHERE id=cp.order_id FOR UPDATE;\n    SELECT * INTO locked_cp FROM public.customer_payments WHERE id=p_record_id FOR UPDATE;\n    IF locked_cp.order_id IS DISTINCT FROM cp.order_id OR locked_cp.cash_shift_id IS DISTINCT FROM cp.cash_shift_id THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PHASE4_LOCK_PLAN_CHANGED_RETRY: Customer Payment relationship changed.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF p_action='supplier_payment' THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase4_lock_supplier_context_internal(NULL,NULL,p_record_id);\n  ELSE\n    PERFORM public.phase4_lock_supplier_context_internal(NULL,p_record_id,NULL);\n  END IF;\n  preview:=public.get_document_correction_preview(p_action,p_record_id);\n  IF preview->>'fingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM p_preview_fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_PREVIEW_STALE: تغير المستند؛ راجع المعاينة الجديدة وأكد مجدداً.'; END IF;\n  IF NOT (preview->>'eligible')::BOOLEAN THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_BLOCKED: %',preview->>'blockedReason'; END IF;\n  CASE p_action\n    WHEN 'pos_sale' THEN result:=public.reverse_pos_sale(p_record_id,reason,k);\n    WHEN 'customer_payment' THEN result:=public.reverse_customer_order_payment(p_record_id,reason);\n    WHEN 'supplier_payment' THEN result:=public.reverse_supplier_payment(p_record_id,reason,k);\n    WHEN 'purchase_receipt' THEN result:=public.cancel_purchase_receipt_v2(p_record_id,reason);\n  END CASE;\n  result:=jsonb_build_object('success',true,'contractVersion',207,'action',p_action,'recordId',p_record_id,\n    'idempotent',false,'preview',preview,'writerResult',result);\n  INSERT INTO public.business_operations(operation_type,initiated_by,idempotency_key,request_fingerprint,result_snapshot,completed_at)\n  VALUES('document_correction207',actor,k,request_hash,result,NOW());\n  RETURN result;\nEND; $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.execute_supplier_replacement_v1(p_action text, p_payload jsonb, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n PERFORM public.sr208_assert_role_internal(p_action);\n IF p_action='reverse' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier215_credits WHERE event_id=(p_payload->>'eventId')::UUID)\n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_USE_CREDIT_REVERSAL'; END IF;\n RETURN public.tb215_supplier_writer_before215_internal(p_action,p_payload,p_idempotency_key);\nEND $function$\n",
