        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_damage_ledger_page_v2(p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_state text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_reason text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_search text DEFAULT ''::text, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n#variable_conflict use_column\nDECLARE owner_values BOOLEAN; result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM public.sr208_assert_role_internal('read');owner_values:=public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner']);\n IF p_from IS NULL OR p_to IS NULL OR p_to<=p_from OR p_to-p_from>INTERVAL '367 days'\n  OR p_state IS NULL OR p_state NOT IN('all','pending_supplier','finished_supplier','final_owner') OR p_reason IS NULL OR length(p_reason)>80\n  OR p_search IS NULL OR length(p_search)>120 OR p_page IS NULL OR p_page NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000 OR p_page_size IS NULL OR p_page_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100\n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DAMAGE215_PAGE_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tb215_damage_roots_internal() r\n  WHERE(r.unit_cost_exact IS NULL OR r.unit_cost_exact<0) AND(p_branch_id IS NULL OR r.branch_id=p_branch_id)\n   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tb215_damage_movements_internal() m WHERE m.root_kind=r.root_kind AND m.root_id=r.root_id AND m.occurred_at>=p_from AND m.occurred_at<p_to))\n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DAMAGE_HISTORICAL_COST_MISSING'; END IF;\n WITH period_movements AS MATERIALIZED(\n  SELECT m.root_kind,m.root_id,sum(m.loss_delta)::BIGINT period_loss,max(m.occurred_at) last_at,\n   jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',m.movement_id,'action',m.action,'quantity',m.quantity,'occurredAt',m.occurred_at,'reason',m.reason)\n    ||CASE WHEN owner_values THEN jsonb_build_object('lossDeltaInMinorUnits',m.loss_delta::TEXT) ELSE '{}'::JSONB END ORDER BY m.occurred_at DESC,m.movement_id) movements\n  FROM public.tb215_damage_movements_internal() m WHERE m.occurred_at>=p_from AND m.occurred_at<p_to GROUP BY m.root_kind,m.root_id\n ), states AS MATERIALIZED(\n  SELECT s.root_kind,s.root_id,sum(s.pending_quantity)::BIGINT pending,\n   sum(s.received_quantity+s.credited_quantity+s.immediate_quantity)::BIGINT finished,sum(s.reversed_damage_quantity)::BIGINT restored,\n   sum(s.received_quantity+s.immediate_quantity)::BIGINT received,sum(s.credited_quantity)::BIGINT credited,\n   array_agg(s.case_id ORDER BY s.case_id) case_ids\n  FROM public.tb215_damage_case_states_internal() s GROUP BY s.root_kind,s.root_id\n ), classified AS MATERIALIZED(\n  SELECT r.*,p.name_ar product_name,p.sku,\n   (SELECT image.image_url FROM public.product_images image WHERE image.product_id=p.id ORDER BY image.is_primary DESC,image.display_order,image.created_at,image.id LIMIT 1) image_url,\n   m.period_loss,m.last_at,m.movements,\n   public.tb215_damage_nonnegative_quantity_internal(COALESCE(s.pending,0)) pending,public.tb215_damage_nonnegative_quantity_internal(COALESCE(s.finished,0)) finished,COALESCE(s.received,0) received,COALESCE(s.credited,0) credited,\n   public.tb215_damage_nonnegative_quantity_internal(r.original_bad_quantity-COALESCE(s.restored,0)) active_bad,\n   public.tb215_damage_nonnegative_quantity_internal(r.original_bad_quantity-COALESCE(s.restored,0)-COALESCE(s.pending,0)-COALESCE(s.finished,0)) final_quantity,\n   COALESCE(s.case_ids,'{}'::UUID[]) case_ids,\n   o.order_number,ret.return_number,\n   CASE WHEN r.root_kind='replacement' THEN r.base_loss-round(r.original_bad_quantity*r.unit_cost_exact)::BIGINT ELSE 0 END cost_difference\n  FROM public.tb215_damage_roots_internal() r JOIN period_movements m ON m.root_kind=r.root_kind AND m.root_id=r.root_id\n  JOIN public.products p ON p.id=r.product_id LEFT JOIN states s ON s.root_kind=r.root_kind AND s.root_id=r.root_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON o.id=r.order_id LEFT JOIN public.sales_return_events ret ON ret.id=r.return_event_id\n  WHERE(p_branch_id IS NULL OR r.branch_id=p_branch_id) AND(p_reason='all' OR r.reason_code=p_reason)\n   AND(p_search='' OR p.name_ar ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%' OR p.sku ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%')\n ), selected AS MATERIALIZED(\n  SELECT * FROM classified x WHERE(x.active_bad>0 OR owner_values AND x.period_loss<>0)\n   AND(p_state='all' OR p_state='pending_supplier' AND x.pending>0 OR p_state='finished_supplier' AND x.finished>0\n    OR p_state='final_owner' AND(x.final_quantity>0 OR owner_values AND x.active_bad=0 AND x.period_loss<>0))\n ), page AS(\n  SELECT * FROM selected ORDER BY last_at DESC,root_kind,root_id LIMIT p_page_size OFFSET(p_page::BIGINT-1)*p_page_size\n ), dto AS(\n  SELECT x.last_at,x.root_kind,x.root_id,\n   jsonb_build_object('source',x.root_kind,'id',x.root_id,'productId',x.product_id,'productName',x.product_name,'imageUrl',x.image_url,\n    'quantity',x.active_bad,'historicalParcelSize',CASE WHEN COALESCE(x.parcel_size_known,false) THEN x.historical_parcel_size END,\n    'parcelSizeKnown',COALESCE(x.parcel_size_known,false),'unitName','باكيت','registeredAt',x.occurred_at,'occurredAt',x.last_at,\n    'reasonCode',x.reason_code,'reason',x.reason,'movements',x.movements,'pendingQuantity',x.pending,'receivedQuantity',x.received,'creditedQuantity',x.credited,\n    'finishedSupplierQuantity',x.finished,'finalOwnerQuantity',x.final_quantity,'financialOnly',x.active_bad=0,\n    'states',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('state',state,'quantity',quantity)),'[]') FROM(VALUES('pending_supplier',x.pending),('finished_supplier',x.finished),('final_owner',x.final_quantity)) s(state,quantity) WHERE quantity>0),\n    'document',CASE WHEN x.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('type','order','id',x.order_id,'number',x.order_number,'returnNumber',x.return_number) ELSE NULL END)\n   ||CASE WHEN owner_values THEN jsonb_build_object('unitCostInMinorUnitsExact',x.unit_cost_exact::TEXT,'periodLossInMinorUnits',x.period_loss::TEXT,\n    'costDifferenceInMinorUnits',x.cost_difference::TEXT,'actions',jsonb_build_object(\n     'cases',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(public.sr208_case_dto_internal(c.id,true) ORDER BY c.id),'[]') FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases c WHERE c.id=ANY(x.case_ids)),\n     'reclassification',CASE WHEN x.active_bad>0 AND(x.root_kind='replacement' OR x.root_kind='damage' AND x.order_id IS NOT NULL) THEN\n      jsonb_build_object('kind',CASE WHEN x.root_kind='replacement' THEN 'replacement' ELSE 'return' END,'sourceId',x.root_id,\n       'blockedReason',public.sr211_blocked_internal(CASE WHEN x.root_kind='replacement' THEN 'replacement' ELSE 'return' END,x.root_id)) ELSE NULL END))\n    ELSE '{}'::JSONB END item FROM page x\n )\n SELECT jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',215,'from',p_from,'to',p_to,'state',p_state,'page',p_page,'pageSize',p_page_size,\n  'totalCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM selected),'totalPages',GREATEST(1,CEIL((SELECT count(*) FROM selected)::NUMERIC/p_page_size)),\n  'rows',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY last_at DESC,root_kind,root_id) FROM dto),'[]'),\n  'quantitySummary',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) ORDER BY g.product_name,g.product_id),'[]') FROM(\n   SELECT product_id,max(product_name) product_name,sum(pending)::BIGINT pending_quantity,sum(finished)::BIGINT finished_supplier_quantity,\n    sum(final_quantity)::BIGINT final_owner_quantity FROM selected GROUP BY product_id) g))\n  ||CASE WHEN owner_values THEN jsonb_build_object('periodLossInMinorUnits',(SELECT COALESCE(sum(period_loss),0)::TEXT FROM selected)) ELSE '{}'::JSONB END INTO result;\n RETURN result;\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_dashboard_analytics()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_today_start TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('day', NOW());\n  v_yesterday_start TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('day', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day');\n  v_week_start TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('week', NOW());\n  v_month_start TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('month', NOW());\n  v_30_days_ago TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('day', NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days');\n\n  -- KPI Variables\n  v_today_sales NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_yesterday_sales NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_week_sales NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_month_sales NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_total_revenue NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_total_cost NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_net_profit NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_today_orders_count INT := 0;\n  v_active_customers_count INT := 0;\n  v_total_products_count INT := 0;\n  v_low_stock_count INT := 0;\n  v_out_of_stock_count INT := 0;\n\n  -- Result Arrays\n  v_daily_sales JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_monthly_revenue JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_orders_by_status JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_top_selling_products JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_sales_by_warehouse JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_sales_by_branch JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_latest_orders JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_latest_customers JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_low_stock_alerts JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_recent_inventory_movements JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_today_notifications JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\nBEGIN\n  -- 1. KPI Calculations\n\n  -- Today Sales & Orders Count (Column in orders is total_in_minor_units)\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0, COUNT(*)\n  INTO v_today_sales, v_today_orders_count\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE created_at >= v_today_start AND status != 'cancelled';\n\n  -- Yesterday Sales\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0\n  INTO v_yesterday_sales\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE created_at >= v_yesterday_start AND created_at < v_today_start AND status != 'cancelled';\n\n  -- This Week Sales\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0\n  INTO v_week_sales\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE created_at >= v_week_start AND status != 'cancelled';\n\n  -- This Month Sales\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0\n  INTO v_month_sales\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE created_at >= v_month_start AND status != 'cancelled';\n\n  -- Total Revenue\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0\n  INTO v_total_revenue\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE status != 'cancelled';\n\n  -- Net Profit Calculation\n  SELECT\n    COALESCE(SUM(oi.line_total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0,\n    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * COALESCE(p.cost_price_in_minor_units, 0)), 0) / 1000.0\n  INTO v_total_revenue, v_total_cost\n  FROM public.order_items oi\n  JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id\n  WHERE o.status != 'cancelled';\n\n  v_net_profit := GREATEST(0, v_total_revenue - v_total_cost);\n\n  -- Counts\n  -- Note: customers table does NOT have is_active column; total registered customers are counted\n  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_active_customers_count FROM public.customers;\n  -- products table DOES have is_active column\n  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_total_products_count FROM public.products WHERE is_active = true;\n\n  -- Stock Status Counts (Column in products is min_stock_level, NOT reorder_level)\n  WITH prod_stock AS (\n    SELECT\n      p.id,\n      p.min_stock_level,\n      COALESCE(SUM(b.on_hand_quantity - b.reserved_quantity), 0) AS total_available\n    FROM public.products p\n    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances b ON b.product_id = p.id\n    WHERE p.is_active = true\n    GROUP BY p.id, p.min_stock_level\n  )\n  SELECT\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE total_available <= min_stock_level AND total_available > 0),\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE total_available <= 0)\n  INTO v_low_stock_count, v_out_of_stock_count\n  FROM prod_stock;\n\n\n  -- 2. Daily Sales (Last 30 Days)\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(d), '[]'::jsonb)\n  INTO v_daily_sales\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      to_char(d.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date,\n      to_char(d.day, 'DD/MM') AS \"formattedDate\",\n      COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS sales,\n      COUNT(o.id) AS \"ordersCount\"\n    FROM generate_series(v_30_days_ago, date_trunc('day', NOW()), INTERVAL '1 day') AS d(day)\n    LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON date_trunc('day', o.created_at) = d.day AND o.status != 'cancelled'\n    GROUP BY d.day\n    ORDER BY d.day ASC\n  ) d;\n\n\n  -- 3. Monthly Revenue\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(m), '[]'::jsonb)\n  INTO v_monthly_revenue\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      to_char(m.month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,\n      to_char(m.month, 'Mon YYYY') AS \"monthName\",\n      COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS revenue\n    FROM generate_series(date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '11 months'), date_trunc('month', NOW()), INTERVAL '1 month') AS m(month)\n    LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON date_trunc('month', o.created_at) = m.month AND o.status != 'cancelled'\n    GROUP BY m.month\n    ORDER BY m.month ASC\n  ) m;\n\n\n  -- 4. Orders by Status\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(s), '[]'::jsonb)\n  INTO v_orders_by_status\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      status,\n      COUNT(*) AS count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS \"totalAmount\"\n    FROM public.orders\n    GROUP BY status\n  ) s;\n\n\n  -- 5. Top Selling Products\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(tp), '[]'::jsonb)\n  INTO v_top_selling_products\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      p.id,\n      p.name_ar AS \"nameAr\",\n      p.sku,\n      COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS \"totalQuantity\",\n      COALESCE(SUM(oi.line_total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS \"totalRevenue\"\n    FROM public.order_items oi\n    JOIN public.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id\n    WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'\n    GROUP BY p.id, p.name_ar, p.sku\n    ORDER BY \"totalRevenue\" DESC\n    LIMIT 5\n  ) tp;\n\n\n  -- 6. Sales by Warehouse\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(w), '[]'::jsonb)\n  INTO v_sales_by_warehouse\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      wh.id,\n      wh.name_ar AS \"nameAr\",\n      COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS sales,\n      COUNT(o.id) AS \"ordersCount\",\n      CASE\n        WHEN v_total_revenue > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 / v_total_revenue) * 100.0, 1)\n        ELSE 0\n      END AS percentage\n    FROM public.warehouses wh\n    LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON o.warehouse_id = wh.id AND o.status != 'cancelled'\n    GROUP BY wh.id, wh.name_ar\n  ) w;\n\n\n  -- 7.         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_operational_business_report(p_branch_id uuid, p_date_from date, p_date_to date)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_totals JSONB;\n  v_profit BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  v_result := public._get_operational_business_report_before133(p_branch_id, p_date_from, p_date_to);\n  v_result := jsonb_set(v_result, '{balances}', (v_result->'balances') || public.phase133_supplier_balances_internal());\n  IF public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner']) THEN\n    v_totals := public.owner_withdrawal_period_totals_internal(\n      p_branch_id,\n      p_date_from::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman',\n      (p_date_to + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman');\n    v_profit := COALESCE((v_result #>> '{sales,netProfitInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT, 0);\n    v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('ownerWithdrawals', v_totals || jsonb_build_object(\n      'netProfitInMinorUnits', v_profit,\n      'remainingAfterWithdrawalsInMinorUnits', v_profit - (v_totals->>'netInMinorUnits')::BIGINT));\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_operational_orders_page(p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25, p_filter text DEFAULT 'action'::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'newest'::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_page INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page, 1);\n  v_page_size INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page_size, 25);\n  v_filter TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_filter), ''), 'action');\n  v_search TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), '');\n  v_sort TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_sort), ''), 'newest');\n  v_offset INTEGER;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY[\n      'owner',\n      'admin',\n      'manager',\n      'accountant',\n      'cashier',\n      'sales',\n      'orders',\n      'delivery_driver'\n    ],\n    'عرض قائمة طلبات المتجر'\n  );\n\n  IF v_page < 1 OR v_page > 100000 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الصفحة غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_page_size < 1 OR v_page_size > 100 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حجم الصفحة يجب أن يكون بين 1 و100.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_filter NOT IN (\n    'all',\n    'action',\n    'active',\n    'completed',\n    'returned',\n    'cancelled'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'فلتر الطلبات غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_sort NOT IN ('newest', 'oldest') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ترتيب الطلبات غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_search IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_search) > 100 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عبارة البحث طويلة جدًا.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_offset := (v_page - 1) * v_page_size;\n\n  WITH filtered_orders AS (\n    SELECT o.id, o.created_at\n    FROM public.orders o\n    LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id\n    WHERE COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos'\n      AND (\n        v_filter = 'all'\n        OR (v_filter = 'action' AND o.status = 'new')\n        OR (\n          v_filter = 'active'\n          AND o.status IN (\n            'confirmed',\n            'preparing',\n            'processing',\n            'ready',\n            'out_for_delivery'\n          )\n        )\n        OR (v_filter = 'completed' AND o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered'))\n        OR (v_filter = 'returned' AND o.status = 'returned')\n        OR (v_filter = 'cancelled' AND o.status = 'cancelled')\n      )\n      AND (\n        v_search IS NULL\n        OR o.order_number ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n        OR COALESCE(o.customer_name_snapshot, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n        OR COALESCE(c.full_name, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n        OR COALESCE(c.phone, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n      )\n  ),\n  paged_orders AS (\n    SELECT id\n    FROM filtered_orders\n    ORDER BY\n      CASE WHEN v_sort = 'oldest' THEN created_at END ASC,\n      CASE WHEN v_sort = 'oldest' THEN id END ASC,\n      CASE WHEN v_sort = 'newest' THEN created_at END DESC,\n      CASE WHEN v_sort = 'newest' THEN id END DESC\n    OFFSET v_offset\n    LIMIT v_page_size\n  ),\n  operational_summary AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'new')::INTEGER AS review_count,\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (\n        WHERE o.status IN (\n          'confirmed',\n          'preparing',\n          'processing',\n          'ready',\n          'out_for_delivery'\n        )\n      )::INTEGER AS active_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(\n        GREATEST(\n          o.total_in_minor_units - o.amount_paid_in_minor_units,\n          0\n        )\n      ) FILTER (WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS due_in_minor_units\n    FROM public.orders o\n    WHERE COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos'\n  )\n  SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n    'order_ids', COALESCE(\n      (SELECT jsonb_agg(id) FROM paged_orders),\n      '[]'::JSONB\n    ),\n    'total_count', (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM filtered_orders),\n    'summary', jsonb_build_object(\n      'review_count', operational_summary.review_count,\n      'active_count', operational_summary.active_count,\n      'due_in_minor_units', operational_summary.due_in_minor_units\n    )\n  )\n  INTO v_result\n  FROM operational_summary;\n\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_or_create_pos_receipt_token(p_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_token UUID;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'إنشاء رابط إيصال البيع المباشر'\n  );\n\n  SELECT *\n  INTO v_order\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_order.source IS DISTINCT FROM 'pos' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'فاتورة البيع المباشر المطلوبة غير موجودة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_order.status NOT IN ('completed', 'returned') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن نشر رابط قبل اكتمال فاتورة البيع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_token := COALESCE(v_order.public_receipt_token, gen_random_uuid());\n\n  IF v_order.public_receipt_token IS NULL THEN\n    UPDATE public.orders\n    SET public_receipt_token = v_token,\n        updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE id = v_order.id;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n      user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n    ) VALUES (\n      auth.uid(),\n      'CREATE_PUBLIC_POS_RECEIPT_LINK',\n      'orders',\n      v_order.id,\n      jsonb_build_object('order_number', v_order.order_number)\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'receiptToken', v_token,\n    'orderNumber', v_order.order_number\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_order_exchange_details_v1(p_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE funding JSONB; exchanges JSONB;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','accountant','cashier','sales','orders','delivery_driver'],'عرض تفاصيل وصل التبديل');\n IF p_order_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_ORDER_REQUIRED'; END IF;\n PERFORM public.tb215_assert_exchange_internal(x.operation_id) FROM public.aftercare215_exchanges x JOIN public.aftercare215_exchange_results r ON r.operation_id=x.operation_id\n WHERE r.new_order_id=p_order_id OR x.order_id=p_order_id;\n SELECT public.tb215_exchange_public_result_internal(r.operation_id)-'referenceNumber' INTO funding FROM public.aftercare215_exchange_results r WHERE r.new_order_id=p_order_id;\n SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(public.tb215_exchange_public_result_internal(x.operation_id)-'referenceNumber' ORDER BY x.created_at,x.operation_id),'[]') INTO exchanges\n FROM public.aftercare215_exchanges x WHERE x.order_id=p_order_id;\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',215,'funding',funding,'exchanges',exchanges);\nEND $function$\n",

document links count too.\n      'hasProductAssociations',(\n        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.order_inventory_reservations WHERE warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_alerts WHERE warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_opening_sessions d JOIN public.inventory_opening_items i ON i.session_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.orders d JOIN public.order_items i ON i.order_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_orders d JOIN public.purchase_order_items i ON i.purchase_order_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_receipts d JOIN public.purchase_receipt_items i ON i.purchase_receipt_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_receipts d JOIN public.supplier_receipt_items i ON i.supplier_receipt_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)\n      )\n    ) ORDER BY w.code,w.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.warehouses w)\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

p_date_from > 366 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_PERIOD_INVALID: الفترة لا تتجاوز سنة.';\n  END IF;\n  v_from := p_date_from::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n  v_to := (p_date_to + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_total FROM public.owner_withdrawal_events_internal(p_branch_id, v_from, v_to);\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_json ORDER BY sort_at DESC, sort_number DESC, sort_kind), '[]'::JSONB) INTO v_rows\n  FROM (\n    SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n      'kind', event.event_kind,\n      'at', event.event_at,\n      'direction', event.direction,\n      'amountInMinorUnits', event.amount_in_minor_units,\n      'withdrawalId', event.withdrawal_id,\n      'withdrawalNumber', event.withdrawal_number,\n      'branchId', event.branch_id,\n      'branchName', branch.name_ar,\n      'shiftId', event.shift_id,\n      'shiftNumber', shift.shift_number,\n      'actorName', profile.full_name,\n      'reason', event.reason,\n      'isReversed', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals active\n        WHERE active.withdrawal_id = event.withdrawal_id AND active.voided_at IS NULL)\n    ) AS row_json, event.event_at AS sort_at, event.withdrawal_number AS sort_number, event.event_kind AS sort_kind\n    FROM public.owner_withdrawal_events_internal(p_branch_id, v_from, v_to) event\n    LEFT JOIN public.branches branch ON branch.id = event.branch_id\n    LEFT JOIN public.cash_shifts shift ON shift.id = event.shift_id\n    LEFT JOIN public.profiles profile ON profile.id = event.actor_id\n    ORDER BY event.event_at DESC, event.withdrawal_number DESC, event.event_kind\n    LIMIT v_size OFFSET (v_page -         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_storefront_catalog(p_limit integer DEFAULT 100, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  WITH base AS (\n    SELECT public.get_public_product_catalog(\n      p_limit, p_offset, p_category_id, p_search\n    ) AS payload\n  ),\n  enriched_items AS (\n    SELECT\n      item.ordinality,\n      item.value || jsonb_build_object(\n        'createdAt', p.created_at,\n        'soldPackagesLast90Days', COALESCE(sales.sold_packages, 0),\n        'flavorMasterProductId', p.flavor_master_product_id,\n        'flavorNameAr', p.flavor_name_ar,\n        'isFlavorMaster', p.is_flavor_master,\n        'flavorSortOrder', p.flavor_sort_order\n      ) AS value\n    FROM base\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(base.payload->'items')\n      WITH ORDINALITY AS item(value, ordinality)\n    JOIN public.products p ON p.id = (item.value->>'id')::UUID\n    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n      SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(oi.sale_package_quantity, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS sold_packages\n      FROM public.order_items oi\n      JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id\n      WHERE oi.product_id = p.id\n        AND o.status = 'completed'\n        AND o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'\n    ) sales ON true\n  ),\n  enriched_categories AS (\n    SELECT\n      category.ordinality,\n      category.value || jsonb_build_object('imageUrl', c.image_url) AS value\n    FROM base\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(base.payload->'categories')\n      WITH ORDINALITY AS category(value, ordinality)\n    LEFT JOIN public.categories c\n      ON c.id = (category.value->>'id')::UUID\n  )\n  SELECT jsonb_set(\n    jsonb_set(\n      base.payload,\n      '{items}',\n      COALESCE(\n        (SELECT jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY ordinality) FROM enriched_items),\n        '[]'::jsonb\n      )\n    ),\n    '{categories}',\n    COALESCE(\n      (SELECT jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY ordinality) FROM enriched_categories),\n      '[]'::jsonb\n    )\n  )\n  FROM base;\n$function$\n",

DEFAULT NULL::text, p_availability text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'recommended'::text, p_brand_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_sale_unit_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_product_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[])\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  WITH stock_by_product AS (\n    SELECT\n      ib.product_id,\n      COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(ib.on_hand_quantity - ib.reserved_quantity, 0)), 0)::INTEGER\n        AS available_quantity\n    FROM public.inventory_balances ib\n    GROUP BY ib.product_id\n  ),\n  sales_by_product AS (\n    SELECT\n      oi.product_id,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(oi.sale_package_quantity, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS sold_packages\n    FROM public.order_items oi\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id\n    WHERE o.status = 'completed'\n      AND o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'\n    GROUP BY oi.product_id\n  ),\n  catalog_source AS (\n    SELECT\n      p.id,\n      p.sku,\n      p.barcode,\n      p.name_ar,\n      p.description,\n      p.category_id,\n      c.code AS category_code,\n      c.name_ar AS category_name_ar,\n      p.brand_id,\n      b.name_ar AS brand_name_ar,\n      p.unit_id,\n      base_unit.name_ar AS unit_name_ar,\n      p.sale_unit_id,\n      sale_unit.name_ar AS sale_unit_name_ar,\n      p.units_per_sale_unit,\n      p.parcel_only,\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      p.sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(stock.available_quantity, 0)::INTEGER AS available_quantity,\n      image.image_url,\n      p.created_at,\n      COALESCE(sales.sold_packages, 0)::BIGINT AS sold_packages_last_90_days,\n      p.flavor_master_product_id,\n      p.flavor_name_ar,\n      p.is_flavor_master,\n      p.flavor_sort_order,\n      COALESCE(p.flavor_master_product_id, p.id) AS family_id\n    FROM public.products p\n    JOIN public.categories c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.is_active = true\n    LEFT JOIN public.brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id\n    JOIN public.units base_unit ON base_unit.id = p.unit_id\n    JOIN public.units sale_unit ON sale_unit.id = p.sale_unit_id\n    LEFT JOIN stock_by_product stock ON stock.product_id = p.id\n    LEFT JOIN sales_by_product sales ON sales.product_id = p.id\n    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n      SELECT pi.image_url\n      FROM public.product_images pi\n      WHERE pi.product_id = p.id\n      ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.display_order, pi.created_at\n      LIMIT 1\n    ) image ON true\n    WHERE p.is_active = true\n      AND sale_unit.code <> 'PCS'\n      AND p.units_per_sale_unit > 0\n      AND p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units > 0\n  ),\n  family_summary AS (\n    SELECT\n      family_id,\n      MIN(category_id::TEXT)::UUID AS category_id,\n      MIN(category_code) AS category_code,\n      MIN(brand_id::TEXT)::UUID AS brand_id,\n      MIN(sale_unit_id::TEXT)::UUID AS sale_unit_id,\n      COALESCE(\n        MIN(name_ar) FILTER (WHERE flavor_master_product_id IS NULL),\n        MIN(name_ar)\n      ) AS family_name_ar,\n      MIN(default_sale_price_in_minor_units) AS sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(SUM(\n        FLOOR(available_quantity::NUMERIC / units_per_sale_unit)\n      ) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_flavor_master), 0)::INTEGER AS available_sale_packages,\n      BOOL_OR(\n        NOT is_flavor_master\n        AND available_quantity >= units_per_sale_unit\n      ) AS is_available,\n      BOOL_OR(\n        NOT is_flavor_master\n        AND available_quantity >= units_per_sale_unit\n        AND FLOOR(available_quantity::NUMERIC / units_per_sale_unit) <= 5\n      ) AS is_low_stock,\n      MAX(created_at) AS created_at,\n      COALESCE(SUM(sold_packages_last_90_days) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_flavor_master), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS sold_packages_last_90_days\n    FROM catalog_source\n    GROUP BY family_id\n  ),\n  normalized_search AS (\n    SELECT LOWER(TRANSLATE(\n      REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), ''), ''), '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'),\n      'أإآى',\n      'اااي'\n    )) AS value\n  ),\n  matching_families AS (\n    SELECT fs.*\n    FROM family_summary fs\n    CROSS JOIN normalized_search normalized\n    WHERE (p_category_id IS NULL OR fs.category_id = p_category_id)\n      AND (p_brand_id IS NULL OR fs.brand_id = p_brand_id)\n      AND (p_sale_unit_id IS NULL OR fs.sale_unit_id = p_sale_unit_id)\n      AND (\n        p_product_ids IS NULL\n        OR fs.family_id = ANY (p_product_ids)\n        OR EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM catalog_source favorite_member\n          WHERE favorite_member.family_id = fs.family_id\n            AND favorite_member.id = ANY (p_product_ids)\n        )\n      )\n      AND (\n        p_availability NOT IN ('available', 'low_stock')\n        OR (p_availability = 'available' AND fs.is_available)\n        OR (p_availability = 'low_stock' AND fs.is_low_stock)\n      )\n      AND (p_sort <> 'offers' OR fs.category_code = 'CAT-OFFERS')\n      AND (p_sort <> 'low_stock' OR fs.is_low_stock)\n      AND (\n        normalized.value = ''\n        OR EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM catalog_source searched_member\n          WHERE searched_member.family_id = fs.family_id\n            AND (\n              LOWER(TRANSLATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(searched_member.name_ar, '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'), 'أإآى', 'اااي')) LIKE '%' || normalized.value || '%'\n              OR LOWER(TRANSLATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(searched_member.sku, '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'), 'أإآى', 'اااي')) LIKE '%' || normalized.value || '%'\n              OR LOWER(TRANSLATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(searched_member.barcode, ''), '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'), 'أإآى', 'اااي')) LIKE '%' || normalized.value || '%'\n              OR LOWER(TRANSLATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(searched_member.description, ''), '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'), 'أإآى', 'اااي')) LIKE '%' || normalized.value || '%'\n              OR LOWER(TRANSLATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(searched_member.brand_name_ar, ''), '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'), 'أإآى', 'اااي')) LIKE '%' || normalized.value || '%'\n            )\n        )\n      )\n  ),\n  paged_families AS (\n    SELECT\n      mf.*,\n      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n        ORDER BY\n          mf.is_available DESC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'name_asc' THEN mf.family_name_ar END ASC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'price_asc' THEN mf.sale_price_in_minor_units END ASC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'price_desc' THEN mf.sale_price_in_minor_units END DESC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'stock_desc' THEN mf.available_sale_packages END DESC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'newest' THEN mf.created_at END DESC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'best_sellers' THEN mf.sold_packages_last_90_days END DESC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'low_stock' THEN mf.available_sale_packages END ASC,\n          mf.family_name_ar ASC,\n          mf.family_id ASC\n      ) AS page_order\n    FROM matching_families mf\n    ORDER BY\n      mf.is_available DESC,\n      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'name_asc' THEN mf.family_name_ar END ASC,\n      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'price_asc' THEN mf.sale_price_in_minor_units END ASC,\n      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'price_desc' THEN mf.sale_price_in_minor_units END DESC,\n      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'stock_desc' THEN mf.available_sale_packages END ),\n  page_items AS (\n    SELECT\n      pf.page_order,\n      cs.*\n    FROM paged_families pf\n    JOIN catalog_source cs ON cs.family_id = pf.family_id\n  ),\n  category_summary AS (\n    SELECT\n      WHERE i.commercial_line_id=l.id AND i.supplier_receipt_id=p_receipt_id) AS components\n      FROM public.supplier_receipt_commercial_lines l\n      WHERE l.supplier_receipt_id=p_receipt_id\n      UNION ALL\n      SELECT i.id,0,\n        CASE WHEN i.units_per_package>1 THEN 'legacy_single_sku_parcel' ELSE 'base_unit' END,\n ))\n      FROM public.supplier_receipt_items i LEFT JOIN public.products p ON p.id=i.product_id\n      WHERE i.supplier_receipt_id=p_receipt_id AND i.commercial_line_id IS NULL\n    ) e\n   AND (\n          v_search IS NULL\n          OR sr.receipt_number ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(sr.supplier_invoice_number, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR     'amount_due_in_minor_units', sr.amount_due_in_minor_units, 'payment_status', sr.payment_status,\n        'payment_method', sr.payment_method, 'payment_reference', sr.payment_reference,\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_supplier_replacements_page_v1(p_supplier_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_status text DEFAULT 'pending'::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE result:=jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',208,'page',p_page,'pageSize',p_page_size,'totalCount',total,\n  'pendingQuantity',pending,'cases',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(public.sr208_case_dto_internal(v,values_allowed) ORDER BY c.occurred_at,c.id),'[]')\n   FROM unnest(ids) v JOIN public.supplier_replacement_cases c ON c.id=v));\n IF values_allowed         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_assert_setup_open_internal()\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_finished_at TIMESTAMPTZ;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT finished_at INTO STRICT v_finished_at\n  FROM public.go_live_setup_state WHERE id FOR SHARE;\n  IF v_finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_SETUP_FINISHED: تم إنهاء بداية التشغيل؛ لا يُقبل أي إدخال افتتاحي بعد الآن.';\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_begin_batch_internal(p_kind text, p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_key TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), '');\n  v_existing public.go_live_import_batches%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_key IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 120 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مفتاح منع التكرار للدفعة غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_rows IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_rows) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الدفعة يجب أن تحتوي من 1 إلى 500 سطر.';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('go-live-batch:' || v_key, 0));\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.go_live_import_batches WHERE idempotency_key = v_key;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RETURN NULL;\n  END IF;\n  IF v_existing.batch_kind <> p_kind OR v_existing.request_hash <> md5(p_rows::TEXT) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_BATCH_KEY_CONFLICT: مفتاح الدفعة استُخدم سابقاً لبيانات مختلفة؛ أعد المعاينة.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_existing.result || jsonb_build_object('idempotentReplay', true);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_cheque_party_internal(p_kind text, p_id text, p_phone text, p_name text)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_id UUID:=NULLIF(btrim(p_id),'')::UUID;v_phone TEXT:=NULLIF(btrim(p_phone),'');\n  v_name TEXT:=NULLIF(public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(p_name),'');v_count BIGINT;v_result UUID;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_id IS NULL AND v_phone IS NULL AND v_name IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'حدد الطرف الموجود في النظام.';END IF;\n  IF p_kind='customer' THEN\n    SELECT count(*),min(id::TEXT)::UUID INTO v_count,v_result FROM public.customers\n    WHERE NOT is_deleted AND(v_id IS NULL OR id=v_id) AND(v_phone IS NULL OR phone=v_phone)\n      AND(v_name IS NULL OR public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(full_name)=v_name);\n  ELSIF p_kind='supplier' THEN\n    SELECT count(*),min(id::TEXT)::UUID INTO v_count,v_result FROM public.suppliers\n    WHERE(v_id IS NULL OR id=v_id) AND(v_phone IS NULL OR phone=v_phone)\n      AND(v_name IS NULL OR public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(company_name)=v_name);\n  ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'نوع الطرف غير صالح.';END IF;\n  IF v_count<>1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطرف غير موجود أو غير فريد؛ صحح الاسم والهاتف أو اختره من القائمة.';END IF;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.go_live_cheque_rows_internal(p_rows jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_row JSONB;v_plan JSONB:='[]'::JSONB;v_errors JSONB:='[]'::JSONB;v_keys JSONB:='{}'::JSONB;\n  v_index INTEGER:=0;v_source INTEGER;v_customer UUID;v_supplier UUID;v_endorsed UUID;\n  v_direction TEXT;v_status TEXT;v_bank TEXT;v_number TEXT;v_amount BIGINT;\n  v_due DATE;v_original DATE;v_cheque_date DATE;v_debt_at TIMESTAMPTZ;v_party RECORD;v_key TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF jsonb_typeof(p_rows) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_rows) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'أدخل من سطر واحد إلى 500 سطر في الدفعة.';\n  END IF;\n  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) LOOP\n    v_index:=v_index+1;v_source:=v_index;\n    BEGIN\n      IF jsonb_typeof(v_row) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'السطر غير صالح.';END IF;\n      IF v_row ? 'sourceRow' THEN\n        IF COALESCE(v_row->>'sourceRow','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,6}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم السطر غير صالح.';END IF;\n        v_source:=(v_row->>'sourceRow')::INTEGER;\n      END IF;\n      IF (v_row-ARRAY['sourceRow','direction','initial_status','bank_name','cheque_number','due_date','amount_in_minor_units',\n        'customer_id','customer_phone','customer_name','supplier_id','supplier_name','endorsed_supplier_id','endorsed_supplier_name',\n        'original_debt_date','cheque_date','notes'])<>'{}'::JSONB THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'السطر يحتوي حقولاً غير معتمدة.';END IF;\n      v_direction:=v_row->>'direction';v_status:=COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'initial_status'),''),'pending');\n      IF v_direction IS NULL OR v_direction NOT IN ('incoming','outgoing') OR v_status NOT IN ('pending','endorsed')\n        OR(v_status='endorsed' AND v_direction<>'incoming') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'اختر وارد أو صادر، وقيد الانتظار أو وارد مجيّر فقط.';END IF;\n      v_bank:=NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'bank_name'),'');v_number:=NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'cheque_number'),'');\n      IF v_bank IS NULL OR char_length(v_bank)>120 OR v_number IS NULL OR char_length(v_number)>80 THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'اسم البنك ورقم الشيك مطلوبان ضمن الطول المسموح.';END IF;\n      IF COALESCE(v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,11}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مبلغ موجب صحيح بالفلس مطلوب.';END IF;\n      v_amount:=(v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;\n      IF COALESCE(v_row->>'due_date','') !~ '^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'تاريخ الاستحقاق مطلوب بصيغة سنة-شهر-يوم.';END IF;\n      v_due:=(v_row->>'due_date')::DATE;v_original:=NULL;v_cheque_date:=NULL;\n      IF NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'original_debt_date'),'') IS NOT NULL THEN\n        IF(v_row->>'original_debt_date') !~ '^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'تاريخ الدين الأصلي غير صالح.';END IF;\n        v_original:=(v_row->>'original_debt_date')::DATE;\n      END IF;\n      IF NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'cheque_date'),'') IS NOT NULL THEN\n        IF(v_row->>'cheque_date') !~ '^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'تاريخ الشيك غير صالح.';END IF;\n        v_cheque_date:=(v_row->>'cheque_date')::DATE;\n      END IF;\n      v_debt_at:=COALESCE(v_original,v_cheque_date)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n      IF char_length(COALESCE(v_row->>'notes',''))>500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الملاحظة لا تتجاوز 500 حرف.';END IF;\n      v_customer:=NULL;v_supplier:=NULL;v_endorsed:=NULL;\n      IF v_direction='incoming' THEN\n        IF NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'supplier_id'),'') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'supplier_name'),'') IS NOT NULL THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION 'الوارد يرتبط بالزبون؛ استخدم حقل المورد المجيّر له عند الحاجة.';END IF;\n        v_customer:=public.go_live_cheque_party_internal('customer',v_row->>'customer_id',v_row->>'customer_phone',v_row->>'customer_name');\n        IF v_status='endorsed' THEN\n          v_endorsed:=public.go_live_cheque_party_internal('supplier',v_row->>'endorsed_supplier_id',NULL,v_row->>'endorsed_supplier_name');\n        ELSIF NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'endorsed_supplier_id'),'') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'endorsed_supplier_name'),'') IS NOT NULL THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION 'اختر حالة مجيّر عند تحديد مورد التجيير.';\n        END IF;\n      ELSE\n        IF NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'customer_id'),'') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'customer_phone'),'') IS NOT NULL\n          OR NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'customer_name'),'') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'endorsed_supplier_id'),'') IS NOT NULL\n          OR NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'endorsed_supplier_name'),'') IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الصادر يرتبط بمورد واحد فقط.';END IF;\n        v_supplier:=public.go_live_cheque_party_internal('supplier',v_row->>'supplier_id',NULL,v_row->>'supplier_name');\n      END IF;\n      FOR v_party IN SELECT 'customer'::TEXT kind,v_customer id WHERE v_customer IS NOT NULL\n        UNION ALL SELECT 'supplier',COALESCE(v_supplier,v_endorsed) WHERE COALESCE(v_supplier,v_endorsed) IS NOT NULL LOOP\n        v_key:=v_party.kind||':'||v_party.id::TEXT||':'||lower(v_bank)||':'||v_number;\n        IF v_keys ? v_key OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cheque_party_keys k WHERE k.party_kind=v_party.kind\n          AND k.party_id=v_party.id AND k.bank_key=lower(v_bank) AND k.cheque_number=v_number) THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION 'الشيك مكرر للطرف والبنك والرقم؛ يشمل ذلك الشيكات المسجلة سابقاً.';END IF;\n        v_keys:=v_keys||jsonb_build_object(v_key,true);\n      END LOOP;\n      v_plan:=v_plan||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('sourceRow',v_source,'direction',v_direction,'status',v_status,\n        'bank',v_bank,'number',v_number,'dueDate',v_due,'amount',v_amount,'customerId',v_customer,'supplierId',v_supplier,\n        'endorsedSupplierId',v_endorsed,'originalDebtAt',v_debt_at,'originalDebtDate',v_original,'chequeDate',v_cheque_date,\n        'notes',NULLIF(btrim(v_row->>'notes'),'')));\n    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n      v_errors:=v_errors||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('row',v_source,'message',\n        CASE WHEN SQLSTATE IN ('22007','22008') THEN 'تاريخ غير صالح؛ استخدم سنة-شهر-يوم.'\n          WHEN SQLSTATE='22P02' THEN 'معرف الطرف غير صالح.' ELSE SQLERRM END));\n    END;\n  END LOOP;\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('rows',v_plan,'errors',v_errors,'rowCount',jsonb_array_length(p_rows),'validCount',jsonb_array_length(v_plan));\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_cash_shift_closing_report_snapshot()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  -- A captured report is an audit artifact: it can never be overwritten,\n  -- cleared, or version-swapped after it has been stored.\n  IF OLD.closing_report_snapshot IS NOT NULL\n    AND (\n      NEW.closing_report_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.closing_report_snapshot\n      OR NEW.closing_report_snapshotted_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.closing_report_snapshotted_at\n      OR NEW.closing_report_snapshot_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.closing_report_snapshot_version\n    )\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لقطة تقرير الإغلاق محفوظة ولا يمكن تعديلها أو حذفها.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Historical closed shifts deliberately remain without a fabricated\n  -- snapshot.     b.result_snapshot->>'order_id' AS order_key,\n      b.result_snapshot, b.completed_at, b.request_identity_snapshot\n    FROM public.business_operations b\n    WHERE b.operation_type = ),\norder_scope AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.branch_id, o.status, o.payment_method, o.delivery_fee_in_minor_units, o.total_in_minor_units, o.source, o.created_at, o.amount_paid_in_minor_units, o.operation_id, fc.at AS completion_at, creation.operation_type,\n      creation.result_snapshot AS creation_result, creation.completed_at AS creation_recorded_at,\n      completion.result_snapshot AS completion_result,\n      completion.completed_at AS completion_recorded_at,\n      completion.request_identity_snapshot AS completion_request\n    FROM public.orders o\n    JOIN first_completion fc ON fc.order_id = o.id\n    LEFT JOIN public.business_operations creation ON creation.id = o.operation_id\n    LEFT JOIN completion_ops completion ON completion.order_key = o.id::TEXT\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id\n  ),\nmodern_returns AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT e.*\n    FROM public.sales_return_events e JOIN order_scope o ON o.id = e.order_id\n    WHERE e.contract_version = 401 AND e.settlement_status = 'settled'\n      AND o.operation_type IN ('phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1')\n  ),\nissued AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT e.*\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_events e JOIN order_scope o ON o.id = e.root_order_id\n    WHERE e.issuance_status = 'issued'\n  ),\nreturn_rows AS (\n    SELECT e.id, e.order_id, e.settled_at AS at,\n      e.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units AS debt,\n      e.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units AS refund, e.refund_method,\n      e.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units + e.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units AS entitlement,\n      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.historical_restock_value_in_minor_units_exact)\n        FROM public.phase42_return_inventory_effects f WHERE f.return_event_id = e.id), 0) AS recovery\n    FROM modern_returns e\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT e.id, e.order_id, e.created_at, 0, e.refund_amount_in_minor_units, e.refund_method,\n      e.refund_amount_in_minor_units,\n      CASE WHEN e.stock_disposition = 'restock' THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.cogs_in_minor_units)\n        FROM public.order_items i WHERE i.order_id = e.order_id), 0) ELSE 0 END\n    FROM public.sales_returns e JOIN order_scope o ON o.id = e.order_id\n    WHERE o.operation_type IS NULL OR o.operation_type NOT IN\n      ('phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1')\n  ),\ninitial_collections AS (\n    SELECT o.id AS order_id,\n      CASE WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_pos_sale_v1' THEN o.creation_recorded_at\n        ELSE COALESCE(o.completion_recorded_at, o.completion_at) END AS at,\n      CASE WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_pos_sale_v1' THEN o.creation_result->>'paymentMethod'\n        WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1' THEN o.completion_request->>'payment_method'\n        WHEN o.payment_method = 'cash_on_delivery' THEN 'cash' ELSE o.payment_method END AS method,\n      CASE WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_pos_sale_v1' THEN (o.creation_result->>'amountPaidInMinorUnits')::BIGINT\n        WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1' THEN\n          CASE WHEN NULLIF(o.completion_result->>'customer_payment_number', '') IS NOT NULL THEN 0\n            ELSE (o.completion_result->>'amount_paid_in_minor_units')::BIGINT END\n        WHEN o.payment_method = 'debt' THEN 0 ELSE o.total_in_minor_units END AS amount\n    FROM order_scope o\n  ),\nmoney_events AS (\n    SELECT order_id, at, method, amount AS collection, 0::BIGINT AS reversal, 0::BIGINT AS refund\n    FROM initial_collections WHERE amount > 0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT p.order_id, p.created_at, p.payment_method, p.amount_in_minor_units, 0, 0\n    FROM public.customer_payments p JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = p.order_id\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT p.order_id, p.reversed_at, p.payment_method, 0, p.amount_in_minor_units, 0\n    FROM public.customer_payments p JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = p.order_id\n    WHERE p.is_reversed AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT r.order_id, r.created_at, m.method, 0, m.amount, 0\n    FROM public.pos_sale_reversals r JOIN order_scope o ON o.id = r.order_id\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES\n      ('cash', (r.actual_effect->>'cash_in_minor_units')::BIGINT),\n      ('cliq', (r.actual_effect->>'cliq_in_minor_units')::BIGINT)) m(method, amount)\n    WHERE m.amount > 0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT order_id, at, refund_method, 0, 0, refund FROM return_rows WHERE refund > 0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT NULL::UUID,c.created_at,c.payment_method,a.amount_in_minor_units,0,0\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c JOIN public.customer_collection_cheque_allocations a ON a.operation_id=c.id\n    JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims k ON k.id=a.claim_id JOIN public.deferred_cheques q ON q.id=k.cheque_id\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.branch_id,q.branch_id)=p_branch_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT NULL::UUID,c.reversed_at,c.payment_method,0,a.amount_in_minor_units,0\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c JOIN public.customer_collection_cheque_allocations a ON a.operation_id=c.id\n    JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims k ON k.id=a.claim_id JOIN public.deferred_cheques q ON q.id=k.cheque_id\n    WHERE c.is_reversed AND(p_branch_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.branch_id,q.branch_id)=p_branch_id)\n    UNION ALL\n    -- Opening allocation is not a customer_payment. The order allocation is\n    -- already counted above and must never be added from collection totals.\n    SELECT NULL::UUID,c.created_at,c.payment_method,a.amount_in_minor_units,0,0\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c\n    JOIN public.customer_collection_opening_allocations a ON a.operation_id=c.id\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.branch_id,public.go_live_main_branch_internal())=p_branch_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT NULL::UUID,c.reversed_at,c.payment_method,0,a.amount_in_minor_units,0\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c\n    JOIN public.customer_collection_opening_allocations a ON a.operation_id=c.id\n    WHERE c.is_reversed AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.branch_id,public.go_live_main_branch_internal())=p_branch_id)\n  ),\ncoverage_by_order AS (\n    SELECT order_id, SUM(collection - reversal)::BIGINT AS coverage\n    FROM money_events GROUP BY order_id\n  ),\ndebt_by_order AS (\n    SELECT order_id, SUM(debt)::BIGINT AS debt_reduction\n    FROM return_rows GROUP BY order_id\n  ),\npositions AS (\n    SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.status, o.total_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(c.coverage, 0)::BIGINT AS coverage,\n      COALESCE(d.debt_reduction, 0)::BIGINT AS debt_reduction,\n      GREATEST(o.total_in_minor_units - COALESCE(c.coverage, 0) - COALESCE(d.debt_reduction, 0), 0)::BIGINT AS due\n    FROM order_scope o\n    LEFT JOIN coverage_by_order c ON c.order_id = o.id\n    LEFT JOIN debt_by_order d ON d.order_id = o.id\n  ),\neligible AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.total_in_minor_units,\n      o.amount_paid_in_minor_units, o.operation_id\n    FROM public.orders o\n    WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')\n      AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL\n      AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      AND (COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos' OR o.payment_method = 'debt')\n  ),\nprior_debt AS MATERIALIZED (\n    -- Exact set-based form of121 phase42_order_financial_position_internal's\n    -- prior_debt source. Do not introduce a projection/cache or new authority.\n    SELECT e.order_id, SUM(e.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units)::BIGINT AS amount\n    FROM public.sales_return_events e JOIN eligible o ON o.id = e.order_id\n    WHERE e.settlement_status = 'settled' AND e.contract_version = 401\n      AND o.amount_paid_in_minor_units < o.total_in_minor_units\n    GROUP BY e.order_id\n  ),\nfinancial_positions AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT o.*, CASE\n      WHEN o.amount_paid_in_minor_units >= o.total_in_minor_units THEN 0::BIGINT\n      ELSE GREATEST(o.total_in_minor_units - o.amount_paid_in_minor_units\n        - COALESCE(d.amount, 0), 0)::BIGINT END AS outstanding\n    FROM eligible o LEFT JOIN prior_debt d ON d.order_id = o.id\n  ),\ncanonical_order_due AS (\n    -- Same set-based canonical positions used by192 aging/CRM;see parity guard.\n    SELECT id, customer_id, outstanding AS due FROM financial_positions\n  ),\nopening_due AS (\n    -- Preserve164 main-branch attribution;do not clamp signed source values.\n    SELECT opening.customer_id, opening.outstanding AS due\n    FROM public.go_live_customer_opening_positions_internal(NULL) opening\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR p_branch_id = public.go_live_main_branch_internal()\n  ),\nbalances AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(due), 0)::BIGINT AS due,\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE due > 0 AND is_order) AS orders,\n      COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE due > 0) AS customers\n    FROM (\n      SELECT true AS is_order, customer_id, due FROM canonical_order_due\n      UNION ALL\n      SELECT false, customer_id, due FROM opening_due\n      UNION ALL\n      SELECT false,c.customer_id,c.outstanding FROM public.cheque_customer_claim_positions_internal() c\n      JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims k ON k.id=c.id JOIN public.deferred_cheques q ON q.id=k.cheque_id\n      WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR q.branch_id=p_branch_id\n    ) receivables\n  ),\n unified_sales219 AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT id,total_in_minor_units,delivery_fee_in_minor_units,completion_at,status FROM order_scope WHERE status IN ('completed', 'returned')\n      AND completion_at >= LEAST(p_month_start,p_week_start) AND completion_at < GREATEST(p_month_end,p_week_end)\n  )\n SELECT jsonb_object_agg(scope219.key,public.home219_adjust215_internal(period219.facts,p_branch_id,scope219.period_start,scope219.period_end,p_timezone,false)) INTO result\n FROM (VALUES('month'::TEXT,p_month_start,p_month_end),('week'::TEXT,p_week_start,p_week_end))scope219(key,period_start,period_end)\n CROSS JOIN LATERAL (\n WITH scope_damage219 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT public.inventory_damage_period_totals_internal(p_branch_id,scope219.period_start,scope219.period_end) AS value),\nperiod_sales AS (\n    SELECT * FROM unified_sales219 WHERE status IN ('completed', 'returned')\n      AND completion_at >= scope219.period_start AND completion_at < scope219.period_end\n  ),\nsales_totals AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS gross,\n      COALESCE(SUM(delivery_fee_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS delivery,\n      COUNT(*) AS count FROM period_sales\n  ),\nperiod_returns AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(entitlement), 0)::BIGINT AS entitlement,\n      COALESCE(SUM(refund), 0)::BIGINT AS refund, COALESCE(SUM(debt), 0)::BIGINT AS debt,\n      ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(recovery), 0))::BIGINT AS recovery, COUNT(*) AS count\n    FROM return_rows WHERE at >= scope219.period_start AND at < scope219.period_end\n  ),\ncosts AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.cogs_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS cogs\n    FROM public.order_items i JOIN period_sales o ON o.id = i.order_id\n  ),\nreplacement_costs AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS cost\n    FROM issued e JOIN public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects f ON f.operation_id = e.operation_id\n    WHERE e.issued_at >= scope219.period_start AND e.issued_at < scope219.period_end\n  ),\nflows AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(collection - reversal) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cash'), 0)::BIGINT AS cash_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection - reversal) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cliq'), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection-reversal) FILTER(WHERE method='bank_transfer'),0)::BIGINT AS bank_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection-reversal) FILTER(WHERE method='cheque'),0)::BIGINT AS cheque_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection-reversal) FILTER(WHERE COALESCE(method,'') NOT IN ('cash','cliq','bank_transfer','cheque')),0)::BIGINT AS other_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection-reversal),0)::BIGINT AS total_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(refund) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cash'), 0)::BIGINT AS cash_refunded,\n      COALESCE(SUM(refund) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cliq'), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq_refunded\n    FROM money_events WHERE at >= scope219.period_start AND at < scope219.period_end\n  ),\ncohort AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.coverage), 0)::BIGINT AS coverage,\n      COALESCE(SUM(p.due), 0)::BIGINT AS due\n    FROM positions p JOIN period_sales o ON o.id = p.id\n  ),\nexpenses AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS amount,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'cash'), 0)::BIGINT AS cash,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'cliq'), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq,\n      COUNT(*) AS count\n    FROM public.operational_expenses\n    WHERE (p_branch_id IS NULL OR branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      AND NOT COALESCE(is_reversed, false)\n      AND created_at >= scope219.period_start AND created_at < scope219.period_end\n  ),\ndaily_collections AS (\n    -- One period-local aggregation. Never rescan all money events twice for\n    -- every date in the month; collection/reversal equations are unchanged.\n    SELECT (m.at AT TIME ZONE p_timezone)::DATE AS day,\n      COALESCE(SUM(m.collection-m.reversal) FILTER(WHERE m.method='cash'),0)::BIGINT AS cash_collected,\n      COALESCE(SUM(m.collection-m.reversal) FILTER(WHERE m.method='cliq'),0)::BIGINT AS cliq_collected,\n      COALESCE(SUM(m.collection-m.reversal) FILTER(WHERE m.method='bank_transfer'),0)::BIGINT AS bank_collected,\n      COALESCE(SUM(m.collection-m.reversal) FILTER(WHERE m.method='cheque'),0)::BIGINT AS cheque_collected,\n      COALESCE(SUM(m.collection-m.reversal) FILTER(WHERE COALESCE(m.method,'') NOT IN ('cash','cliq','bank_transfer','cheque')),0)::BIGINT AS other_collected,\n      COALESCE(SUM(m.collection-m.reversal),0)::BIGINT AS total_collected\n    FROM money_events m WHERE m.at>=scope219.period_start AND m.at<scope219.period_end\n    GROUP BY (m.at AT TIME ZONE p_timezone)::DATE\n  ),\ndays AS (\n    SELECT day::DATE AS day FROM generate_series((scope219.period_start AT TIME ZONE p_timezone)::DATE,\n      (scope219.period_end AT TIME ZONE p_timezone)::DATE - 1, INTERVAL '1 day') day\n  ),\ndaily AS (\n    SELECT d.day,\n      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.total_in_minor_units) FROM period_sales o\n        WHERE (o.completion_at AT TIME ZONE p_timezone)::DATE = d.day), 0)::BIGINT AS gross,\n      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM period_sales o\n        WHERE (o.completion_at AT TIME ZONE p_timezone)::DATE = d.day)::BIGINT AS count,\n      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.entitlement) FROM return_rows r\n        WHERE r.at >= scope219.period_start AND r.at < scope219.period_end\n          AND (r.at AT TIME ZONE p_timezone)::DATE = d.day), 0)::BIGINT AS returned,\n      COALESCE(dc.cash_collected,0)::BIGINT AS cash_collected,\n      COALESCE(dc.cliq_collected,0)::BIGINT AS cliq_collected,\n      COALESCE(dc.bank_collected,0)::BIGINT AS bank_collected,\n      COALESCE(dc.cheque_collected,0)::BIGINT AS cheque_collected,\n      COALESCE(dc.other_collected,0)::BIGINT AS other_collected,\n      COALESCE(dc.total_collected,0)::BIGINT AS total_collected\n    FROM days d LEFT JOIN daily_collections dc ON dc.day=d.day\n  )\n SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n    'sales', jsonb_build_object('grossSalesInMinorUnits', s.gross, 'deliveryFeesInMinorUnits', s.delivery,\n      'returnEntitlementInMinorUnits', r.entitlement, 'refundsInMinorUnits', r.refund,\n      'debtReductionInMinorUnits', r.debt, 'netSalesInMinorUnits', s.gross - r.entitlement,\n      'cogsInMinorUnits', c.cogs, 'replacementCostInMinorUnits', rc.cost,\n      'restockRecoveryInMinorUnits', r.recovery, 'grossProfitInMinorUnits', s.gross - s.delivery - c.cogs,\n      'aftercareAdjustedMarginInMinorUnits', s.gross - r.entitlement - c.cogs - rc.cost + r.recovery,\n      'netProfitInMinorUnits', s.gross - r.entitlement - c.cogs - rc.cost + r.recovery - x.amount\n        - ((SELECT value FROM scope_damage219)->>'additionalInMinorUnits')::BIGINT,\n      'damageLosses',(SELECT value FROM scope_damage219),\n      'collectedInMinorUnits', co.coverage, 'outstandingInMinorUnits', co.due, 'returnCount', r.count,\n      'orderCount', s.count, 'completedOrderCount', s.count),\n    'cashFlow', jsonb_build_object('customerCollections',jsonb_build_object(\n      'cashInMinorUnits',f.cash_received,'cliqInMinorUnits',f.cliq_received,\n      'bankTransferInMinorUnits',f.bank_received,'chequeInMinorUnits',f.cheque_received,\n      'otherInMinorUnits',f.other_received,'totalInMinorUnits',f.total_received),\n      'cashCollectedInMinorUnits', f.cash_received,\n      'cliqCollectedInMinorUnits', f.cliq_received, 'cashRefundedInMinorUnits', f.cash_refunded,\n      'cliqRefundedInMinorUnits', f.cliq_refunded, 'cashNetFlowInMinorUnits', f.cash_received - f.cash_refunded,\n      'cliqNetFlowInMinorUnits', f.cliq_received - f.cliq_refunded),\n    'balances', jsonb_build_object('customerDueInMinorUnits', b.due, 'customerOrderCount', b.orders,\n      'customerCount', b.customers),\n    'expenses', jsonb_build_object('totalInMinorUnits', x.amount, 'cashInMinorUnits', x.cash,\n      'cliqInMinorUnits', x.cliq, 'count', x.count),\n    'dailyBreakdown', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date', day,\n      'completedOrderCount', count, 'grossSalesInMinorUnits', gross,\n      'returnEntitlementInMinorUnits', returned, 'netSalesInMinorUnits', gross - returned,\n      'cashCollectedInMinorUnits',cash_collected,'cliqCollectedInMinorUnits',cliq_collected,\n      'customerCollections',jsonb_build_object('cashInMinorUnits',cash_collected,'cliqInMinorUnits',cliq_collected,\n        'bankTransferInMinorUnits',bank_collected,'chequeInMinorUnits',cheque_collected,\n        'otherInMinorUnits',other_collected,'totalInMinorUnits',total_collected))\n      ORDER BY day), '[]'::JSONB) FROM daily)\n  )\n  FROM sales_totals s CROSS JOIN period_returns r CROSS JOIN costs c\n    CROSS JOIN replacement_costs rc CROSS JOIN flows f CROSS JOIN balances b\n    CROSS JOIN cohort co CROSS JOIN expenses x\n )period219(facts);\n RETURN result;\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.import_go_live_products_v1(p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb, p_dry_run boolean DEFAULT false)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_replay JSONB;\n  v_row JSONB;\n  v_n INTEGER := 0;\n  v_errors JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_error TEXT;\n  v_sku TEXT;\n  v_barcode TEXT;\n  v_name TEXT;\n  v_category_id UUID;\n  v_unit_id UUID;\n  v_purchase_unit_id UUID;\n  v_sale_unit_id UUID;\n  v_units_per_purchase INTEGER;\n  v_units_per_sale INTEGER;\n  v_sale_price BIGINT;\n  v_purchase_price BIGINT;\n  v_cost BIGINT;\n  v_min_stock INTEGER;\n  v_count INTEGER;\n  v_created JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_product JSONB;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'استيراد منتجات بداية التشغيل');\n  PERFORM public.go_live_assert_setup_open_internal();\n  IF NOT COALESCE(p_dry_run, false) THEN\n    v_replay := public.go_live_begin_batch_internal('products', p_idempotency_key, p_rows);\n    IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN\n      RETURN v_replay;\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF p_rows IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_rows) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الدفعة يجب أن تحتوي من 1 إلى 500 سطر.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)\n  LOOP\n    v_n := v_n + 1;\n    v_error := NULL;\n    v_sku := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'sku'), '');\n    v_barcode := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'barcode'), '');\n    v_name := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'name_ar'), '');\n    v_category_id := NULL; v_unit_id := NULL; v_purchase_unit_id := NULL; v_sale_unit_id := NULL;\n\n    IF jsonb_typeof(v_row) <> 'object' THEN\n      v_error := 'بيانات السطر غير صحيحة.';\n    ELSIF v_sku IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_sku) > 64 THEN\n      v_error := 'رمز الصنف SKU مطلوب وبحد أقصى 64 حرفاً.';\n    ELSIF v_name IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_name) > 200 THEN\n      v_error := 'اسم المنتج مطلوب وبحد أقصى 200 حرف.';\n    ELSIF v_barcode IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_barcode) > 64 THEN\n      v_error := 'الباركود أطول من المسموح.';\n    ELSIF COALESCE(v_row->>'units_per_purchase_unit', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,5}$'\n      OR COALESCE(v_row->>'units_per_sale_unit', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,5}$' THEN\n      v_error := 'عدد الحبات داخل الطرد يجب أن يكون رقماً صحيحاً أكبر من صفر.';\n    ELSIF v_row ? 'parcel_only' AND jsonb_typeof(v_row->'parcel_only') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean' THEN\n      v_error := 'PARCEL209_METHOD_INVALID: حقل بيتباع بالطرد بس يجب أن يكون نعم أو لا.';\n    ELSIF COALESCE((v_row->>'parcel_only')::BOOLEAN,false) AND (v_row->>'units_per_sale_unit')::INTEGER<=1 THEN\n      v_error := 'PARCEL209_PARCEL_SIZE_REQUIRED: الطرد فقط يحتاج أكثر من وحدة في طرد البيع.';\n    ELSIF COALESCE(v_row->>'sale_package_price_in_minor_units', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,11}$' THEN\n      v_error := 'سعر بيع الطرد يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر.';\n    ELSIF COALESCE(v_row->>'purchase_package_price_in_minor_units', '') !~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'\n      OR COALESCE(v_row->>'cost_per_base_unit_in_minor_units', '') !~ '^[0-9]{1,12}$'\n      OR COALESCE(v_row->>'min_stock_level', '0') !~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$' THEN\n      v_error := 'الأسعار والحد الأدنى يجب أن تكون أرقاماً موجبة صحيحة.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_error IS NULL THEN\n      SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(id::TEXT)::UUID INTO v_count, v_category_id FROM public.categories\n      WHERE is_active AND name_ar = BTRIM(v_row->>'category_name');\n      IF v_count <> 1 THEN\n        v_error := CASE WHEN v_count = 0 THEN 'القسم غير موجود؛ أضفه أولاً أو صحّح اسمه.'\n          ELSE 'اسم القسم مكرر؛ صحّح الأقسام أولاً.' END;\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL THEN\n      v_unit_id := public.go_live_resolve_unit_internal(v_row->>'base_unit_name');\n      IF v_unit_id IS NULL THEN\n        v_error := 'الوحدة الصغرى غير موجودة أو اسمها مكرر؛ اكتب رمز الوحدة (مثل PKT).';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL THEN\n      v_purchase_unit_id := public.go_live_resolve_unit_internal(v_row->>'purchase_unit_name');\n      IF v_purchase_unit_id IS NULL THEN\n        v_error := 'وحدة طرد الشراء غير موجودة أو اسمها مكرر؛ اكتب رمز الوحدة (مثل CTN).';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL THEN\n      v_sale_unit_id := public.go_live_resolve_unit_internal(v_row->>'sale_unit_name');\n      IF v_sale_unit_id IS NULL THEN\n        v_error := 'وحدة طرد البيع غير موجودة أو اسمها مكرر؛ اكتب رمز الوحدة (مثل CTN).';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.products WHERE lower(sku) = lower(v_sku)) THEN\n      v_error := 'رمز SKU مستخدم لمنتج موجود.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL AND v_barcode IS NOT NULL\n      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.products WHERE barcode = v_barcode) THEN\n      v_error := 'الباركود مستخدم لمنتج موجود.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL AND (\n      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) other\n      WHERE lower(BTRIM(other->>'sku')) = lower(v_sku)) > 1 THEN\n      v_error := 'رمز SKU مكرر داخل الملف.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL AND v_barcode IS NOT NULL AND (\n      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) other\n      WHERE BTRIM(other->>'barcode') = v_barcode) > 1 THEN\n      v_error := 'الباركود مكرر داخل الملف.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_error IS NOT NULL THEN\n      v_errors := v_errors || jsonb_build_object('row', v_n, 'message', v_error);\n      CONTINUE;\n    END IF;\n    IF COALESCE(p_dry_run, false) THEN\n      CONTINUE;\n    END IF;\n\n    v_units_per_purchase := (v_row->>'units_per_purchase_unit')::INTEGER;\n    v_units_per_sale := (v_row->>'units_per_sale_unit')::INTEGER;\n    v_sale_price := (v_row->>'sale_package_price_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;\n    v_purchase_price := (v_row->>'purchase_package_price_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;\n    v_cost := (v_row->>'cost_per_base_unit_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;\n    v_min_stock := COALESCE((v_row->>'min_stock_level')::INTEGER, 0);\n    BEGIN\n      v_product := public.create_product_with_opening_stock_v5(\n        v_sku, v_barcode, v_name, NULL, v_category_id, NULL, v_unit_id,\n        v_purchase_unit_id, v_units_per_purchase, v_purchase_price,\n        v_sale_unit_id, v_units_per_sale, v_sale_price, v_cost, v_min_stock,\n        NULL, NULL, 0, 'تعريف منتج من بداية التشغيل', NULL, COALESCE((v_row->>'parcel_only')::BOOLEAN,false));\n    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_ROW_FAILED: السطر ' || v_n || ': ' || SQLERRM;\n    END;\n    v_created := v_created || jsonb_build_object('row', v_n, 'productId', v_product->>'product_id', 'sku', v_sku);\n  END LOOP;\n\n  IF COALESCE(p_dry_run, false) THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'dryRun', true, 'rowCount', v_n,\n      'validCount', v_n - jsonb_array_length(v_errors), 'errors', v_errors);\n  END IF;\n  IF jsonb_array_length(v_errors) > 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_BATCH_INVALID: الملف يحتوي أسطراً غير صالحة؛ لم يُحفظ أي سطر.',\n      DETAIL = v_errors::TEXT;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'dryRun', false, 'idempotentReplay', false,\n    'kind', 'products', 'rowCount', v_n, 'created', v_created);\n  INSERT INTO public.go_live_import_batches(batch_kind, idempotency_key, request_hash, row_count, result, created_by)\n  VALUES ('products', BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), md5(p_rows::TEXT), v_n, v_result, v_user_id);\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n  VALUES (v_user_id, 'GO_LIVE_IMPORT_PRODUCTS', 'go_live_import_batches', NULL,\n    jsonb_build_object('idempotency_key', BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), 'row_count', v_n,\n      'skus', (SELECT jsonb_agg(c->>'sku') FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_created) c)));\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.inventory_damage_period_totals_internal(p_branch_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n WITH scoped AS MATERIALIZED (\n  SELECT * FROM public.inventory_damage_events\n  WHERE (p_branch_id IS NULL OR branch_id=p_branch_id) AND occurred_at>=p_from AND occurred_at<p_to\n ), reasons AS (\n  SELECT reason_code,COUNT(*) AS count,SUM(quantity) AS quantity,SUM(loss_in_minor_units) AS amount,\n   COALESCE(SUM(loss_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE origin='customer_return'),0) AS included\n  FROM scoped GROUP BY reason_code\n ) SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n  'totalInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(loss_in_minor_units),0),\n  'additionalInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(loss_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE origin='shop'),0),\n  'alreadyIncludedInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(loss_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE origin='customer_return'),0),\n  'reasons',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code',reason_code,'count',count,'quantity',quantity,\n   'amountInMinorUnits',amount,'alreadyIncludedInMinorUnits',included) ORDER BY reason_code) FROM reasons),'[]'::jsonb)\n ) FROM scoped;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_erp_staff()\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT\n    public.is_mfa_policy_satisfied()\n    AND EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.profiles p\n      JOIN public.user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = p.id\n      JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id\n      WHERE p.id = auth.uid()\n        AND p.is_active = true\n        AND r.code = ANY (\n          ARRAY[\n            'owner',\n            'admin',\n            'manager',\n            'accountant',\n            'cashier',\n            'sales',\n            'warehouse_keeper',\n            'orders',\n            'delivery_driver',\n            'view_only'\n          ]::TEXT[]\n        )\n    );\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.issue_supplier_cheque_v1(p_supplier_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_bank_name text, p_cheque_number text, p_due_date date, p_amount_in_minor_units is_active) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'اختر فرعاً نشطاً.';END IF;\n  -- Same PO-before-supplier row lock order as the existing133 writer.\n  IF p_purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE id=p_purchase_order_id AND supplier_id=p_supplier_id FOR UPDATE;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'أمر الشراء لا يتبع المورد المحدد.';END IF;\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=p_supplier_id AND is_active FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'المورد غير موجود أو غير نشط.';END IF;\n  v_plan:=public.cheque_supplier_plan_internal(p_supplier_id,p_amount_in_minor_units,p_claim_id,p_purchase_order_id,p_opening_only);\n  INSERT INTO public.deferred_cheques(id,tracking_number,direction,cheque_number,bank_name,due_date,amount_in_minor_units,\n    supplier_id,branch_id,notes,created_by,changed_by)\n  VALUES(v_id,'CHQ-'||lpad(nextval('public.deferred_cheque_number_seq')::TEXT,8,'0'),'outgoing',btrim(p_cheque_number),\n    btrim(p_bank_name),p_due_date,p_amount_in_minor_units,p_supplier_id,p_branch_id,NULLIF(btrim(p_notes),''),auth.uid(),auth.uid());\n  INSERT INTO public.cheque_party_keys(party_kind,party_id,bank_key,cheque_number,cheque_id)\n  VALUES('supplier',p_supplier_id,lower(btrim(p_bank_name)),btrim(p_cheque_number),v_id);\n  v_payment:=public.cheque_pay_supplier_internal(v_id,p_supplier_id,v_plan,p_purchase_order_id);\n  UPDATE public.deferred_cheques SET supplier_payment_id=v_payment WHERE id=v_id;\n  RETURN public.cheque_finish_event_internal(v_id,'issued',NULL,NULL,p_idempotency_key,v_request);\nEND;\n$function$\n",
