        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lite1_activate_epoch2(p_rows jsonb, p_notes text, p_key text, p_preview text, p_confirmation text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE request JSONB;identity JSONB;fingerprint TEXT;r sales_lite1.requests;plan JSONB;line JSONB;result JSONB;\n eid UUID:=gen_random_uuid();at TIMESTAMPTZ;delta INTEGER;movement UUID;pid UUID;wid UUID;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM sales_lite1.owner();IF auth.jwt()->>'aal' IS DISTINCT FROM 'aal2' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE2_OWNER_AAL2_REQUIRED';END IF;\n IF p_key IS NULL OR length(p_key) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 128 OR COALESCE(p_preview,'')!~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'\n OR p_confirmation IS DISTINCT FROM 'تفعيل المحاسبة بالجرد المعتمد' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE2_EPOCH_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED';END IF;\n request:=sales_lite2.epoch_request(p_rows,p_notes);identity:=jsonb_build_object('request',request,'preview',p_preview);\n fingerprint:=encode(extensions.digest(identity::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_key,0));\n SELECT * INTO r FROM sales_lite1.requests WHERE key=p_key;\n IF FOUND THEN\n  IF r.kind<>'epoch2' OR r.actor IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() OR r.fingerprint<>fingerprint OR r.result IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE1_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT';END IF;\n  RETURN r.result;\n END IF;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_operations WHERE idempotency_key=p_key) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.orders WHERE idempotency_key=p_key) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE1_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT';END IF;\n BEGIN\n  PERFORM 1 FROM sales_lite1.mode WHERE id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;\n  -- Prevent catalog/warehouse/balance phantoms during the short activation.\n  -- No new trigger, global setting or relaxed legacy writer is necessary.\n  LOCK TABLE public.products,public.warehouses,public.branches,public.inventory_balances IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE NOWAIT;\n EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE2_EPOCH_BUSY';END;\n plan:=sales_lite2.prepare_epoch(request);\n IF encode(extensions.digest(plan::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex')<>p_preview THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE2_EPOCH_PREVIEW_CHANGED';END IF;\n INSERT INTO sales_lite1.requests VALUES(p_key,'epoch2',fingerprint,auth.uid(),NULL);\n at:=clock_timestamp();INSERT INTO sales_lite2.opening_epochs VALUES(eid,p_key,at,auth.uid(),plan,p_preview);\n -- Mode, physical counts and costs commit atomically. Any error rolls back ALL.\n -- The original inventory/cost guards now admit only ordinary full-mode work.\n UPDATE sales_lite1.mode SET full_accounting=true WHERE id;\n -- One cost per SKU was already validated across every warehouse. Update each\n -- product once, not once per warehouse; keep all ordinary triggers enabled.\n UPDATE public.products p SET cost_price_in_minor_units=c.cost,\n  wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact=c.cost::NUMERIC,updated_at=at\n FROM (SELECT DISTINCT (x->>'productId')::UUID pid,(x->>'unitCostInMinorUnits')::BIGINT cost FROM jsonb_array_elements(plan->'lines') x) c WHERE p.id=c.pid;\n FOR line IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(plan->'lines') LOOP\n  pid:=(line->>'productId')::UUID;wid:=(line->>'warehouseId')::UUID;\n  INSERT INTO public.inventory_balances(product_id,warehouse_id,on_hand_quantity,reserved_quantity,updated_at)\n   VALUES(pid,wid,(line->>'actualQuantity')::INTEGER,0,at)\n   ON CONFLICT(product_id,warehouse_id) DO UPDATE SET on_hand_quantity=EXCLUDED.on_hand_quantity,updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at;\n  delta:=(line->>'actualQuantity')::INTEGER-(line->>'previousQuantity')::INTEGER;movement:=NULL;\n  IF delta<>0 THEN\n   INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements(product_id,warehouse_id,movement_type,quantity,balance_before,balance_after,reference_type,reference_id,notes,created_by,created_at)\n   VALUES(pid,wid,'opening_balance',delta,(line->>'previousQuantity')::INTEGER,(line->>'actualQuantity')::INTEGER,'sales_lite2_opening_epoch',eid,request->>'notes',auth.uid(),at) RETURNING id INTO movement;\n  END IF;\n  INSERT INTO sales_lite2.opening_epoch_items VALUES(eid,pid,wid,(line->>'previousQuantity')::INTEGER,(line->>'actualQuantity')::INTEGER,\n idempotency_key=p_key) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.orders WHERE idempotency_key=p_key) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE1_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT';END IF;\n -- Old lite invoices remain non-stock even after INSERT INTO sales_lite2.return_details(return_id,parcel_instance_id,applied_damage,request_snapshot,plan_snapshot)\n result:=jsonb_build_object('success',true,'contractVersion',215,'operationId',rid,'returnOperationId',rid,'returnId',rid,'returnNumber','L2R-'||rid::TEXT,'orderId',o.id,'entitlementInMinorUnits',plan->'entitlementInMinorUnits',\n  'debtReductionInMinorUnits',plan->'debtReductionInMinorUnits','moneyRefundInMinorUnits',plan->'moneyRefundInMinorUnits','accountingTracked',false,\n THEN method ELSE NULL END);\n INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id,action,entity_name,entity_id,details)         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lite1_shift_closing2(p_shift_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE original JSONB;lite_count BIGINT;cash BIGINT;cliq BIGINT;summary JSONB;\nBEGIN\n original:=public.get_cash_shift_closing_report(p_shift_id);\n IF COALESCE(original->>'success','false')<>'true' OR original->>'accountingTracked'='false' THEN RETURN original;END IF;\n SELECT count(*),COALESCE(sum(money_refund) FILTER(WHERE method='cash'),0),COALESCE(sum(money_refund) FILTER(WHERE method='cliq'),0)\n INTO lite_count,cash,cliq FROM sales_lite1.returns WHERE shift_id=p_shift_id AND money_refund>0;\n IF lite_count=0 THEN RETURN original;END IF;\n PERFORM sales_lite1.owner();\n summary:=original->'shift';\n IF jsonb_typeof(summary) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR original#>>'{sales,orderCount}' IS NULL\n OR original#>>'{outflows,returnCount}' IS NULL\n OR (summary->>'cashRefundsInMinorUnits')::BIGINT<cash OR (summary->>'cliqRefundsInMinorUnits')::BIGINT<cliq\n OR original#>>'{outflows,cashRefundsInMinorUnits}' IS DISTINCT FROM summary->>'cashRefundsInMinorUnits'\n OR original#>>'{outflows,cliqRefundsInMinorUnits}' IS DISTINCT FROM summary->>'cliqRefundsInMinorUnits'\n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE2_MIXED_SHIFT_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH';END IF;\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'accountingTracked',false,'historyWithoutCost',true,'contractVersion','lite2-mixed-shift-v1',\n 'shiftId',p_shift_id,'summary',summary,'reconciliation',original->'reconciliation','snapshotStatus',original->'snapshotStatus',\n 'orderCount',(original#>>'{sales,orderCount}')::BIGINT,'returnCount',(original#>>'{outflows,returnCount}')::BIGINT+lite_count,\n 'returnMoneyInMinorUnits',(summary->>'cashRefundsInMinorUnits')::BIGINT+(summary->>'cliqRefundsInMinorUnits')::BIGINT,\n 'cashExpensesInMinorUnits',(summary->>'cashExpensesInMinorUnits')::BIGINT);\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lite1_transition2(p_order uuid, p_next text, p_key text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE replay JSONB;o public.orders;allowed BOOLEAN;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM sales_lite1.owner();\n replay:=sales_lite1.lock_request(p_key,'transition2',jsonb_build_object('order',p_order,'next',p_next,'notes',p_notes));IF replay IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN replay;END IF;\n PERFORM public.phase4_lock_customer_order_context_internal(p_order,false,false);\n SELECT * INTO o FROM public.orders WHERE id=p_order FOR UPDATE;\n IF NOT FOUND OR NOT sales_lite1.is_order(o.id) OR o.source<>'website' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE2_ORDER_CONTEXT_INVALID';END IF;\n allowed:=CASE o.status WHEN 'new' THEN p_next IN('confirmed','preparing') WHEN 'confirmed' THEN p_next='preparing'\n  WHEN 'preparing' THEN p_next IN('ready','out_for_delivery') WHEN 'ready' THEN p_next='out_for_delivery' ELSE false END;\n IF allowed IS DISTINCT FROM true OR length(COALESCE(p_notes,''))>1000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_LIFECYCLE_INVALID';END IF;\n UPDATE public.orders SET status=p_next,updated_at=now() WHERE id=p_order;\n INSERT INTO public.order_status_history(order_id,old_status,new_status,changed_by,notes) VALUES(p_order,o.status,p_next,auth.uid(),NULLIF(btrim(p_notes),''));\n RETURN sales_lite1.finish(p_key,jsonb_build_object('success',true,'order_id',p_order,'order_number',o.order_number,'status',p_next,'accountingTracked',false));\nEND $function$\n",

FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QUANTITY223_PRODUCT_REQUIRED';END IF;\n family:=p.is_flavor_master OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.products c WHERE c.flavor_master_product_id=p.id);\n -- Never label a 'unitId',leaf.unit_id,'unitName',COALESCE(u.name_ar,'باكيت'),\n  'enabled',COALESCE(c.enabled,false),'quantity',COALESCE(c.quantity,0),\n  'threshold',COALESCE(c.low_threshold,0),'revision',COALESCE(c.revision,0),\n  'everEnabled',COALESCE(c.ever_enabled,false),'active',leaf.is_active,\n  'manualAvailable',COALESCE(sales_lite1.available(leaf.id),false),\n  'effectiveAvailable',COALESCE(sales_lite1.available(leaf.id),false) AND(NOT COALESCE(c.enabled,false) OR c.quantity>0)\n ) ORDER BY leaf.sku,leaf.id),'[]') INTO rows\n FROM public.products leaf LEFT JOIN public.units u ON u.id=leaf.unit_id\n LEFT JOIN sales_lite3.quantity_counters c ON c.product_id=leaf.id\n WHERE NOT THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVENTORY224_PAGE_INVALID';\n END IF;\n needle:=btrim(regexp_replace(translate(lower(normalize(COALESCE(p_search,''),NFKC)),\n  '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹','01234567890123456789'),'[[:space:]]+',' ','g'));\n WITH tracked AS MATERIALIZED(\n  SELECT p.id,p.name_ar,p.flavor_name_ar,p.flavor_master_product_id,parent.name_ar AS family_name,\n   p.sku,p.barcode,c.unit_id,COALESCE(u.name_ar,'باكيت') AS unit_name,c.quantity,c.low_threshold,c.revision,c.updated_at,\n   CASE WHEN c.quantity=0 THEN 0 WHEN c.quantity<c.low_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS priority,\n   btrim(regexp_replace(translate(lower(normalize(concat_ws(' ',p.name_ar,p.flavor_name_ar,parent.name_ar,p.sku,p.barcode),NFKC)),\n    '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹','01234567890123456789'),'[[:space:]]+',' ','g')) AS search_text\n  FROM sales_lite3.quantity_counters c JOIN public.products p ON p.id=c.product_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.products filtered),'page',p_page,'pageSize',p_page_size,\n  'items',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n   'productId',r.id,'name',r.name_ar,'flavorName',r.flavor_name_ar,\n   'familyId',r.flavor_master_product_id,'familyName',r.family_name,'sku',r.sku,'barcode',r.barcode,\n   'unitId',r.unit_id,'unitName',r.unit_name,'enabled',true,'quantity',r.quantity,'threshold',r.low_threshold,\n   'status',CASE r.priority WHEN 0 THEN 'zero' WHEN 1 THEN 'low' ELSE 'available' END,\n   'revision',r.revision,'updatedAt',r.updated_at,'lastEvent',event.data\n  ) ORDER BY r.priority,r.name_ar,r.flavor_name_ar,r.sku,r.id)\n  FROM page_rows r LEFT JOIN LATERAL(\n   SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind',e.kind,'delta',e.quantity_after-e.quantity_before,'at',e.created_at,\n    'actorDisplayName',NULLIF(btrim(actor.full_name),''),'source',o.source) AS data\n   FROM sales_lite3.quantity_events e LEFT JOIN public.profiles actor ON actor.id=e.created_by\n   LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON o.id=e.order_id\n   WHERE e.product_id=r.id ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 1\n  ) event ON true),'[]'::JSONB)) INTO result;\n RETURN result;\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_customer_phone(p_phone text)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  WITH cleaned AS (\n    SELECT regexp_replace(TRIM(p_phone), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS digits\n  ),\n  international_prefix_removed AS (\n    SELECT CASE\n      WHEN digits LIKE '00962%' THEN SUBSTRING(digits FROM 3)\n      ELSE digits\n    END AS digits\n    FROM cleaned\n  )\n  SELECT CASE\n    WHEN digits ~ '^962[0-9]{9}$' THEN '0' || SUBSTRING(digits FROM 4)\n    WHEN digits ~ '^7[0-9]{8}$' THEN '0' || digits\n    ELSE digits\n  END\n  FROM international_prefix_removed;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.open_cash_shift(p_branch_id uuid, p_opening_cash_in_minor_units bigint)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_shift_id UUID;\n  v_shift_number TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'فتح وردية الصندوق'\n  );\n  IF COALESCE(p_opening_cash_in_minor_units, -1) < 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'العهدة الافتتاحية لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.branches WHERE id = p_branch_id AND is_active) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الفرع المحدد غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n  END IF;\n  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE branch_id = p_branch_id AND status = 'open') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'توجد وردية مفتوحة بالفعل لهذا الفرع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_shift_number := 'SHF-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || LPAD(NEXTVAL('public.cash_shift_number_seq')::TEXT, 6, '0');\n  INSERT INTO public.cash_shifts (\n    shift_number, branch_id, opened_by, opening_cash_in_minor_units,\n    expected_cash_in_minor_units\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_shift_number, p_branch_id, v_user_id, p_opening_cash_in_minor_units,\n    p_opening_cash_in_minor_units\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_shift_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n  VALUES (v_user_id, 'OPEN_CASH_SHIFT', 'cash_shifts', v_shift_id,\n    jsonb_build_object('shift_number', v_shift_number, 'branch_id', p_branch_id,\n      'opening_cash_in_minor_units', p_opening_cash_in_minor_units));\n\n  RETURN public.get_cash_shift_summary(v_shift_id) || jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true, 'message', 'تم فتح الوردية وربطها بالصندوق بنجاح.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner217_claim_deliveries_internal(p_channel text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10, p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 120)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_channel TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_channel, '')));\n  v_limit INTEGER := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 10), 1), 50);\n  v_lease_seconds INTEGER :=\n    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_lease_seconds, 120), 30), 900);\n  v_items JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_channel NOT IN ('telegram', 'whatsapp') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid automation delivery channel.';\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.automation_event_deliveries (event_id, channel)\n  SELECT ae.id, v_channel\n  FROM public.automation_events ae\n  WHERE ae.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'\n  ON CONFLICT (event_id, channel) DO NOTHING;\n\n  -- Finalize exhausted retries explicitly. A live lease is never stolen; an\n  -- exhausted processing row is dead-lettered only after its lease expires.\n  UPDATE public.automation_event_deliveries d\n  SET\n    status = 'dead_letter',\n    dead_lettered_at = COALESCE(d.dead_lettered_at, NOW()),\n    lease_expires_at = NULL,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE d.channel = v_channel\n    AND d.attempt_count >= 10\n    AND (\n      d.status IN ('pending', 'failed')\n      OR (d.status = 'processing' AND d.lease_expires_at <= NOW())\n    );\n\n  WITH candidates AS (\n    SELECT d.event_id\n    FROM public.automation_event_deliveries d\n    JOIN public.automation_events ae ON ae.id = d.event_id\n    WHERE d.channel = v_channel\n      AND d.attempt_count < 10\n      AND (\n        (d.status IN ('pending', 'failed') AND d.next_attempt_at <= NOW())\n        OR\n        (d.status = 'processing' AND d.lease_expires_at <= NOW())\n      )\n    ORDER BY ae.created_at, ae.id\n    FOR UPDATE OF d SKIP LOCKED\n    LIMIT v_limit\n  ), claimed AS (\n    UPDATE public.automation_event_deliveries d\n    SET\n      status = 'processing',\n      attempt_count = d.attempt_count + 1,\n      first_attempt_at = COALESCE(d.first_attempt_at, NOW()),\n      last_attempt_at = NOW(),\n      lease_expires_at = NOW() + make_interval(secs => v_lease_seconds),\n      last_error = NULL,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n    FROM candidates c\n    WHERE d.event_id = c.event_id\n      AND d.channel = v_channel\n    RETURNING d.event_id, d.attempt_count, d.lease_expires_at\n  )\n  SELECT jsonb_agg(\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'eventId', ae.id,\n      'eventType', ae.event_type,\n      'entityId', ae.entity_id,\n      'payload', ae.payload,\n      'createdAt', ae.created_at,\n      'attemptCount', c.attempt_count,\n      'leaseExpiresAt', c.lease_expires_at\n    ) ORDER BY ae.created_at, ae.id\n  ) INTO v_items\n  FROM claimed c\n  JOIN public.automation_events ae ON ae.id = c.event_id;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'channel', v_channel,\n    'items', COALESCE(v_items, '[]'::JSONB)\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner217_complete_delivery_internal(p_event_id uuid, p_channel text, p_success boolean, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_channel TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_channel, '')));\n  v_status TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_event_id IS NULL OR v_channel NOT IN ('telegram', 'whatsapp') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid automation delivery completion.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.automation_event_deliveries d\n  SET\n    status = CASE\n      WHEN COALESCE(p_success, false) THEN 'delivered'\n      WHEN d.attempt_count >= 10 THEN 'dead_letter'\n      ELSE 'failed'\n    END,\n    delivered_at = CASE WHEN COALESCE(p_success, false)\n      THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,\n    dead_lettered_at = CASE\n      WHEN NOT COALESCE(p_success, false) AND d.attempt_count >= 10\n        THEN COALESCE(d.dead_lettered_at, NOW())\n      ELSE NULL\n    END,\n    next_attempt_at = CASE WHEN COALESCE(p_success, false)\n      THEN d.next_attempt_at\n      ELSE NOW() + make_interval(\n        secs => LEAST(3600, 60 * power(2, LEAST(d.attempt_count, 6))::INTEGER)\n      )\n    END,\n    lease_expires_at = NULL,\n    last_error = CASE WHEN COALESCE(p_success, false)\n      THEN NULL ELSE LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_error), ''), 'Delivery failed'), 1000)\n    END,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE d.event_id = p_event_id\n    AND d.channel = v_channel\n    AND d.status = 'processing'\n  RETURNING d.status INTO v_status;\n\n  IF v_status IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Automation delivery is not currently processing.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'eventId', p_event_id,\n    'channel', v_channel,\n    'status', v_status\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_assert_whole_single_sku_quantity_internal(p_order_item_id uuid, p_quantity integer)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_item public.order_items%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO v_item FROM public.order_items WHERE id=p_order_item_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_SOURCE_INVALID: Missing immutable sale root'; END IF;\n  IF v_item.commercial_line_kind='legacy_single_sku_parcel' AND (\n    v_item.units_per_sale_package IS NULL OR v_item.units_per_sale_package<=0\n    OR v_item.sale_package_quantity IS NULL OR v_item.sale_package_quantity<=0\n    OR v_item.quantity::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM v_item.sale_package_quantity::bigint*v_item.units_per_sale_package\n    OR p_quantity IS NULL OR p_quantity<=0\n    OR mod(p_quantity, v_item.units_per_sale_package)<>0\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PACKAGE_D_WHOLE_SINGLE_SKU_PARCEL_REQUIRED: اختر كراتين كاملة حسب حجم الكرتونة التاريخي';\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_capture_single_sku_price_snapshot()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_type TEXT; v_phone TEXT; v_code TEXT; v_frozen TIMESTAMPTZ; v_packet_price BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n    IF NEW.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM\n       OLD.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      OR (OLD.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NOT NULL\n        AND ROW(NEW.order_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.commercial_line_kind,NEW.quantity,NEW.units_per_sale_package,\n          NEW.sale_package_quantity,NEW.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units)\n        IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.order_id,OLD.product_id,OLD.commercial_line_kind,OLD.quantity,OLD.units_per_sale_package,\n          OLD.sale_package_quantity,OLD.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units)) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='P0001',\n        MESSAGE='PACKAGE_D_CARTON_PRICE_IMMUTABLE: Historical standalone price cannot be changed or backfilled.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='P0001',\n      MESSAGE='PHASE4_STANDALONE_PRICE_SERVER_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Caller supplied snapshot forbidden.';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.commercial_line_kind='legacy_single_sku_parcel' THEN\n    SELECT sale_price_in_minor_units INTO v_packet_price FROM public.products\n    WHERE id=NEW.product_id AND is_active AND NOT is_flavor_master FOR SHARE;\n    -- A missing standalone packet price is not a missing carton price. Keep\n    -- the nullable evidence absent; only CUSTOMER_DAMAGE requires this fact.\n    -- Do not catch unrelated pricing/promotion/authority errors.\n    IF FOUND AND v_packet_price=0 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n    SELECT op.operation_type, c.phone, o.promotion_code_snapshot, op.completed_at\n      INTO v_type,v_phone,v_code,v_frozen\n    FROM public.orders o JOIN public.business_operations op ON op.id=o.operation_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.id=NEW.order_id;\n    IF v_type='phase3_pos_sale_v1' THEN\n      NEW.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units :=\n        public.phase4_effective_standalone_unit_price_internal(NEW.product_id,'admin_pos',NULL,NULL,v_frozen);\n    ELSIF v_type='phase3_customer_reservation_v1' THEN\n      NEW.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units :=\n        public.phase4_effective_standalone_unit_price_internal(NEW.product_id,'customer_v2',v_phone,v_code,v_frozen);\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_create_customer_order_before_source_guard_internal(p_customer_full_name text, p_customer_phone text, p_customer_email text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_governorate text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_city text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_area text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_street text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_building text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_floor text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_apartment text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_address_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_latitude double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_longitude double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_formatted_address text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_google_maps_url text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_location_source text DEFAULT 'manual'::text, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_items jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_discount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_customer_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_internal_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_source text DEFAULT 'website'::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_item JSONB;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_package_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_units_per_package INTEGER;\n  v_package_price BIGINT;\n  v_package_name TEXT;\n  v_base_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_line_total BIGINT;\n  v_exact_subtotal BIGINT := 0;\n  v_exact_total BIGINT;\n  v_base_items JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_line_snapshots JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_legacy_result JSONB;\n  v_order_id UUID;\n  v_customer_id UUID;\n  v_order_number TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_items IS NULL\n    OR jsonb_typeof(p_items) <> 'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سلة الطلب فارغة، يجب اختيار طرد واحد على الأقل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF COALESCE(p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units, 0) < 0\n    OR COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0) < 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رسوم التوصيل والخصم لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_item IN\n    SELECT item.value\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS item(value)\n    ORDER BY item.value->>'product_id'\n  LOOP\n    BEGIN\n      v_product_id := (v_item->>'product_id')::UUID;\n      v_package_quantity := (v_item->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n    EXCEPTION\n      WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات أحد طرود الطلب غير صحيحة.';\n    END;\n\n    IF v_product_id IS NULL\n      OR v_package_quantity IS NULL\n      OR v_package_quantity <= 0\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'كل صنف يحتاج منتجاً وعدد طرود صحيحاً أكبر من صفر.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT\n      p.units_per_sale_unit,\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(su.name_ar, 'طرد')\n    INTO\n      v_units_per_package,\n      v_package_price,\n      v_package_name\n    FROM public.products p\n    LEFT JOIN public.units su ON su.id = p.sale_unit_id\n    WHERE p.id = v_product_id\n      AND p.is_active = true;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'أحد منتجات الطلب غير متاح للبيع على الموقع.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF COALESCE(v_units_per_package, 0) <= 0\n      OR COALESCE(v_package_price, 0) <= 0\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'طرد بيع المنتج غير مضبوط، تواصل مع إدارة المتجر.';\n    END IF;\n\n    v_base_quantity := v_package_quantity * v_units_per_package;\n    v_line_total := v_package_quantity * v_package_price;\n    v_exact_subtotal := v_exact_subtotal + v_line_total;\n\n    v_base_items := v_base_items || jsonb_build_array(\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'product_id', v_product_id,\n        'quantity', v_base_quantity\n      )\n    );\n    v_line_snapshots := v_line_snapshots || jsonb_build_array(\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'product_id', v_product_id,\n        'package_quantity', v_package_quantity,\n        'units_per_package', v_units_per_package,\n        'package_name', v_package_name,\n        'package_price', v_package_price,\n        'line_total', v_line_total\n      )\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n\n  v_exact_total :=\n    v_exact_subtotal\n    + COALESCE(p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units, 0)\n    - COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0);\n\n  IF v_exact_total < 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'قيمة الخصم أكبر من إجمالي الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_legacy_result :=\n    public.create_customer_order_base_units_legacy(\n      p_customer_full_name,\n      p_customer_phone,\n      p_customer_email,\n      p_governorate,\n      p_city,\n      p_area,\n      p_street,\n      p_building,\n      p_floor,\n      p_apartment,\n      p_address_notes,\n      p_latitude,\n      p_longitude,\n      p_formatted_address,\n      p_google_maps_url,\n      p_location_source,\n      p_branch_id,\n      p_warehouse_id,\n      v_base_items,\n      p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units,\n      0,\n      p_customer_notes,\n      p_internal_notes,\n      p_source\n    );\n\n  IF NOT COALESCE((v_legacy_result->>'success')::BOOLEAN, false) THEN\n    RETURN v_legacy_result;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_order_id := (v_legacy_result->>'order_id')::UUID;\n  v_customer_id := (v_legacy_result->>'customer_id')::UUID;\n  v_order_number := v_legacy_result->>'order_number';\n\n  UPDATE public.customers\n  SET customer_type = 'wholesale', updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = v_customer_id;\n\n  FOR v_item IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_line_snapshots)\n  LOOP\n    UPDATE public.order_items\n    SET\n      sale_package_quantity =\n        (v_item->>'package_quantity')::INTEGER,\n      units_per_sale_package =\n        (v_item->>'units_per_package')::INTEGER,\n      sale_package_name_snapshot = v_item->>'package_name',\n      sale_package_price_in_minor_units =\n        (v_item->>'package_price')::BIGINT,\n      line_total_in_minor_units =\n        (v_item->>'line_total')::BIGINT,\n      cogs_in_minor_units =\n        quantity * unit_cost_in_minor_units,\n      profit_in_minor_units =\n        (v_item->>'line_total')::BIGINT\n        - (quantity * unit_cost_in_minor_units)\n    WHERE order_id = v_order_id\n      AND product_id = (v_item->>'product_id')::UUID;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET\n    subtotal_in_minor_units = v_exact_subtotal,\n    discount_in_minor_units =\n      COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0),\n    total_in_minor_units = v_exact_total,\n    whatsapp_message =\n      'تم استلام طلبك رقم '\n      || v_order_number\n      || ' بقيمة إجمالية '\n      || (v_exact_total::NUMERIC / 1000)::TEXT\n      || ' د.أ. سيتم التواصل معك لتأكيد التوصيل.',\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = v_order_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    auth.uid(),\n    'APPLY_WHOLESALE_CUSTOMER_ORDER_ACCOUNTING',\n    'orders',\n    v_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'subtotal_in_minor_units', v_exact_subtotal,\n      'delivery_fee_in_minor_units',\n        COALESCE(p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units, 0),\n      'discount_in_minor_units',\n        COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0),\n      'total_in_minor_units', v_exact_total,\n      'package_lines', v_line_snapshots\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'order_id', v_order_id,\n    'order_number', v_order_number,\n    'customer_id', v_customer_id,\n    'customer_address_id',\n      v_legacy_result->>'customer_address_id',\n    'customer_reused',\n      COALESCE(\n        (v_legacy_result->>'customer_reused')::BOOLEAN,\n        false\n      ),\n    'subtotal', v_exact_subtotal,\n    'total', v_exact_total,\n    'status', 'new',\n    'message', 'تم إنشاء طلب طرود الجملة وحجز حباتها من المخزون بدقة.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "identity": "package_d_create_pos_sale_before_attempt_guard_internal(p_warehouse_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_customer_name text, p_payment_method text, p_lines jsonb, p_discount_in_minor_units bigint, p_amount_received_in_minor_units bigint, p_idempotency_key text)",
        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_create_pos_sale_before_attempt_guard_internal(p_warehouse_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_customer_name text, p_payment_method text, p_lines jsonb, p_discount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_amount_received_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  -- Apply the exact centralized POS authorization/MFA policy before any\n  -- Customer-specific lookup or lock.  The private implementation keeps the\n  -- same guard as defense in depth after this serialization boundary.\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'تنفيذ بيع نقطة البيع بالإصدار المحمي'\n  );\n\n  IF p_customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM 1\n    FROM public.customers customer\n    WHERE customer.id = p_customer_id\n    FOR KEY SHARE;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_CUSTOMER_INVALID: العميل المحدد غير موجود.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN public._create_pos_sale_v2_before_registered_customer_lock(\n    p_warehouse_id,\n    p_branch_id,\n    p_customer_id,\n    p_customer_name,\n    p_payment_method,\n    p_lines,\n    p_discount_in_minor_units,\n    p_amount_received_in_minor_units,\n    p_idempotency_key\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_guard_physical_capacity_internal()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_capacity INTEGER; v_used BIGINT; v_root RECORD;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.consumption_state NOT IN ('draft', 'settled') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_operation_order_internal(NEW.operation_id, NULL);\n  SELECT * INTO v_root FROM public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(NEW.source_kind,NEW.source_id,NEW.product_id);\n  IF v_root.root_kind='base_order_item' THEN\n    PERFORM public.aftercare211_assert_replacement_root_internal(v_root.root_id,NEW.consumed_quantity);\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'phase4-aftercare|' || NEW.source_kind || '|' || NEW.source_id::TEXT, 0\n  ));\n  IF NEW.source_kind = 'base_order_item' THEN\n    SELECT quantity INTO v_capacity FROM public.order_items\n    WHERE id = NEW.source_id AND product_id = NEW.product_id FOR UPDATE;\n  ELSIF NEW.source_kind = 'parcel_component' THEN\n    SELECT base_quantity INTO v_capacity FROM public.order_parcel_components\n    WHERE id = NEW.source_id AND product_id = NEW.product_id FOR UPDATE;\n  ELSIF NEW.source_kind = 'replacement_item' THEN\n    SELECT quantity INTO v_capacity FROM public.sales_replacement_items\n    WHERE id = NEW.source_id AND product_id = NEW.product_id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(consumed_quantity), 0) INTO v_used\n  FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions\n  WHERE source_kind = NEW.source_kind AND source_id = NEW.source_id\n    AND id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id\n    AND (consumption_state = 'settled'\n      OR (operation_id = NEW.operation_id AND consumption_state = 'draft'));\n  IF v_capacity IS NULL OR NEW.consumed_quantity <= 0\n    OR v_used + NEW.consumed_quantity > v_capacity THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_LOGICAL_QUANTITY_ALREADY_CONSUMED: تغيرت الكمية المتبقية لهذه القطعة؛ أعد تحميل الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_public_parcel_options_before_policy_internal(p_family_product_ids uuid[])\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_feature_state TEXT := public.get_configurable_parcel_feature_state();\n  v_requested_count INTEGER := COALESCE(CARDINALITY(p_family_product_ids), 0);\n  v_options JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_requested_count < 1\n    OR v_requested_count > 48\n    OR ARRAY_POSITION(p_family_product_ids, NULL) IS NOT NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PUBLIC_CONFIGURABLE_PARCEL_REQUEST_INVALID: Provide between 1 and 48 valid Family IDs.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- OWNER_PILOT intentionally grants no Customer guest creation capability.\n  -- Returning an empty projection also prevents stale configuration discovery\n  -- while creation is unavailable to the public guest actor.\n  IF v_feature_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'ENABLED' THEN\n    RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'featureState', v_feature_state,\n      'guestCreationEnabled', false,\n      'options', '[]'::JSONB\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  WITH requested_families AS (\n    SELECT DISTINCT requested.family_product_id\n    FROM UNNEST(p_family_product_ids) AS requested(family_product_id)\n  ), storefront_warehouse AS (\n    -- This is intentionally identical to the Customer V2 warehouse selector.\n    SELECT warehouse.id\n    FROM public.warehouses warehouse\n    JOIN public.branches branch\n      ON branch.id = warehouse.branch_id\n    WHERE warehouse.is_active\n      AND branch.is_active\n    ORDER BY warehouse.created_at, warehouse.id\n    LIMIT 1\n  ), configuration_source AS (\n    SELECT\n      configuration.id AS parcel_configuration_id,\n      configuration.family_product_id,\n      configuration.configuration_revision,\n      configuration.composition_mode,\n      family.units_per_sale_unit AS units_per_parcel,\n      family.default_sale_price_in_minor_units AS parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n      base_unit.name_ar AS base_unit_name_ar,\n      sale_unit.name_ar AS sale_unit_name_ar\n    FROM requested_families requested\n    JOIN public.product_parcel_configurations configuration\n      ON configuration.family_product_id = requested.family_product_id\n    JOIN public.products family\n      ON family.id = configuration.family_product_id\n    JOIN public.categories family_category\n      ON family_category.id = family.category_id\n      AND family_category.is_active\n    JOIN public.units base_unit\n      ON base_unit.id = family.unit_id\n    JOIN public.units sale_unit\n      ON sale_unit.id = family.sale_unit_id\n    WHERE configuration.is_active\n      AND configuration.composition_mode = 'configurable_mix'\n      AND configuration.configuration_revision > 0\n      AND family.is_active\n      AND family.is_flavor_master\n      AND family.units_per_sale_unit > 0\n      AND family.default_sale_price_in_minor_units > 0\n      AND sale_unit.code <> 'PCS'\n  ), eligible_components AS (\n    SELECT\n      configuration.parcel_configuration_id,\n      configuration.family_product_id,\n      configuration.configuration_revision,\n      configuration.composition_mode,\n      configuration.units_per_parcel,\n      configuration.parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n      configuration.base_unit_name_ar,\n      configuration.sale_unit_name_ar,\n      component.id AS product_id,\n      component.sku,\n      component.name_ar,\n      component.flavor_name_ar,\n      component_unit.name_ar AS component_unit_name_ar,\n      image.image_url,\n      COALESCE(balance.available_quantity, 0)::INTEGER AS available_quantity\n    FROM configuration_source configuration\n    CROSS JOIN storefront_warehouse warehouse\n    JOIN public.products component\n      ON component.flavor_master_product_id = configuration.family_product_id\n      AND component.is_active\n      AND NOT component.is_flavor_master\n      AND component.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact IS NOT NULL\n    JOIN public.categories component_category\n      ON component_category.id = component.category_id\n      AND component_category.is_active\n    JOIN public.units component_unit\n      ON component_unit.id = component.unit_id\n    JOIN public.units component_sale_unit\n      ON component_sale_unit.id = component.sale_unit_id\n    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances balance\n      ON balance.warehouse_id = warehouse.id\n      AND balance.product_id = component.id\n    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n      SELECT product_image.image_url\n      FROM public.product_images product_image\n      WHERE product_image.product_id = component.id\n      ORDER BY product_image.is_primary DESC,\n        product_image.display_order,\n        product_image.created_at,\n        product_image.id\n      LIMIT 1\n    ) image ON true\n    WHERE component.units_per_sale_unit > 0\n      AND component.default_sale_price_in_minor_units > 0\n      AND component_sale_unit.code <> 'PCS'\n  ), option_groups AS (\n    SELECT\n      component.parcel_configuration_id,\n      component.family_product_id,\n      component.configuration_revision,\n      component.composition_mode,\n      component.units_per_parcel,\n      component.parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n      component.base_unit_name_ar,\n      component.sale_unit_name_ar,\n      SUM(component.available_quantity)::BIGINT AS total_available_quantity,\n      JSONB_AGG(\n        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n          'productId', component.product_id,\n          'sku', component.sku,\n          'nameAr', component.name_ar,\n          'flavorNameAr', component.flavor_name_ar,\n          'unitNameAr', component.component_unit_name_ar,\n          'imageUrl', component.image_url,\n          'availableQuantity', component.available_quantity\n        )\n        ORDER BY component.flavor_name_ar NULLS LAST,\n          component.name_ar,\n          component.product_id\n      ) AS components\n    FROM eligible_components component\n    GROUP BY\n      component.parcel_configuration_id,\n      component.family_product_id,\n      component.configuration_revision,\n      component.composition_mode,\n      component.units_per_parcel,\n      component.parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n      component.base_unit_name_ar,\n      component.sale_unit_name_ar\n    HAVING SUM(component.available_quantity) >= component.units_per_parcel\n  )\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    JSONB_AGG(\n      JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n        'familyProductId', option_group.family_product_id,\n        'parcelConfigurationId', option_group.parcel_configuration_id,\n        'configurationRevision', option_group.configuration_revision,\n        'compositionMode', option_group.composition_mode,\n        'unitsPerParcel', '[]'::JSONB\n  )\n  INTO v_options\n  FROM option_groups option_group;\n\n  RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'featureState', v_feature_state,\n    'guestCreationEnabled', true,\n    'options',         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_replacement_evidence_before_carton_internal(p_operation_id uuid, p_require_issued boolean)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation public.business_operations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_event public.sales_replacement_events%ROWTYPE;\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_evidence public.phase43_replacement_settlement_evidence%ROWTYPE;\n  v_actual JSONB;\n  v_expected_count INTEGER;\n  v_actual_count INTEGER;\n  v_covered_item_count INTEGER;\n  v_effect_count INTEGER;\n  v_movement_count INTEGER;\n  v_consumption_count INTEGER;\n  v_operation_consumption_count INTEGER;\n  v_request_count INTEGER;\n  v_issued_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_replacement_cogs BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_require_issued IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Evidence lifecycle requirement is missing.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO v_operation FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = p_operation_id;\n  SELECT * INTO v_event FROM public.sales_replacement_events event\n  WHERE event.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.orders customer_order\n  WHERE customer_order.id = v_event.root_order_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_operation.operation_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase4_replacement_v1'\n    OR v_operation.request_identity_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'operationalCoordinatorVersion')::INTEGER IS DISTINCT FROM 403\n    OR v_event.contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n    OR v_event.issuance_coordinator_version IS DISTINCT FROM 403\n    OR v_event.branch_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order.branch_id\n    OR v_event.warehouse_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order.warehouse_id\n    OR v_event.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_operation.initiated_by\n    OR JSONB_TYPEOF(v_operation.request_identity_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n    OR (v_operation.request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id')::UUID\n      IS DISTINCT FROM v_event.root_order_id\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_OPERATIONAL_REPLACEMENT_UNPROVEN: Replacement coordinator identity is incomplete.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_evidence FROM public.phase43_replacement_settlement_evidence evidence\n  WHERE evidence.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  v_actual := public.phase43_inventory_effects_snapshot_internal(p_operation_id);\n  IF NOT FOUND\n    OR v_evidence.replacement_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_event.id\n    OR v_evidence.order_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_event.root_order_id\n    OR v_evidence.result_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM v_operation.result_snapshot\n    OR v_evidence.inventory_effects_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM v_actual\n    OR JSONB_TYPEOF(v_operation.result_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'success')::BOOLEAN IS DISTINCT FROM true\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'idempotentReplay')::BOOLEAN IS DISTINCT FROM false\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'operationId')::UUID IS DISTINCT FROM v_operation.id\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'replacementId')::UUID IS DISTINCT FROM v_event.id\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'orderId')::UUID IS DISTINCT FROM v_event.root_order_id\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'operationalCoordinatorVersion')::INTEGER\n      IS DISTINCT FROM 403\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'moneyRefundInMinorUnits')::BIGINT IS DISTINCT FROM 0\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'debtReductionInMinorUnits')::BIGINT IS DISTINCT FROM 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Durable Replacement evidence does not match the operation.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_expected_count\n  FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n  WHERE item.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  SELECT JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(v_operation.request_identity_snapshot->'items')\n  INTO v_request_count;\n\n  -- Operational issuance creates exactly one consumption per immutable item.\n  -- Row UUID is not its business identity: (operation_id, replacement_item_id)\n  -- is. Check both directions before joins can multiply A and hide missing B.\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n    WHERE item.operation_id = p_operation_id\n      AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n        WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n          AND consumption.replacement_item_id = item.id) <> 1\n  ) OR EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n    WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n      AND NOT EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n        WHERE item.operation_id = p_operation_id\n          AND item.id = consumption.replacement_item_id\n      )\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_EFFECTS_INCOMPLETE: Each authoritative item requires exactly one owned consumption.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER, COUNT(DISTINCT item.id)::INTEGER,\n    COALESCE(SUM(effect.issued_quantity), 0)::INTEGER,\n    COALESCE(SUM(effect.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT\n  INTO v_actual_count, v_covered_item_count, v_issued_quantity, v_replacement_cogs\n  FROM public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects effect\n  JOIN public.sales_replacement_items item\n    ON item.id = effect.replacement_item_id\n    AND item.operation_id = effect.operation_id\n    AND item.replacement_event_id = effect.replacement_event_id\n    AND item.product_id = effect.product_id\n    AND item.quantity = effect.issued_quantity\n    AND item.replacement_unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact\n      = effect.replacement_unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact\n    AND item.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      = effect.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n    AND item.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      = ROUND(item.replacement_unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact * item.quantity)::BIGINT\n    AND effect.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      = ROUND(effect.replacement_unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact\n        * effect.issued_quantity)::BIGINT\n  JOIN public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n    ON consumption.operation_id = effect.operation_id\n    AND consumption.replacement_item_id = effect.replacement_item_id\n    AND consumption.consumption_kind = 'replacement'\n    AND consumption.source_kind = effect.source_kind\n    AND consumption.source_id = effect.source_id\n    AND consumption.product_id = effect.product_id\n    AND consumption.consumed_quantity = effect.issued_quantity\n    AND consumption.consumption_state = CASE\n      WHEN p_require_issued THEN 'settled'\n      ELSE 'draft'\n    END\n    AND (\n      (p_require_issued AND consumption.settled_at IS NOT NULL)\n      OR (NOT p_require_issued AND consumption.settled_at IS NULL)\n    )\n  JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_operation.request_identity_snapshot->'items') request_item\n    ON request_item->>'source_kind' = effect.source_kind\n    AND (request_item->>'source_id')::UUID = effect.source_id\n    AND (request_item->>'quantity')::INTEGER = effect.issued_quantity\n  JOIN public.inventory_movements movement\n    ON movement.id = effect.inventory_movement_id\n    AND movement.operation_id = effect.operation_id\n    AND movement.warehouse_id = effect.warehouse_id\n    AND movement.product_id = effect.product_id\n    AND movement.movement_type = 'sales_deduction'\n    AND movement.quantity = -effect.issued_quantity\n    AND movement.balance_before = effect.target_balance_before\n    AND movement.balance_after = effect.target_balance_after\n    AND movement.reference_type = 'phase4_replacement_item'\n    AND movement.reference_id = effect.replacement_item_id\n    AND movement.created_by IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_operation.initiated_by\n  CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n    effect.source_kind, effect.source_id, effect.product_id\n  ) source_root\n  LEFT JOIN public.order_items root_item\n    ON source_root.root_kind = 'base_order_item'\n    AND root_item.id = source_root.root_id\n    AND root_item.order_id = v_event.root_order_id\n    AND root_item.product_id = effect.product_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.order_parcel_components root_component\n    ON source_root.root_kind = 'parcel_component'\n    AND root_component.id = source_root.root_id\n    AND root_component.product_id = effect.product_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.order_parcel_instances root_instance\n    ON root_instance.id = root_component.parcel_instance_id\n    AND root_instance.order_id = v_event.root_order_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.sales_replacement_items source_replacement\n    ON effect.source_kind = 'replacement_item'\n    AND source_replacement.id = effect.source_id\n    AND source_replacement.product_id = effect.product_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.sales_replacement_events source_event\n    ON source_event.id = source_replacement.replacement_event_id\n    AND source_event.replacement_status = 'settled'\n    AND source_event.issuance_status = 'issued'\n    AND source_event.issuance_coordinator_version = 403\n  WHERE effect.operation_id = p_operation_id\n    AND effect.replacement_event_id = v_event.id\n    AND effect.warehouse_id = v_event.warehouse_id\n    AND (\n      (source_root.root_kind = 'base_order_item' AND root_item.id IS NOT NULL)\n      OR (source_root.root_kind = 'parcel_component' AND root_instance.id IS NOT NULL)\n    )\n    AND (\n      (source_root.root_kind = 'base_order_item'\n        AND item.root_order_item_id = root_item.id\n        AND item.root_parcel_instance_id IS NULL\n        AND item.root_parcel_component_id IS NULL\n        AND item.original_sale_operation_id IS NULL)\n      OR (source_root.root_kind = 'parcel_component'\n        AND item.root_order_item_id = root_instance.order_item_id\n        AND item.root_parcel_instance_id = root_instance.id\n        AND item.root_parcel_component_id = root_component.id\n        AND item.original_sale_operation_id = root_component.operation_id)\n    )\n    AND (\n      (effect.source_kind = 'replacement_item'\n        AND source_event.id IS NOT NULL\n        AND source_event.root_order_id = v_event.root_order_id\n        AND item.parent_replacement_item_id = source_replacement.id)\n      OR (effect.source_kind <> 'replacement_item'\n        AND item.parent_replacement_item_id IS NULL)\n    );\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_consumption_count\n  FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n  WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n    AND consumption.consumption_kind = 'replacement';\n\n  -- Distinct authoritative item coverage and per-item consumption cardinality\n  -- prove identity, not merely bag counts. Raw operation counts additionally\n  -- exclude orphan evidence; totals below are supplementary arithmetic checks.\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_effect_count\n  FROM public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects effect\n  WHERE effect.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_movement_count\n  FROM public.inventory_movements movement\n  WHERE movement.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_operation_consumption_count\n  FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n  WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n\n  IF v_expected_count <= 0\n    OR v_request_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR v_actual_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR v_covered_item_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR v_effect_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR v_movement_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR v_consumption_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR v_operation_consumption_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'issuedQuantity')::INTEGER\n      IS DISTINCT FROM v_issued_quantity\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'replacementCogsInMinorUnits')::BIGINT\n      IS DISTINCT FROM v_replacement_cogs\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_EFFECTS_INCOMPLETE: Every issued Replacement item requires exact inventory and cost evidence.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF (p_require_issued AND (\n      v_event.replacement_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'settled'\n      OR v_event.settled_at IS NULL\n      OR v_event.issuance_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'issued'\n      OR v_event.issued_at IS NULL\n    )) OR (NOT p_require_issued AND (\n      v_event.replacement_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'draft'\n      OR v_event.settled_at IS NOT NULL\n      OR v_event.issuance_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'not_issued'\n      OR v_event.issued_at IS NOT NULL\n    )) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_NOT_ISSUED: Foundation settlement is not operational issuance.';\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_settle_sales_replacement_before_guard_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_idempotency_key text, p_items jsonb, p_reason text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_actor_hash TEXT;\n  v_key TEXT;\n  v_canonical JSONB;\n  v_fingerprint TEXT;\n  v_replay JSONB;\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_creation_type TEXT;\n  v_completion_at TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_operation_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_event_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_item JSONB;\n  v_prepared JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_product_ids UUID[];\n  v_source_kind TEXT;\n  v_source_id UUID;\n  v_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_root_order_item_id UUID;\n  v_root_parcel_instance_id UUID;\n  v_root_parcel_component_id UUID;\n  v_original_sale_operation_id UUID;\n  v_parent_replacement_item_id UUID;\n  v_capacity INTEGER;\n  v_consumed INTEGER;\n  v_wac NUMERIC(24, 6);\n  v_cogs BIGINT;\n  v_replacement_item_id UUID;\n  v_before INTEGER;\n  v_available INTEGER;\n  v_after INTEGER;\n  v_movement_id UUID;\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_total_quantity INTEGER := 0;\n  v_total_cogs BIGINT := 0;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner', 'admin'], 'إصدار استبدال مبيعات Phase 4.3');\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '42501',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_ACTOR_REQUIRED: Authenticated ERP actor is required.';\n  END IF;\n  v_key := public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(p_idempotency_key);\n  v_canonical := public.phase43_canonicalize_replacement_request_internal(\n    p_order_id, p_items, p_reason, p_notes\n  );\n  v_actor_hash := public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal('erp_user', v_user_id, NULL, NULL);\n  v_fingerprint := public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(v_canonical);\n  v_replay := public.phase43_resolve_replacement_replay_internal(\n    v_key, v_actor_hash, v_fingerprint\n  );\n  IF v_replay->>'decision' = 'REPLAY' THEN\n    RETURN v_replay->'result_snapshot';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_customer_order_context_internal(p_order_id, false, false);\n  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.orders customer_order\n  WHERE customer_order.id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_order.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed'\n    OR v_order.branch_id IS NULL OR v_order.warehouse_id IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_ORIGINAL_SALE_INVALID: Replacement requires a completed sale with branch and warehouse evidence.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT operation.operation_type INTO v_creation_type\n  FROM public.business_operations operation WHERE operation.id = v_order.operation_id FOR SHARE;\n  IF v_creation_type IS NULL OR v_creation_type NOT IN ('phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_SALE_CONTRACT_UNSUPPORTED: Only proven Phase-3 POS V2 and Customer V2 sales are supported.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical->'items')\n    ORDER BY value->>'source_kind', value->>'source_id'\n  LOOP\n    v_source_kind := v_item->>'source_kind';\n    v_source_id := (v_item->>'source_id')::UUID;\n    v_quantity := (v_item->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n    v_root_order_item_id := NULL;\n    v_root_parcel_instance_id := NULL;\n    v_root_parcel_component_id := NULL;\n    v_original_sale_operation_id := NULL;\n    v_parent_replacement_item_id := NULL;\n\n    IF v_source_kind = 'base_order_item' THEN\n      SELECT item.id, item.product_id, item.quantity\n      INTO v_root_order_item_id, v_product_id, v_capacity\n      FROM public.order_items item\n      WHERE item.id = v_source_id AND item.order_id = p_order_id\n        AND item.commercial_line_kind IN ('base_unit','legacy_single_sku_parcel');\n    ELSIF v_source_kind = 'parcel_component' THEN\n      SELECT order_item.id, instance.id, component.id, component.operation_id,\n        component.product_id, component.base_quantity\n      INTO v_root_order_item_id, v_root_parcel_instance_id,\n        v_root_parcel_component_id, v_original_sale_operation_id,\n        v_product_id, v_capacity\n      FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n      JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id\n      JOIN public.order_items order_item ON order_item.id = instance.order_item_id\n      WHERE component.id = v_source_id AND instance.order_id = p_order_id;\n    ELSE\n      SELECT item.root_order_item_id, item.root_parcel_instance_id,\n        item.root_parcel_component_id, item.original_sale_operation_id,\n        item.product_id, item.quantity, item.id\n      INTO v_root_order_item_id, v_root_parcel_instance_id,\n        v_root_parcel_component_id, v_original_sale_operation_id,\n        v_product_id, v_capacity, v_parent_replacement_item_id\n      FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n      JOIN public.sales_replacement_events event ON event.id = item.replacement_event_id\n      WHERE item.id = v_source_id AND event.root_order_id = p_order_id\n        AND event.replacement_status = 'settled'\n        AND event.issuance_status = 'issued'\n        AND event.issuance_coordinator_version = 403;\n      IF v_parent_replacement_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n        PERFORM public.phase43_assert_operational_replacement_evidence_internal(\n          (SELECT operation_id FROM public.sales_replacement_items WHERE id = v_parent_replacement_item_id), true\n        );\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_product_id IS NULL OR v_capacity IS NULL OR v_quantity > v_capacity THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_SOURCE_INVALID: Source is unavailable or quantity exceeds its immutable capacity.';\n    END IF;\n    PERFORM public.package_d_assert_whole_single_sku_quantity_internal(v_root_order_item_id,v_quantity);\n    v_prepared := v_prepared || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'source_kind', v_source_kind, 'source_id', v_source_id,\n      'quantity', v_quantity, 'product_id', v_product_id,\n      'root_order_item_id', v_root_order_item_id,\n      'root_parcel_instance_id', v_root_parcel_instance_id,\n      'root_parcel_component_id', v_root_parcel_component_id,\n      'original_sale_operation_id', v_original_sale_operation_id,\n      'parent_replacement_item_id', v_parent_replacement_item_id\n    ));\n  END LOOP;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT (item->>'product_id')::UUID ORDER BY (item->>'product_id')::UUID)\n  INTO v_product_ids FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_prepared) item;\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(v_product_ids);\n  v_completion_at := public.phase4_authoritative_completion_internal(p_order_id);\n  IF clock_timestamp() > v_completion_at + INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_REPLACEMENT_WINDOW_INVALID: Replacement is outside the original 48-hour window.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_item IN        AND v_component->>'accepted_stock_disposition' = 'restock'\n        THEN\n          v_item_stock_disposition := 'restock';\n          v_unit_cost_exact := CASE\n            WHEN v_component_row.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NOT NULL\n              THEN ROUND(v_component_row.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n                / v_component_row.base_quantity::NUMERIC, 6)\n            ELSE v_component_row.unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units\n          END;\n          IF v_unit_cost_exact IS NULL THEN\n            RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n              MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_HISTORICAL_COST_MISSING: Parcel Component historical cost is missing.';\n          END IF;\n          v_inventory_sources := v_inventory_sources || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(\n v_component_row.product_id,\n              'quantity', v_accepted,\n              'historical_value_exact', ROUND(v_unit_cost_exact * v_accepted, 6)\n            )\n          );\n        END IF;\n 'original_sale_operation_id', v_component_row.operation_id,\n            'product_id', v_component_row.product_id,\n            'original_quantity', v_component_row.base_quantity,\n v_component->>'rejected_stock_disposition'\n          )\n        );\n      END LOOP;\n      IF v_accepted_total + v_rejected_total\n          IS DISTINCT FROM v_instance.units_per_parcel_snapshot      v_applied_damage := LEAST(\n        v_instance.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units, v_raw_damage\n      );\n      v_item_refund :=\n        v_instance.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units\n          - v_applied_damage;\n      v_prepared_items := v_prepared_items || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(\n        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n          'id', v_return_item_id,\n          'return_scope', 'parcel_instance',\n          'order_item_id', v_order_item.id,\n          'parcel_instance_id', v_instance.id,\n          'returned_quantity', 1,\n  )\n      );\n      v_total_entitlement := v_total_entitlement + v_item_refund;\n      v_total_raw_damage := v_total_raw_damage + v_raw_damage;\n      v_total_applied_damage := v_total_applied_damage + v_applied_damage;\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_financial\n  FROM public.phase42_order_financial_position_internal(p_order_id);\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING v_reference IS NULL)\n    ))\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_REFUND_METHOD_INVALID: Refund method must match the authoritative monetary outcome.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_now := clock_timestamp();\n  -- Do not consume a non-transactional sequence: an injected failure must\n  -- leave no externally visible Return-number side effect. UPPER(SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(v_operation_id::TEXT, '-', '', 'g') FROM 1 FOR 12));\n  v_result := JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'success', true,\n    'idempotentReplay', false,\n    'operationId', v_operation_id,\n    'returnId', v_return_event_id,\n    'returnNumber', v_return_number,\n    'orderId', p_order_id,\n    'merchandiseEntitlementInMinorUnits', v_total_entitlement,\n 0,\n    'taxRefundInMinorUnits', 0\n  );\n\n  INSERT INTO public.business_operations(\n    id, operation_type, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, initiated_by,\n    result_snapshot, completed_at,  FOR v_component IN\n        SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_item->'components')\n        ORDER BY value->>'parcel_component_id'\n      LOOP\n        INSERT INTO rejected_quantity, accepted_condition,\n          accepted_stock_disposition, rejection_reason,\n          rejected_stock_disposition\n        ) VALUES (\n          (v_item->>'id')::UUID,         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_validate_configurable_parcel_before_policy_internal(p_actor_scope_type text, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_family_product_id uuid, p_parcel_configuration_id uuid, p_configuration_revision integer, p_components jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_configuration public.product_parcel_configurations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_capacity INTEGER;\n  v_family_is_master BOOLEAN;\n  v_components JSONB;\n  v_component_total BIGINT;\n  v_product_ids UUID[];\n  v_invalid_count INTEGER;\n  v_missing_wac_count INTEGER;\n  v_enriched JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.phase3_assert_configurable_parcel_creation_allowed_internal(\n    p_actor_scope_type, p_actor_user_id\n  );\n\n  IF p_configuration_revision IS NULL OR p_configuration_revision <= 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_CONFIGURATION_STALE: Parcel configuration revision is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_configuration\n  FROM public.product_parcel_configurations configuration\n  WHERE configuration.id = p_parcel_configuration_id\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND\n    OR NOT v_configuration.is_active\n    OR v_configuration.composition_mode <> 'configurable_mix'\n    OR v_configuration.family_product_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_family_product_id\n    OR v_configuration.configuration_revision IS DISTINCT FROM p_configuration_revision\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_CONFIGURATION_STALE: Parcel configuration is unavailable or changed.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT product.units_per_sale_unit, product.is_flavor_master\n  INTO v_capacity, v_family_is_master\n  FROM public.products product\n  WHERE product.id = p_family_product_id\n    AND product.is_active\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_family_is_master OR COALESCE(v_capacity, 0) <= 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_CONFIGURATION_STALE: Parcel Family is not a valid configurable stock family.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_components := public.phase3_canonicalize_components_internal(p_components);\n  SELECT\n    SUM((component->>'base_quantity')::BIGINT),\n    ARRAY_AGG((component->>'product_id')::UUID ORDER BY (component->>'product_id')::UUID)\n  INTO v_component_total, v_product_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_components) component;\n\n  IF v_component_total IS DISTINCT FROM v_capacity::BIGINT THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'phase3_parcel_capacity_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_CAPACITY_MISMATCH: Parcel composition must equal configured capacity.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase3_lock_inventory_products_internal(v_product_ids);\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (\n    WHERE NOT product.is_active\n      OR product.is_flavor_master\n      OR COALESCE(product.flavor_master_product_id, product.id)\n        IS DISTINCT FROM p_family_product_id\n  ), COUNT(*) FILTER (\n    WHERE product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact IS NULL\n  )\n  INTO v_invalid_count, v_missing_wac_count\n  FROM public.products product\n  WHERE product.id = ANY(v_product_ids);\n\n  IF v_invalid_count <> 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'phase3_parcel_component_family_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_COMPONENT_FAMILY_MISMATCH: Parcel component is not a stocked SKU in the configured Family.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_missing_wac_count <> 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_EXACT_WAC_UNAVAILABLE: Exact WAC is required for configurable Parcel sale.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT JSONB_AGG(\n    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'product_id', LOWER(product.id::TEXT),\n      'base_quantity', (component->>'base_quantity')::INTEGER,\n      'product_name_snapshot', product.name_ar,\n      'sku_snapshot', product.sku,\n      'base_unit_name_snapshot', unit.name_ar,\n      'unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact', product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact\n    )\n    ORDER BY product.id\n  )\n  INTO v_enriched\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_components) component\n  JOIN public.products product\n    ON product.id = (component->>'product_id')::UUID\n  LEFT JOIN public.units unit ON unit.id = product.unit_id;\n\n  RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'family_product_id', LOWER(p_family_product_id::TEXT),\n    'parcel_configuration_id', LOWER(p_parcel_configuration_id::TEXT),\n    'configuration_revision', p_configuration_revision,\n    'units_per_parcel', v_component_total,\n    'composition_fingerprint', public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(v_components),\n    'components', v_enriched\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.parcel209_guard_modern_lines_internal(p_lines jsonb)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_ids UUID[];v_line JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT id ORDER BY id) INTO v_ids FROM (\n    SELECT (line->>'product_id')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) line\n      WHERE line->>'commercial_line_kind' IN ('base_unit','legacy_single_sku_parcel')\n    UNION SELECT (line->>'family_product_id')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) line\n      WHERE line->>'commercial_line_kind'='configurable_parcel'\n    UNION SELECT (component->>'product_id')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) line\n      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(line->'parcel_instances') instance\n      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(instance->'components') component\n      WHERE line->>'commercial_line_kind'='configurable_parcel'\n  ) requested WHERE id IS NOT NULL;\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(v_ids);\n  FOR v_line IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) LOOP\n    IF v_line->>'commercial_line_kind'='base_unit'\n      AND public.parcel209_effective_only_internal((v_line->>'product_id')::UUID) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23514',\n        MESSAGE='PARCEL209_UNIT_SALE_FORBIDDEN: هذا الصنف بيتباع بالطرد بس؛ اختر طرداً.';\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

(r->>'root_parcel_instance_id')::UUID instance_id\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_prepared) r\n    WHERE public.parcel209_effective_only_internal((r->>'product_id')::UUID)\n  LOOP\n    SELECT * INTO v_item.commercial_line_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'configurable_parcel'\n        OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.order_parcel_instances i\n          WHERE i.id=v_root.instance_id AND i.order_item_id=v_root.order_item_id)\n        OR EXISTS(\n          SELECT 1 FROM public.order_parcel_components c WHERE c.parcel_instance_id=v_root.instance_id\n          AND c.base_quantity IS         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.parcel209_pos_customer_internal(p_warehouse_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_customer_name text, p_payment_method text, p_lines jsonb, p_discount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_amount_received_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  -- Apply the exact centralized POS authorization/MFA policy before any\n  -- Customer-specific lookup or lock.  The private implementation keeps the\n  -- same guard as defense in depth after this serialization boundary.\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'تنفيذ بيع نقطة البيع بالإصدار المحمي'\n  );\n\n  IF p_customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM 1\n    FROM public.customers customer\n    WHERE customer.id = p_customer_id\n    FOR KEY SHARE;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_CUSTOMER_INVALID: العميل المحدد غير موجود.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN public.parcel209_pos_sale_internal(\n    p_warehouse_id,\n    p_branch_id,\n    p_customer_id,\n    p_customer_name,\n    p_payment_method,\n    p_lines,\n    p_discount_in_minor_units,\n    p_amount_received_in_minor_units,\n    p_idempotency_key\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",
