        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.parcel209_pos_sale_internal(p_warehouse_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_customer_name text, p_payment_method text, p_lines jsonb, p_discount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_amount_received_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_key TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), '');\n  v_payment_method TEXT := LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_payment_method), ''), 'cash'));\n  v_customer_name TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_customer_name), ''), 'زبون نقدي');\n  v_customer_identity_hash TEXT;\n  v_actor_hash TEXT;\n  v_request JSONB;\n  v_canonical_request JSONB;\n  v_fingerprint TEXT;\n  v_replay JSONB;\n  v_line JSONB;\n  v_instance JSONB;\n  v_validated JSONB;\n  v_cogs_allocation JSONB;\n  v_plan_lines JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_final_lines JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_plan_instances JSONB;\n  v_final_instances JSONB;\n  v_plan_components JSONB;\n  v_line_weighted_keys JSONB;\n  v_instance_weighted_keys JSONB;\n  v_product_ids UUID[];\n  v_configuration_ids UUID[];\n  v_family_ids UUID[];\n  v_line_sequence INTEGER := 0;\n  v_line_kind TEXT;\n  v_product public.products%ROWTYPE;\n  v_order_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_operation_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_order_item_id UUID;\n  v_parcel_instance_id UUID;\n  v_order_number TEXT;\n  v_shift_id UUID;\n  v_base_unit_name TEXT;\n  v_parcel_unit_name TEXT;\n  v_commercial_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_base_quantity BIGINT;\n  v_units_per_parcel INTEGER;\n  v_unit_price BIGINT;\n  v_line_gross BIGINT;\n  v_line_cogs BIGINT;\n  v_unit_cost_exact NUMERIC(24,6);\n  v_line_exact_cogs NUMERIC(30,6);\n  v_line_discount BIGINT;\n  v_line_net BIGINT;\n  v_line_profit BIGINT;\n  v_instance_discount BIGINT;\n  v_subtotal BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total BIGINT;\n  v_paid BIGINT;\n  v_change BIGINT;\n  v_demand RECORD;\n  v_on_hand INTEGER;\n  v_reserved INTEGER;\n  v_balance_after INTEGER;\n  v_result_items JSONB;\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_component JSONB;\n  v_movement_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_constraint_name TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'تنفيذ بيع نقطة البيع بالإصدار المحمي'\n  );\n\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED: المستخدم الحالي غير مصادق عليه.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_key IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_IDEMPOTENCY_INPUT_INVALID: مفتاح إعادة المحاولة غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR p_branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_LOCATION_REQUIRED: المستودع والفرع مطلوبان.';\n  END IF;\n  IF COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, -1) < 0\n    OR COALESCE(p_amount_received_in_minor_units, -1) < 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_MONEY_INVALID: قيم الخصم أو المبلغ المستلم غير صالحة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_payment_method NOT IN (\n    'cash', 'cliq', 'card', 'bank_transfer', 'debt', 'mixed'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PAYMENT_METHOD_INVALID: طريقة الدفع غير معتمدة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Cross-version order is deliberate: V1 and V2 first serialize on the exact\n  -- same raw-key lock.  Only then may V2 enter its versioned operation lock.\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(v_key));\n\n  v_actor_hash := public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal(\n    'erp_user', v_user_id, NULL, NULL\n  );\n  IF p_customer_id IS NULL THEN\n    v_customer_identity_hash := ENCODE(extensions.digest(\n      'phase3:walk-in-customer:v1|' || LOWER(v_customer_name),\n      'sha256'::TEXT\n    ), 'hex');\n  END IF;\n\n  v_request := JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'contract_version', 'phase3-sale-v1',\n    'actor_scope_type', 'erp_user',\n    'actor_scope_hash', v_actor_hash,\n    'operation_source', 'admin_pos',\n    'warehouse_id', p_warehouse_id,\n    'branch_id', p_branch_id,\n    'customer_id', p_customer_id,\n    'customer_identity_hash', v_customer_identity_hash,\n    'payment_method', v_payment_method,\n    'order_discount_in_minor_units', COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0),\n    'amount_received_in_minor_units', COALESCE(p_amount_received_in_minor_units, 0),\n    'lines', p_lines\n  );\n  v_canonical_request := public.phase3_canonicalize_sale_request_internal(v_request);\n  v_fingerprint := public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(v_canonical_request);\n  v_replay := public.phase3_resolve_operation_replay_internal(\n    'phase3_pos_sale_v1', v_key, 'erp_user', v_actor_hash, v_fingerprint\n  );\n  IF v_replay->>'decision' = 'REPLAY' THEN\n    RETURN v_replay->'result_snapshot';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- A key already consumed by V1 can never be reconstructed as a proven V2\n  -- request.  Reject generically without exposing the historical order.\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.orders existing_order\n    WHERE existing_order.idempotency_key = v_key\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Operation identity is unavailable.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM 1\n  FROM public.warehouses warehouse\n  WHERE warehouse.id = p_warehouse_id\n    AND warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id\n    AND warehouse.is_active;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_LOCATION_INVALID: المستودع لا يتبع الفرع المحدد أو غير نشط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    SELECT customer.full_name INTO v_customer_name\n    FROM public.customers customer\n    WHERE customer.id = p_customer_id;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_CUSTOMER_INVALID: العميل المحدد غير موجود.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF v_payment_method = 'debt' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_DEBT_CUSTOMER_REQUIRED: البيع الآجل يحتاج عميلاً مسجلاً.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Shift precedes configuration/product/inventory locks throughout the paid\n  -- operational paths and their reversal orchestrator.\n  SELECT shift.id INTO v_shift_id\n  FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n  WHERE shift.branch_id = p_branch_id AND shift.status = 'open'\n  ORDER BY shift.id\n  LIMIT 1\n  FOR SHARE;\n  IF v_shift_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_OPEN_SHIFT_REQUIRED: افتح وردية الصندوق قبل إتمام البيع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical_request->'lines') candidate\n    WHERE candidate->>'commercial_line_kind' = 'configurable_parcel'\n  ) THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase3_assert_configurable_parcel_creation_allowed_internal(\n      'erp_user', v_user_id\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical_request->'lines') candidate\n    WHERE COALESCE((candidate->>'line_discount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT, 0) <> 0\n      OR candidate->>'price_authority' <> 'server_catalog'\n      OR candidate->'commercial_unit_price_override_in_minor_units' <> 'null'::JSONB\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PRICE_AUTHORITY_INVALID: هذا المسار يعتمد سعر الخادم وخصم الطلب الحالي فقط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.parcel209_guard_modern_lines_internal(v_canonical_request->'lines');\n\n  SELECT\n    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT (candidate->>'parcel_configuration_id')::UUID\n      ORDER BY (candidate->>'parcel_configuration_id')::UUID),\n    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT (candidate->>'family_product_id')::UUID\n      ORDER BY (candidate->>'family_product_id')::UUID)\n  INTO v_configuration_ids, v_family_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical_request->'lines') candidate\n  WHERE candidate->>'commercial_line_kind' = 'configurable_parcel';\n\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_configuration_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM configuration.id\n    FROM public.product_parcel_configurations configuration\n    WHERE configuration.id = ANY(v_configuration_ids)\n    ORDER BY configuration.id\n    FOR SHARE;\n\n    PERFORM family.id\n    FROM public.products family\n    WHERE family.id = ANY(v_family_ids)\n    ORDER BY family.id\n    FOR SHARE;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT identity.product_id ORDER BY identity.product_id)\n  INTO v_product_ids\n  FROM (\n    SELECT (candidate->>'product_id')::UUID AS product_id\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical_request->'lines') candidate\n    WHERE candidate->>'commercial_line_kind' IN ('base_unit', 'legacy_single_sku_parcel')\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT (component->>'product_id')::UUID\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical_request->'lines') candidate\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(candidate->'parcel_instances') parcel\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(parcel->'components') component\n    WHERE candidate->>'commercial_line_kind' = 'configurable_parcel'\n  ) identity;\n\n  -- Family is commercial identity, never stock identity. Keep its shared\n  -- snapshot lock ahead of the global stock-product hierarchy, but never pass\n  -- it to the inventory helper (which would attempt a row-lock upgrade).\n  PERFORM public.phase3_lock_inventory_products_internal(v_product_ids);\n\n  -- Build a complete immutable plan before any business row is inserted.\n  FOR v_line IN\n    SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical_request->'lines')\n    ORDER BY value::TEXT\n  LOOP\n    v_line_sequence := v_line_sequence + 1;\n    v_order_item_id := gen_random_uuid();\n    v_line_kind := v_line->>'commercial_line_kind';\n    v_plan_instances := '[]'::JSONB;\n    v_unit_cost_exact := NULL;\n    v_line_exact_cogs := NULL;\n\n    IF v_line_kind = 'base_unit' THEN\n      SELECT * INTO v_product FROM public.products\n      WHERE id = (v_line->>'product_id')::UUID AND is_active;\n      IF NOT FOUND OR v_product.is_flavor_master THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PRODUCT_INVALID: منتج الوحدة الأساسية غير صالح للبيع.';\n      END IF;\n      v_commercial_quantity := (v_line->>'base_quantity')::INTEGER;\n      v_base_quantity := v_commercial_quantity;\n      v_units_per_parcel := 1;\n      v_unit_price := v_product.sale_price_in_minor_units;\n      v_unit_cost_exact := COALESCE(v_product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,\n        v_product.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC);\n      v_line_exact_cogs := ROUND(v_base_quantity::NUMERIC * v_unit_cost_exact, 6);\n      -- Round once at the financial line boundary, never per physical unit.\n      v_line_cogs := ROUND(v_line_exact_cogs)::BIGINT;\n      SELECT COALESCE(unit.name_ar, 'وحدة') INTO v_base_unit_name\n      FROM public.units unit WHERE unit.id = v_product.unit_id;\n      v_base_unit_name := COALESCE(v_base_unit_name, 'وحدة');\n      v_parcel_unit_name := v_base_unit_name;\n    ELSIF v_line_kind = 'legacy_single_sku_parcel' THEN\n      SELECT * INTO v_product FROM public.products\n      WHERE id = (v_line->>'product_id')::UUID AND is_active;\n      IF NOT FOUND THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PRODUCT_INVALID: منتج الطرد التجاري غير صالح للبيع.';\n      END IF;\n      IF v_product.units_per_sale_unit IS DISTINCT FROM\n          (v_line->>'units_per_parcel')::INTEGER\n        OR COALESCE(v_product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units, 0) <= 0\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PRICE_OR_PACKAGE_STALE: إعداد الطرد أو سعره تغير.';\n      END IF;\n      v_commercial_quantity := (v_line->>'parcel_quantity')::INTEGER;\n      v_units_per_parcel := v_product.units_per_sale_unit;\n      v_base_quantity := v_commercial_quantity::BIGINT * v_units_per_parcel::BIGINT;\n      IF v_base_quantity > 2147483647 THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22003',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_QUANTITY_OVERFLOW: كمية الوحدات الأساسية تتجاوز الحد الآمن.';\n      END IF;\n      v_unit_price := v_product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units;\n      v_unit_cost_exact := COALESCE(v_product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,\n        v_product.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC);\n      v_line_exact_cogs := ROUND(v_base_quantity::NUMERIC * v_unit_cost_exact, 6);\n      -- Round once at the financial line boundary, never per physical unit.\n      v_line_cogs := ROUND(v_line_exact_cogs)::BIGINT;\n      SELECT COALESCE(base_unit.name_ar, 'وحدة'), COALESCE(parcel_unit.name_ar, 'طرد')\n      INTO v_base_unit_name, v_parcel_unit_name\n      FROM public.products product\n      LEFT JOIN public.units base_unit ON base_unit.id = product.unit_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.units parcel_unit ON parcel_unit.id = product.sale_unit_id\n      WHERE product.id = v_product.id;\n    ELSE\n      SELECT * INTO v_product FROM public.products\n      WHERE id = (v_line->>'family_product_id')::UUID AND is_active;\n      IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_product.is_flavor_master\n        OR COALESCE(v_product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units, 0) <= 0\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PRICE_OR_PACKAGE_STALE: عائلة الطرد أو سعرها غير صالح.';\n      END IF;\n      v_commercial_quantity := (v_line->>'parcel_quantity')::INTEGER;\n      v_units_per_parcel := v_product.units_per_sale_unit;\n      v_base_quantity := v_commercial_quantity::BIGINT * v_units_per_parcel::BIGINT;\n      v_unit_price := v_product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units;\n      v_line_cogs := 0;\n      SELECT COALESCE(base_unit.name_ar, 'وحدة'), COALESCE(parcel_unit.name_ar, 'طرد')\n      INTO v_base_unit_name, v_parcel_unit_name\n      FROM public.products product\n      LEFT JOIN public.units base_unit ON base_unit.id = product.unit_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.units parcel_unit ON parcel_unit.id = product.sale_unit_id\n      WHERE product.id = v_product.id;\n\n      FOR v_instance IN\n        SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_line->'parcel_instances')\n        ORDER BY         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase2_allocate_largest_remainder_internal(p_total bigint, p_weighted_keys jsonb)\n RETURNS TABLE(allocation_key text, allocated_amount bigint)\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  WITH parsed AS (\n    SELECT\n      NULLIF(BTRIM(item->>'key'), '') AS allocation_key,\n      (item->>'weight')::NUMERIC AS weight\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_weighted_keys, '[]'::JSONB)) item\n  ), basis AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(weight), 0::NUMERIC) AS total_weight FROM parsed\n  ), shares AS (\n    SELECT\n      parsed.allocation_key,\n      CASE\n        WHEN p_total = 0 OR basis.total_weight = 0 THEN 0::BIGINT\n        ELSE FLOOR((p_total::NUMERIC * parsed.weight) / basis.total_weight)::BIGINT\n      END AS base_amount,\n      CASE\n        WHEN p_total = 0 OR basis.total_weight = 0 THEN 0::NUMERIC\n        ELSE (p_total::NUMERIC * parsed.weight) / basis.total_weight\n          - FLOOR((p_total::NUMERIC * parsed.weight) / basis.total_weight)\n      END AS fractional_remainder\n    FROM parsed CROSS JOIN basis\n  ), residual AS (\n    SELECT p_total - COALESCE(SUM(base_amount), 0) AS units FROM shares\n  ), ranked AS (\n    SELECT\n      shares.*,\n      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n        ORDER BY fractional_remainder DESC, allocation_key ASC\n      ) AS residual_rank\n    FROM shares\n  )\n  SELECT\n    ranked.allocation_key,\n    ranked.base_amount\n      + CASE WHEN ranked.residual_rank <= residual.units THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\n  FROM ranked CROSS JOIN residual\n  ORDER BY ranked.allocation_key;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(p_product_ids uuid[])\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_ids UUID[];v_id UUID;v_requested INTEGER;v_found INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT count(DISTINCT id) INTO v_requested FROM unnest(p_product_ids) id WHERE id IS NOT NULL;\n  IF v_requested=0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023',MESSAGE='PHASE2_PRODUCT_LOCK_SET_EMPTY: مجموعة منتجات الاستلام فارغة.';\n  END IF;\n  v_ids:=public.parcel209_inventory_family_set_internal(p_product_ids);\n  FOREACH v_id IN ARRAY v_ids LOOP\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('inventory-product:'||v_id::TEXT,0));\n  END LOOP;\n  -- A newly created/moved flavor cannot be added late to an already locked set.\n  IF v_ids IS DISTINCT FROM public.parcel209_inventory_family_set_internal(p_product_ids) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PARCEL209_FAMILY_CHANGED_RETRY: تغيّرت النكهات؛ حدّث البيانات ثم أعد المحاولة.';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM b.id FROM public.inventory_balances b WHERE b.product_id=ANY(v_ids)\n    ORDER BY b.product_id,b.warehouse_id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM p.id FROM public.products p WHERE p.id=ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY p.id FOR NO KEY UPDATE;\n  SELECT count(*) INTO v_found FROM public.products p WHERE p.id=ANY(p_product_ids);\n  IF v_found<>v_requested THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23503',CONSTRAINT='phase2_receipt_product_lock_set_check',\n      MESSAGE='PHASE2_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: أحد منتجات الاستلام غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_ids IS DISTINCT FROM public.parcel209_inventory_family_set_internal(p_product_ids) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PARCEL209_FAMILY_CHANGED_RETRY: تغيّرت النكهات؛ حدّث البيانات ثم أعد المحاولة.';\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase2_lock_payment_shift_internal(p_branch_id uuid, p_payment_method text, p_amount bigint)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  -- Callers pass the payment method after applying their own existing contract.\n  -- Keep this comparison exact so lock selection cannot broaden accepted inputs.\n  IF p_amount > 0 AND p_payment_method IN ('cash', 'cliq') THEN\n    IF p_branch_id IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_PAYMENT_BRANCH_REQUIRED: تعذر تحديد فرع دفعة المورد.';\n    END IF;\n    PERFORM shift.id FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n    WHERE shift.branch_id = p_branch_id AND shift.status = 'open'\n    ORDER BY shift.id FOR SHARE;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_OPEN_SHIFT_REQUIRED: افتح وردية الصندوق قبل تسجيل دفعة المورد.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase2_reverse_inventory_and_wac_internal(p_original_operation_id uuid, p_reversal_operation_id uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid, p_source_kind text, p_source_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_reason text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_snapshot public.phase2_receipt_wac_snapshots%ROWTYPE;\n  v_original_movement public.inventory_movements%ROWTYPE;\n  v_target_on_hand INTEGER;\n  v_target_reserved INTEGER;\n  v_global_on_hand INTEGER;\n  v_current_exact NUMERIC(24, 6);\n  v_current_legacy BIGINT;\n  v_running_balance INTEGER;\n  v_reversed_units INTEGER := 0;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_source_kind NOT IN ('supplier_receipt', 'purchase_receipt') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE2_REVERSAL_SOURCE_INVALID';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY(\n    SELECT snapshot.product_id\n    FROM public.phase2_receipt_wac_snapshots snapshot\n    WHERE snapshot.operation_id = p_original_operation_id\n    ORDER BY snapshot.product_id\n  ));\n\n  FOR v_snapshot IN\n    SELECT * FROM public.phase2_receipt_wac_snapshots snapshot\n    WHERE snapshot.operation_id = p_original_operation_id\n    ORDER BY snapshot.product_id\n  LOOP\n    SELECT\n      product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,\n      product.cost_price_in_minor_units\n    INTO v_current_exact, v_current_legacy\n    FROM public.products product\n    WHERE product.id = v_snapshot.product_id;\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance.on_hand_quantity), 0)::INTEGER\n    INTO v_global_on_hand\n    FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n    WHERE balance.product_id = v_snapshot.product_id;\n    SELECT balance.on_hand_quantity, balance.reserved_quantity\n    INTO v_target_on_hand, v_target_reserved\n    FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n    WHERE balance.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n      AND balance.product_id = v_snapshot.product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    IF v_current_exact IS DISTINCT FROM v_snapshot.resulting_exact_wac_in_minor_units\n      OR v_current_legacy IS DISTINCT FROM v_snapshot.resulting_legacy_wac_in_minor_units\n      OR v_global_on_hand IS DISTINCT FROM\n        v_snapshot.opening_global_quantity + v_snapshot.received_base_quantity\n      OR COALESCE(v_target_on_hand, 0) - v_snapshot.received_base_quantity\n        < COALESCE(v_target_reserved, 0)\n      OR EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_movements movement\n        WHERE movement.product_id = v_snapshot.product_id\n          AND movement.mutation_sequence > v_snapshot.receipt_movement_sequence_max\n      )\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_REVERSAL_UNSAFE: تحرك المخزون أو تغير WAC بعد السند؛ يلزم مسار تصحيحي مستقل.';\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  FOR v_snapshot IN\n    SELECT * FROM public.phase2_receipt_wac_snapshots snapshot\n    WHERE snapshot.operation_id = p_original_operation_id\n    ORDER BY snapshot.product_id\n  LOOP\n    SELECT balance.on_hand_quantity\n    INTO v_running_balance\n    FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n    WHERE balance.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n      AND balance.product_id = v_snapshot.product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    FOR v_original_movement IN\n      SELECT movement.*\n      FROM public.inventory_movements movement\n      WHERE movement.operation_id = p_original_operation_id\n        AND movement.product_id = v_snapshot.product_id\n        AND movement.movement_type = 'purchase_receipt'\n      ORDER BY movement.mutation_sequence DESC\n    LOOP\n      INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements (\n        warehouse_id, product_id, movement_type, quantity,\n        balance_before, balance_after, reference_type, reference_id,\n        notes, created_by, operation_id, reversed_movement_id\n      ) VALUES (\n        p_warehouse_id, v_snapshot.product_id, 'return_out',\n        -v_original_movement.quantity,\n        v_running_balance,\n        v_running_balance - v_original_movement.quantity,\n        p_source_kind || '_cancellation', p_source_id,\n        'عكس استلام Phase 2: ' || p_reason,\n        p_user_id, p_reversal_operation_id, v_original_movement.id\n      );\n      v_running_balance := v_running_balance - v_original_movement.quantity;\n      v_reversed_units := v_reversed_units + v_original_movement.quantity;\n    END LOOP;\n\n    UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n    SET on_hand_quantity = v_running_balance, updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n      AND product_id = v_snapshot.product_id;\n    UPDATE public.products\n    SET\n      wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact = CASE\n        WHEN v_snapshot.opening_global_quantity = 0 THEN NULL\n        ELSE v_snapshot.prior_exact_wac_in_minor_units\n      END,\n      cost_price_in_minor_units = v_snapshot.prior_legacy_wac_in_minor_units,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE id = v_snapshot.product_id;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'reversed_base_units', v_reversed_units,\n    'original_operation_id', p_original_operation_id,\n    'reversal_operation_id', p_reversal_operation_id\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase2_validate_receipt_lines_internal(p_lines jsonb)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_line JSONB;\n  v_component JSONB;\n  v_line_kind TEXT;\n  v_family_id UUID;\n  v_configuration_id UUID;\n  v_configuration_revision INTEGER;\n  v_commercial_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_units_per_parcel INTEGER;\n  v_gross BIGINT;\n  v_line_discount BIGINT;\n  v_line_net BIGINT;\n  v_component_count INTEGER;\n  v_explicit_count INTEGER;\n  v_component_quantity NUMERIC;\n  v_explicit_total NUMERIC;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_product_family UUID;\n  v_is_master BOOLEAN;\n  v_is_active BOOLEAN;\n  v_config public.product_parcel_configurations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_family public.products%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_lines IS NULL\n    OR jsonb_typeof(p_lines) <> 'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_lines) = 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_LINES_REQUIRED: يجب إضافة سطر استلام واحد على الأقل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) line\n    GROUP BY (line->>'client_line_id')::UUID\n    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23505',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_client_line_identity_unique',\n      MESSAGE = 'DUPLICATE_COMMERCIAL_LINE_IDENTITY: هوية السطر التجاري مكررة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_line IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_lines)\n  LOOP\n    PERFORM (v_line->>'client_line_id')::UUID;\n    v_line_kind := LOWER(BTRIM(v_line->>'line_kind'));\n    v_family_id := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'family_product_id'), '')::UUID;\n    v_configuration_id :=\n      NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'parcel_configuration_id'), '')::UUID;\n    v_configuration_revision :=\n      NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'configuration_revision'), '')::INTEGER;\n    v_commercial_quantity := (v_line->>'commercial_quantity')::INTEGER;\n    v_units_per_parcel :=\n      NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'units_per_parcel'), '')::INTEGER;\n    v_gross := (v_line->>'gross_amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;\n    v_line_discount :=\n      COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'line_discount_in_minor_units'), '')::BIGINT, 0);\n\n    IF v_line_kind NOT IN ('base_unit', 'configurable_parcel') THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '22023',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_LINE_KIND_INVALID: نوع السطر التجاري غير مدعوم.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_commercial_quantity <= 0 OR v_gross < 0 OR v_line_discount < 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '22023',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_LINE_VALUE_INVALID: الكمية والأسعار والخصومات يجب أن تكون ضمن الحدود المسموحة.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_line_discount > v_gross THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_line_discount_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_LINE_DISCOUNT_EXCEEDS_GROSS: خصم السطر يتجاوز إجماليه.';\n    END IF;\n    IF NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'base_unit_name'), '') IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '22023',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_BASE_UNIT_NAME_REQUIRED: اسم وحدة المخزون الأساسية مطلوب.';\n    END IF;\n\n    v_line_net := v_gross - v_line_discount;\n    v_component_count := jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(v_line->'components', '[]'::JSONB));\n    IF v_component_count = 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '22023',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_COMPONENTS_REQUIRED: مكونات السطر التجاري مطلوبة.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_line->'components') component\n      GROUP BY (component->>'product_id')::UUID\n      HAVING COUNT(*) > 1\n    ) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23505',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_component_identity_unique',\n        MESSAGE = 'DUPLICATE_COMPONENT_IDENTITY: لا يجوز تكرار نفس SKU داخل السطر التجاري.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (\n        WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(component->>'explicit_merchandise_cost_in_minor_units'), '') IS NOT NULL\n      ),\n      COALESCE(SUM((component->>'base_quantity')::NUMERIC), 0),\n      COALESCE(SUM(\n        NULLIF(BTRIM(component->>'explicit_merchandise_cost_in_minor_units'), '')::NUMERIC\n      ), 0)\n    INTO v_explicit_count, v_component_quantity, v_explicit_total\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_line->'components') component;\n\n    IF v_explicit_count NOT IN (0, v_component_count) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_component_cost_completeness_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'PARTIAL_EXPLICIT_COMPONENT_COST: يجب إدخال تكلفة كل المكونات أو عدم إدخالها كلها.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_explicit_count = v_component_count\n      AND v_explicit_total IS DISTINCT FROM v_line_net::NUMERIC\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_component_merchandise_cost_total_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'EXPLICIT_COMPONENT_COST_MISMATCH: تكاليف المكونات لا تطابق صافي السطر التجاري.';\n    END IF;\n\n    FOR v_component IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_line->'components')\n    LOOP\n      v_product_id := (v_component->>'product_id')::UUID;\n      IF (v_component->>'base_quantity')::INTEGER <= 0 THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '22023',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_COMPONENT_QUANTITY_INVALID: كمية مكون SKU يجب أن تكون موجبة.';\n      END IF;\n      IF NULLIF(BTRIM(v_component->>'explicit_merchandise_cost_in_minor_units'), '')::BIGINT < 0 THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '22023',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_COMPONENT_COST_INVALID: تكلفة مكون SKU لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة.';\n      END IF;\n\n      SELECT\n        COALESCE(product.flavor_master_product_id, product.id),\n        product.is_flavor_master,\n        product.is_active\n      INTO v_product_family, v_is_master, v_is_active\n      FROM public.products product\n      WHERE product.id = v_product_id;\n\n      IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_is_active OR v_is_master THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '23514',\n          CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_stocked_sku_check',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_STOCKED_SKU_REQUIRED: الاستلام يقبل SKU مخزنيًا نشطًا فقط.';\n      END IF;\n      IF v_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel'\n        AND v_product_family IS DISTINCT FROM v_family_id\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '23514',\n          CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_component_family_check',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_COMPONENT_FAMILY_MISMATCH: مكون الطرد خارج العائلة التجارية.';\n      END IF;\n    END LOOP;\n\n    IF v_component_quantity > 2147483647::NUMERIC THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '22003',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_COMPONENT_QUANTITY_OVERFLOW: إجمالي كمية المكونات يتجاوز الحد المدعوم.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_line_kind = 'base_unit' THEN\n      IF v_family_id IS NOT NULL\n        OR v_configuration_id IS NOT NULL\n        OR v_configuration_revision IS NOT NULL\n        OR v_units_per_parcel IS NOT NULL\n        OR NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'parcel_unit_name'), '') IS NOT NULL\n        OR v_component_count <> 1\n        OR v_component_quantity <> v_commercial_quantity::NUMERIC\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '23514',\n          CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_base_unit_line_shape_check',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_BASE_UNIT_LINE_INVALID: سطر الوحدة الأساسية يجب أن يحتوي SKU واحدًا وكمية مطابقة.';\n      END IF;\n    ELSE\n      PERFORM public.assert_configurable_parcel_creation_allowed();\n\n      SELECT * INTO v_config\n      FROM public.product_parcel_configurations configuration\n      WHERE configuration.id = v_configuration_id\n      FOR SHARE;\n      SELECT * INTO v_family\n      FROM public.products product\n      WHERE product.id = v_family_id\n      FOR SHARE;\n\n      IF v_config.id IS NULL\n        OR NOT v_config.is_active\n        OR v_config.composition_mode <> 'configurable_mix'\n        OR v_config.family_product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_family_id\n        OR v_config.configuration_revision IS DISTINCT FROM v_configuration_revision\n        OR v_family.id IS NULL\n        OR NOT v_family.is_flavor_master\n        OR v_units_per_parcel IS DISTINCT FROM v_family.units_per_sale_unit\n        OR NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'parcel_unit_name'), '') IS NULL\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '23514',\n          CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_parcel_configuration_check',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_PARCEL_CONFIGURATION_MISMATCH: إعداد الطرد أو نسخته أو سعته غير متطابقة.';\n      END IF;\n\n      IF v_component_quantity\n        <> v_commercial_quantity::NUMERIC * v_units_per_parcel::NUMERIC\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '23514',\n          CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_parcel_capacity_check',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_PARCEL_CAPACITY_MISMATCH: مجموع وحدات الطرد لا يطابق العدد والسعة.';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase35_report_base_unit_count_internal(p_order_item_id uuid, p_commercial_line_kind text, p_legacy_quantity integer)\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT CASE\n    WHEN p_commercial_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel' THEN COALESCE((\n      SELECT SUM(component.base_quantity)::BIGINT\n      FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n      JOIN public.order_parcel_components component\n        ON component.parcel_instance_id = instance.id\n      WHERE instance.order_item_id = p_order_item_id\n    ), 0::BIGINT)\n    ELSE COALESCE(p_legacy_quantity, 0)::BIGINT\n  END;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase35_report_package_count_internal(p_order_item_id uuid, p_commercial_line_kind text, p_sale_package_quantity integer, p_units_per_sale_package integer)\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT CASE\n    WHEN p_commercial_line_kind = 'base_unit' THEN 0::BIGINT\n    WHEN p_commercial_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel' THEN (\n      SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT\n      FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n      WHERE instance.order_item_id = p_order_item_id\n    )\n    WHEN p_commercial_line_kind = 'legacy_single_sku_parcel' THEN\n      COALESCE(p_sale_package_quantity, 0)::BIGINT\n    WHEN p_commercial_line_kind IS NULL\n      AND p_sale_package_quantity IS NOT NULL\n      AND p_units_per_sale_package IS NOT NULL\n      AND p_units_per_sale_package > 0\n    THEN p_sale_package_quantity::BIGINT\n    ELSE 0::BIGINT\n  END;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal(p_actor_scope_type text, p_erp_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_guest_phone_hash text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_guest_session_hash text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_scope_type TEXT := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_actor_scope_type), ''));\n  v_material TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_scope_type = 'erp_user' THEN\n    IF p_erp_user_id IS NULL OR p_guest_phone_hash IS NOT NULL\n      OR p_guest_session_hash IS NOT NULL\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_SCOPE_INVALID: ERP actor scope is malformed.';\n    END IF;\n    v_material := 'phase3:erp_user:v1|' || LOWER(p_erp_user_id::TEXT);\n  ELSIF v_scope_type = 'guest_gateway' THEN\n    IF p_erp_user_id IS NOT NULL\n      OR COALESCE(p_guest_phone_hash, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n      OR COALESCE(p_guest_session_hash, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_SCOPE_INVALID: Guest actor scope is malformed.';\n    END IF;\n    v_material := 'phase3:guest_gateway:v1|'\n      || p_guest_phone_hash || '|' || p_guest_session_hash;\n  ELSIF v_scope_type = 'system_job' THEN\n    IF p_erp_user_id IS NOT NULL OR p_guest_phone_hash IS NOT NULL\n      OR p_guest_session_hash IS NOT NULL\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_SCOPE_INVALID: System actor scope is malformed.';\n    END IF;\n    v_material := 'phase3:system_job:v1|customer-reservation-lifecycle';\n  ELSE\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_SCOPE_INVALID: Unsupported actor scope.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN ENCODE(extensions.digest(v_material, 'sha256'::TEXT), 'hex');\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_allocate_parcel_cogs_internal(p_components jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_duplicate_count INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  IF JSONB_TYPEOF(p_components) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'\n    OR JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(p_components) = 0\n    OR JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(p_components) > 200\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_COGS_INPUT_INVALID: COGS components are invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT component->>'product_id')\n  INTO v_duplicate_count\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_components) component;\n  IF v_duplicate_count <> 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_COGS_INPUT_INVALID: COGS components must be canonical and unique.';\n  END IF;\n\n  BEGIN\n    WITH parsed AS (\n      SELECT\n        (component->>'product_id')::UUID AS product_id,\n        (component->>'base_quantity')::INTEGER AS base_quantity,\n        (component->>'unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact')::NUMERIC(24, 6)\n          AS unit_cost,\n        (component->>'base_quantity')::INTEGER\n          * (component->>'unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact')::NUMERIC(24, 6)\n          AS exact_cost\n      FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_components) component\n    ), validated AS (\n      SELECT * FROM parsed\n      WHERE base_quantity > 0 AND unit_cost >= 0\n    ), totals AS (\n      SELECT\n        ROUND(SUM(exact_cost), 0)::BIGINT AS target_total,\n        SUM(FLOOR(exact_cost))::BIGINT AS floor_total,\n        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS item_count\n      FROM validated\n    ), ranked AS (\n      SELECT\n        validated.*,\n        FLOOR(exact_cost)::BIGINT AS floor_cost,\n        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n          ORDER BY exact_cost - FLOOR(exact_cost) DESC, product_id\n        )::BIGINT AS residual_rank,\n        totals.target_total,\n        totals.target_total - totals.floor_total AS residual,\n        totals.item_count\n      FROM validated CROSS JOIN totals\n    )\n    SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'rounding_boundary', 'parcel_instance',\n      'total_cogs_in_minor_units', MAX(target_total),\n      'components', JSONB_AGG(\n        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n          'product_id', LOWER(product_id::TEXT),\n          'base_quantity', base_quantity,\n          'unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact', unit_cost,\n          'exact_cogs_in_minor_units', exact_cost,\n          'allocated_cogs_in_minor_units',\n            floor_cost + CASE WHEN residual_rank <= residual THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\n        )\n        ORDER BY product_id\n      )\n    )\n    INTO v_result\n    FROM ranked;\n  EXCEPTION\n    WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_COGS_INPUT_INVALID: COGS component values are malformed.';\n  END;\n\n  IF v_result IS NULL\n    OR JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(v_result->'components') <> JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(p_components)\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_COGS_INPUT_INVALID: COGS component values are invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_assert_configurable_parcel_creation_allowed_internal(p_actor_scope_type text, p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_scope_type TEXT := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_actor_scope_type), ''));\n  v_state TEXT := public.get_configurable_parcel_feature_state();\nBEGIN\n  IF v_scope_type = 'erp_user' THEN\n    IF p_actor_user_id IS NULL\n      OR auth.uid() IS NULL\n      OR p_actor_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid()\n      OR NOT public.is_active_erp_staff()\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED: ERP actor is not authorized.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF v_scope_type = 'guest_gateway' THEN\n    IF p_actor_user_id IS NOT NULL OR auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Guest gateway proof is invalid.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Unsupported actor scope.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_state = 'ENABLED' THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n  IF v_state = 'OWNER_PILOT'\n    AND v_scope_type = 'erp_user'\n    AND public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'])\n  THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n\n  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n    MESSAGE = 'CONFIGURABLE_PARCEL_DISABLED: الوظيفة غير مفعلة لإنشاء عمليات جديدة.';\nEND;\n$function$\n",

= 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Parcel components must be a non-empty array.';\n  END IF;\n  IF JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(p_components) > 200 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Parcel component entry limit exceeded.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_component IN SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_components)\n  LOOP\n    IF JSONB_TYPEOF(v_component) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Parcel component must be an object.';\n    END IF;\n    PERFORM public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n      v_component->>'product_id', 'component product_id'\n    );\n    PERFORM public.phase3_require_positive_integer_internal(\n      v_component->>'base_quantity', 'component base_quantity'\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n\n  SELECT SUM(quantity), JSONB_AGG(\n    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'product_id', LOWER(product_id::TEXT),\n      'base_quantity', quantity\n    )\n    ORDER BY product_id\n  )\n  INTO v_total, v_result\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      (component->>'product_id')::UUID AS product_id,\n      SUM((component->>'base_quantity')::BIGINT) AS quantity\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_components) component\n    GROUP BY (component->>'product_id')::UUID\n  ) normalized;\n\n  IF v_total > 2147483647\n    OR EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_result) component\n      WHERE BIGINT;\n  v_price_override BIGINT;\n  v_price_authority TEXT;\n  v_total_commercial_quantity BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total_instances INTEGER := 0;\n  v_branch_id UUID;\n  v_customer_id UUID;\n  v_customer_hash TEXT;\n  v_delivery_hash TEXT;\n  v_amount_received BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  IF JSONB_TYPEOF(p_request) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n    OR p_request->>'contract_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase3-sale-v1'\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Unsupported sale contract version.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_actor_scope_type := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'actor_scope_type'), ''));\n  v_actor_scope_hash := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'actor_scope_hash'), ''));\n  v_source := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'operation_source'), ''));\n  IF v_actor_scope_type NOT IN ('erp_user', 'guest_gateway')\n    OR COALESCE(v_actor_scope_hash, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n    OR v_source NOT IN ('admin_pos', 'customer_reservation')\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Actor or operation source is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n    p_request->>'warehouse_id', 'warehouse_id'\n  );\n  IF NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'branch_id'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN\n    v_branch_id := public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n      p_request->>'branch_id', 'branch_id'\n    );\n  END IF;\n  IF NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'customer_id'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN\n    v_customer_id := public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n      p_request->>'customer_id', 'customer_id'\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  v_customer_hash := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'customer_identity_hash'), ''));\n  v_delivery_hash := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'delivery_identity_hash'), ''));\n  IF (v_customer_hash IS NOT NULL AND v_customer_hash !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')\n    OR (v_delivery_hash IS NOT NULL AND v_delivery_hash !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Privacy-safe customer or delivery identity is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'amount_received_in_minor_units'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN\n    v_amount_received := public.phase3_require_nonnegative_bigint_internal(\n      p_request->>'amount_received_in_minor_units',\n      'amount_received_in_minor_units'\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  v_lines := p_request->'lines';\n  IF JSONB_TYPEOF(v_lines) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'\n    OR JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(v_lines) = 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Sale lines must be a non-empty array.';\n  END IF;\n  IF         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_customer_cost_finalization_allowed_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_row_kind text, p_row_id uuid)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.orders customer_order\n      JOIN public.business_operations creation\n        ON creation.id = customer_order.operation_id\n      WHERE customer_order.id = p_order_id\n        AND customer_order.source = 'website'\n        AND customer_order.status IN ('ready', 'out_for_delivery')\n        AND customer_order.cost_finalized_at IS NULL\n        AND creation.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1'\n    )\n    AND EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.phase3_customer_cost_finalization_guards guard_authorization\n      WHERE guard_authorization.transaction_id = pg_current_xact_id()\n        AND guard_authorization.order_id = p_order_id\n        AND guard_authorization.row_kind = p_row_kind\n        AND guard_authorization.row_id = p_row_id\n        AND guard_authorization.lifecycle_operation_id::TEXT = CURRENT_SETTING(\n          'nawasrah.customer_cost_finalization_operation_id', true\n        )\n    );\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_customer_line_identity_internal(p_line jsonb)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_kind TEXT := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_line->>'commercial_line_kind'), ''));\nBEGIN\n  IF v_kind = 'base_unit' THEN\n    RETURN 'base_unit:' || LOWER(public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n      p_line->>'product_id', 'quote product_id'\n    )::TEXT);\n  ELSIF v_kind = 'legacy_single_sku_parcel' THEN\n    RETURN 'legacy_single_sku_parcel:' || LOWER(public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n      p_line->>'product_id', 'quote product_id'\n    )::TEXT);\n  ELSIF v_kind = 'configurable_parcel' THEN\n    RETURN 'configurable_parcel:'\n      || LOWER(public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n        p_line->>'family_product_id', 'quote family_product_id'\n      )::TEXT) || ':'\n      || LOWER(public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n        p_line->>'parcel_configuration_id', 'quote parcel_configuration_id'\n      )::TEXT) || ':'\n      || public.phase3_require_positive_integer_internal(\n        p_line->>'configuration_revision', 'quote configuration_revision'\n      )::TEXT;\n  END IF;\n  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n    MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Unsupported Customer line kind.';\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_expire_customer_order_v2_internal(p_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_key TEXT := 'expiry:' || LOWER(p_order_id::TEXT);\n  v_actor_hash TEXT := public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal(\n    'system_job', NULL, NULL, NULL\n  );\n  v_request JSONB := JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'contract_version', 'phase3-customer-expiry-v1',\n    'order_id', LOWER(p_order_id::TEXT)\n  );\n  v_fingerprint TEXT;\n  v_replay JSONB;\n  v_operation_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_reason CONSTANT TEXT := 'انتهت مهلة حجز طلب الموقع (5 ساعات) قبل قبول الطلب.';\nBEGIN\n  v_fingerprint := public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(v_request);\n  v_replay := public.phase3_resolve_operation_replay_internal(\n    'phase3_customer_expiry_v1', v_key, 'system_job', v_actor_hash, v_fingerprint\n  );\n  IF v_replay->>'decision' = 'REPLAY' THEN\n    RETURN v_replay->'result_snapshot';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN public.phase3_release_customer_reservations_internal(\n    p_order_id, v_operation_id, 'phase3_customer_expiry_v1', v_key,\n    v_fingerprint, v_request, 'system_job', v_actor_hash, NULL,\n    'released', v_reason\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_lock_open_pos_shift_internal(p_branch_id uuid)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_shift_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تنفيذ البيع المباشر دون فرع محدد.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT shift.id INTO v_shift_id\n  FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n  WHERE shift.branch_id = p_branch_id\n    AND shift.status = 'open'\n  ORDER BY shift.id\n  LIMIT 1;\n\n  IF v_shift_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'افتح وردية الصندوق أولاً قبل إتمام البيع المباشر.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Full-shift reversal and POS reversal already serialize on this key before\n  -- taking the shift row.  Joining that gate prevents the historical\n  -- Inventory -> Shift / Shift -> Inventory cycle without changing V1 data or\n  -- its caller-visible contract.\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'cash-shift-full-reversal:' || v_shift_id::TEXT,\n    0\n  ));\n\n  PERFORM shift.id\n  FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n  WHERE shift.id = v_shift_id\n    AND shift.branch_id = p_branch_id\n    AND shift.status = 'open'\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'افتح وردية الصندوق أولاً قبل إتمام البيع المباشر.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN v_shift_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(p_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS TABLE(order_item_id uuid, product_id uuid, base_quantity integer, parcel_component_id uuid, operation_id uuid)\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT\n    item.id,\n    item.product_id,\n    item.quantity,\n    NULL::UUID,\n    orders.operation_id\n  FROM public.order_items item\n  JOIN public.orders orders ON orders.id = item.order_id\n  WHERE item.order_id = p_order_id\n    AND item.product_id IS NOT NULL\n    AND item.commercial_line_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'configurable_parcel'\n  UNION ALL\n  SELECT\n    instance.order_item_id,\n    component.product_id,\n    component.base_quantity,\n    component.id,\n    component.operation_id\n  FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n  JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance\n    ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id\n  JOIN public.order_items item ON item.id = instance.order_item_id\n  WHERE instance.order_id = p_order_id\n    AND item.commercial_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel';\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_release_customer_reservations_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_lifecycle_operation_id uuid, p_operation_type text, p_idempotency_key text, p_request_fingerprint text, p_request_snapshot jsonb, p_actor_scope_type text, p_actor_scope_hash text, p_initiated_by uuid, p_terminal_state text, p_reason text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_product_ids UUID[];\n  v_demand RECORD;\n  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ := NOW();\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_target_order_status TEXT;\n  v_target_reservation_state TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_operation_type NOT IN (\n      'phase3_customer_cancellation_v1', 'phase3_customer_expiry_v1'\n    ) OR p_terminal_state NOT IN ('cancelled', 'released')\n    OR (p_operation_type = 'phase3_customer_cancellation_v1'\n      AND p_terminal_state <> 'cancelled')\n    OR (p_operation_type = 'phase3_customer_expiry_v1'\n      AND p_terminal_state <> 'released')\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_LIFECYCLE_INVALID: Release protocol is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n  v_target_order_status := CASE WHEN p_terminal_state = 'released'\n    THEN 'expired' ELSE 'cancelled' END;\n  v_target_reservation_state := p_terminal_state;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.orders WHERE id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.business_operations operation\n    WHERE operation.id = v_order.operation_id\n      AND operation.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH: Order is not Customer V2.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_order.status = 'completed' OR v_order.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_LIFECYCLE_INVALID: Completed order cannot release reservations.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_terminal_state = 'released' AND (\n    v_order.status <> 'new' OR v_order.reservation_expires_at IS NULL\n      OR v_order.reservation_expires_at > NOW()\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_LIFECYCLE_INVALID: Order is not eligible for expiry.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT reservation.product_id ORDER BY reservation.product_id)\n  INTO v_product_ids FROM public.order_inventory_reservations reservation\n  WHERE reservation.order_id = p_order_id\n    AND reservation.reservation_state = 'active';\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_product_ids), 0) = 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_RESERVATION_TERMINAL: No active reservation remains.';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM public.phase3_lock_inventory_products_internal(v_product_ids);\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n  WHERE balance.warehouse_id = v_order.warehouse_id\n    AND balance.product_id = ANY(v_product_ids)\n  ORDER BY balance.product_id FOR UPDATE;\n\n  FOR v_demand IN\n    SELECT reservation.product_id,\n      SUM(reservation.reserved_quantity)::INTEGER quantity\n    FROM public.order_inventory_reservations reservation\n    WHERE reservation.order_id = p_order_id\n      AND reservation.reservation_state = 'active'\n    GROUP BY reservation.product_id ORDER BY reservation.product_id\n  LOOP\n    UPDATE public.inventory_balances balance\n    SET reserved_quantity = balance.reserved_quantity - v_demand.quantity,\n      updated_at = v_now\n    WHERE balance.warehouse_id = v_order.warehouse_id\n      AND balance.product_id = v_demand.product_id\n      AND balance.reserved_quantity >= v_demand.quantity;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_RESERVATION_MISMATCH: Reserved quantity cannot be released.';\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  UPDATE public.order_inventory_reservations SET\n    reservation_state = v_target_reservation_state, resolved_at = v_now\n  WHERE order_id = p_order_id AND reservation_state = 'active';\n  PERFORM SET_CONFIG(\n    'nawasrah.customer_lifecycle_operation_id',\n    p_lifecycle_operation_id::TEXT, true\n  );\n  INSERT INTO public.phase3_customer_lifecycle_transition_guards(\n    transaction_id, lifecycle_operation_id, order_id, target_status\n  ) VALUES (\n    pg_current_xact_id(), p_lifecycle_operation_id, p_order_id,\n    v_target_order_status\n  );\n  UPDATE public.orders SET\n    status = v_target_order_status, reservation_released_at = v_now,\n    expired_at = CASE WHEN v_target_order_status = 'expired' THEN v_now ELSE expired_at END,\n    expired_reason = CASE WHEN v_target_order_status = 'expired'\n      THEN p_reason ELSE expired_reason END,\n    updated_at = v_now\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n  DELETE FROM public.phase3_customer_lifecycle_transition_guards\n  WHERE transaction_id = pg_current_xact_id()\n    AND lifecycle_operation_id = p_lifecycle_operation_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.order_status_history(order_id, old_status, new_status, changed_by, notes)\n  VALUES (p_order_id, v_order.status, v_target_order_status, p_initiated_by, p_reason);\n  v_result := JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'success', true, 'idempotent_replay', false,\n    'operation_id', p_lifecycle_operation_id, 'order_id', p_order_id,\n    'order_number', v_order.order_number, 'status', v_target_order_status,\n    'reservation_state', v_target_reservation_state,\n    'released_reservations', (SELECT COUNT(*)\n      FROM         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_resolve_legacy_pos_location_internal(p_warehouse_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid)\n RETURNS TABLE(warehouse_id uuid, branch_id uuid)\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_warehouse_id UUID := p_warehouse_id;\n  v_branch_id UUID := p_branch_id;\nBEGIN\n  -- Preserve the published V1 resolver exactly. An explicit warehouse preserves an explicit branch,\n  -- including the historical mismatch behavior, and infers only a NULL one.\n  IF v_warehouse_id IS NULL THEN\n    SELECT warehouse.id, warehouse.branch_id\n    INTO v_warehouse_id, v_branch_id\n    FROM public.warehouses warehouse\n    WHERE warehouse.is_active = true\n    ORDER BY warehouse.created_at\n    LIMIT 1;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT COALESCE(v_branch_id, warehouse.branch_id)\n    INTO v_branch_id\n    FROM public.warehouses warehouse\n    WHERE warehouse.id = v_warehouse_id\n      AND warehouse.is_active = true;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'المستودع المحدد غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_warehouse_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يوجد مستودع نشط لتنفيذ البيع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_warehouse_id, v_branch_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'phase3-operation:' || v_operation_type || ':' || v_key, 0\n  ));\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_operation\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_validate_configurable_parcel_internal(p_actor_scope_type text, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_family_product_id uuid, p_parcel_configuration_id uuid, p_configuration_revision integer, p_components jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  -- Every caller, including receiving/quotes, takes inventory/family locks\n  -- before the historical configuration/family snapshot locks.\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY[p_family_product_id]||ARRAY(\n    SELECT (c->>'product_id')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_components) c));\n  v_result:=public.package_d_validate_configurable_parcel_before_policy_internal(\n    p_actor_scope_type,p_actor_user_id,p_family_product_id,p_parcel_configuration_id,\n    p_configuration_revision,p_components);\n  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_result->'components') component\n    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.product_parcel_allowed_components allowed\n      WHERE allowed.configuration_id=p_parcel_configuration_id\n        AND allowed.product_id=(component->>'product_id')::UUID)) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='P0001',\n      MESSAGE='PARCEL_COMPONENT_NOT_ALLOWED: إحدى النكهات غير مسموحة لهذا الطرد.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase42_apply_return_inventory_before_phase43_internal(p_operation_id uuid, p_return_event_id uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid, p_sources jsonb, p_user_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_product RECORD;\n  v_opening_global INTEGER;\n  v_target_before INTEGER;\n  v_target_after INTEGER;\n  v_prior_exact NUMERIC(24, 6);\n  v_prior_legacy BIGINT;\n  v_restock_value NUMERIC(30, 6);\n  v_resulting_value NUMERIC(30, 6);\n  v_resulting_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_new_exact NUMERIC(24, 6);\n  v_new_legacy BIGINT;\n  v_movement_id UUID;\n  v_effects JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_operation_id IS NULL OR p_return_event_id IS NULL\n    OR p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR p_user_id IS NULL\n    OR p_sources IS NULL OR JSONB_TYPEOF(p_sources) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_INVENTORY_EFFECT_INPUT_INVALID: Return inventory effect input is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n  IF JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(p_sources) = 0 THEN\n    RETURN v_effects;\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY(\n    SELECT DISTINCT (source->>'product_id')::UUID\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_sources) source\n    ORDER BY (source->>'product_id')::UUID\n  ));\n\n  FOR v_product IN\n    SELECT (source->>'product_id')::UUID AS product_id,\n      SUM((source->>'quantity')::INTEGER)::INTEGER AS quantity,\n      SUM((source->>'historical_value_exact')::NUMERIC(30, 6))::NUMERIC(30, 6)\n        AS historical_value_exact,\n      JSONB_AGG(source ORDER BY source->>'source_kind', source->>'source_id')\n        AS source_evidence\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_sources) source\n    GROUP BY (source->>'product_id')::UUID\n    ORDER BY (source->>'product_id')::UUID\n  LOOP\n    IF v_product.quantity <= 0 OR v_product.historical_value_exact < 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_INVENTORY_EFFECT_INVALID: Sellable quantity and historical value must be valid.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,\n      product.cost_price_in_minor_units\n    INTO v_prior_exact, v_prior_legacy\n    FROM public.products product\n    WHERE product.id = v_product.product_id\n    FOR NO KEY UPDATE;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_RETURN_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: Return product is unavailable.';\n    END IF;\n    v_prior_exact := COALESCE(v_prior_exact, v_prior_legacy::NUMERIC);\n\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance.on_hand_quantity), 0)::INTEGER\n    INTO v_opening_global\n    FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n    WHERE balance.product_id = v_product.product_id;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.inventory_balances(\n      warehouse_id, product_id, on_hand_quantity, reserved_quantity\n    ) VALUES (p_warehouse_id, v_product.product_id, 0, 0)\n    ON CONFLICT (warehouse_id, product_id) DO NOTHING;\n\n    SELECT balance.on_hand_quantity INTO v_target_before\n    FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n    WHERE balance.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n      AND balance.product_id = v_product.product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    v_restock_value := v_product.historical_value_exact;\n    v_resulting_quantity := v_opening_global + v_product.quantity;\n    v_resulting_value := ROUND(\n      v_opening_global::NUMERIC * v_prior_exact + v_restock_value, 6\n    );\n    v_new_exact := ROUND(\n      v_resulting_value / v_resulting_quantity::NUMERIC, 6\n    );\n    v_new_legacy := ROUND(v_new_exact)::BIGINT;\n    v_target_after := v_target_before + v_product.quantity;\n    v_movement_id := gen_random_uuid();\n\n    UPDATE public.products\n    SET wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact = v_new_exact,\n      cost_price_in_minor_units = v_new_legacy,\n      updated_at = clock_timestamp()\n    WHERE id = v_product.product_id;\n\n    UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n    SET on_hand_quantity = v_target_after, updated_at = clock_timestamp()\n    WHERE warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n      AND product_id = v_product.product_id;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements(\n      id, warehouse_id, product_id, movement_type, quantity,\n      balance_before, balance_after, reference_type, reference_id,\n      notes, created_by\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_movement_id, p_warehouse_id, v_product.product_id, 'return_in',\n      v_product.quantity, v_target_before, v_target_after,\n      'phase4_sales_return', p_return_event_id,\n      'Phase 4.2 historical-cost sellable Return restock', p_user_id\n    );\n\n    INSERT INTO public.phase42_return_inventory_effects(\n      operation_id, return_event_id, warehouse_id, product_id,\n      inventory_movement_id, sellable_quantity,\n      historical_restock_value_in_minor_units_exact,\n      opening_global_quantity, target_balance_before, target_balance_after,\n      prior_wac_in_minor_units_exact, resulting_wac_in_minor_units_exact,\n      resulting_global_quantity, resulting_global_value_in_minor_units_exact,\n      source_evidence\n    ) VALUES (\n      p_operation_id, p_return_event_id, p_warehouse_id,\n      v_product.product_id, v_movement_id, v_product.quantity,\n      v_restock_value, v_opening_global, v_target_before, v_target_after,\n      v_prior_exact, v_new_exact, v_resulting_quantity,\n      v_resulting_value, v_product.source_evidence\n    );\n\n    v_effects := v_effects || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'productId', v_product.product_id,\n      'quantity', v_product.quantity,\n      'historicalRestockValueInMinorUnitsExact', v_restock_value,\n      'priorWacInMinorUnitsExact', v_prior_exact,\n      'resultingWacInMinorUnitsExact', v_new_exact,\n      'inventoryMovementId', v_movement_id\n    ));\n  END LOOP;\n  RETURN v_effects;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase42_assert_operational_return_evidence_before_phase43(p_operation_id uuid, p_require_settled boolean)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation public.business_operations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_event public.sales_return_events%ROWTYPE;\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_evidence public.phase42_return_settlement_evidence%ROWTYPE;\n  v_creation_type TEXT;\n  v_inventory JSONB;\n  v_expected_inventory JSONB;\n  v_actual_inventory JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO v_operation\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = p_operation_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_operation.operation_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase4_return_v1' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_OPERATIONAL_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Return operation identity is missing or invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_event\n  FROM public.sales_return_events event\n  WHERE event.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_OPERATIONAL_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Return event identity is missing.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_order\n  FROM public.orders customer_order\n  WHERE customer_order.id = v_event.order_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_OPERATIONAL_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Return sale identity is missing.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT creation.operation_type INTO v_creation_type\n  FROM public.business_operations creation\n  WHERE creation.id = v_order.operation_id;\n\n  -- Historical/non-modern Returns retain the Phase 4.1 foundation contract.\n  IF v_creation_type NOT IN (\n    'phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1'\n  ) THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_evidence\n  FROM public.phase42_return_settlement_evidence evidence\n  WHERE evidence.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  v_inventory := public.phase42_inventory_effects_snapshot_internal(\n    p_operation_id\n  );\n\n  -- Derive the complete required restoration independently from persisted\n  -- operational effects. This binds quantity, historical valuation and every\n  -- logical source to the immutable sale/inspection evidence.\n  v_expected_inventory :=\n    public.phase42_expected_return_inventory_effects_internal(p_operation_id);\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    JSONB_OBJECT_AGG(product_id::TEXT, JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'quantity', sellable_quantity,\n      'historicalValueExact',\n        historical_restock_value_in_minor_units_exact,\n      'sourceEvidence', source_evidence\n    )),\n    '{}'::JSONB\n  )\n  INTO v_actual_inventory\n  FROM public.phase42_return_inventory_effects effect\n  WHERE effect.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  IF v_actual_inventory IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_inventory THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_OPERATIONAL_EFFECTS_INCOMPLETE: Inventory effects do not match accepted sellable evidence.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Durable evidence must point to the exact inventory movement produced for\n  -- this Return and its authoritative sale warehouse. Current balances are not\n  -- consulted, so legitimate later inventory activity cannot invalidate replay.\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.phase42_return_inventory_effects effect\n    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_movements movement\n      ON movement.id = effect.inventory_movement_id\n    WHERE effect.operation_id = p_operation_id\n      AND (\n        effect.return_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_event.id\n        OR v_event.warehouse_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order.warehouse_id\n        OR effect.warehouse_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order.warehouse_id\n        OR effect.target_balance_after IS DISTINCT FROM\n          effect.target_balance_before + effect.sellable_quantity\n        OR effect.resulting_global_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM\n collected_amount - prior_debt, 0)::BIGINT\n      AS outstanding_amount\n    FROM position\n  ), delivery AS (\n    SELECT *, LEAST(delivery_amount, outstanding_amount)::BIGINT\n      AS delivery_outstanding\n    FROM derived\n  )\n  SELECT total_amount, delivery_amount, collected_amount, prior_debt,\n    prior_refunds, outstanding_amount, delivery_outstanding,\n    GREATEST(outstanding_amount - delivery_outstanding, 0)::BIGINT,\n    GREATEST(collected_amount - prior_refunds\n      - (delivery_amount - delivery_outstanding), 0)::BIGINT\n  FROM delivery;\n$function$\n",

'physical_sources', false) THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n\n  WITH expected AS (\n    SELECT return_item.id return_item_id,\n      source->>'root_source_kind' root_source_kind,\n      (source->>'root_source_id')::UUID root_source_id,\n      source->>'source_kind' source_kind,\n      (source->>'source_id')::UUID source_id,\n      (source->>'product_id')::UUID product_id,\n      (source->>'quantity')::INTEGER quantity\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_request->'physical_sources') source\n    JOIN public.sales_return_items return_item\n      ON return_item.operation_id = p_operation_id\n      AND (\n        (source->>'root_source_kind' = 'base_order_item'\n          AND return_item.return_scope = 'base_unit'\n          AND return_item.order_item_id = (source->>'root_source_id')::UUID)\n        OR\n        (source->>'root_source_kind' = 'parcel_component'\n          AND return_item.return_scope = 'parcel_instance'\n          AND EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n            WHERE component.id = (source->>'root_source_id')::UUID\n              AND component.parcel_instance_id = return_item.parcel_instance_id\n          ))\n      )\n  ), actual AS (\n    SELECT consumption.return_item_id,\n      root.root_kind root_source_kind, root.root_id root_source_id,\n      consumption.source_kind, consumption.source_id,\n      consumption.product_id, consumption.consumed_quantity quantity\n    FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n      consumption.source_kind, consumption.source_id, consumption.product_id\n    ) root\n    WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n      AND consumption.consumption_kind = 'return'\n  ), delta AS (\n    (SELECT * FROM expected EXCEPT SELECT * FROM actual)\n    UNION ALL\n    (SELECT * FROM actual EXCEPT SELECT * FROM expected)\n  )\n  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM delta) INTO v_mismatch;\n  IF v_mismatch THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Expected and persisted physical-consumption sets differ.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.sales_return_component_inspections inspection\n    JOIN public.sales_return_items return_item\n      ON return_item.id = inspection.sales_return_item_id\n      AND return_item.operation_id = p_operation_id\n    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n      SELECT\n        COALESCE(SUM((source->>'sellable_restock_quantity')::INTEGER), 0)::INTEGER sellable,\n        COALESCE(SUM((source->>'defect_non_sellable_quantity')::INTEGER), 0)::INTEGER defect,\n        COALESCE(SUM((source->>'customer_damage_quantity')::INTEGER), 0)::INTEGER damage\n      FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_request->'physical_sources') source\n      WHERE source->>'root_source_kind' = 'parcel_component'\n        AND (source->>'root_source_id')::UUID = inspection.parcel_component_id\n    ) allocation ON true\n    WHERE inspection.accepted_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM allocation.sellable + allocation.defect\n      OR inspection.rejected_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM allocation.damage\n      OR (allocation.sellable > 0 AND (\n        inspection.accepted_condition IS DISTINCT FROM 'sellable'\n        OR inspection.accepted_stock_disposition IS DISTINCT FROM 'restock'))\n      OR (allocation.sellable = 0 AND allocation.defect > 0 AND (\n        inspection.accepted_condition IS DISTINCT FROM 'supplier_defect'\n        OR inspection.accepted_stock_disposition IS DISTINCT FROM 'non_sellable'))\n      OR (allocation.damage > 0 AND (\n        inspection.rejection_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'customer_damage'\n        OR inspection.rejected_stock_disposition IS DISTINCT FROM 'returned_to_customer'))\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_INSPECTION_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Persisted inspection does not match the immutable leaf allocation.';\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase43_assert_return_physical_source_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_root_kind text, p_root_id uuid, p_source_kind text, p_source_id uuid, p_product_id uuid)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_root RECORD;\n  v_source_order UUID;\n  v_operation_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO v_root FROM public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n    p_source_kind, p_source_id, p_product_id\n  );\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_root.root_kind IS DISTINCT FROM p_root_kind\n    OR v_root.root_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_root_id\n    OR v_root.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_product_id\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_LINEAGE_INVALID: Physical source does not represent the requested original sale root.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_root_kind = 'base_order_item' THEN\n    SELECT item.order_id INTO v_source_order FROM public.order_items item\n    WHERE item.id = p_root_id;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT instance.order_id INTO v_source_order\n    FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n    JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id\n    WHERE component.id = p_root_id;\n  END IF;\n  IF v_source_order IS DISTINCT FROM p_order_id THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_LINEAGE_INVALID: Physical source belongs to another sale.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_source_kind = 'replacement_item' THEN\n    SELECT item.operation_id INTO v_operation_id\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n    JOIN public.sales_replacement_events event ON event.id = item.replacement_event_id\n    WHERE item.id = p_source_id AND event.issuance_status = 'issued'\n      AND event.issuance_coordinator_version = 403;\n    IF v_operation_id IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_LINEAGE_INVALID: Replacement leaf lacks operational issuance evidence.';\n    END IF;\n    PERFORM public.phase43_assert_operational_replacement_evidence_internal(v_operation_id, true);\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase43_canonicalize_replacement_request_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_items jsonb, p_reason text, p_notes text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_items JSONB;\n  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_reason), '');\n  v_notes TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_notes), '');\nBEGIN\n  IF p_order_id IS NULL OR v_reason IS NULL\n    OR JSONB_TYPEOF(p_items) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'\n    OR JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(p_items) = 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_INVALID: Order, reason and non-empty items are required.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_items) item\n    WHERE JSONB_TYPEOF(item) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n      OR item->>'sourceKind' NOT IN ('base_order_item', 'parcel_component', 'replacement_item')\n      OR COALESCE(item->>'sourceId', '') !~\n        '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'\n      OR COALESCE(item->>'quantity', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'\n      OR (item - ARRAY['sourceKind', 'sourceId', 'quantity']) <> '{}'::JSONB\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_ITEM_INVALID: Each item requires one supported immutable source and positive quantity.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'source_kind', item->>'sourceKind',\n    'source_id', LOWER(item->>'sourceId'),\n    'quantity', (item->>'quantity')::INTEGER\n  ) ORDER BY item->>'sourceKind', LOWER(item->>'sourceId'))\n  INTO v_items\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_items) item;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_items) item\n    GROUP BY item->>'source_kind', item->>'source_id'\n    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_SOURCE_DUPLICATE: Replacement source identities must be unique.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN JSONB_STRIP_NULLS(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'order_id', LOWER(p_order_id::TEXT),\n    'items', v_items,\n    'reason', v_reason,\n    'notes', v_notes,\n    'operational_coordinator_version', 403\n  ));\nEND;\n$function$\n",
