        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase43_canonicalize_return_physical_sources_internal(p_sources jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_source JSONB;\n  v_result JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_root_kind TEXT;\n  v_source_kind TEXT;\n  v_root_id UUID;\n  v_source_id UUID;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_sellable INTEGER;\n  v_supplier_defect INTEGER;\n  v_customer_damage INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_sources IS NULL OR JSONB_TYPEOF(p_sources) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'\n    OR JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(p_sources) > 200\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_PHYSICAL_SOURCES_INVALID: Physical lineage allocations must be an array.';\n  END IF;\n  FOR v_source IN SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_sources)\n    ORDER BY value->>'root_source_kind', value->>'root_source_id',\n      value->>'source_kind', value->>'source_id'\n  LOOP\n    IF JSONB_TYPEOF(v_source) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n      OR v_source - ARRAY[\n        'root_source_kind', 'root_source_id', 'source_kind', 'source_id',\n        'product_id', 'quantity', 'sellable_restock_quantity',\n        'defect_non_sellable_quantity', 'customer_damage_quantity'\n      ]::TEXT[] <> '{}'::JSONB\n      OR COALESCE(v_source->>'quantity', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'\n      OR COALESCE(v_source->>'sellable_restock_quantity', '') !~ '^[0-9]+$'\n      OR COALESCE(v_source->>'defect_non_sellable_quantity', '') !~ '^[0-9]+$'\n      OR COALESCE(v_source->>'customer_damage_quantity', '') !~ '^[0-9]+$'\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_PHYSICAL_SOURCE_INVALID: Physical lineage allocation shape is invalid.';\n    END IF;\n    v_root_kind := LOWER(v_source->>'root_source_kind');\n    v_source_kind := LOWER(v_source->>'source_kind');\n    IF v_root_kind NOT IN ('base_order_item', 'parcel_component')\n      OR v_source_kind NOT IN ('base_order_item', 'parcel_component', 'replacement_item')\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_PHYSICAL_SOURCE_INVALID: Physical source kinds are invalid.';\n    END IF;\n    v_root_id := public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(v_source->>'root_source_id', 'root_source_id');\n    v_source_id := public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(v_source->>'source_id', 'source_id');\n    v_product_id := public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(v_source->>'product_id', (v_source->>'defect_non_sellable_quantity')::INTEGER;\n    v_customer_damage := (v_source->>'customer_damage_quantity')::INTEGER;\n    IF v_sellable + v_supplier_defect + v_customer_damage\n      IS DISTINCT FROM v_quantity\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_PHYSICAL_SOURCE_INVALID: Every physical leaf unit requires exactly one inspection bucket.';\n    END IF;\n    v_result := v_result || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'root_source_kind', v_root_kind, 'root_source_id', LOWER(v_root_id::TEXT),\n      'source_kind', v_source_kind, 'source_id', LOWER(v_source_id::TEXT),\n      'product_id', LOWER(v_product_id::TEXT), 'quantity', v_quantity,\n      'sellable_restock_quantity', v_sellable,\n      'defect_non_sellable_quantity', v_supplier_defect,\n      'customer_damage_quantity', v_customer_damage\n    ));\n  END LOOP;\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_result) source\n    GROUP BY source->>'source_kind', source->>'source_id'\n    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_PHYSICAL_SOURCE_DUPLICATE: A physical lineage leaf may appear only once.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase43_current_physical_representatives_internal(p_root_kind text, p_root_id uuid, p_product_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  WITH root_capacity AS (\n    SELECT CASE\n      WHEN p_root_kind = 'base_order_item' THEN (\n        SELECT item.quantity FROM public.order_items item\n        WHERE item.id = p_root_id AND item.product_id = p_product_id\n      )\n      WHEN p_root_kind = 'parcel_component' THEN (\n        SELECT component.base_quantity FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n        WHERE component.id = p_root_id AND component.product_id = p_product_id\n      )\n    END::INTEGER quantity\n  ), original AS (\n    SELECT p_root_kind source_kind, p_root_id source_id, p_product_id product_id,\n      GREATEST(root.quantity - COALESCE((\n        SELECT SUM(consumption.consumed_quantity)::INTEGER\n        FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n        WHERE consumption.source_kind = p_root_kind\n          AND consumption.source_id = p_root_id\n          AND consumption.consumption_state = 'settled'\n      ), 0), 0)::INTEGER remaining_quantity,\n      NULL::UUID parent_replacement_item_id\n    FROM root_capacity root WHERE root.quantity IS NOT NULL\n  ), replacements AS (\n    SELECT 'replacement_item'::TEXT source_kind, item.id source_id,\n      item.product_id,\n      GREATEST(item.quantity - COALESCE((\n        SELECT SUM(consumption.consumed_quantity)::INTEGER\n        FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n        WHERE consumption.source_kind = 'replacement_item'\n          AND consumption.source_id = item.id\n          AND consumption.consumption_state = 'settled'\n      ), 0), 0)::INTEGER remaining_quantity,\n      item.parent_replacement_item_id\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n    JOIN public.sales_replacement_events event ON event.id = item.replacement_event_id\n    JOIN public.phase43_replacement_settlement_evidence evidence\n      ON evidence.operation_id = item.operation_id\n      AND evidence.replacement_event_id = event.id\n    WHERE item.product_id = p_product_id\n      AND CASE WHEN p_root_kind = 'base_order_item'\n        THEN item.root_parcel_component_id IS NULL\n          AND item.root_order_item_id = p_root_id\n        ELSE item.root_parcel_component_id = p_root_id END\n      AND event.root_order_id = (\n        SELECT CASE WHEN p_root_kind = 'base_order_item'\n          THEN (SELECT order_id FROM public.order_items WHERE id = p_root_id)\n          ELSE (SELECT instance.order_id\n            FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n            JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance\n              ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id\n            WHERE component.id = p_root_id) END\n      )\n      AND event.replacement_status = 'settled'\n      AND event.issuance_status = 'issued'\n      AND event.issuance_coordinator_version = 403\n  ), representatives AS (\n    SELECT * FROM original UNION ALL SELECT * FROM replacements\n  )\n  SELECT COALESCE(JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'sourceKind', source_kind, 'sourceId', source_id,\n    'productId', product_id, 'remainingQuantity', remaining_quantity,\n    'parentReplacementItemId', parent_replacement_item_id\n  ) ORDER BY source_kind, source_id) FILTER (WHERE remaining_quantity > 0), '[]'::JSONB)\n  FROM representatives;\n$function$\n",

'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_id UUID;\n  v_sources JSONB;\n  v_source JSONB;\n  v_total INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.consumption_kind <> 'return'\n    OR pg_trigger_depth() > 1\n  THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT event.order_id, operation.request_identity_snapshot->'physical_sources'\n  INTO v_order_id, v_sources\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  JOIN public.sales_return_events event ON event.operation_id = operation.id\n  WHERE operation.id = NEW.operation_id;\n  IF v_sources IS NULL OR JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(v_sources) = 0 THEN\n    IF EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n      JOIN public.sales_replacement_events event ON event.id = item.replacement_event_id\n      CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n        'replacement_item', item.id, item.product_id\n      ) root\n      WHERE root.root_kind = NEW.source_kind AND root.root_id = NEW.source_id\n        AND root.product_id = NEW.product_id AND event.issuance_status = 'issued'\n    ) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_PHYSICAL_LINEAGE_REQUIRED: Return must identify every current physical representative.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM((source->>'quantity')::INTEGER), 0)::INTEGER INTO v_total\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_sources) source\n  WHERE source->>'root_source_kind' = NEW.source_kind\n    AND (source->>'root_source_id')::UUID = NEW.source_id\n    AND (source->>'product_id')::UUID = NEW.product_id;\n  IF v_total = 0 THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  IF v_total IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.consumed_quantity THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_LINEAGE_QUANTITY_INVALID: Physical lineage does not cover the exact Return consumption.';\n  END IF;\n  FOR v_source IN SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_sources)\n    WHERE value->>'root_source_kind' = NEW.source_kind\n      AND (value->>'root_source_id')::UUID = NEW.source_id\n      AND (value->>'product_id')::UUID = NEW.product_id\n    ORDER BY value->>'source_kind', value->>'source_id'\n  LOOP\n    PERFORM public.phase43_assert_return_physical_source_internal(\n      v_order_id, NEW.source_kind, NEW.source_id,\n      v_source->>'source_kind', (v_source->>'source_id')::UUID, NEW.product_id\n    );\n    INSERT INTO public.sales_aftercare_consumptions(\n      operation_id, return_item_id, source_kind, source_id, product_id,\n      consumed_quantity, consumption_kind\n    ) VALUES (\n      NEW.operation_id, NEW.return_item_id, v_source->>'source_kind',\n      (v_source->>'source_id')::UUID, NEW.product_id,\n      (v_source->>'quantity')::INTEGER, 'return'\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n  RETURN NULL;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase43_return_inventory_sources_internal(p_operation_id uuid, p_sources jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_request JSONB;\n  v_order_id UUID;\n  v_root JSONB;\n  v_leaf JSONB;\n  v_result JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_mapped INTEGER;\n  v_unit_cost NUMERIC(24, 6);\n  v_leaf_quantity INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT operation.request_identity_snapshot, event.order_id\n  INTO v_request, v_order_id\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  JOIN public.sales_return_events event ON event.operation_id = operation.id\n  WHERE operation.id = p_operation_id;\n  IF v_request->'physical_sources' IS NULL THEN RETURN p_sources; END IF;\n  FOR v_root IN SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_sources)\n  LOOP\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM((leaf->>'sellable_restock_quantity')::INTEGER), 0)::INTEGER\n    INTO v_mapped FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_request->'physical_sources') leaf\n    WHERE leaf->>'root_source_kind' = v_root->>'source_kind'\n      AND leaf->>'root_source_id' = v_root->>'source_id';\n    IF v_mapped > (v_root->>'quantity')::INTEGER THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_RESTOCK_LINEAGE_INCOMPLETE: Sellable leaf allocation exceeds accepted Return evidence.';\n    END IF;\n    FOR v_leaf IN SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_request->'physical_sources')\n      WHERE value->>'root_source_kind' = v_root->>'source_kind'\n        AND value->>'root_source_id' = v_root->>'source_id'\n        AND (value->>'sellable_restock_quantity')::INTEGER > 0\n      ORDER BY value->>'source_kind', value->>'source_id'\n    LOOP\n      PERFORM public.phase43_assert_return_physical_source_internal(\n        v_order_id, v_root->>'source_kind', (v_root->>'source_id')::UUID,\n        v_leaf->>'source_kind', (v_leaf->>'source_id')::UUID,\n        (v_leaf->>'product_id')::UUID\n      );\n      v_leaf_quantity := (v_leaf->>'sellable_restock_quantity')::INTEGER;\n      IF v_leaf->>'source_kind' = 'replacement_item' THEN\n        SELECT item.replacement_unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact\n        INTO v_unit_cost FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n        WHERE item.id = (v_leaf->>'source_id')::UUID;\n      ELSE\n        v_unit_cost := (v_root->>'historical_value_exact')::NUMERIC\n          / (v_root->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n      END IF;\n      v_result := v_result || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n        'source_kind', v_leaf->>'source_kind',\n        'source_id', v_leaf->>'source_id',\n        'return_item_id', v_root->>'return_item_id',\n        'product_id', v_leaf->>'product_id', 'quantity', v_leaf_quantity,\n        'historical_value_exact', ROUND(v_unit_cost * v_leaf_quantity, 6)\n      ));\n    END LOOP;\n  END LOOP;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(p_source_kind text, p_source_id uuid, p_product_id uuid)\n RETURNS TABLE(root_kind text, root_id uuid, product_id uuid)\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF p_source_kind IN ('base_order_item', 'parcel_component') THEN\n    root_kind := p_source_kind;\n    root_id := p_source_id;\n    product_id := p_product_id;\n    RETURN NEXT;\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n  IF p_source_kind = 'replacement_item' THEN\n    RETURN QUERY\n    SELECT CASE WHEN replacement.root_parcel_component_id IS NULL\n        THEN 'base_order_item' ELSE 'parcel_component' END,\n      COALESCE(replacement.root_parcel_component_id,\n        replacement.root_order_item_id),\n      replacement.product_id\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_items replacement\n    JOIN public.sales_replacement_events event\n      ON event.id = replacement.replacement_event_id\n    WHERE replacement.id = p_source_id\n      AND replacement.product_id = p_product_id\n      AND event.replacement_status = 'settled';\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation public.business_operations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_expected_type TEXT;\nBEGIN\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_effective_standalone_unit_price_internal(p_product_id uuid, p_channel text, p_customer_phone text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_promotion_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_price_frozen_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_price BIGINT;\n  v_effective_at TIMESTAMPTZ := COALESCE(p_price_frozen_at, statement_timestamp());\n  v_code TEXT := UPPER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_promotion_code), ''));\n  v_phone TEXT := CASE\n    WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(p_customer_phone), '') IS NULL THEN NULL\n    ELSE public.normalize_customer_phone(p_customer_phone)\n  END;\n  v_promotion public.promotion_codes%ROWTYPE;\n  v_discount BIGINT := 0;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_channel NOT IN ('admin_pos', 'customer_v2') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_STANDALONE_PRICE_CONTEXT_INVALID: Unsupported commercial channel.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT product.sale_price_in_minor_units\n  INTO v_price\n  FROM public.products product\n  WHERE product.id = p_product_id\n    AND product.is_active\n    AND NOT product.is_flavor_master\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR COALESCE(v_price, 0) <= 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_STANDALONE_PRICE_UNPROVEN: The authoritative standalone Base Unit price cannot be proven.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- POS V2 has no standalone promotion-code contract.  Its existing total\n  -- discount must never be reinterpreted as a unit promotion.\n  IF p_channel = 'admin_pos' OR v_code IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN v_price;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT promotion.*\n  INTO v_promotion\n  FROM public.promotion_codes promotion\n  WHERE promotion.code = v_code\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  -- A pinned order promotion affects the standalone snapshot only when that\n  -- exact one-unit hypothetical sale is itself eligible.  Ineligibility means\n  -- the normal server price is the correct result, not a fallback guess.\n  IF NOT FOUND\n    OR NOT v_promotion.is_active\n    OR (v_promotion.starts_at IS NOT NULL AND v_effective_at < v_promotion.starts_at)\n    OR (v_promotion.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND v_effective_at >= v_promotion.expires_at)\n    OR v_price < v_promotion.minimum_subtotal_in_minor_units\n    OR (v_promotion.maximum_redemptions_per_phone IS NOT NULL AND v_phone IS NULL)\n  THEN\n    RETURN v_price;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_promotion.maximum_total_redemptions IS NOT NULL AND (\n    SELECT COUNT(*)\n    FROM public.promotion_redemptions redemption\n    WHERE redemption.promotion_code_id = v_promotion.id\n  ) >= v_promotion.maximum_total_redemptions THEN\n    RETURN v_price;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_promotion.maximum_redemptions_per_phone IS NOT NULL AND (\n    SELECT COUNT(*)\n    FROM public.promotion_redemptions redemption\n    WHERE redemption.promotion_code_id = v_promotion.id\n      AND redemption.customer_phone = v_phone\n  ) >= v_promotion.maximum_redemptions_per_phone THEN\n    RETURN v_price;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_promotion.discount_type = 'fixed' THEN\n    v_discount := LEAST(v_promotion.discount_value, v_price);\n  ELSIF v_promotion.discount_type = 'percentage' THEN\n    v_discount := FLOOR(v_price::NUMERIC * v_promotion.discount_value / 10000)::BIGINT;\n    IF v_promotion.maximum_discount_in_minor_units IS NOT NULL THEN\n      v_discount := LEAST(v_discount, v_promotion.maximum_discount_in_minor_units);\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_STANDALONE_PRICE_UNPROVEN: Promotion pricing contract is unsupported.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN v_price - LEAST(GREATEST(v_discount, 0), v_price);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_guard_aftercare_operation_order_gate()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.operation_type NOT IN ('phase4_return_v1', 'phase4_replacement_v1') THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- This is the single earliest Phase-4 write boundary. Invalid operations are\n  -- rejected with zero writes; valid operations acquire their root Order gate\n  -- before the INSERT can take FK locks or persist evidence.\n  IF COALESCE(NEW.request_fingerprint, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n    OR NEW.request_identity_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n    OR NEW.request_identity_snapshot IS NULL\n    OR JSONB_TYPEOF(NEW.request_identity_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n    OR COALESCE(LOWER(NEW.request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id'), '') !~\n      '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'\n    OR NEW.completed_at IS NULL\n    OR NEW.actor_scope_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'erp_user'\n    OR COALESCE(NEW.actor_scope_hash, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n    OR NEW.initiated_by IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_INSERT_SHAPE_INVALID: Phase-4 operation identity and structural result evidence must be complete.';\n  END IF;\n\n  NEW.idempotency_key := public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(\n    NEW.idempotency_key\n  );\n\n  PERFORM public.phase4_assert_success_result_internal(\n    NEW.id, NEW.operation_type, NEW.result_snapshot, NULL\n  );\n\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_order_gate_internal(\n    NEW.operation_type, NEW.request_identity_snapshot, NULL\n  );\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_guard_customer_payment_reversal_dependency()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.is_reversed AND NOT OLD.is_reversed AND OLD.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase4_assert_no_settled_aftercare_for_order_internal(OLD.order_id);\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_guard_order_reversal_dependency()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.status = 'cancelled' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled' THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase4_assert_no_settled_aftercare_for_order_internal(OLD.id);\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_guard_replacement_event_insert_state()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_operation_order_internal(\n    NEW.operation_id, NEW.root_order_id\n  );\n  PERFORM public.phase4_assert_aftercare_operation_binding_internal(\n    NEW.operation_id, 'replacement', NEW.id, NEW.contract_version\n  );\n  IF NEW.replacement_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'draft'\n    OR NEW.settled_at IS NOT NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_REPLACEMENT_INITIAL_STATE_INVALID: Replacement evidence must begin as an unsettled draft.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_guard_return_event_insert_state()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  -- Historical/non-versioned Returns keep their pre-Phase-4 contract. Only a\n  -- versioned Return participates in the new root-Order serialization gate.\n  IF NEW.contract_version IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_operation_order_internal(\n      NEW.operation_id, NEW.order_id\n    );\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM public.phase4_assert_aftercare_operation_binding_internal(\n    NEW.operation_id, 'return', NEW.id, NEW.contract_version\n  );\n  IF NEW.contract_version IS NOT NULL\n    AND (NEW.settlement_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'draft'\n      OR NEW.settled_at IS NOT NULL)\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_INITIAL_STATE_INVALID: Versioned Return evidence must begin as an unsettled draft.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_lock_aftercare_operation_order_internal(p_operation_id uuid, p_expected_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation_type TEXT;\n  v_request_identity_snapshot JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT operation.operation_type, operation.request_identity_snapshot\n  INTO v_operation_type, v_request_identity_snapshot\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = p_operation_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_NOT_FOUND: Business operation does not exist.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN public.phase4_lock_aftercare_order_gate_internal(\n    v_operation_type, v_request_identity_snapshot, p_expected_order_id\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_lock_aftercare_order_gate_internal(p_operation_type text, p_request_identity_snapshot jsonb, p_expected_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_text TEXT;\n  v_order_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_operation_type NOT IN ('phase4_return_v1', 'phase4_replacement_v1')\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_ORDER_IDENTITY_INVALID: Unsupported Phase-4 operation type.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_request_identity_snapshot IS NULL\n    OR JSONB_TYPEOF(p_request_identity_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_ORDER_IDENTITY_INVALID: Immutable request evidence must contain one root Order.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_order_text := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(\n    p_request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id'\n  ), ''));\n  IF v_order_text IS NULL OR v_order_text !~\n    '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_ORDER_IDENTITY_INVALID: Immutable request evidence has an invalid root Order.';\n  END IF;\n  v_order_id := v_order_text::UUID;\n\n  IF p_expected_order_id IS NOT NULL\n    AND v_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_order_id\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_ORDER_IDENTITY_INVALID: Immutable request evidence does not match the aftercare root Order.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'phase4-order|' || v_order_id::TEXT, 0\n  ));\n  RETURN v_order_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "identity": "phase4_lock_aftercare_parent_order_internal(p_parent_kind text, p_parent_id uuid, p_expected_operation_id uuid, p_expected_order_id uuid)",
        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_lock_aftercare_parent_order_internal(p_parent_kind text, p_parent_id uuid, p_expected_operation_id uuid, p_expected_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation_id UUID;\n  v_order_id UUID;\n  v_contract_version SMALLINT;\n  v_operation_type TEXT;\n  v_request_identity_snapshot JSONB;\n  v_fresh_operation_id UUID;\n  v_fresh_order_id UUID;\n  v_fresh_contract_version SMALLINT;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_parent_id IS NULL OR p_parent_kind NOT IN (\n    'return_event', 'return_item',\n    'replacement_event', 'replacement_item'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_IDENTITY_INVALID: Aftercare parent identity is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Discovery is deliberately non-locking.  No FK/header/child row lock may\n  -- precede the canonical root advisory gate.\n  IF p_parent_kind = 'return_event' THEN\n    SELECT event.operation_id, event.order_id, event.contract_version\n    INTO v_operation_id, v_order_id, v_contract_version\n    FROM public.sales_return_events event\n    WHERE event.id = p_parent_id;\n  ELSIF p_parent_kind = 'return_item' THEN\n    SELECT item.operation_id, item.order_id, event.contract_version\n    INTO v_operation_id, v_order_id, v_contract_version\n    FROM public.sales_return_items item\n    JOIN public.sales_return_events event\n      ON event.id = item.sales_return_event_id\n    WHERE item.id = p_parent_id;\n  ELSIF p_parent_kind = 'replacement_event' THEN\n    SELECT event.operation_id, event.root_order_id, event.contract_version\n    INTO v_operation_id, v_order_id, v_contract_version\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_events event\n    WHERE event.id = p_parent_id;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT item.operation_id, event.root_order_id, event.contract_version\n    INTO v_operation_id, v_order_id, v_contract_version\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n    JOIN public.sales_replacement_events event\n      ON event.id = item.replacement_event_id\n    WHERE item.id = p_parent_id;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_operation_id IS NULL OR v_order_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_NOT_FOUND: Aftercare parent does not exist.';\n  END IF;\n  IF (p_expected_operation_id IS NOT NULL\n      AND v_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_operation_id)\n    OR (p_expected_order_id IS NOT NULL\n      AND v_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_order_id)\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_IDENTITY_INVALID: Aftercare parent does not match the submitted operation or Order.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT operation.operation_type, operation.request_identity_snapshot\n  INTO v_operation_type, v_request_identity_snapshot\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = v_operation_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_NOT_FOUND: Business operation does not exist.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Historical Return rows keep the pre-Phase-4 contract.  A Phase-4\n  -- operation may never masquerade as one by omitting the parent version.\n  IF v_contract_version IS NULL\n    AND p_parent_kind IN ('return_event', 'return_item')\n    AND v_operation_type NOT IN ('phase4_return_v1', 'phase4_replacement_v1')\n  THEN\n    RETURN v_order_id;\n  END IF;\n  IF v_contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_CONTRACT_INVALID: Versioned aftercare evidence requires contract version 401.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_order_gate_internal(\n    v_operation_type, v_request_identity_snapshot, v_order_id\n  );\n\n  -- Fresh lock/revalidation after the gate.  Operation always precedes its\n  -- header, and an item parent is locked only after its header.\n  SELECT operation.operation_type, operation.request_identity_snapshot\n  INTO v_operation_type, v_request_identity_snapshot\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = v_operation_id\n  FOR SHARE;\n  IF NOT FOUND\n    OR v_operation_type NOT IN ('phase4_return_v1', 'phase4_replacement_v1')\n    OR LOWER(v_request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id')\n      IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(v_order_id::TEXT)\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_REVALIDATION_FAILED: Operation root identity changed during evidence creation.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_parent_kind IN ('return_event', 'return_item') THEN\n    SELECT event.operation_id, event.order_id, event.contract_version\n    INTO v_fresh_operation_id, v_fresh_order_id, v_fresh_contract_version\n    FROM public.sales_return_events event\n    WHERE event.id = CASE p_parent_kind\n      WHEN 'return_event' THEN p_parent_id\n      ELSE (SELECT item.sales_return_event_id\n        FROM public.sales_return_items item WHERE item.id = p_parent_id)\n    END\n    FOR SHARE;\n    IF p_parent_kind = 'return_item' THEN\n      PERFORM 1 FROM public.sales_return_items item\n      WHERE item.id = p_parent_id FOR SHARE;\n      IF NOT FOUND THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_NOT_FOUND: Return Item parent does not exist.';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n    IF v_operation_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase4_return_v1' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_CONTRACT_INVALID: Return evidence requires a Return operation.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT event.operation_id, event.root_order_id, event.contract_version\n    INTO v_fresh_operation_id, v_fresh_order_id, v_fresh_contract_version\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_events event\n    WHERE event.id = CASE p_parent_kind\n      WHEN 'replacement_event' THEN p_parent_id\n      ELSE (SELECT item.replacement_event_id\n        FROM public.sales_replacement_items item WHERE item.id = p_parent_id)\n    END\n    FOR SHARE;\n    IF p_parent_kind = 'replacement_item' THEN\n      PERFORM 1 FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n      WHERE item.id = p_parent_id FOR SHARE;\n      IF NOT FOUND THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_NOT_FOUND: Replacement Item parent does not exist.';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n    IF v_operation_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase4_replacement_v1' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_CONTRACT_INVALID: Replacement evidence requires a Replacement operation.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_fresh_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_operation_id\n    OR v_fresh_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order_id\n    OR v_fresh_contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_REVALIDATION_FAILED: Parent identity changed; retry safely.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_order_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_lock_customer_order_context_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_require_open_shift boolean, p_lock_inventory boolean)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_branch_id UUID;\n  v_shift_id UUID;\n  v_locked_branch_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(\n    hashtextextended('phase4-order|' || p_order_id::TEXT, 0)\n  );\n\n  SELECT customer_order.branch_id INTO v_branch_id\n  FROM public.orders customer_order WHERE customer_order.id = p_order_id;\n  IF v_branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_ORDER_CONTEXT_INVALID: Order or branch is unavailable.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT shift.id INTO v_shift_id\n  FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n  WHERE shift.branch_id = v_branch_id AND shift.status = 'open'\n  ORDER BY shift.id LIMIT 1;\n\n  IF v_shift_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n    WHERE shift.id = v_shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n  ELSIF p_require_open_shift THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPEN_SHIFT_REQUIRED: An open Shift is required.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT customer_order.branch_id INTO v_locked_branch_id\n  FROM public.orders customer_order\n  WHERE customer_order.id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF v_locked_branch_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_branch_id\n    OR (v_shift_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n      WHERE shift.id = v_shift_id\n        AND shift.branch_id = v_locked_branch_id\n        AND shift.status = 'open'\n    ))\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_LOCK_PLAN_CHANGED_RETRY: Customer Order lock plan changed.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_lock_inventory THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase4_lock_order_inventory_internal(p_order_id);\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM set_config(\n    'nawasrah.phase4_prelocked_shift_id', COALESCE(v_shift_id::TEXT, ''), true\n  );\n  RETURN v_shift_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_lock_full_shift_context_internal(p_shift_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_plan JSONB;\n  v_fresh JSONB;\n  v_ids UUID[];\n  v_shift_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_plan := public.phase4_full_shift_context_snapshot_internal(p_shift_id);\n\n  FOR v_shift_id IN\n    SELECT value::UUID\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'shift_ids')\n    ORDER BY value::UUID\n  LOOP\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n      'cash-shift-full-reversal:' || v_shift_id::TEXT, 0\n    ));\n  END LOOP;\n  v_fresh := public.phase4_full_shift_context_snapshot_internal(p_shift_id);\n  IF v_fresh IS DISTINCT FROM v_plan THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_LOCK_PLAN_CHANGED_RETRY: Full Shift resource set changed before locking.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'shift_ids');\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n  WHERE shift.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY shift.id FOR UPDATE;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'order_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders customer_order\n    WHERE customer_order.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY customer_order.id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'product_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase3_lock_inventory_products_internal(v_ids);\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'supplier_receipt_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.supplier_receipts receipt\n    WHERE receipt.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY receipt.id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'purchase_receipt_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.purchase_receipts receipt\n    WHERE receipt.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY receipt.id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'purchase_order_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.purchase_orders purchase_order\n    WHERE purchase_order.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY purchase_order.id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'supplier_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers supplier\n    WHERE supplier.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY supplier.id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'customer_payment_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.customer_payments payment\n    WHERE payment.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY payment.id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'supplier_payment_ids');\n  IF 'PHASE4_IDEMPOTENCY_INPUT_INVALID: Invalid operation identity.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_key := public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(\n    p_idempotency_key\n  );\n\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'phase4-operation|' || v_type || '|' || v_actor_hash || '|' || v_key, 0\n  ));\n  SELECT * INTO v_operation\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.operation_type = v_type\n    AND operation.actor_scope_type = 'erp_user'\n    AND operation.actor_scope_hash = v_actor_hash\n    AND public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(\n      operation.idempotency_key\n    ) = v_key\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('decision', 'NEW');\n  END IF;\n  IF v_operation.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM v_fingerprint THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Operation identity is unavailable.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_operation.request_identity_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n    OR v_operation.request_identity_snapshot IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.result_snapshot IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.completed_at IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_IDENTITY_UNPROVEN: Stored operation identity is incomplete.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_type = 'phase4_return_v1' THEN\n    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER,\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event.settlement_status = 'settled'\n        AND event.settled_at IS NOT NULL\n        AND event.operation_id = v_operation.id;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_outcome_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1\n    OR v_settled_outcome_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_NOT_SETTLED: Stored operation is not a committed successful aftercare outcome.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase4_assert_aftercare_operation_binding_internal(\n    v_operation.id,\n    CASE v_type WHEN 'phase4_return_v1' THEN 'return' ELSE 'replacement' END,\n    v_outcome_id,\n    401::SMALLINT\n  );\n\n  IF v_type = 'phase4_return_v1' THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase42_assert_operational_return_evidence_internal(\n      v_operation.id, true\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'decision', 'REPLAY',\n    'operation_id',         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_validate_return_item_insert()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_contract_version SMALLINT;\n  v_status TEXT;\n  v_event_operation_id UUID;\n  v_event_order_id UUID;\n  v_original_entitlement BIGINT;\n  v_original_cogs BIGINT;\n  v_total_units INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_parent_order_internal(\n    'return_event', NEW.sales_return_event_id,\n    NEW.operation_id, NEW.order_id\n  );\n\n  SELECT event.contract_version, event.settlement_status,\n    event.operation_id, event.order_id\n  INTO v_contract_version, v_status, v_event_operation_id, v_event_order_id\n  FROM public.sales_return_events event\n  WHERE event.id = NEW.sales_return_event_id\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_EVENT_REQUIRED: Return Item must reference an existing Return event.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_contract_version IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  IF v_contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n    OR v_event_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.operation_id\n    OR v_event_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.order_id\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_ITEM_CHAIN_INVALID: Versioned Return Item must match its event operation and order.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_status NOT IN ('draft', 'inspected') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_EVIDENCE_CLOSED: Versioned Return evidence is closed.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- A versioned Return Item is immutable, so all settlement-relevant evidence\n  -- must be structurally complete at its first and only write.  Historical\n  -- Return Items retain their nullable pre-Phase-4 shape above.\n  IF NEW.accepted_base_quantity IS NULL\n    OR NEW.rejected_base_quantity IS NULL\n    OR NEW.original_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NULL\n    OR NEW.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units IS NULL\n    OR NEW.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units IS NULL\n    OR NEW.accepted_base_quantity < 0\n    OR NEW.rejected_base_quantity < 0\n    OR NEW.accepted_base_quantity + NEW.rejected_base_quantity <= 0\n    OR NEW.original_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units < 0\n    OR NEW.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units < 0\n    OR NEW.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units < 0\n    OR NEW.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n      > NEW.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_ITEM_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: Versioned Return Item evidence must be complete and internally valid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.return_scope = 'base_unit' THEN\n    PERFORM public.package_d_assert_carton_return_item_internal(to_jsonb(NEW));\n    IF NEW.accepted_base_quantity + NEW.rejected_base_quantity\n        IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.returned_quantity\n      OR (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi WHERE oi.id=NEW.order_item_id\n        AND oi.commercial_line_kind='legacy_single_sku_parcel') AND (\n          NEW.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units <> 0\n          OR NEW.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units <> 0))\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_BASE_RETURN_ITEM_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Base Unit Return evidence does not match its immutable quantity contract.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT instance.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n      instance.cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n      instance.units_per_parcel_snapshot\n    INTO v_original_entitlement, v_original_cogs, v_total_units\n    FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n    WHERE instance.id = NEW.parcel_instance_id\n      AND instance.order_item_id = NEW.order_item_id\n    FOR SHARE;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND\n      OR NEW.accepted_base_quantity + NEW.rejected_base_quantity\n        IS DISTINCT FROM v_total_units\n      OR NEW.original_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n        IS DISTINCT FROM v_original_cogs\n      OR NEW.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n        IS DISTINCT FROM LEAST(\n          v_original_entitlement,\n          NEW.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n        )\n      OR NEW.refund_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM\n        v_original_entitlement\n          - NEW.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARCEL_RETURN_ITEM_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Parcel Return evidence does not match its immutable sale snapshots.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase6_financial_facts_before208_internal(p_branch_id uuid, p_period_start timestamp with time zone, p_period_end timestamp with time zone, p_timezone text, p_verify_evidence boolean)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_facts JSONB;\n  v_damage JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_period_start IS NULL OR p_period_end IS NULL\n    OR p_period_end <= p_period_start OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p_timezone), '') IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Phase 6 financial facts period.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Fail closed on corrupt evidence for the rows this period reports.\n  IF p_verify_evidence THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase42_assert_operational_return_evidence_internal(e.operation_id, true)\n    FROM public.sales_return_events e\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = e.order_id\n    JOIN public.business_operations creation ON creation.id = o.operation_id\n    WHERE e.contract_version = 401 AND e.settlement_status = 'settled'\n      AND creation.operation_type IN ('phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1')\n      AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      AND e.settled_at >= p_period_start AND e.settled_at < p_period_end;\n\n    PERFORM public.phase43_assert_operational_replacement_evidence_internal(e.operation_id, true)\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_events e\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = e.root_order_id\n    WHERE e.issuance_status = 'issued'\n      AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      AND e.issued_at >= p_period_start AND e.issued_at < p_period_end;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_damage := public.inventory_damage_period_totals_internal(p_branch_id,p_period_start,p_period_end);\n  WITH first_completion AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT h.order_id, MIN(h.created_at) AS at\n    FROM public.order_status_history h\n    WHERE h.new_status = 'completed'\n    GROUP BY h.order_id\n  ), completion_ops AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT DISTINCT ON (b.result_snapshot->>'order_id')\n      b.result_snapshot->>'order_id' AS order_key,\n      b.result_snapshot, b.completed_at, b.request_identity_snapshot\n    FROM public.business_operations b\n    WHERE b.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_completion_v1'\n      AND b.result_snapshot->>'order_id' = b.request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id'\n    ORDER BY b.result_snapshot->>'order_id', b.completed_at, b.id\n  ), order_scope AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.branch_id, o.status, o.payment_method, o.delivery_fee_in_minor_units, o.total_in_minor_units, o.source, o.created_at, o.amount_paid_in_minor_units, o.operation_id, fc.at AS completion_at, creation.operation_type,\n      creation.result_snapshot AS creation_result, creation.completed_at AS creation_recorded_at,\n      completion.result_snapshot AS completion_result,\n      completion.completed_at AS completion_recorded_at,\n      completion.request_identity_snapshot AS completion_request\n    FROM public.orders o\n    JOIN first_completion fc ON fc.order_id = o.id\n    LEFT JOIN public.business_operations creation ON creation.id = o.operation_id\n    LEFT JOIN completion_ops completion ON completion.order_key = o.id::TEXT\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id\n  ), modern_returns AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT e.*\n    FROM public.sales_return_events e JOIN order_scope o ON o.id = e.order_id\n    WHERE e.contract_version = 401 AND e.settlement_status = 'settled'\n      AND o.operation_type IN ('phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1')\n  ), issued AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT e.*\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_events e JOIN order_scope o ON o.id = e.root_order_id\n    WHERE e.issuance_status = 'issued'\n  ), return_rows AS (\n    SELECT e.id, e.order_id, e.settled_at AS at,\n      e.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units AS debt,\n      e.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units AS refund, e.refund_method,\n      e.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units + e.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units AS entitlement,\n      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.historical_restock_value_in_minor_units_exact)\n        FROM public.phase42_return_inventory_effects f WHERE f.return_event_id = e.id), 0) AS recovery\n    FROM modern_returns e\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT e.id, e.order_id, e.created_at, 0, e.refund_amount_in_minor_units, e.refund_method,\n      e.refund_amount_in_minor_units,\n      CASE WHEN e.stock_disposition = 'restock' THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.cogs_in_minor_units)\n        FROM public.order_items i WHERE i.order_id = e.order_id), 0) ELSE 0 END\n    FROM public.sales_returns e JOIN order_scope o ON o.id = e.order_id\n    WHERE o.operation_type IS NULL OR o.operation_type NOT IN\n      ('phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1')\n  ), initial_collections AS (\n    SELECT o.id AS order_id,\n      CASE WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_pos_sale_v1' THEN o.creation_recorded_at\n        ELSE COALESCE(o.completion_recorded_at, o.completion_at) END AS at,\n      CASE WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_pos_sale_v1' THEN o.creation_result->>'paymentMethod'\n        WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1' THEN o.completion_request->>'payment_method'\n        WHEN o.payment_method = 'cash_on_delivery' THEN 'cash' ELSE o.payment_method END AS method,\n      CASE WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_pos_sale_v1' THEN (o.creation_result->>'amountPaidInMinorUnits')::BIGINT\n        WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1' THEN\n          CASE WHEN NULLIF(o.completion_result->>'customer_payment_number', '') IS NOT NULL THEN 0\n            ELSE (o.completion_result->>'amount_paid_in_minor_units')::BIGINT END\n        WHEN o.payment_method = 'debt' THEN 0 ELSE o.total_in_minor_units END AS amount\n    FROM order_scope o\n  ), money_events AS (\n    SELECT order_id, at, method, amount AS collection, 0::BIGINT AS reversal, 0::BIGINT AS refund\n    FROM initial_collections WHERE amount > 0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT p.order_id, p.created_at, p.payment_method, p.amount_in_minor_units, 0, 0\n    FROM public.customer_payments p JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = p.order_id\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT p.order_id, p.reversed_at, p.payment_method, 0, p.amount_in_minor_units, 0\n    FROM public.customer_payments p JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = p.order_id\n    WHERE p.is_reversed AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT r.order_id, r.created_at, m.method, 0, m.amount, 0\n    FROM public.pos_sale_reversals r JOIN order_scope o ON o.id = r.order_id\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES\n      ('cash', (r.actual_effect->>'cash_in_minor_units')::BIGINT),\n      ('cliq', (r.actual_effect->>'cliq_in_minor_units')::BIGINT)) m(method, amount)\n    WHERE m.amount > 0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT order_id, at, refund_method, 0, 0, refund FROM return_rows WHERE refund > 0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT NULL::UUID,c.created_at,c.payment_method,a.amount_in_minor_units,0,0\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c JOIN public.customer_collection_cheque_allocations a ON a.operation_id=c.id\n    JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims k ON k.id=a.claim_id JOIN public.deferred_cheques q ON q.id=k.cheque_id\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.branch_id,q.branch_id)=p_branch_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT NULL::UUID,c.reversed_at,c.payment_method,0,a.amount_in_minor_units,0\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c JOIN public.customer_collection_cheque_allocations a ON a.operation_id=c.id\n    JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims k ON k.id=a.claim_id JOIN public.deferred_cheques q ON q.id=k.cheque_id\n    WHERE c.is_reversed AND(p_branch_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.branch_id,q.branch_id)=p_branch_id)\n    UNION ALL\n    -- Opening allocation is not a customer_payment. The order allocation is\n    -- already counted above and must never be added from collection totals.\n    SELECT NULL::UUID,c.created_at,c.payment_method,a.amount_in_minor_units,0,0\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c\n    JOIN public.customer_collection_opening_allocations a ON a.operation_id=c.id\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.branch_id,public.go_live_main_branch_internal())=p_branch_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT NULL::UUID,c.reversed_at,c.payment_method,0,a.amount_in_minor_units,0\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c\n    JOIN public.customer_collection_opening_allocations a ON a.operation_id=c.id\n    WHERE c.is_reversed AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.branch_id,public.go_live_main_branch_internal())=p_branch_id)\n  ), coverage_by_order AS (\n    SELECT order_id, SUM(collection - reversal)::BIGINT AS coverage\n    FROM money_events GROUP BY order_id\n  ), debt_by_order AS (\n    SELECT order_id, SUM(debt)::BIGINT AS debt_reduction\n    FROM return_rows GROUP BY order_id\n  ), positions AS (\n    SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.status, o.total_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(c.coverage, 0)::BIGINT AS coverage,\n      COALESCE(d.debt_reduction, 0)::BIGINT AS debt_reduction,\n      GREATEST(o.total_in_minor_units - COALESCE(c.coverage, 0) - COALESCE(d.debt_reduction, 0), 0)::BIGINT AS due\n    FROM order_scope o\n    LEFT JOIN coverage_by_order c ON c.order_id = o.id\n    LEFT JOIN debt_by_order d ON d.order_id = o.id\n  ), period_sales AS (\n    SELECT * FROM order_scope WHERE status IN ('completed', 'returned')\n      AND completion_at >= p_period_start AND completion_at < p_period_end\n  ), sales_totals AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS gross,\n      COALESCE(SUM(delivery_fee_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS delivery,\n      COUNT(*) AS count FROM period_sales\n  ), period_returns AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(entitlement), 0)::BIGINT AS entitlement,\n      COALESCE(SUM(refund), 0)::BIGINT AS refund, COALESCE(SUM(debt), 0)::BIGINT AS debt,\n      ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(recovery), 0))::BIGINT AS recovery, COUNT(*) AS count\n    FROM return_rows WHERE at >= p_period_start AND at < p_period_end\n  ), costs AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.cogs_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS cogs\n    FROM public.order_items i JOIN period_sales o ON o.id = i.order_id\n  ), replacement_costs AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS cost\n    FROM issued e JOIN public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects f ON f.operation_id = e.operation_id\n    WHERE e.issued_at >= p_period_start AND e.issued_at < p_period_end\n  ), flows AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(collection - reversal) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cash'), 0)::BIGINT AS cash_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection - reversal) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cliq'), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection-reversal) FILTER(WHERE method='bank_transfer'),0)::BIGINT AS bank_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection-reversal) FILTER(WHERE method='cheque'),0)::BIGINT AS cheque_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection-reversal) FILTER(WHERE COALESCE(method,'') NOT IN ('cash','cliq','bank_transfer','cheque')),0)::BIGINT AS other_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection-reversal),0)::BIGINT AS total_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(refund) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cash'), 0)::BIGINT AS cash_refunded,\n      COALESCE(SUM(refund) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cliq'), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq_refunded\n    FROM money_events WHERE at >= p_period_start AND at < p_period_end\n  ), eligible AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.total_in_minor_units,\n      o.amount_paid_in_minor_units, o.operation_id\n    FROM public.orders o\n    WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')\n      AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL\n      AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      AND (COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos' OR o.payment_method = 'debt')\n  ), prior_debt AS MATERIALIZED (\n    -- Exact set-based form of121 phase42_order_financial_position_internal's\n    -- prior_debt source. Do not introduce a projection/cache or new authority.\n    SELECT e.order_id, SUM(e.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units)::BIGINT AS amount\n    FROM public.sales_return_events e JOIN eligible o ON o.id = e.order_id\n    WHERE e.settlement_status = 'settled' AND e.contract_version = 401\n      AND o.amount_paid_in_minor_units < o.total_in_minor_units\n    GROUP BY e.order_id\n  ), financial_positions AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT o.*, CASE\n      WHEN o.amount_paid_in_minor_units >= o.total_in_minor_units THEN 0::BIGINT\n      ELSE GREATEST(o.total_in_minor_units - o.amount_paid_in_minor_units\n        - COALESCE(d.amount, 0) - COALESCE((SELECT sum(r.debt_reduction) FROM sales_lite1.returns r WHERE r.order_id=o.id),0), 0)::BIGINT END AS outstanding\n    FROM eligible o LEFT JOIN prior_debt d ON d.order_id = o.id\n  ), canonical_order_due AS (\n    -- Same set-based canonical positions used by192 aging/CRM;see parity guard.\n    SELECT id, customer_id, outstanding AS due FROM financial_positions\n  ), opening_due AS (\n    -- Preserve164 main-branch attribution;do not clamp signed source values.\n    SELECT opening.customer_id, opening.outstanding AS due\n    FROM public.go_live_customer_opening_positions_internal(NULL) opening\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR p_branch_id = public.go_live_main_branch_internal()\n  ), balances AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(due), 0)::BIGINT AS due,\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE due > 0 AND is_order) AS orders,\n      COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE due > 0) AS customers\n    FROM (\n      SELECT true AS is_order, customer_id, due FROM canonical_order_due\n      UNION ALL\n      SELECT false, customer_id, due FROM opening_due\n      UNION ALL\n      SELECT false,c.customer_id,c.outstanding FROM public.cheque_customer_claim_positions_internal() c\n      JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims k ON k.id=c.id JOIN public.deferred_cheques q ON q.id=k.cheque_id\n      WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR q.branch_id=p_branch_id\n    ) receivables\n  ), cohort AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.coverage), 0)::BIGINT AS coverage,\n      COALESCE(SUM(p.due), 0)::BIGINT AS due\n    FROM positions p JOIN period_sales o ON o.id = p.id\n  ), expenses AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS amount,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'cash'), 0)::BIGINT AS cash,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'cliq'), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq,\n      COUNT(*) AS count\n    FROM public.operational_expenses\n    WHERE (p_branch_id IS NULL OR branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      AND NOT COALESCE(is_reversed, false)\n      AND created_at >= p_period_start AND created_at < p_period_end\n  ), daily_collections AS (\n END IF;\n ELSE\n  IF p_action='reverse' THEN\n   SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE id=(p_payload->>'eventId')::UUID;\n   SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases WHERE id=e.case_id;\n   SELECT * INTO STRICT f FROM public.supplier_replacement_inventory_effects WHERE event_id=e.id;\n   IF e.action='reverse' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE reverses_event_id=e.id) THEN blocked:='الحدث معكوس أو هو حدث عكس.';\n   ELSIF public.sr208_inventory_fingerprint_internal(c.product_id) IS DISTINCT FROM f.post_inventory_fingerprint THEN blocked:='تحرك المخزون أو الحجز أو التكلفة بعد الحدث.';\n   ELSIF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS(SELECT id,action FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE previous_event_id=e.id UNION ALL\n    SELECT n.id,n.action FROM public.supplier_replacement_events n JOIN descendants d ON n.previous_event_id=d.id)\n    SELECT 1 FROM descendants d WHERE d.action<>'reverse' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_events r WHERE r.reverses_event_id=d.id)) THEN blocked:='للحدث عمليات لاحقة؛ اعكسها أولاً.'; END IF;\n  ELSE\n   SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases WHERE id=(p_payload->>'caseId')::UUID;\n   IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'quantity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (p_payload->>'quantity')!~'^[1-9][0-9]*$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_QUANTITY_INVALID'; END IF;\n   qty:=(p_payload->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n   SELECT sum(held_delta) INTO held FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE case_id=c.id;\n   IF qty>held THEN blocked:='الكمية أكبر من المعلّق المتبقي.'; END IF;\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM public.sr208_assert_operation_internal(v.operation_id) FROM(SELECT DISTINCT operation_id FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE case_id=c.id) v;\n  result:=jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',208,'action',p_action,'eligible',blocked IS NULL,'blockedReason',blocked,'case',public.sr208_case_dto_internal(c.id,public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'])));\n END IF;\n RETURN result;\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.price225_assert_prices_internal(p_unit uuid, p_parcel_unit uuid, p_units integer, p_single bigint, p_parcel bigint, p_parcel_enabled boolean, p_parcel_only boolean)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n IF p_unit IS NULL OR p_parcel_unit IS NULL OR p_units IS NULL OR p_units<1\n OR p_parcel_enabled IS NULL OR p_parcel_only IS NULL THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRICES225_UNIT_REQUIRED: اختر الوحدة وعدد وحدات الطرد الصحيح.';\n END IF;\n IF p_single IS NULL OR p_parcel IS NULL OR p_single<=0 OR p_parcel<=0 THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRICES225_POSITIVE_PRICE_REQUIRED: يجب أن يكون السعر أكبر من صفر وبثلاث منازل.';\n END IF;\n IF p_units=1 THEN\n  IF p_single<>p_parcel OR p_parcel_only THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRICES225_SINGLE_PRICE_MISMATCH: البيع المفرد له سعر واحد ولا يُباع كطرد متعدد.';\n  END IF;\n ELSE\n  IF p_unit=p_parcel_unit THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRICES225_DISTINCT_PARCEL_UNIT_REQUIRED: اختر للطرد وحدة تختلف عن وحدة المحتوى.';\n  END IF;\n  -- A paused parcel preserves its recorded price. Only its reactivation is\n  -- admitted against the latest single price; no sale may bypass the pause.\n  IF p_parcel_enabled THEN\n   IF p_parcel=p_single THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRICES225_UNSAFE_PARCEL_PRICE: لا يمكن بيع عدة وحدات بسعر وحدة واحدة.';\n   END IF;\n   IF p_parcel::NUMERIC>p_units::NUMERIC*p_single::NUMERIC THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRICES225_PARCEL_PRICE_TOO_HIGH: سعر الطرد أعلى من مجموع الوحدات المفردة. عدّل سعر الطرد ثم أعد تفعيل بيعه.';\n   END IF;\n  END IF;\n END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.price225_create_loss_confirmation_internal(p_product uuid, p_single bigint, p_parcel bigint, p_units integer, p_parcel_only boolean, p_confirmation jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_expected JSONB;v_risks JSONB;\nBEGIN\n BEGIN\n  PERFORM public.price225_loss_confirmation_internal(p_product,p_single,p_parcel,p_units,true,p_parcel_only,NULL);\n EXCEPTION WHEN raise_exception THEN\n  IF SQLERRM NOT LIKE 'PRICES225_BELOW_WAC_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED:%' THEN RAISE;END IF;\n  GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_expected=PG_EXCEPTION_DETAIL;\n END;\n IF v_expected IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;\n SELECT jsonb_agg((r.value-'productId')||jsonb_build_object('productSku',p.sku) ORDER BY p.sku)\n INTO v_risks FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_expected->'risks') r(value)\n JOIN public.products p ON p.id=(r.value->>'productId')::UUID;\n v_expected:=(v_expected-'productId')||jsonb_build_object('contractVersion','on-prices225-create-confirmation-v1',\n  'productSku',(SELECT sku FROM public.products WHERE id=p_product),'risks',v_risks);\n IF p_confirmation IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE='PRICES225_BELOW_WAC_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: السعر أقل من التكلفة؛ راجع التحذير وأكّد قرار البيع بخسارة.',DETAIL=v_expected::TEXT;\n END IF;\n RETURN v_expected;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.price225_guard_new_parcel_internal()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_product UUID; v_root UUID;\nBEGIN\n IF sales_lite1.enabled() THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n IF NEW.commercial_line_kind IS NULL THEN\n  -- The legacy customer writer sets its package snapshot in a later UPDATE.\n  IF coalesce(NEW.units_per_sale_package,1)<=1 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n ELSIF NEW.commercial_line_kind NOT IN ('legacy_single_sku_parcel','configurable_parcel') THEN\n  RETURN NEW;\n END IF;\n IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND ROW(NEW.commercial_line_kind,NEW.product_id,NEW.family_product_id,NEW.units_per_sale_package)\n   IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.commercial_line_kind,OLD.product_id,OLD.family_product_id,OLD.units_per_sale_package) THEN\n  RETURN NEW;\n END IF;\n v_product:=coalesce(NEW.family_product_id,NEW.product_id);\n -- A product update locks this root before writing pricing state. Lock it\n -- even when the sidecar is absent, then read the state in a fresh statement.\n SELECT root.id INTO STRICT v_root\n FROM public.products item\n JOIN public.products root ON root.id=coalesce(item.flavor_master_product_id,item.id)\n WHERE item.id=v_product\n FOR SHARE OF root;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.product_sale_pricing_state225 WHERE product_id=v_root AND NOT parcel_enabled) THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRICES225_PARCEL_PAUSED: بيع الطرد متوقف مؤقتاً لهذا الصنف.';\n END IF;\n RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.price225_loss_confirmation_internal(p_product uuid, p_single bigint, p_parcel bigint, p_units integer, p_parcel_enabled boolean, p_parcel_only boolean, p_confirmation jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_risks JSONB;v_expected JSONB;\nBEGIN\n SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n  'productId',p.id,'name',p.name_ar,\n  'wacInMinorUnitsExact',coalesce(p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,p.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC)::TEXT,\n  'unitBelowCost',NOT p_parcel_only AND p_single::NUMERIC<coalesce(p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,p.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC),\n  'parcelBelowCost',p_parcel_enabled AND p_units>1 AND p_parcel::NUMERIC<p_units::NUMERIC*coalesce(p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,p.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC)\n ) ORDER BY p.id),'[]') INTO v_risks\n FROM public.products p\n WHERE (p.id=p_product AND NOT p.is_flavor_master OR p.flavor_master_product_id=p_product)\n AND ((NOT p_parcel_only AND p_single::NUMERIC<coalesce(p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,p.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC))\n   OR (p_parcel_enabled AND p_units>1 AND p_parcel::NUMERIC<p_units::NUMERIC*coalesce(p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,p.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC)));\n IF jsonb_array_length(v_risks)=0 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;\n v_expected:=jsonb_build_object('acknowledged',true,'unitPrice',p_single,'parcelPrice',p_parcel,\n  'unitsPerParcel',p_units,'parcelEnabled',p_parcel_enabled,'parcelOnly',p_parcel_only,'risks',v_risks);\n IF p_confirmation IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE='PRICES225_BELOW_WAC_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: السعر أقل من التكلفة؛ راجع القيم الحالية وأكّد البيع بخسارة.',\n   DETAIL=v_expected::TEXT;\n END IF;\n RETURN v_expected;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.product_edit_assert_version_internal(p_product_id uuid, p_expected_updated_at timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_current TIMESTAMPTZ;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_expected_updated_at IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRODUCT_EDIT_VERSION_REQUIRED: أعد فتح المنتج ثم احفظ التعديل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY[p_product_id]);\n\n  SELECT product.updated_at\n  INTO v_current\n  FROM public.products product\n  WHERE product.id = p_product_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المنتج المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_current IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_updated_at THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      MESSAGE = 'PRODUCT_EDIT_CONFLICT: عدّل مستخدم آخر هذا المنتج قبل قليل.',\n      DETAIL = public.product_edit_snapshot_internal(p_product_id)::TEXT,\n      HINT = 'اعرض القيم الحالية ثم أعد تطبيق تعديلاتك.';\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.product_edit_snapshot_internal(p_product_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n    'productId', product.id,\n    'parcelOnly', product.parcel_only,\n    'updatedAt', product.updated_at,\n    'nameAr', product.name_ar,\n    'sku', product.sku,\n    'barcode', product.barcode,\n    'description', product.description,\n    'categoryId', product.category_id,\n    'brandId', product.brand_id,\n    'unitName', base_unit.name_ar,\n    'purchasePackage', purchase_unit.name_ar,\n    'unitsPerPackage', product.units_per_purchase_unit,\n    'defaultPurchasePriceInMinorUnits', product.default_purchase_price_in_minor_units,\n    'salePackage', sale_unit.name_ar,\n    'unitsPerSalePackage', product.units_per_sale_unit,\n    'salePackagePriceInMinorUnits', product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n    'costPriceInMinorUnits', product.cost_price_in_minor_units,\n    'minStockLevel', product.min_stock_level,\n    'maxStockLevel', product.max_stock_level,\n    'isActive', product.is_active,\n    'flavorNameAr', product.flavor_name_ar,\n    'imageUrl', (\n      SELECT image.image_url\n      FROM public.product_images image\n      WHERE image.product_id = product.id AND image.is_primary = true\n      ORDER BY image.display_order, image.created_at\n      LIMIT 1\n    )\n  )\n  FROM public.products product\n  LEFT JOIN public.units base_unit ON base_unit.id = product.unit_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.units purchase_unit ON purchase_unit.id = product.purchase_unit_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.units sale_unit ON sale_unit.id = product.sale_unit_id\n  WHERE product.id = p_product_id;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.product_has_cost_history_internal(p_product_id uuid)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.products product\n    WHERE (product.id = p_product_id OR product.flavor_master_product_id = p_product_id)\n      AND (\n        product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact IS NOT NULL\n        OR EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_movements movement\n          WHERE movement.product_id = product.id\n        )\n      )\n  );\n$function$\n",
