        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.public_storefront_catalog_page225(p_limit integer DEFAULT 24, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_availability text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'recommended'::text, p_brand_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_sale_unit_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_product_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[])\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n IF sales_lite1.enabled() THEN\n  RETURN public.lite1_catalog_page2(p_limit,p_offset,p_category_id,p_search,p_availability,p_sort,p_brand_id,p_sale_unit_id,p_product_ids);\n END IF;\n RETURN (WITH stock_by_product AS (\n    SELECT\n      ib.product_id,\n      COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(ib.on_hand_quantity - ib.reserved_quantity, 0)), 0)::INTEGER\n        AS available_quantity\n    FROM public.inventory_balances ib\n    GROUP BY ib.product_id\n  ),\n  sales_by_product AS (\n    SELECT\n      oi.product_id,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(oi.sale_package_quantity, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS sold_packages\n    FROM public.order_items oi\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id\n    WHERE o.status = 'completed'\n      AND o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'\n    GROUP BY oi.product_id\n  ),\n  catalog_source AS (\n    SELECT\n      p.id,\n      p.sku,\n      p.barcode,\n      p.name_ar,\n      p.description,\n      p.category_id,\n      c.code AS category_code,\n      c.name_ar AS category_name_ar,\n      p.brand_id,\n      b.name_ar AS brand_name_ar,\n      p.unit_id,\n      base_unit.name_ar AS unit_name_ar,\n      p.sale_unit_id,\n      sale_unit.name_ar AS sale_unit_name_ar,\n      p.units_per_sale_unit,\n      p.parcel_only,\n      COALESCE(pricing.parcel_enabled,true) AS parcel_sale_enabled,\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      p.sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(stock.available_quantity, 0)::INTEGER AS available_quantity,\n      image.image_url,\n      p.created_at,\n      COALESCE(sales.sold_packages, 0)::BIGINT AS sold_packages_last_90_days,\n      p.flavor_master_product_id,\n      p.flavor_name_ar,\n      p.is_flavor_master,\n      p.flavor_sort_order,\n      COALESCE(p.flavor_master_product_id, p.id) AS family_id\n    FROM public.products p\n    JOIN public.categories c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.is_active = true\n    LEFT JOIN public.brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id\n    JOIN public.units base_unit ON base_unit.id = p.unit_id\n    JOIN public.units sale_unit ON sale_unit.id = p.sale_unit_id\n    LEFT JOIN stock_by_product stock ON stock.product_id = p.id\n    LEFT JOIN public.product_sale_pricing_state225 pricing ON pricing.product_id=coalesce(p.flavor_master_product_id,p.id)\n    LEFT JOIN sales_by_product sales ON sales.product_id = p.id\n    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n      SELECT pi.image_url\n      FROM public.product_images pi\n      WHERE pi.product_id = p.id\n      ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.display_order, pi.created_at\n      LIMIT 1\n    ) image ON true\n    WHERE p.is_active = true\n      AND sale_unit.code <> 'PCS'\n      AND p.units_per_sale_unit > 0\n      AND p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units > 0\n  ),\n  method_availability AS (\n    SELECT catalog_source.*,\n      NOT is_flavor_master AND NOT parcel_only AND sale_price_in_minor_units>0\n        AND available_quantity>0 AS single_available,\n      NOT is_flavor_master AND parcel_sale_enabled\n        AND available_quantity>=units_per_sale_unit AS parcel_available,\n      CASE WHEN parcel_sale_enabled THEN floor(available_quantity::numeric/units_per_sale_unit)\n        ELSE 0 END::integer AS sale_packages\n    FROM catalog_source\n  ),\n  family_summary AS (\n    SELECT\n      family_id,\n      MIN(category_id::TEXT)::UUID AS category_id,\n      MIN(category_code) AS category_code,\n      MIN(brand_id::TEXT)::UUID AS brand_id,\n      MIN(sale_unit_id::TEXT)::UUID AS sale_unit_id,\n      COALESCE(\n        MIN(name_ar) FILTER (WHERE flavor_master_product_id IS NULL),\n        MIN(name_ar)\n      ) AS family_name_ar,\n      MIN(default_sale_price_in_minor_units) AS sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(SUM(sale_packages) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_flavor_master),0)::integer AS available_sale_packages,\n      BOOL_OR(single_available OR parcel_available) AS is_available,\n      BOOL_OR((single_available OR parcel_available) AND sale_packages<=5) AS is_low_stock,\n      MAX(created_at) AS created_at,\n      COALESCE(SUM(sold_packages_last_90_days) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_flavor_master), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS sold_packages_last_90_days\n    FROM method_availability\n    GROUP BY family_id\n  ),\n  normalized_search AS (\n    SELECT LOWER(TRANSLATE(\n      REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), ''), ''), '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'),\n      'أإآى',\n      'اااي'\n    )) AS value\n  ),\n  matching_families AS (\n    SELECT fs.*\n    FROM family_summary fs\n    CROSS JOIN normalized_search normalized\n    WHERE (p_category_id IS NULL OR fs.category_id = p_category_id)\n      AND (p_brand_id IS NULL OR fs.brand_id = p_brand_id)\n      AND (p_sale_unit_id IS NULL OR fs.sale_unit_id = p_sale_unit_id)\n      AND (\n        p_product_ids IS NULL\n        OR fs.family_id = ANY (p_product_ids)\n        OR EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM catalog_source favorite_member\n          WHERE favorite_member.family_id = fs.family_id\n            AND favorite_member.id = ANY (p_product_ids)\n        )\n      )\n      AND (\n        p_availability NOT IN ('available', 'low_stock')\n        OR (p_availability = 'available' AND fs.is_available)\n        OR (p_availability = 'low_stock' AND fs.is_low_stock)\n      )\n      AND (p_sort <> 'offers' OR fs.category_code = 'CAT-OFFERS')\n      AND (p_sort <> 'low_stock' OR fs.is_low_stock)\n      AND (\n        normalized.value = ''\n        OR EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM catalog_source searched_member\n          WHERE searched_member.family_id = fs.family_id\n            AND (\n              LOWER(TRANSLATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(searched_member.name_ar, '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'), 'أإآى', 'اااي')) LIKE '%' || normalized.value || '%'\n              OR LOWER(TRANSLATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(searched_member.sku, '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'), 'أإآى', 'اااي')) LIKE '%' || normalized.value || '%'\n              OR LOWER(TRANSLATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(searched_member.barcode, ''), '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'), 'أإآى', 'اااي')) LIKE '%' || normalized.value || '%'\n              OR LOWER(TRANSLATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(searched_member.description, ''), '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'), 'أإآى', 'اااي')) LIKE '%' || normalized.value || '%'\n              OR LOWER(TRANSLATE(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(searched_member.brand_name_ar, ''), '[ً-ٰٟـ]', '', 'g'), 'أإآى', 'اااي')) LIKE '%' || normalized.value || '%'\n            )\n        )\n      )\n  ),\n  paged_families AS (\n    SELECT\n      mf.*,\n      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n        ORDER BY\n          mf.is_available DESC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'name_asc' THEN mf.family_name_ar END ASC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'price_asc' THEN mf.sale_price_in_minor_units END ASC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'price_desc' THEN mf.sale_price_in_minor_units END DESC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'stock_desc' THEN mf.available_sale_packages END DESC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'newest' THEN mf.created_at END DESC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'best_sellers' THEN mf.sold_packages_last_90_days END DESC,\n          CASE WHEN p_sort = 'low_stock' THEN mf.available_sale_packages END ASC,\n          mf.family_name_ar ASC,\n          mf.family_id ASC\n      ) AS page_order\n    FROM matching_families mf\n    ORDER BY\n      mf.is_available DESC,\n      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'name_asc' THEN mf.family_name_ar END ASC,\n      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'price_asc' THEN mf.sale_price_in_minor_units END ASC,\n      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'price_desc' THEN mf.sale_price_in_minor_units END DESC,\n      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'stock_desc' THEN mf.available_sale_packages END DESC,\n      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'newest' THEN mf.created_at END DESC,\n      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'best_sellers' THEN mf.sold_packages_last_90_days END DESC,\n      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'low_stock' THEN mf.available_sale_packages END ASC,\n      mf.family_name_ar ASC,\n      mf.family_id ASC\n    LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 24), 1), 48)\n    OFFSET GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, 0), 0)\n  ),\n  page_items AS (\n    SELECT\n      pf.page_order,\n      cs.*\n    FROM paged_families pf\n    JOIN method_availability cs ON cs.family_id = pf.family_id\n  ),\n  category_summary AS (\n    SELECT\n      c.id,\n      c.code,\n      c.name_ar,\n      c.image_url,\n      COUNT(fs.family_id)::INTEGER AS product_count,\n      COUNT(fs.family_id) FILTER (WHERE fs.is_available)::INTEGER AS available_product_count,\n      CASE c.code\n        WHEN 'CAT-BEV' THEN 10 WHEN 'CAT-WATER' THEN 20\n        WHEN 'CAT-ENERGY' THEN 30 WHEN 'CAT-BISCUIT' THEN 40\n        WHEN 'CAT-CAKE' THEN 50 WHEN 'CAT-CHOCO' THEN 60\n        WHEN 'CAT-CANDY' THEN 70 WHEN 'CAT-GUM' THEN 80\n        WHEN 'CAT-CHIPS' THEN 90 WHEN 'CAT-FOOD' THEN 100\n        WHEN 'CAT-GIFTS' THEN 110 WHEN 'CAT-OFFERS' THEN 120\n        ELSE 1000\n      END AS sort_order\n    FROM public.categories c\n    LEFT JOIN family_summary fs ON fs.category_id = c.id\n    WHERE c.is_active = true\n    GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.name_ar, c.image_url\n  ),\n  brand_facets AS (\n    SELECT fs.brand_id AS id, MIN(cs.brand_name_ar) AS name_ar\n    FROM family_summary fs\n    JOIN catalog_source cs ON cs.family_id = fs.family_id\n    WHERE fs.brand_id IS NOT NULL\n    GROUP BY fs.brand_id\n  ),\n  sale_unit_facets AS (\n    SELECT fs.sale_unit_id AS id, MIN(cs.sale_unit_name_ar) AS name_ar\n    FROM family_summary fs\n    JOIN catalog_source cs ON cs.family_id = fs.family_id\n    WHERE fs.sale_unit_id IS NOT NULL\n    GROUP BY fs.sale_unit_id\n  )\n  SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n    'items', COALESCE((\n      SELECT jsonb_agg(\n        jsonb_build_object(\n          'id', id,\n          'sku', sku,\n          'barcode', barcode,\n          'nameAr', name_ar,\n          'description', description,\n          'categoryId', category_id,\n          'categoryCode', category_code,\n          'categoryNameAr', category_name_ar,\n          'brandId', brand_id,\n          'brandNameAr', brand_name_ar,\n          'unitId', unit_id,\n          'unitNameAr', unit_name_ar,\n          'saleUnitId', sale_unit_id,\n          'saleUnitNameAr', sale_unit_name_ar,\n          'unitsPerSalePackage', units_per_sale_unit,\n          'parcelOnly', parcel_only,\n          'salePackagePriceInMinorUnits', default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n          'salePriceInMinorUnits', sale_price_in_minor_units,\n          'availableQuantity', available_quantity,\n          'availableSalePackages', sale_packages,\n          'parcelSaleEnabled', parcel_sale_enabled,\n          'minimumOrderPackages', 1,\n          'imageUrl', image_url,\n          'isAvailable', single_available OR parcel_available,\n          'createdAt', created_at,\n          'soldPackagesLast90Days', sold_packages_last_90_days,\n          'flavorMasterProductId', flavor_master_product_id,\n          'flavorNameAr', flavor_name_ar,\n          'isFlavorMaster', is_flavor_master,\n          'flavorSortOrder', flavor_sort_order\n        )\n        ORDER BY page_order,\n          CASE WHEN flavor_master_product_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,\n          flavor_sort_order,\n          name_ar,\n          id\n      )\n      FROM page_items\n    ), '[]'::jsonb),\n    'categories', COALESCE((\n      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n        'id', id, 'code', code, 'nameAr', name_ar, 'imageUrl', image_url,\n        'productCount', product_count, 'availableProductCount', available_product_count\n      ) ORDER BY sort_order, name_ar, id)\n      FROM category_summary\n    ), '[]'::jsonb),\n    'brands', COALESCE((\n      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'nameAr', name_ar) ORDER BY name_ar, id)\n      FROM brand_facets\n    ), '[]'::jsonb),\n    'saleUnits', COALESCE((\n      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'nameAr', name_ar) ORDER BY name_ar, id)\n      FROM sale_unit_facets\n    ), '[]'::jsonb),\n    'summary', jsonb_build_object(\n      'availableProducts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matching_families WHERE is_available),\n      'availableSalePackages', (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(available_sale_packages), 0) FROM matching_families),\n      'lowStockProducts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matching_families WHERE is_low_stock)\n    ),\n    'total', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matching_families),\n    'limit', LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 24), 1), 48),\n    'offset', GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, 0), 0)\n  ));\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_external_monitoring_snapshot(p_checks jsonb, p_observed_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())\n RETURNS integer\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_item JSONB;\n  v_count INTEGER := 0;\n  v_allowed CONSTANT TEXT[] := ARRAY[\n    'external:backup:erp','external:backup:n8n','external:backup:restore',\n    'external:infrastructure:docker','external:infrastructure:n8n',\n    'external:deployment:github','external:deployment:uptime',\n    'external:deployment:cloudflare-admin','external:deployment:cloudflare-customer'\n  ];\nBEGIN\n  IF p_observed_at IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_checks)<>'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_checks)>20 OR octet_length(p_checks::TEXT)>16384\n  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid external monitoring snapshot.'; END IF;\n  FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_checks)\n  LOOP\n    IF NOT (v_item->>'key'=ANY(v_allowed))\n      OR v_item->>'category' NOT IN ('backup','infrastructure','deployment')\n      OR v_item->>'status' NOT IN ('healthy','warning','critical','unknown')\n      OR v_item->>'severity' NOT IN ('low','medium','high','critical')\n      OR COALESCE((v_item->>'issueCount')::INTEGER,-1)<0\n    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid external monitoring item.'; END IF;\n    PERFORM public._set_advanced_monitoring_check(\n      v_item->>'key',v_item->>'category','external',v_item->>'status',\n      v_item->>'severity',(v_item->>'issueCount')::INTEGER,\n      LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(v_item->>'summary'),''),'External check'),240),\n      COALESCE(v_item->'details','{}'::JSONB),p_observed_at);\n    v_count:=v_count+1;\n  END LOOP;\n  RETURN v_count;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_go_live_cheques_v1(p_branch_id uuid, p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_envelope JSONB:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('branch',p_branch_id,'rows',p_rows));\n  v_replay JSONB;v_plan JSONB;v_locked_rows JSONB;v_row JSONB;v_party RECORD;v_id UUID;v_index INTEGER:=0;v_created JSONB:='[]'::JSONB;v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'],'تسجيل الشيكات القائمة قبل التشغيل');\n  v_replay:=public.go_live_begin_batch_internal('opening_cheques',p_idempotency_key,v_envelope);\n  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.go_live_import_batches WHERE idempotency_key=p_idempotency_key AND created_by<>auth.uid()) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'GO_LIVE_BATCH_KEY_CONFLICT: المفتاح يخص عملية لفاعل آخر.';END IF;\n  IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_replay;END IF;\n  PERFORM public.go_live_assert_setup_open_internal();\n  -- Discover all parties before row locks. Same customer gate as collection;\n  -- supplier rows are locked in UUID order before any cheque row is created.\n  v_plan:=public.preview_go_live_cheques_v1(p_branch_id,p_rows);\n  IF jsonb_array_length(v_plan->'errors')>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE='GO_LIVE_CHEQUE_ROWS_INVALID: صحح الأسطر قبل الحفظ.',DETAIL=(v_plan->'errors')::TEXT;END IF;\n  v_locked_rows:=v_plan->'rows';\n  FOR v_party IN SELECT DISTINCT (r->>'customerId')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'rows') r\n    WHERE r->>'customerId' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LOOP\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('go-live-collection-customer:'||v_party.id::TEXT,0));\n  END LOOP;\n  FOR v_party IN SELECT DISTINCT (r->>'customerId')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'rows') r\n    WHERE r->>'customerId' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LOOP\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.customers WHERE id=v_party.id AND NOT is_deleted FOR UPDATE;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'العميل غير موجود أو حُذف؛ أعد المعاينة.';END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  FOR v_party IN SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(r->>'supplierId',r->>'endorsedSupplierId')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'rows') r\n    WHERE COALESCE(r->>'supplierId',r->>'endorsedSupplierId') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LOOP\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=v_party.id FOR UPDATE;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'المورد غير موجود؛ أعد المعاينة.';END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  -- Revalidate duplicates under party gates;preview is never write authority.\n  v_plan:=public.preview_go_live_cheques_v1(p_branch_id,p_rows);\n  IF jsonb_array_length(v_plan->'errors')>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE='GO_LIVE_CHEQUE_ROWS_INVALID: صحح الأسطر قبل الحفظ.',DETAIL=(v_plan->'errors')::TEXT;END IF;\n  IF v_plan->'rows' IS DISTINCT FROM v_locked_rows THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'GO_LIVE_CHEQUE_PARTIES_CHANGED: تغيّرت هوية الأطراف أثناء الحفظ؛ أعد المعاينة.';\n  END IF;\n  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'rows') LOOP\n    v_index:=v_index+1;v_id:=gen_random_uuid();\n    INSERT INTO public.deferred_cheques(id,tracking_number,direction,origin,cheque_number,bank_name,due_date,amount_in_minor_units,\n      customer_id,supplier_id,endorsed_supplier_id,branch_id,status,original_debt_at,notes,created_by,changed_by)\n    VALUES(v_id,'CHQ-'||lpad(nextval('public.deferred_cheque_number_seq')::TEXT,8,'0'),v_row->>'direction','opening',\n      v_row->>'number',v_row->>'bank',(v_row->>'dueDate')::DATE,(v_row->>'amount')::BIGINT,\n      (v_row->>'customerId')::UUID,(v_row->>'supplierId')::UUID,(v_row->>'endorsedSupplierId')::UUID,p_branch_id,\n      v_row->>'status',(v_row->>'originalDebtAt')::TIMESTAMPTZ,v_row->>'notes',auth.uid(),auth.uid());\n    FOR v_party IN SELECT 'customer'::TEXT kind,(v_row->>'customerId')::UUID id WHERE v_row->>'customerId' IS NOT NULL\n      UNION ALL SELECT 'supplier',COALESCE(v_row->>'supplierId',v_row->>'endorsedSupplierId')::UUID\n        WHERE COALESCE(v_row->>'supplierId',v_row->>'endorsedSupplierId') IS NOT NULL LOOP\n      INSERT INTO public.cheque_party_keys(party_kind,party_id,bank_key,cheque_number,cheque_id)\n      VALUES(v_party.kind,v_party.id,lower(v_row->>'bank'),v_row->>'number',v_id);\n      INSERT INTO public.deferred_cheque_allocations(cheque_id,party_kind,party_id,origin_kind,origin_id,original_debt_at,amount_in_minor_units)\n      VALUES(v_id,v_party.kind,v_party.id,'opening_cheque',v_id,(v_row->>'originalDebtAt')::TIMESTAMPTZ,(v_row->>'amount')::BIGINT);\n    END LOOP;\n    v_result:=public.cheque_finish_event_internal(v_id,'opening_registered',NULL,NULL,\n      'opening-cheque-'||md5(p_idempotency_key)||'-'||v_index::TEXT,\n      jsonb_build_object('action','opening_register','branch',p_branch_id,'batchKey',p_idempotency_key,'row',v_row));\n    v_created:=v_created||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id',v_id,'trackingNumber',v_result#>>'{cheque,tracking_number}'));\n  END LOOP;\n  v_result:=jsonb_build_object('success',true,'idempotentReplay',false,'created',v_created,'rowCount',v_index,\n    'parties',v_plan->'parties','balanceEffectInMinorUnits',0);\n  INSERT INTO public.go_live_import_batches(batch_kind,idempotency_key,request_hash,row_count,result,created_by)\n  VALUES('opening_cheques',p_idempotency_key,md5(v_envelope::TEXT),v_index,v_result,auth.uid());\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_supplier_opening_balances_v1(p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb, p_dry_run boolean DEFAULT false, p_confirm_new_suppliers boolean DEFAULT false)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_replay JSONB;\n  v_row JSONB;\n  v_n INTEGER := 0;\n  v_errors JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_error TEXT;\n  v_supplier_id UUID;\n  v_count INTEGER;\n  v_warning BOOLEAN;\n  v_name TEXT;\n  v_phone TEXT;\n  v_other TEXT;\n  v_new_key TEXT;\n  v_new JSONB := '{}'::JSONB;\n  v_created_suppliers JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_date DATE;\n  v_direction TEXT;\n  v_notes TEXT;\n  v_today DATE := (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;\n  v_valid JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_batch_id UUID;\n  v_created JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_entry public.supplier_opening_balances%ROWTYPE;\n  v_payable BIGINT := 0;\n  v_advance BIGINT := 0;\n  v_supplier UUID;\n  v_signed BIGINT;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'إدخال أرصدة الموردين الافتتاحية');\n  PERFORM public.go_live_assert_setup_open_internal();\n  IF NOT COALESCE(p_dry_run, false) THEN\n    v_replay := public.go_live_begin_batch_internal('supplier_opening', p_idempotency_key, p_rows);\n    IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN\n      RETURN v_replay;\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF p_rows IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_rows) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الدفعة يجب أن تحتوي من 1 إلى 500 سطر.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)\n  LOOP\n    v_n := v_n + 1;\n    v_error := NULL; v_warning := false; v_supplier_id := NULL; v_date := NULL; v_new_key := NULL; v_other := NULL;\n    v_name := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'supplier_name'), '');\n    v_phone := NULLIF(public.normalize_customer_phone(COALESCE(v_row->>'supplier_phone', '')), '');\n    v_direction := v_row->>'direction';\n    v_notes := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'notes'), '');\n    IF jsonb_typeof(v_row) <> 'object' THEN\n      v_error := 'بيانات السطر غير صحيحة.';\n    ELSIF v_direction IS NULL OR v_direction NOT IN ('payable', 'advance') THEN\n      v_error := 'اتجاه الرصيد يجب أن يكون \"له\" أو \"عليه\".';\n    ELSIF COALESCE(v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,11}$' THEN\n      v_error := 'المبلغ يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر وبثلاث منازل عشرية كحد أقصى.';\n    ELSIF COALESCE(v_row->>'original_balance_date', '') !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN\n      v_error := 'تاريخ الرصيد الأصلي مطلوب بصيغة YYYY-MM-DD.';\n    ELSIF v_notes IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_notes) > 300 THEN\n      v_error := 'الملاحظة أطول من 300 حرف.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL THEN\n      BEGIN\n        v_date := (v_row->>'original_balance_date')::DATE;\n      EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n        v_error := 'تاريخ الرصيد الأصلي غير صحيح.';\n      END;\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL AND v_date > v_today THEN\n      v_error := 'تاريخ الرصيد الأصلي لا يمكن أن يكون في المستقبل.';\n    ELSIF v_error IS NULL AND v_date < DATE '2000-01-01' THEN\n      v_error := 'تاريخ الرصيد الأصلي أقدم من المسموح (2000-01-01).';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL AND v_name IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_name) > 150 THEN\n      v_error := 'اسم المورد أطول من المسموح.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL AND COALESCE(v_row->>'supplier_id', '') <> '' THEN\n      IF v_row->>'supplier_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN\n        SELECT id INTO v_supplier_id FROM public.suppliers\n        WHERE id = (v_row->>'supplier_id')::UUID AND is_active;\n      END IF;\n      IF v_supplier_id IS NULL THEN v_error := 'المورد غير موجود أو غير نشط.'; END IF;\n    ELSIF v_error IS NULL AND v_name IS NULL AND v_phone IS NULL THEN\n      v_error := 'اسم المورد أو هاتفه مطلوب لمطابقته.';\n    ELSIF v_error IS NULL THEN\n      IF v_phone IS NOT NULL THEN\n        SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(id::TEXT)::UUID INTO v_count, v_supplier_id FROM public.suppliers\n        WHERE is_active AND NULLIF(public.normalize_customer_phone(COALESCE(phone, '')), '') = v_phone;\n        IF v_count > 1 THEN\n          v_supplier_id := NULL;\n          v_error := 'يوجد أكثر من مورد بهذا الهاتف؛ أدخل الرصيد يدوياً باختيار المورد.';\n        ELSIF v_count = 0 THEN\n          v_supplier_id := NULL;\n        END IF;\n      ELSE\n        SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(id::TEXT)::UUID INTO v_count, v_supplier_id FROM public.suppliers\n        WHERE is_active AND BTRIM(company_name) = v_name;\n        IF v_count > 1 THEN\n          v_supplier_id := NULL;\n          v_error := 'يوجد أكثر من مورد بهذا الاسم؛ أدخل الرصيد يدوياً باختيار المورد.';\n        ELSIF v_count = 0 THEN\n          v_supplier_id := NULL;\n        END IF;\n      END IF;\n      IF v_error IS NULL AND v_supplier_id IS NULL THEN\n        SELECT company_name || COALESCE(' — ' || NULLIF(phone, ''), '') INTO v_other FROM public.suppliers\n        WHERE is_active AND v_name IS NOT NULL\n          AND public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(company_name) = public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(v_name)\n        ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1;\n        IF         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_supplier_payment(p_supplier_id uuid, p_purchase_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_amount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, NUMERIC;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'تسجيل دفعات الموردين'\n  );\n\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب AND c.status='pending' AND c.supplier_payment_id IS NULL\n        AND c.amount_in_minor_units=p_amount_in_minor_units\n        AND k.bank_key=c.bank_key AND k.cheque_number=c.cheque_number\n        AND p_reference_number=c.cheque_number\n        AND v_key='cheque-supplier-'||c.id::TEXT\n        AND ((c.direction='outgoing' AND c.supplier_id=p_supplier_id)\n          OR(c.direction='incoming' AND hashtextextended(\n      v_user_id::TEXT || ':purchase_order_payment:' || v_key,\n      0\n    )\n  );\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing\n  FROM public.supplier_payments\n  WHERE created_by = v_user_id\n    AND idempotency_scope = 'purchase_order_payment'\n    AND idempotency_key = v_key\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing.supplier_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_supplier_id\n      OR   );\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_payment_shift_internal(\n    (SELECT branch_id FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE id = p_purchase_order_id),\n    p_payment_method, FROM public.supplier_payments WHERE purchase_order_id=p_purchase_order_id AND NOT is_reversed;\n    v_actual_payable := GREATEST(v_po.total_in_minor_units::NUMERIC,\n      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.supplier_invoice_payable_total_snapshot_in_minor_units::NUMERIC)\n        FROM public.purchase_receipts r WHERE r.purchase_order_id=p_purchase_order_id\n          AND r.status='completed' AND link.customer_payment_id\n      WHERE link.operation_id = op.id AND payment.cash_shift_id = p_shift_id))\n  ) OR EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_opening_payments link\n    JOIN    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_SHIFT_HAS_UNIFIED_OPERATIONS: الوردية تحتوي تحصيلاً موحداً أو سداد رصيد مورد افتتاحي؛ اعكس هذه العمليات أولاً.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Withdrawals of this shift and returns booked in it: lock, then decide\n  -- before any write.\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawals WHERE cash_shift_id = p_shift_id ORDER BY id FOR p_shift_id)\n  ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  v_plan := public.owner_withdrawal_shift_reversal_plan_internal(p_shift_id);\n  IF NOT (v_plan->>'canExecute')::BOOLEAN THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE IF COALESCE((v_result->>'idempotent')::BOOLEAN, false) THEN\n    -- The first execution already handled withdrawals in its transaction.\n    RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object('ownerWithdrawals', VALUES (\n      (v_item->>'withdrawalId')::UUID, p_shift_id, (v_item->>'amountInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, v_reason, v_user_id,\n      v_reversal_id, 'shift-reversal:' || v_reversal_id::TEXT || ':' || (v_item->>'withdrawalId'),\n      md5('shift-reversal|' || v_reversal_id::TEXT || '|' || (v_item->>'withdrawalId'))\n    );\n    v_reversed_count := v_reversed_count + 1;\n    v_reversed_amount := المحاولة.';\n    END IF;\n    v_voided_count := v_voided_count + 1;\n    v_voided_amount := v_voided_amount + (v_item->>'amountInMinorUnits')::BIGINT;\n  END LOOP;\n  PERFORM set_config('nawasrah.owner_withdrawal_void', 'off', true);\n\n  IF v_reversed_count + v_voided_count > 0 THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n    VALUES (v_user_id, 'REVERSE_OWNER_WITHDRAWALS_FOR_SHIFT', 'cash_shifts', p_shift_id,\n      jsonb_build_object('reversal_id', v_reversal_id, 'reason', v_reason,\n        'withdrawals_reversed', v_plan->'withdrawalsToReverse', 'returns_voided', v_plan->'returnsToVoid'));\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object('ownerWithdrawals', jsonb_build_object(\n    'withdrawalsReversedCount', v_reversed_count,\n    'withdrawalsReversedInMinorUnits', v_reversed_amount,\n    'returnsVoidedCount', v_voided_count,\n    'returnsVoidedInMinorUnits', v_voided_amount));\nEND;\n$function$\n",

SELECT v_operation.cash_shift_id AS shift_id\n    UNION SELECT (p->>'shiftId')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'payments') p\n  ) resources WHERE shift_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY shift_id\n  LOOP         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_customer_order_payment(p_payment_id uuid, p_reason text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_id UUID;\n  v_shift_id UUID;\n  v_locked_order_id UUID;\n  v_locked_shift_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'عكس سند قبض عميل'\n  );\n  SELECT payment.order_id, payment.cash_shift_id\n  INTO v_order_id, v_shift_id\n  FROM public.customer_payments payment WHERE payment.id = p_payment_id;\n  IF v_order_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', MESSAGE = 'Customer payment not found.';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('phase4-order|' || v_order_id::TEXT, 0));\n  IF v_shift_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts shift WHERE shift.id = v_shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders customer_order WHERE customer_order.id = v_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n  SELECT payment.order_id, payment.cash_shift_id\n  INTO v_locked_order_id, v_locked_shift_id\n  FROM public.customer_payments payment\n  WHERE payment.id = p_payment_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF v_locked_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order_id\n    OR v_locked_shift_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_shift_id\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_LOCK_PLAN_CHANGED_RETRY: Customer Payment relationship changed.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN public._reverse_customer_order_payment_before_phase4_lock(\n    p_payment_id, p_reason\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_owner_cash_withdrawal_v1(p_withdrawal_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID;\n  v_key TEXT := BTRIM(COALESCE(p_idempotency_key, ''));\n  v_reason TEXT := BTRIM(COALESCE(p_reason, ''));\n  v_fingerprint TEXT;\n  v_existing public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals%ROWTYPE;\n  v_withdrawal public.owner_cash_withdrawals%ROWTYPE;\n  v_original public.cash_shifts%ROWTYPE;\n  v_effective_shift UUID;\n  v_lock UUID;\n  v_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := public.assert_reversal_owner('عكس سحب المالك');\n  IF char_length(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_KEY_INVALID: مفتاح العملية غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF char_length(v_reason) NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_REVERSAL_REASON_REQUIRED: سبب العكس مطلوب (5 إلى 500 حرف).';\n  END IF;\n  v_fingerprint := md5(COALESCE(p_withdrawal_id::TEXT, '') || '|' || v_reason);\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals\n  WHERE reversed_by = v_user_id AND idempotency_key = v_key;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing.request_fingerprint <> v_fingerprint THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_KEY_CONFLICT: استُخدم مفتاح العملية لطلب عكس مختلف.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN public.owner_withdrawal_result_internal(v_existing.withdrawal_id, true)\n      || jsonb_build_object('reversalId', v_existing.id, 'effectiveShiftId', v_existing.effective_shift_id);\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_withdrawal FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawals WHERE id = p_withdrawal_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_NOT_FOUND: السحب المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO v_original FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id = v_withdrawal.cash_shift_id;\n  -- The return goes back into the withdrawal's shift while it is open,\n  -- otherwise into the open shift of the same branch (one per branch).\n  IF v_original.status = 'open' THEN\n    v_effective_shift := v_original.id;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT shift.id INTO v_effective_shift FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n    WHERE shift.branch_id = v_withdrawal.branch_id AND shift.status = 'open';\n    IF v_effective_shift IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_REVERSAL_NEEDS_OPEN_SHIFT: افتح وردية في فرع السحب ليُعاد المبلغ إلى درجها.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Lock order: reversal domains (sorted), shift rows (sorted), then the withdrawal.\n  FOR v_lock IN SELECT DISTINCT id FROM unnest(ARRAY[v_original.id, v_effective_shift]) id ORDER BY id LOOP\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('cash-shift-full-reversal:' || v_lock::TEXT, 0));\n  END LOOP;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id IN (v_original.id, v_effective_shift) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawals WHERE id = p_withdrawal_id FOR UPDATE;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals\n  WHERE reversed_by = v_user_id AND idempotency_key = v_key;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing.request_fingerprint <> v_fingerprint THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_KEY_CONFLICT: استُخدم مفتاح العملية لطلب عكس مختلف.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN public.owner_withdrawal_result_internal(v_existing.withdrawal_id, true)\n      || jsonb_build_object('reversalId', v_existing.id, 'effectiveShiftId', v_existing.effective_shift_id);\n  END IF;\n  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals\n    WHERE withdrawal_id = p_withdrawal_id AND voided_at IS NULL) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_ALREADY_REVERSED: هذا السحب معكوس مسبقاً.';\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id = v_effective_shift AND status = 'open') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_REVERSAL_NEEDS_OPEN_SHIFT: افتح وردية في فرع السحب ليُعاد المبلغ إلى درجها.';\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals (\n    withdrawal_id, effective_shift_id, amount_in_minor_units, reason, reversed_by,\n    idempotency_key, request_fingerprint\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_withdrawal_id, v_effective_shift, v_withdrawal.amount_in_minor_units, v_reason, v_user_id,\n    v_key, v_fingerprint\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n  VALUES (v_user_id, 'REVERSE_OWNER_CASH_WITHDRAWAL', 'owner_cash_withdrawals', p_withdrawal_id,\n    jsonb_build_object('reversal_id', v_id, 'original_shift_id', v_original.id,\n      'effective_shift_id', v_effective_shift, 'amount_in_minor_units', v_withdrawal.amount_in_minor_units,\n      'reason', v_reason, 'original_shift_status', v_original.status));\n\n  RETURN public.owner_withdrawal_result_internal(p_withdrawal_id, false)\n    || jsonb_build_object('reversalId', v_id, 'effectiveShiftId', v_effective_shift,\n      'shiftSummary', public.get_cash_shift_summary(v_effective_shift));\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_pos_sale(p_order_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID;\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_shift public.cash_shifts%ROWTYPE;\n  v_existing public.pos_sale_reversals%ROWTYPE;\n  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_reason), '');\n  v_key TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), '');\n  v_item RECORD;\n  v_balance_before INTEGER;\n  v_balance_after INTEGER;\n  v_reserved INTEGER;\n  v_cogs BIGINT := 0;\n  v_profit BIGINT := 0;\n  v_quantity INTEGER := 0;\n  v_effect JSONB;\n  v_product_ids UUID[];\n  v_reversal_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := public.assert_reversal_owner('عكس بيع نقطة بيع مكتمل');\n  IF p_order_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_ORDER_REQUIRED: بيع نقطة البيع غير محدد.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_reason IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_REASON_INVALID: سبب العكس غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_key IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_KEY_INVALID: مفتاح منع التكرار غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM SET_CONFIG('lock_timeout', '3s', true);\n  PERFORM SET_CONFIG('statement_timeout', '30s', true);\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.orders WHERE id = p_order_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_ORDER_NOT_FOUND: بيع نقطة البيع غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_order.cash_shift_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_SHIFT_MISSING: البيع غير مرتبط بورديّة صريحة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'cash-shift-full-reversal:' || v_order.cash_shift_id::TEXT, 0\n  ));\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'pos-sale-reversal:' || p_order_id::TEXT, 0\n  ));\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_shift FROM public.cash_shifts\n  WHERE id = v_order.cash_shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_shift.status <> 'open' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_SHIFT_CLOSED: لا يمكن العكس على ورديّة غير مفتوحة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.pos_sale_reversals\n  WHERE requested_by = v_user_id AND idempotency_key = v_key\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing.order_id <> p_order_id THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: مفتاح العكس مستخدم لبيع آخر.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'success', true,\n      'idempotent', true,\n      'reversal_id', v_existing.id,\n      'order_id', v_existing.order_id,\n      'cash_shift_id', v_existing.cash_shift_id,\n      'actual_effect', v_existing.actual_effect\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_order.source IS DISTINCT FROM 'pos'\n    OR v_order.cash_shift_id <> v_shift.id\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_ORDER_INVALID: السجل ليس بيع POS قابلاً للعكس.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.pos_sale_reversals\n  WHERE order_id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_DUPLICATE: تم عكس البيع مسبقًا.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_order.status <> 'completed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_ORDER_INVALID: البيع لم يعد مكتملًا قابلاً للعكس.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.customer_payments payment\n      WHERE payment.order_id = p_order_id)\n    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_returns return_row\n      WHERE return_row.order_id = p_order_id)\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_DEPENDENCY_EXISTS: توجد دفعة أو مرتجع مرتبط بالبيع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT inventory_row.product_id\n    ORDER BY inventory_row.product_id)\n  INTO v_product_ids\n  FROM public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(p_order_id) inventory_row;\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_product_ids), 0) = 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_INVENTORY_IDENTITY_MISSING: لا توجد حقيقة مخزون قابلة للعكس.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Reuse the same SKU advisory/balance/product hierarchy as sale and receipt.\n  PERFORM public.phase3_lock_inventory_products_internal(v_product_ids);\n\n  -- Check chronology only after taking the shared product/balance lock hierarchy.\n  -- This closes the race where a concurrent sale/receipt could commit between\n  -- the chronology read and the inventory restoration.\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(p_order_id) inventory_row\n    JOIN public.inventory_movements movement\n      ON movement.warehouse_id = v_order.warehouse_id\n     AND movement.product_id = inventory_row.product_id\n    WHERE movement.reference_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_order_id\n      AND movement.created_at >= v_order.created_at\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_LATER_MOVEMENT: توجد حركة مخزون لاحقة على أحد أصناف البيع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_item IN\n    SELECT DISTINCT inventory_row.product_id\n    FROM public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(p_order_id) inventory_row\n    ORDER BY inventory_row.product_id\n  LOOP\n    SELECT balance.reserved_quantity INTO v_reserved\n    FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n    WHERE balance.warehouse_id = v_order.warehouse_id\n      AND balance.product_id = v_item.product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n    IF NOT FOUND OR v_reserved <> 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_REVERSAL_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE: مخزون أحد الأصناف غير متاح أو محجوز.';\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  SELECT\n    COALESCE(SUM(item.cogs_in_minor_units), 0),\n    COALESCE(SUM(item.profit_in_minor_units), 0)\n  INTO v_cogs, v_profit\n  FROM public.order_items item\n  WHERE item.order_id = p_order_id;\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inventory_row.base_quantity), 0)::INTEGER\n  INTO v_quantity\n  FROM public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(p_order_id) inventory_row;\n\n  v_effect := JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'payment_method', v_order.payment_method,\n    'cash_in_minor_units', CASE WHEN v_order.payment_method = 'cash'\n      THEN v_order.total_in_minor_units ELSE 0 END,\n    'cliq_in_minor_units', CASE WHEN v_order.payment_method = 'cliq'\n      THEN v_order.total_in_minor_units ELSE 0 END,\n    'customer_receivable_in_minor_units', CASE WHEN v_order.payment_method = 'debt'\n      THEN v_order.total_in_minor_units ELSE 0 END,\n    'discount_in_minor_units', v_order.discount_in_minor_units,\n    'cogs_in_minor_units', v_cogs,\n    'profit_in_minor_units', v_profit,\n    'restored_base_units', v_quantity\n  );\n\n  INSERT INTO public.pos_sale_reversals (\n    id, order_id, cash_shift_id, requested_by, reason, idempotency_key,\n    expected_effect, actual_effect\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_reversal_id, v_order.id, v_shift.id, v_user_id, v_reason, v_key,\n    v_effect, v_effect\n  );\n\n  FOR v_item IN\n    SELECT *\n    FROM public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(p_order_id) inventory_row\n    ORDER BY inventory_row.product_id,\n      inventory_row.parcel_component_id NULLS FIRST,\n      inventory_row.order_item_id\n  LOOP\n    SELECT balance.on_hand_quantity INTO v_balance_before\n    FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n    WHERE balance.warehouse_id = v_order.warehouse_id\n      AND balance.product_id = v_item.product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n    v_balance_after := v_balance_before + v_item.base_quantity;\n    UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n    SET on_hand_quantity = v_balance_after, updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE warehouse_id = v_order.warehouse_id\n      AND product_id = v_item.product_id;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements (\n      warehouse_id, product_id, movement_type, quantity,\n      balance_before, balance_after, reference_type, reference_id,\n      notes, created_by, operation_id, parcel_component_id\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_order.warehouse_id, v_item.product_id, 'return_in',\n      v_item.base_quantity, v_balance_before, v_balance_after,\n      'pos_sale_reversal', v_reversal_id,\n      'عكس بيع نقطة البيع ' || v_order.order_number, v_user_id,\n      v_item.operation_id, v_item.parcel_component_id\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET status = 'cancelled', amount_paid_in_minor_units = 0,\n    change_due_in_minor_units = 0, updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = v_order.id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.order_status_history (\n    order_id, old_status, new_status, changed_by, notes\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_order.id, 'completed', 'cancelled', v_user_id,\n    'عكس POS موثق: ' || v_reason\n  );\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id, 'REVERSE_POS_SALE', 'pos_sale_reversals', v_reversal_id,\n    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'order_id', v_order.id,\n      'order_number', v_order.order_number,\n      'cash_shift_id', v_shift.id,\n      'reason', v_reason,\n      'effect', v_effect\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'success', true,\n    'idempotent', false,\n    'reversal_id', v_reversal_id,\n    'order_id', v_order.id,\n    'cash_shift_id', v_shift.id,\n    'actual_effect', v_effect\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_supplier_cheque_claim_payment_v1(p_supplier_payment_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_actor UUID;v_payment public.supplier_payments%ROWTYPE;v_initial public.supplier_payments%ROWTYPE;\n  v_existing public.supplier_cheque_claim_reversals%ROWTYPE;v_shift public.cash_shifts%ROWTYPE;\n  v_reason TEXT:=NULLIF(btrim(p_reason),'');v_key TEXT:=NULLIF(btrim(p_idempotency_key),'');v_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_actor:=public.assert_reversal_owner('عكس سداد قيد شيك المورد');\n  IF v_reason IS NULL OR char_length(v_reason) NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سبب عكس سداد القيد مطلوب، من 5 إلى 500 حرف.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_key IS NULL OR char_length(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 160 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مفتاح العكس غير صالح.';END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('supplier-cheque-claim-reversal-key:'||v_actor::TEXT||':'||v_key,0));\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.supplier_cheque_claim_reversals WHERE requested_by=v_actor AND idempotency_key=v_key;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing.supplier_payment_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_supplier_payment_id OR v_existing.reason IS DISTINCT FROM v_reason THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CHEQUE_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: مفتاح عكس القيد مستخدم لطلب مختلف.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'idempotentReplay',true,'reversalId',v_existing.id,'paymentId',v_existing.supplier_payment_id);\n  END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO v_initial FROM public.supplier_payments         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_supplier_opening_balance_v1(p_entry_id uuid, p_reason text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_reason), '');\n  v_entry public.supplier_opening_balances%ROWTYPE;\n  v_supplier_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  -- Owner decision 3: allowed also after go-live finish (owner, reason, audit).\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'عكس رصيد مورد افتتاحي');\n  IF v_reason IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_reason) NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 300 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'اكتب سبب العكس (5 إلى 300 حرف).';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT supplier_id INTO v_supplier_id FROM public.supplier_opening_balances WHERE id = p_entry_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الرصيد الافتتاحي غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  -- Supplier first, then entry: the same order as the batch writer.\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id = v_supplier_id FOR UPDATE;\n  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_entry FROM public.supplier_opening_balances WHERE id = p_entry_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF v_entry.is_reversed THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'idempotentReplay', true, 'entryId', v_entry.id,\n      'entryNumber', v_entry.entry_number, 'reversedAt', v_entry.reversed_at);\n  END IF;\n  UPDATE public.supplier_opening_balances\n  SET is_reversed = true, reversed_at = NOW(), reversed_by = v_user_id, reversal_reason = v_reason\n  WHERE id = p_entry_id RETURNING * INTO v_entry;\n  UPDATE public.suppliers\n  SET current_balance_in_minor_units = current_balance_in_minor_units\n    - CASE WHEN v_entry.direction = 'payable' THEN v_entry.amount_in_minor_units\n      ELSE -v_entry.amount_in_minor_units END,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = v_entry.supplier_id;\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n  VALUES (v_user_id, 'GO_LIVE_SUPPLIER_OPENING_REVERSED', 'supplier_opening_balances', v_entry.id,\n    jsonb_build_object('entry_number', v_entry.entry_number, 'supplier_id', v_entry.supplier_id,\n      'direction', v_entry.direction, 'amount_in_minor_units', v_entry.amount_in_minor_units,\n      'original_balance_date', v_entry.original_balance_date, 'reason', v_reason));\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'idempotentReplay', false, 'entryId', v_entry.id,\n    'entryNumber', v_entry.entry_number, 'reversedAt', v_entry.reversed_at);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

  FROM public.orders o\n    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id\n    WHERE o.source = 'website'\n      AND o.status IN ('new','confirmed','preparing','ready','out_for_delivery')\n      AND o.reservation_released_at IS NULL\n      AND NOT sales_lite1.is_order(o.id)\n      AND NOT EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1\n        FROM public.order_inventory_reservations reservation\n        WHERE SUM(oi.quantity)::BIGINT AS qty\n    FROM public.orders o\n    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id\n    WHERE o.status IN ('completed','returned') AND NOT sales_lite1.is_order(o.id)\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_product_parcel_configuration_v1(p_family_product_id uuid, p_composition_mode text, p_is_active boolean DEFAULT true)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_units INTEGER; v_ids UUID[]; v_configuration public.product_parcel_configurations%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'],'إعداد الطرود');\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY[p_family_product_id]);\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('parcel-configuration|' || p_family_product_id::TEXT,0));\n  SELECT * INTO v_configuration FROM public.product_parcel_configurations\n  WHERE family_product_id=p_family_product_id FOR UPDATE;\n  SELECT units_per_sale_unit INTO v_units FROM public.products WHERE id=p_family_product_id;\n  IF v_configuration.id IS NOT NULL AND v_configuration.composition_mode=p_composition_mode THEN\n    SELECT array_agg(allowed.product_id ORDER BY allowed.product_id) INTO v_ids\n    FROM public.product_parcel_allowed_components allowed\n    JOIN public.products component ON component.id=allowed.product_id AND component.is_active\n    WHERE allowed.configuration_id=v_configuration.id;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT array_agg(product.id ORDER BY product.id) INTO v_ids FROM public.products product\n    WHERE product.is_active AND CASE WHEN p_composition_mode='single_sku'\n      THEN product.id=p_family_product_id\n      ELSE product.flavor_master_product_id=p_family_product_id AND NOT product.is_flavor_master END;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN public.save_product_parcel_configuration_v1(\n    p_family_product_id,p_composition_mode,p_is_active,v_units,COALESCE(v_ids,'{}'::UUID[]));\nEND;\n$function$\n",

END IF;\n  -- Configuration before family/product matches the sales validator order.\n  -- Serialize creation of a previously absent configuration as well.\n  PERFORM v_configuration FROM public.product_parcel_configurations\n  WHERE family_product_id=p_family_product_id FOR UPDATE;\n  SELECT * INTO v_family FROM public.products WHERE id=p_family_product_id FOR component.is_flavor_master))) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='PARCEL_COMPONENT_FAMILY_MISMATCH: النكهات المسموحة يجب أن تنتمي للعائلة نفسها.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT VALUES(p_family_product_id,p_composition_mode,p_is_active,auth.uid(),auth.uid())\n    RETURNING * INTO v_configuration;\n  ELSE\n    UPDATE public.product_parcel_configurations SET v_configuration.composition_mode IS DISTINCT FROM p_composition_mode\n        OR v_configuration.is_active IS DISTINCT FROM p_is_active\n        OR v_family.units_per_sale_unit IS DISTINCT FROM v_configuration.id,unnest(v_ids);\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'configuration',to_jsonb(v_configuration),\n WHERE (p_product_id IS NULL OR product.id = p_product_id)\n        AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR product.category_id = p_category_id)\n        AND (\n          v_search IS NULL\n          OR old_op UUID; row RECORD; x JSONB; c_id UUID;\n at TIMESTAMPTZ:=clock_timestamp(); warehouse UUID; branch UUID; before_qty INTEGER; global_qty BIGINT; before_wac NUMERIC(24,6);\n after_wac NUMERIC(24,6); movement UUID; unit_name TEXT; cases UUID[]:='{}'::UUID[]; recovery BIGINT; manifest JSONB;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin'],'تأكيد الإرجاع أو الاستبدال');\n IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' OR actor IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='AFTERCARE215_ROLE_DENIED'; END IF;\n request:=public.tb215_canonical_inspection_internal(p_payload);\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(request->'items') x WHERE x->>'supplierId' IS NOT NULL)\n THEN PERFORM public.sr208_assert_role_internal('customer_return'); END IF;\n key:=public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(p_idempotency_key);\n IF length(key)>200 OR COALESCE(p_preview_fingerprint,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_PREVIEW_REQUIRED'; END IF;\n identity:=jsonb_build_object('request',request,'previewFingerprint',p_preview_fingerprint);\n fingerprint:=encode(extensions.digest(identity::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');\n actor_hash:=public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal('erp_user',actor,NULL,NULL);\n -- Same legacy operation lock first: a direct old issuer cannot interleave.\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('phase4-operation|phase4_replacement_v1|'||actor_hash||'|'||key,0));\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('aftercare215|'||actor::TEXT||'|'||key,0));\n SELECT * INTO existing FROM public.business_operations WHERE operation_type='aftercare215_inspection' AND initiated_by=actor AND idempotency_key=key;\n IF FOUND THEN\n  IF existing.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n  PERFORM public.tb215_assert_inspection_internal(existing.id);\n  RETURN (existing.result_snapshot-'evidenceFingerprint')||jsonb_build_object('idempotentReplay',true);\n END IF;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_operations WHERE initiated_by=actor AND idempotency_key=key\n  AND operation_type IN('phase4_replacement_v1','supplier_replacement208')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_LEGACY_KEY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n PERFORM public.phase4_lock_customer_order_context_internal((request->>'orderId')::UUID,false,false);\n -- Discover all products before locking, then reuse the issuer's canonical\n -- inventory lock hierarchy. No supplier lock is taken ahead of inventory.\n plan:=public.tb215_prepare_inspection_internal(request);\n PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT (x->>'productId')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(plan->'items') x ORDER BY 1));\n plan:=public.tb215_prepare_inspection_internal(request);\n IF p_preview_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(plan::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_PREVIEW_CHANGED'; END IF;\n warehouse:=(plan->'order'->>'warehouseId')::UUID;branch:=(plan->'order'->>'branchId')::UUID;\n -- Re-entrant issuer owns all capacity, sale-window and inventory evidence.\n issued:=public.settle_sales_replacement_v1((request->>'orderId')::UUID,key,\n  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceKind',x->'sourceKind','sourceId',x->'sourceId','quantity',x->'quantity')) FROM jsonb_array_elements(request->'items') x),\n  request->>'reason',request->>'notes');\n old_op:=(issued->>'operationId')::UUID;\n FOR row IN SELECT DISTINCT (x->>'supplierId')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(request->'items') x WHERE x->>'supplierId' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1 LOOP\n  BEGIN\n   PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=row.id AND is_active FOR SHARE NOWAIT;\n  EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PARENT_BUSY_RETRY'; END;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n END LOOP;\n FOR row IN SELECT f.* FROM public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects f WHERE f.operation_id=old_op ORDER BY f.product_id,f.source_kind,f.source_id LOOP\n  SELECT value INTO STRICT x FROM jsonb_array_elements(plan->'items') WHERE value->>'sourceKind'=row.source_kind AND(value->>'sourceId')::UUID=row.source_id;\n  SELECT on_hand_quantity INTO STRICT before_qty FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE warehouse_id=warehouse AND product_id=row.product_id FOR UPDATE;\n  SELECT wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact INTO STRICT before_wac FROM public.products WHERE id=row.product_id FOR NO KEY UPDATE;\n  SELECT COALESCE(sum(on_hand_quantity),0) INTO global_qty FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE product_id=row.product_id;\n  after_wac:=before_wac;movement:=NULL;c_id:=NULL;\n  IF (x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER>0 THEN\n   after_wac:=round((global_qty*before_wac+(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER*(x->>'sourceUnitCostExact')::NUMERIC)/(global_qty+(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER),6);\n   UPDATE public.inventory_balances SET on_hand_quantity=on_hand_quantity+(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE warehouse_id=warehouse AND product_id=row.product_id;\n   UPDATE public.products SET wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact=after_wac,cost_price_in_minor_units=round(after_wac)::BIGINT,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=row.product_id;\n   INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements(warehouse_id,product_id,movement_type,quantity,balance_before,balance_after,reference_type,reference_id,notes,created_by,operation_id,created_at)\n    VALUES(warehouse,row.product_id,'adjustment_add',(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,before_qty,before_qty+(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,\n     'aftercare215_inspection',row.replacement_item_id,'استرداد السليم من استبدال مفحوص',actor,NULL,clock_timestamp()) RETURNING id INTO movement;\n  END IF;\n  IF x->>'supplierId' IS NOT NULL THEN\n   SELECT COALESCE(u.name_ar,'باكيت') INTO unit_name FROM public.products p LEFT JOIN public.units u ON u.id=p.unit_id WHERE p.id=row.product_id;\n   INSERT INTO public.supplier_replacement_cases(operation_id,supplier_id,product_id,warehouse_id,branch_id,origin,quantity,commercial_quantity,\n    units_per_commercial_unit,unit_name,base_unit_name,unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,occurred_at,created_by)\n    VALUES(tail,(x->>'supplierId')::UUID,row.product_id,warehouse,branch,'inspected_replacement',row.issued_quantity-(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,\n     row.issued_quantity-(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,1,unit_name,unit_name,(x->>'sourceUnitCostExact')::NUMERIC,at,actor) RETURNING id INTO c_id;\n   PERFORM public.sr208_append_event_internal(tail,c_id,'send',row.issued_quantity-(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,row.issued_quantity-(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,\n    -round((row.issued_quantity-(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER)*(x->>'sourceUnitCostExact')::NUMERIC)::BIGINT,0,request->>'reason',at);\n   cases:=array_append(cases,c_id);\n  END IF;\n  INSERT INTO public.aftercare215_inspection_items(replacement_item_id,operation_id,product_id,warehouse_id,good_quantity,bad_quantity,source_unit_cost_exact,\n   global_quantity_before_restock,on_hand_before,on_hand_after,wac_before,wac_after,movement_id,supplier_case_id)\n   VALUES(row.replacement_item_id,op,row.product_id,warehouse,(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,row.issued_quantity-(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,\n    (x->>'sourceUnitCostExact')::NUMERIC,global_qty,before_qty,before_qty+(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,before_wac,after_wac,movement,c_id);\n END LOOP;\n SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(good_quantity*source_unit_cost_exact),0))::BIGINT INTO recovery FROM public.aftercare215_inspection_items WHERE operation_id=op;\n INSERT INTO public.aftercare215_inspections VALUES(op,old_op,(request->>'orderId')::UUID,recovery,at,actor);\n IF cardinality(cases)>0 THEN\n  manifest:=public.sr208_operation_manifest_internal(tail);\n  INSERT INTO public.business_operations(id,operation_type,idempotency_key,request_fingerprint,request_identity_version,request_identity_snapshot,initiated_by,result_snapshot,completed_at)\n   VALUES(tail,'supplier_replacement208',key,encode(extensions.digest(jsonb_build_object('action','inspected_replacement','inspectionId',op)::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'),208,\n    jsonb_build_object('action','inspected_replacement','inspectionId',op),actor,jsonb_build_object('evidenceFingerprint',encode(extensions.digest(manifest::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'),\n     'caseIds',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'id' ORDER BY x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'cases') x),\n     'eventIds',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'id' ORDER BY x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'events') x)),at);\n END IF;\n result:=public.tb215_inspection_public_result_internal(op)||jsonb_build_object('evidenceFingerprint',encode(extensions.digest(public.tb215_inspection_manifest_internal(op)::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'));\n INSERT INTO public.business_operations(id,operation_type,idempotency_key,request_fingerprint,request_identity_version,request_identity_snapshot,initiated_by,result_snapshot,completed_at)\n  VALUES(op,'aftercare215_inspection',key,fingerprint,215,identity,actor,result,at);\n PERFORM public.tb215_assert_inspection_internal(op);\n IF cardinality(cases)>0 THEN PERFORM public.sr208_assert_operation_internal(tail); END IF;\n INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id,action,entity_name,entity_id,details) VALUES(actor,'INSPECTED_REPLACEMENT','business_operations',op,\n  jsonb_build_object('order_id',request->'orderId','replacement_operation_id',old_op));\n RETURN (result-'evidenceFingerprint')||jsonb_build_object('idempotentReplay',false);\nEND $function$\n",

initiated_by=actor AND idempotency_key=key;\n IF FOUND THEN\n  IF old.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n  PERFORM public.tb215_assert_exchange_internal(old.id);\n  RETURN(old.result_snapshot-'evidenceFingerprint')||jsonb_build_object('idempotentReplay',true);\n END IF;\n pos_key:='aftercare215-exchange-pos-'||encode(extensions.digest(actor::TEXT||'|'||key,'sha256'),'hex');\n return_key:='aftercare215-exchange-return-'||encode(extensions.digest(actor::TEXT||'|'||key,'sha256'),'hex');\n actor_hash:=public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal('erp_user',actor,NULL,NULL);\n -- IN(pos_key,return_key))\n  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.orders WHERE idempotency_key=pos_key)\n  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.pos_uncommitted_attempt_cancellations WHERE actor_id=actor AND idempotency_key=pos_key)\n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_LEGACY_KEY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n -- Match collection/POS parent ordering before taking order,shift or stock.\n SELECT customer_id INTO discovered_customer FROM public.orders WHERE id=(request->'returnRequest'->'baseRequest'->>'order_id')::UUID;\n IF discovered_customer IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM 1 FROM public.customers WHERE id=discovered_customer FOR UPDATE; END IF;\n PERFORM public.phase4_lock_customer_order_context_internal((request->'returnRequest'->'baseRequest'->>'order_id')::UUID,true,false);\n SELECT customer_id SELECT DISTINCT id FROM(SELECT (s->>'product_id')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(plan->'returnPlan'->'physicalSources') s\n   UNION SELECT (plan->>'productId')::UUID) ids ORDER BY id));\n plan:=public.tb215_prepare_exchange_internal(request);\n IF encode(extensions.digest(plan::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM p_preview_fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_PREVIEW_CHANGED'; END IF;\n IF jsonb_array_length(plan->'issues')>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_FIELDS_REQUIRED'; END IF;\n INSERT INTO public.aftercare215_exchanges(operation_id,created_by,transaction_id,order_id,idempotency_key,return_key,pos_key,prepared_plan,preview_fingerprint,original_completed_at,created_at)\n pos_result:=public.tb215_exchange_pos_internal((plan->>'warehouseId')::UUID,(plan->>'branchId')::UUID,(plan->>'customerId')::UUID,\n  plan->>'customerName','exchange_credit',jsonb_build_array(plan->'line'),0,0,pos_key);\n base:=plan->'returnPlan'->'request'->'baseRequest';\n return_result:=public.tb215_exchange_return_internal((plan->>'orderId')::UUID,return_key,base->'items',base->>'reason','exchange_credit',NULL,base->>'notes');\n supplier_operation:=public.tb215_hold_return_subset_internal((return_result->>'operationId')::UUID,request->'returnRequest'->'supplierAssignments',return_key,base->>'reason');\n INSERT INTO public.aftercare215_exchange_results(operation_id,return_operation_id,new_order_id,supplier_operation_id)\n VALUES(operation,(return_result->>'operationId')::UUID,(pos_result->>'orderId')::UUID,supplier_operation);\n result:=public.tb215_exchange_public_result_internal(operation)||jsonb_build_object('evidenceFingerprint',encode(extensions.digest(public.tb215_exchange_manifest_internal(operation)::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'));\n INSERT INTO public.business_operations(id,operation_type,idempotency_key,request_fingerprint,initiated_by,result_snapshot,completed_at,request_identity_version,request_identity_snapshot,actor_scope_type,actor_scope_hash)\n VALUES(operation,'aftercare215_exchange',key,fingerprint,actor,result,at,215,identity,'erp_user',actor_hash);\n PERFORM public.tb215_assert_exchange_internal(operation);\n 'balance_before_in_minor_units',c.balance_before_in_minor_units::TEXT,'balance_after_in_minor_units',c.balance_after_in_minor_units::TEXT) FROM public.supplier215_credits c WHERE c.operation_id=existing.id));\n END IF;\n plan:=public.tb215_credit_plan_internal(p_action,p_payload);\n IF p_preview_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(plan::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_CREDIT_PREVIEW_CHANGED'; END IF;\n event:=public.sr208_append_event_internal(operation,case_id,CASE WHEN p_action='credit' THEN 'credit' ELSE 'reverse' END,\n  (plan->>'quantity')::INTEGER,CASE WHEN p_action='credit' THEN -(plan->>'quantity')::INTEGER ELSE(plan->>'quantity')::INTEGER END,\n  0,0,plan->'payload'->>'reason',at,(plan->>'reversesEventId')::UUID);\n INSERT INTO      AND LOWER(operation.request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id')\n        = LOWER(p_order_id::TEXT)\n      AND LOWER(operation.result_snapshot->>'order_id')\n        = LOWER(p_order_id::TEXT)\n      AND operation.completed_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_order.cost_finalized_at;\n\n    IF v_completion_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = original public.supplier215_credits%ROWTYPE; event public.supplier_replacement_events%ROWTYPE;\n quantity INTEGER; amount BIGINT; pending BIGINT; prior BIGINT; balance BIGINT; cached BIGINT; last_id UUID; membership TEXT; reason TEXT:=nullif(btrim(p_payload->>'reason'),'');\nBEGIN\n IF p_action IS NULL OR p_action NOT IN('credit','reverse_credit') OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n  OR reason IS NULL OR length(reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500\n  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_payload) k WHERE NOT k=ANY(CASE WHEN p_action='credit' THEN ARRAY['caseId','quantity','reason'] ELSE ARRAY['eventId','reason'] END))\n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_CREDIT_REQUEST_INVALID'; END IF;\n  quantity:=(p_payload->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases WHERE id=(p_payload->>'caseId')::UUID;\n ELSE\n  SELECT * INTO original FROM public.supplier215_credits WHERE event_id=(p_payload->>'eventId')::UUID AND amount_delta_in_minor_units>0;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_CREDIT_EVENT_INVALID'; END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO STRICT event FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE id=original.event_id;\n  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases WHERE id=original.case_id;\n  quantity:=event.quantity;\n END IF;\n IF c.id IS NULL OR c.supplier_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_CREDIT_CASE_INVALID'; END IF;\n SELECT id INTO last_id FROM public.supplier_replacement_events e WHERE e.case_id=c.id\n  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_events n WHERE n.previous_event_id=e.id);\n SELECT COALESCE(sum(held_delta),0) INTO pending FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE case_id=c.id;\n SELECT current_balance_in_minor_units INTO cached FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=c.supplier_id AND is_active;\n IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n SELECT e.balance INTO balance FROM public.phase133_supplier_balance_evidence_internal() e WHERE e.supplier_id=c.supplier_id;\n IF balance IS NULL OR balance IS DISTINCT FROM cached THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_PAYABLE_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;\n membership:=public.tb215_supplier_membership_internal(c.supplier_id);\n IF p_action='credit' THEN\n  IF quantity>pending THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_EXCEEDS_PENDING'; END IF;\n  SELECT COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN e.action='credit' THEN e.quantity ELSE -e.quantity END),0) INTO prior\n   FROM public.supplier215_credits l JOIN public.supplier_replacement_events e ON e.id=l.event_id WHERE l.case_id=c.id;\n  amount:=round((prior+quantity)*c.unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact)::BIGINT-round(prior*c.unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact)::BIGINT;\n  IF amount<=0 OR amount>balance THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_CREDIT_EXCEEDS_PAYABLE'; END IF;\n ELSE\n  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier215_credits WHERE reverses_credit_event_id=original.event_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_ALREADY_REVERSED'; END IF;\n  IF last_id IS DISTINCT FROM original.event_id OR pending+quantity>c.quantity\n   OR balance IS DISTINCT FROM original.balance_after_in_minor_units OR membership IS DISTINCT FROM original.financial_membership_sha256\n  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_CREDIT_LATER_DEPENDENCY'; END IF;\n  amount:=-original.amount_delta_in_minor_units;\n END IF;\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'payload',p_payload||jsonb_build_object('reason',reason),'caseId',c.id,'supplierId',c.supplier_id,\n  'productId',c.product_id,'quantity',quantity,'amountDeltaInMinorUnits',amount::TEXT,'balanceBeforeInMinorUnits',balance::TEXT,\n  'balanceAfterInMinorUnits',(balance-amount)::TEXT,'lastEventId',last_id,'pendingBefore',pending,'membership',membership,'reversesEventId',original.event_id);\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tb215_damage_candidates_before215_internal(p_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE rows JSONB;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM public.sr208_assert_role_internal('customer_return');\n WITH candidates AS (\n  SELECT 'replacement'::TEXT kind,f.replacement_item_id id,e.issued_at occurred_at,f.product_id\n   FROM public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects f JOIN public.sales_replacement_events e ON e.id=f.replacement_event_id WHERE e.root_order_id=p_order_id\n  UNION ALL SELECT 'return',d.id,d.occurred_at,d.product_id FROM public.inventory_damage_events d JOIN public.sales_return_events e ON e.id=d.return_event_id\n   WHERE e.order_id=p_order_id AND d.origin='customer_return'\n ), sources AS(SELECT c.*,public.sr211_source_internal(c.kind,c.id) source FROM candidates c)\n SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'id',id,'productId',product_id,\n  'productName',(SELECT name_ar FROM public.products WHERE products.id=sources.product_id),'occurredAt',occurred_at,\n  'quantity',source->'quantity','blockedReason',public.sr211_blocked_internal(kind,id)) ORDER BY occurred_at,id),'[]') INTO rows FROM sources;\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',211,'candidates',rows);\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tb215_damage_loss_presentation_internal(p_facts jsonb, p_branch_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE net BIGINT; gross BIGINT; recovered BIGINT; quantity BIGINT; count_rows BIGINT; damage JSONB; reason JSONB;\nBEGIN\n SELECT count(*),COALESCE(sum(w.net_cost),0)::BIGINT,COALESCE(sum(GREATEST(w.net_cost,0)),0)::BIGINT,\n  COALESCE(-sum(LEAST(w.net_cost,0)),0)::BIGINT,COALESCE(sum(w.bad_quantity),0)::BIGINT\n INTO count_rows,net,gross,recovered,quantity FROM public.tb215_warranty_damage_facts_internal() w\n WHERE(p_branch_id IS NULL OR w.branch_id=p_branch_id) AND w.occurred_at>=p_from AND w.occurred_at<p_to;\n IF count_rows=0 THEN RETURN p_facts; END IF;\n damage:=p_facts->'sales'->'damageLosses';\n reason:=jsonb_build_object('code','customer_replacement_inspected','count',count_rows,'quantity',quantity,'amountInMinorUnits',net,\n  'alreadyIncludedInMinorUnits',net,'grossInMinorUnits',gross,'recoveredInMinorUnits',recovered);\n damage:=damage||jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',215,'totalInMinorUnits',(damage->>'totalInMinorUnits')::BIGINT+net,\n  'grossInMinorUnits',(damage->>'grossInMinorUnits')::BIGINT+gross,'recoveredInMinorUnits',(damage->>'recoveredInMinorUnits')::BIGINT+recovered,\n  'alreadyIncludedInMinorUnits',(damage->>'alreadyIncludedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT+net,'reasons',(damage->'reasons')||jsonb_build_array(reason));\n RETURN jsonb_set(p_facts,'{sales,damageLosses}',damage);\nEND $function$\n",

original_bad_quantity bigint, unit_cost_exact numeric, occurred_at timestamp with time zone, reason_code text, reason text, order_id uuid, return_event_id uuid, historical_parcel_size integer, parcel_size_known boolean, base_loss bigint)\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n WITH case_factors AS(\n  SELECT m.root_kind,m.root_id,max(c.units_per_commercial_unit) FILTER(WHERE c.units_per_commercial_unit>1) factor\n  FROM public.tb215_damage_case_roots_internal() m JOIN public.supplier_replacement_cases c ON c.id=m.case_id GROUP BY m.root_kind,m.root_id\n )\n SELECT 'damage'::TEXT,d.id,d.product_id,d.branch_id,d.warehouse_id,d.quantity::BIGINT,d.unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,d.occurred_at,d.reason_code,d.reason,\n  e.order_id,d.return_event_id,\n  CASE WHEN oi.commercial_line_kind='legacy_single_sku_parcel' THEN oi.units_per_sale_package ELSE COALESCE(cf.factor,1) END,\n  oi.commercial_line_kind IN('base_unit','legacy_single_sku_parcel') OR cf.factor IS NOT NULL,d.loss_in_minor_units\n FROM public.inventory_damage_events d LEFT JOIN public.sales_return_events e ON e.id=d.return_event_id\n LEFT JOIN public.sales_replacement_items previous ON d.source_kind='replacement_item' AND previous.id=d.source_id\n LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.id=CASE WHEN d.source_kind='base_order_item' THEN d.source_id WHEN d.source_kind='replacement_item' THEN previous.root_order_item_id END\n LEFT JOIN case_factors cf ON cf.root_kind='damage' AND cf.root_id=d.id\n UNION ALL\n SELECT 'replacement',w.replacement_item_id,w.product_id,w.branch_id,w.warehouse_id,w.bad_quantity::BIGINT,w.unit_cost_exact,w.occurred_at,\n  'customer_replacement',w.reason,w.root_order_id,NULL::UUID,\n  CASE WHEN oi.commercial_line_kind='legacy_single_sku_parcel' THEN oi.units_per_sale_package ELSE 1 END,\n  oi.commercial_line_kind IN('base_unit','legacy_single_sku_parcel'),w.net_cost\n FROM public.tb215_warranty_damage_facts_internal() w JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.id=w.root_order_item_id\n UNION ALL\n SELECT 'supplier',c.id,c.product_id,c.branch_id,c.warehouse_id,\n  s.pending_quantity+s.received_quantity+s.credited_quantity+s.written_off_quantity+s.immediate_quantity,\n  c.unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,c.occurred_at,CASE WHEN s.immediate_quantity>0 THEN 'shop_immediate' ELSE 'shop_pending' END,\n  COALESCE((SELECT e.reason FROM public.supplier_replacement_events e WHERE e.case_id=c.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at,e.id LIMIT 1),'بضاعة عند المورد'),\n  NULL::UUID,NULL::UUID,c.units_per_commercial_unit,c.units_per_commercial_unit>1,0::BIGINT\n FROM public.tb215_damage_case_states_internal() s JOIN public.supplier_replacement_cases c ON c.id=s.case_id WHERE s.root_kind='supplier';\n$function$\n",
        "configuration": [
          "search_path=public, pg_temp"
        ]
      },
      {
        "acl": [
          "postgres=X/postgres"

        "identity": "tb215_exchange_canonical_return_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_items jsonb, p_reason text, p_method text, p_reference text, p_notes text)",
        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tb215_exchange_canonical_return_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_items jsonb, p_reason text, p_method text, p_reference text, p_notes text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE ctx public.aftercare215_exchanges%ROWTYPE; base JSONB; sources JSONB;\nBEGIN\n ctx:=public.tb215_active_exchange_internal();\n PERFORM public.tb215_assert_exchange_return_admission_internal(p_order_id,ctx.return_key,p_items,p_reason,p_method,p_reference,p_notes);\n base:=public.phase42_canonicalize_return_request_before_phase43_internal(p_order_id,p_items,p_reason,NULL,NULL,p_notes);\n sources:=ctx.prepared_plan->'returnPlan'->'request'->'physicalSources';\n PERFORM public.tb215_assert_return_allocation_internal(base,sources);\n RETURN base||jsonb_build_object('refund_method','exchange_credit','physical_sources',sources);\nEND $function$\n",

        ]

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tb215_exchange_completion_guard_internal()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN PERFORM public.tb215_assert_exchange_internal(NEW.operation_id);RETURN NULL;END $function$\n",

      {
        "acl": [
          "postgres=X/postgres"
