        "identity": "tb215_exchange_finalize_internal(p_operation_id uuid)",
        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tb215_exchange_finalize_internal(p_operation_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation public.business_operations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_source RECORD;\n  v_item RECORD;\n  v_order_item public.order_items%ROWTYPE;\n  v_return_event public.sales_return_events%ROWTYPE;\n  v_replacement_event public.sales_replacement_events%ROWTYPE;\n  v_capacity INTEGER;\n  v_consumed INTEGER;\n  v_completion_at TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_item_count INTEGER;\n  v_other_settled INTEGER;\n  v_original_entitlement BIGINT;\n  v_original_cogs BIGINT;\n  v_total_units INTEGER;\n  v_accepted_units INTEGER;\n  v_rejected_units INTEGER;\n  v_raw_damage BIGINT;\n  v_expected_applied_damage BIGINT;\n  v_item_refund_total BIGINT;\n  v_item_raw_total BIGINT;\n  v_item_applied_total BIGINT;\n  v_current_consumption INTEGER;\n  v_cumulative_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_cumulative_refund BIGINT;\n  v_cumulative_cogs BIGINT;\n  v_return_count INTEGER;\n  v_replacement_count INTEGER;\n  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_operation_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22004',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_REQUIRED: Operation identity is required.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Reacquire the same transaction-scoped root gate before locking the\n  -- operation/header. This covers finalization of a draft committed by an\n  -- earlier transaction while remaining re-entrant for create+finalize.\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_operation_order_internal(\n    p_operation_id, NULL\n  );\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_operation\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = p_operation_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_NOT_FOUND: Business operation does not exist.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_operation.idempotency_key IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.request_fingerprint IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.request_identity_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n    OR v_operation.request_identity_snapshot IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.actor_scope_type IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.actor_scope_hash IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.result_snapshot IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.completed_at IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: Immutable request/result evidence is required before finalization.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_return_count\n  FROM public.sales_return_events event\n  WHERE event.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_replacement_count\n  FROM public.sales_replacement_events event\n  WHERE event.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n\n  IF (v_operation.operation_type = 'phase4_return_v1'\n      AND (v_return_count <> 1 OR v_replacement_count <> 0))\n    OR (v_operation.operation_type = 'phase4_replacement_v1'\n      AND (v_replacement_count <> 1 OR v_return_count <> 0))\n    OR v_operation.operation_type NOT IN (\n      'phase4_return_v1', 'phase4_replacement_v1'\n    )\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_SHAPE_INVALID: Operation type and aftercare evidence do not match.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM set_config(\n    'nawasrah.phase4_finalization_operation_id', p_operation_id::TEXT, true\n  );\n\n  IF v_return_count = 1 THEN\n    SELECT * INTO v_return_event\n    FROM public.sales_return_events event\n    WHERE event.operation_id = p_operation_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    PERFORM public.tb215_assert_exchange_return_event_internal(v_return_event.id);\n\n    IF v_return_event.contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n      OR v_return_event.settlement_status NOT IN ('draft', 'inspected')\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_NOT_FINALIZABLE: Return is not a valid versioned draft.';\n    END IF;\n\n    PERFORM public.phase4_assert_aftercare_operation_binding_internal(\n      v_operation.id, 'return', v_return_event.id,\n      v_return_event.contract_version\n    );\n\n    IF v_return_event.outstanding_debt_before_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NULL\n      OR v_return_event.net_collected_before_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NULL\n      OR v_return_event.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units IS NULL\n      OR v_return_event.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units IS NULL\n      OR (v_return_event.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units = 0 AND (\n        v_return_event.refund_method IS NOT NULL\n        OR v_return_event.cash_shift_id IS NOT NULL\n        OR v_return_event.reference_number IS NOT NULL\n      ))\n      OR (v_return_event.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units > 0 AND (\n        v_return_event.refund_method NOT IN ('cash', 'cliq', 'exchange_credit')\n        OR v_return_event.cash_shift_id IS NULL\n        OR (v_return_event.refund_method = 'cliq'\n          AND NULLIF(BTRIM(v_return_event.reference_number), '') IS NULL)\n      ))\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_FINANCIAL_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: Versioned Return financial evidence is incomplete.';\n    END IF;\n\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders customer_order\n    WHERE customer_order.id = v_return_event.order_id FOR UPDATE;\n    v_completion_at := public.phase4_authoritative_completion_internal(\n      v_return_event.order_id\n    );\n\n    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_item_count\n    FROM public.sales_return_items item\n    WHERE item.sales_return_event_id = v_return_event.id\n      AND item.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n    IF v_item_count = 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_ITEMS_REQUIRED: Return requires immutable item evidence.';\n    END IF;\n\n    FOR v_item IN\n      SELECT item.* FROM public.sales_return_items item\n      WHERE item.sales_return_event_id = v_return_event.id\n        AND item.operation_id = p_operation_id\n      ORDER BY item.order_item_id, item.id\n    LOOP\n      SELECT * INTO v_order_item FROM public.order_items item\n      WHERE item.id = v_item.order_item_id FOR UPDATE;\n\n      IF v_item.return_scope = 'parcel_instance' THEN\n        SELECT instance.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n          instance.cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n          instance.units_per_parcel_snapshot\n        INTO v_original_entitlement, v_original_cogs, v_total_units\n        FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n        WHERE instance.id = v_item.parcel_instance_id\n          AND instance.order_item_id = v_item.order_item_id\n        FOR UPDATE;\n\n        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_other_settled\n        FROM public.sales_return_items other_item\n        JOIN public.sales_return_events other_event\n          ON other_event.id = other_item.sales_return_event_id\n        WHERE other_item.parcel_instance_id = v_item.parcel_instance_id\n          AND other_item.id <> v_item.id\n          AND other_event.settlement_status = 'settled';\n        IF v_other_settled > 0 THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n            MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARCEL_RETURN_ALREADY_CONSUMED: Original Parcel Return identity was already settled.';\n        END IF;\n\n        IF EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n          LEFT JOIN public.sales_return_component_inspections inspection\n            ON inspection.parcel_component_id = component.id\n            AND inspection.sales_return_item_id = v_item.id\n          WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = v_item.parcel_instance_id\n            AND (inspection.id IS NULL\n              OR inspection.accepted_quantity + inspection.rejected_quantity\n                <> component.base_quantity\n              OR (inspection.accepted_quantity > 0 AND (\n                inspection.accepted_condition IS NULL\n                OR inspection.accepted_stock_disposition IS NULL\n                OR (inspection.accepted_condition = 'sellable'\n                  AND inspection.accepted_stock_disposition <> 'restock')\n                OR (inspection.accepted_condition = 'supplier_defect'\n                  AND inspection.accepted_stock_disposition <> 'non_sellable')\n              ))\n              OR (inspection.rejected_quantity > 0 AND (\n                inspection.rejection_reason IS NULL\n                OR inspection.rejection_reason <> 'customer_damage'\n                OR inspection.rejected_stock_disposition IS NULL\n                OR inspection.rejected_stock_disposition <> 'returned_to_customer'\n              )))\n        ) THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n            MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARCEL_INSPECTION_INCOMPLETE: Every original Component quantity must be classified before settlement.';\n        END IF;\n\n        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inspection.accepted_quantity), 0)::INTEGER,\n          COALESCE(SUM(inspection.rejected_quantity), 0)::INTEGER,\n          COALESCE(SUM(inspection.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT\n        INTO v_accepted_units, v_rejected_units, v_raw_damage\n        FROM public.sales_return_component_inspections inspection\n        WHERE inspection.sales_return_item_id = v_item.id;\n        v_expected_applied_damage := LEAST(v_original_entitlement, v_raw_damage);\n\n        IF v_accepted_units + v_rejected_units <> v_total_units\n          OR v_item.accepted_base_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM v_accepted_units\n          OR v_item.rejected_base_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM v_rejected_units\n          OR v_item.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n            IS DISTINCT FROM v_raw_damage\n          OR v_item.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n            IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_applied_damage\n          OR v_item.refund_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units\n            IS DISTINCT FROM v_original_entitlement - v_expected_applied_damage\n          OR v_item.original_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n            IS DISTINCT FROM v_original_cogs\n        THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n            MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARCEL_SETTLEMENT_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Parcel accepted/rejected, refund, damage, or COGS evidence does not reconcile.';\n        END IF;\n\n        IF EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n          LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(consumption.consumed_quantity), 0)::INTEGER quantity\n            FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n            CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n              consumption.source_kind, consumption.source_id,\n              consumption.product_id\n            ) root\n            WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n              AND consumption.return_item_id = v_item.id\n              AND root.root_kind = 'parcel_component'\n              AND root.root_id = component.id\n              AND root.product_id = component.product_id\n              AND consumption.consumption_kind = 'return'\n              AND consumption.consumption_state = 'draft'\n          ) used ON true\n          WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = v_item.parcel_instance_id\n            AND used.quantity <> component.base_quantity\n        ) THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n            MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARCEL_CONSUMPTION_INCOMPLETE: Whole Parcel settlement must consume every original Component quantity.';\n        END IF;\n      ELSE\n        v_total_units := v_order_item.quantity;\n        v_original_entitlement :=\n          v_order_item.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units;\n        v_original_cogs := v_order_item.cogs_in_minor_units;\n\n        IF v_original_entitlement IS NULL\n          OR v_item.accepted_base_quantity + v_item.rejected_base_quantity\n            IS DISTINCT FROM v_item.returned_quantity\n      OR (v_order_item.commercial_line_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'legacy_single_sku_parcel'\n        AND (COALESCE(v_item.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units, 0) <> 0\n          OR COALESCE(v_item.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units, 0) <> 0))\n        THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n            MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_BASE_RETURN_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Base Unit Return evidence is incomplete or unsupported.';\n        END IF;\n\n        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(consumption.consumed_quantity), 0)::INTEGER\n        INTO v_current_consumption\n        FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n        CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n          consumption.source_kind, consumption.source_id,\n          consumption.product_id\n        ) root\n        WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n          AND consumption.return_item_id = v_item.id\n          AND root.root_kind = 'base_order_item'\n          AND root.root_id = v_item.order_item_id\n          AND root.product_id = v_item.product_id\n          AND consumption.consumption_kind = 'return'\n          AND consumption.consumption_state = 'draft';\n        IF v_current_consumption IS DISTINCT FROM v_item.returned_quantity THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n            MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_BASE_RETURN_CONSUMPTION_INVALID: Logical Base Unit consumption does not match the Return quantity.';\n        END IF;\n\n        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(consumed.item_quantity), 0)::INTEGER,\n          COALESCE(SUM(consumed.item_refund), 0)::BIGINT,\n          COALESCE(SUM(consumed.item_cogs), 0)::BIGINT\n        INTO v_cumulative_quantity, v_cumulative_refund, v_cumulative_cogs\n        FROM (\n          SELECT item.id,\n            SUM(consumption.consumed_quantity)::INTEGER AS item_quantity,\n            item.refund_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units\n              + item.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units AS item_refund,\n            item.original_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units AS item_cogs\n          FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n          JOIN public.sales_return_items item\n            ON item.id = consumption.return_item_id\n          JOIN public.sales_return_events event\n            ON event.id = item.sales_return_event_id\n          CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n            consumption.source_kind, consumption.source_id,\n            consumption.product_id\n          ) root\n          WHERE root.root_kind = 'base_order_item'\n            AND root.root_id = v_item.order_item_id\n            AND consumption.consumption_kind = 'return'\n            AND (consumption.consumption_state = 'settled'\n              OR (consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n                AND consumption.consumption_state = 'draft'))\n            AND event.settlement_status <> 'cancelled'\n          GROUP BY item.id, item.refund_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units, item.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units,\n            item.original_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n        ) consumed;\n\n        IF v_cumulative_quantity > v_total_units\n          OR v_cumulative_refund > v_original_entitlement\n          OR v_cumulative_cogs > v_original_cogs\n          OR (v_cumulative_quantity = v_total_units\n            AND (v_cumulative_refund <> v_original_entitlement\n              OR v_cumulative_cogs <> v_original_cogs))\n        THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n            MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_BASE_RETURN_CUMULATIVE_BOUND_INVALID: Quantity, refund, COGS, or final residual exceeds the immutable sale bounds.';\n        END IF;\n      END IF;\n    END LOOP;\n\n    IF EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n      WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n        AND consumption.consumption_state = 'draft'\n        AND NOT EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM public.sales_return_items item\n          CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n            consumption.source_kind, consumption.source_id,\n            consumption.product_id\n          ) root\n          WHERE item.id = consumption.return_item_id\n            AND item.operation_id = p_operation_id\n            AND consumption.consumption_kind = 'return'\n            AND consumption.replacement_item_id IS NULL\n            AND (\n              (item.return_scope = 'base_unit'\n                AND consumption.product_id = item.product_id\n                AND root.root_kind = 'base_order_item'\n                AND root.root_id = item.order_item_id\n                AND root.product_id = item.product_id)\n              OR (item.return_scope = 'parcel_instance'\n                AND root.root_kind = 'parcel_component'\n                AND root.product_id = consumption.product_id\n                AND EXISTS (\n                  SELECT 1\n                  FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n                  WHERE component.id = root.root_id\n                    AND component.parcel_instance_id = item.parcel_instance_id\n                    AND component.product_id = consumption.product_id\n                ))\n            )\n        )\n    ) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_CONSUMPTION_SCOPE_INVALID: Return consumption contains an unauthorized logical source.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(item.refund_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT,\n      COALESCE(SUM(item.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT,\n      COALESCE(SUM(item.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT\n    INTO v_item_refund_total, v_item_raw_total, v_item_applied_total\n    FROM public.sales_return_items item\n    WHERE item.sales_return_event_id = v_return_event.id;\n\n    IF v_return_event.merchandise_refund_amount_in_minor_units\n        IS DISTINCT FROM v_item_refund_total\n      OR v_return_event.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n        IS DISTINCT FROM v_item_raw_total\n      OR v_return_event.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n        IS DISTINCT FROM v_item_applied_total\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_FINANCIAL_RECONCILIATION_FAILED: Return item and event financial evidence do not reconcile.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT * INTO v_replacement_event\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_events event\n    WHERE event.operation_id = p_operation_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    IF v_replacement_event.contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_REPLACEMENT_NOT_FINALIZABLE: Replacement is not a valid versioned draft.';\n    END IF;\n    PERFORM public.phase4_assert_aftercare_operation_binding_internal(\n      v_operation.id, 'replacement', v_replacement_event.id,\n      v_replacement_event.contract_version\n    );\n    IF v_replacement_event.replacement_status <> 'draft' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_REPLACEMENT_NOT_FINALIZABLE: Replacement is not a draft.';\n    END IF;\n\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders customer_order\n    WHERE customer_order.id = v_replacement_event.root_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n    v_completion_at := public.phase4_authoritative_completion_internal(\n      v_replacement_event.root_order_id\n    );\n    IF v_completion_at IS DISTINCT FROM\n        v_replacement_event.original_completed_at_snapshot THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_REPLACEMENT_WINDOW_INVALID: Replacement must use the original completion evidence.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT v_defect INTEGER;\n  v_damage INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_base_request->'items')\n  LOOP\n    IF v_item->>'return_scope' = 'base_unit' THEN\n      v_root_kind := 'base_order_item';\n      v_root_id := v_item->>'order_item_id';\n      v_quantity := (v_item->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n      SELECT FROM COALESCE((v_item->>'customer_damage_quantity')::INTEGER,0)\n        OR (v_item->>'stock_disposition' = 'restock' AND v_sellable <= 0)\n        OR (v_item->>'stock_disposition' = 'damaged' AND v_root_id := v_component->>'parcel_component_id';\n        SELECT COALESCE(SUM((source->>'sellable_restock_quantity')::INTEGER), 0)::INTEGER,\n          COALESCE(SUM((source->>'defect_non_sellable_quantity')::INTEGER), 0)::INTEGER,\n          COALESCE(SUM((source->>'customer_damage_quantity')::INTEGER), 0)::INTEGER\n        INTO v_sellable, v_defect,         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tb215_return_source_cost_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_source jsonb)\n RETURNS numeric\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n#variable_conflict use_variable\nDECLARE cost NUMERIC(24,6); capacity INTEGER; consumed BIGINT; pid UUID:=(p_source->>'product_id')::UUID;\n kind TEXT:=p_source->>'source_kind'; source_id UUID:=(p_source->>'source_id')::UUID;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM public.phase43_assert_return_physical_source_internal(p_order_id,p_source->>'root_source_kind',(p_source->>'root_source_id')::UUID,kind,source_id,pid);\n IF kind='base_order_item' THEN\n  SELECT COALESCE(unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact,unit_cost_in_minor_units::NUMERIC),quantity INTO cost,capacity\n   FROM public.order_items WHERE id=source_id AND product_id=pid;\n ELSIF kind='parcel_component' THEN\n  SELECT COALESCE(round(exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units/NULLIF(base_quantity,0),6),unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units),base_quantity INTO cost,capacity\n   FROM public.order_parcel_components WHERE id=source_id AND product_id=pid;\n ELSE\n  SELECT replacement_unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact,quantity INTO cost,capacity FROM public.sales_replacement_items WHERE id=source_id AND product_id=pid;\n END IF;\n IF cost IS NULL OR cost<0 OR capacity IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_HISTORICAL_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;\n SELECT COALESCE(sum(c.consumed_quantity),0) INTO consumed FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions c\n  WHERE c.source_kind=kind AND c.source_id=source_id AND c.consumption_state='settled';\n IF consumed+(p_source->>'quantity')::INTEGER>capacity THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE4_LOGICAL_QUANTITY_ALREADY_CONSUMED'; END IF;\n RETURN cost;\nEND $function$\n",

WHERE link.cash_shift_id = p_shift_id AND NOT COALESCE(payment.is_reversed, false);\n  v_comp:=public.cheque_shift_settlement_section_internal(p_shift_id);\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tb215_supplier_membership_internal(p_supplier_id uuid)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n SELECT encode(extensions.digest(jsonb_build_object(\n  'direct',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id),'[]') FROM public.supplier_receipts r WHERE r.supplier_id=p_supplier_id),\n  'purchase',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.id),'[]') FROM public.purchase_receipts r JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON po.id=r.purchase_order_id WHERE po.supplier_id=p_supplier_id),\n  'legacyPurchasePayable',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.purchase_order_id),'[]') FROM public.phase133_legacy_po_payables_internal() r WHERE r.supplier_id=p_supplier_id),\n  'payments',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id),'[]') FROM public.supplier_payments r WHERE r.supplier_id=p_supplier_id),\n  'opening',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id),'[]') FROM public.supplier_opening_balances r WHERE r.supplier_id=p_supplier_id),\n  'claims',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id),'[]') FROM public.cheque_compensation_claims r WHERE r.party_kind='supplier' AND r.party_id=p_supplier_id)\n )::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tb215_supplier_writer_before215_internal(p_action text, p_payload jsonb, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY UUID:=gen_random_uuid();\n existing public.business_operations%ROWTYPE; c public.supplier_replacement_cases%ROWTYPE;\n e public.supplier_replacement_events%ROWTYPE; f public.supplier_replacement_inventory_effects%ROWTYPE;\n d public.inventory_damage_events%ROWTYPE; p public.products%ROWTYPE;\n reason TEXT; allowed TEXT[]; supplier_id UUID; product_id UUID; warehouse_id UUID; branch_id UUID;\n commercial INTEGER; units INTEGER; qty INTEGER; held BIGINT; written BIGINT; expense BIGINT:=0; stock_delta INTEGER:=0;\n case_id UUID; event_at TIMESTAMPTZ; JSONB; item JSONB; result JSONB; manifest JSONB; order_id UUID; current_values BOOLEAN;\nBEGIN\n actor:=public.sr208_assert_role_internal(p_action);current_values:=public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner']);\n IF k IS NULL OR char_length(k) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_KEY_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_INVALID'; END IF;\n reason:=NULLIF(btrim(p_payload->>'reason'),'');\n IF reason IS NULL OR char_length(reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_REASON_INVALID'; END IF;\n allowed:=CASE WHEN p_action IN ('shop_pending','shop_immediate') THEN ARRAY['supplierId','productId','warehouseId','quantity','unit','reason']\n  WHEN p_action='shop_damage' THEN ARRAY['productId','warehouseId','quantity','unit','reason','reasonCode']\n  WHEN p_action IN ('receive','writeoff') THEN ARRAY['caseId','quantity','reason']\n  WHEN p_action='reverse' THEN ARRAY['eventId','reason']\n  ELSE ARRAY['orderId','items','physicalSources','reason','refundMethod','referenceNumber','notes','supplierAssignments'] END;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_payload) x WHERE NOT x=ANY(allowed)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_FIELD_INVALID'; END IF;\n request:=jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'payload',p_payload||jsonb_build_object('reason',reason));\n IF p_action='customer_return' THEN\n  order_id:=(p_payload->>'orderId')::UUID;\n  PERFORM set_config('nawasrah.phase43_return_physical_sources',public.phase43_canonicalize_return_physical_sources_internal(p_payload->'physicalSources')::TEXT,true);\n  financial_request:=public.phase42_canonicalize_return_request_internal(order_id,p_payload->'items',reason,\n   p_payload->>'refundMethod',p_payload->>'referenceNumber',p_payload->>'notes');\n  IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_ASSIGNMENTS_INVALID';\n  END IF;\n  FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') LOOP\n   IF jsonb_typeof(item) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(item))<>3\n    OR NULLIF(item->>'supplierId','') IS NULL OR NULLIF(item->>'sourceId','') IS NULL\n    OR item->>'sourceKind' NOT IN ('base_order_item','parcel_component','replacement_item') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_ASSIGNMENTS_INVALID';\n   END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') x GROUP BY x->>'sourceKind',(x->>'sourceId')::UUID HAVING count(*)<>1) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_ASSIGNMENTS_INVALID';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceKind',x->>'sourceKind','sourceId',(x->>'sourceId')::UUID,'supplierId',(x->>'supplierId')::UUID) ORDER BY x->>'sourceKind',(x->>'sourceId')::UUID)\n  INTO assignments FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') x;\n  request:=jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'financialRequest',financial_request,'supplierAssignments',assignments);\n  -- Exactly the old canonical key/lock/evidence helper, before ANY order or\n  -- inventory lock. A previously standalone return cannot acquire a C9 tail.\n  financial_replay:=public.phase4_resolve_operation_replay_internal('phase4_return_v1',k,\n   public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal('erp_user',actor,NULL,NULL),public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(financial_request));\n END IF;\n fingerprint:=encode(extensions.digest(request::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('supplier-replacement208|'||actor::TEXT||'|'||k,0));\n SELECT * INTO existing FROM public.business_operations WHERE operation_type='supplier_replacement208' AND initiated_by=actor AND idempotency_key=k;\n IF FOUND THEN\n  IF existing.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n  RETURN result;\n END IF;\n IF p_action='customer_return' AND financial_replay->>'decision' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NEW' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_IDENTITY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n IF p_action IN ('shop_pending','shop_immediate','shop_damage') THEN\n  product_id:=(p_payload->>'productId')::UUID;warehouse_id:=(p_payload->>'warehouseId')::UUID;\n  supplier_id:=(p_payload->>'supplierId')::UUID;\n  IF p_payload->>'unit' IS NULL OR p_payload->>'unit' NOT IN ('base','parcel')\n   OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'quantity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (p_payload->>'quantity')!~'^[1-9][0-9]*$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_QUANTITY_INVALID'; END IF;\n  commercial:=(p_payload->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n  -- Warehouse table access precedes inventory locks, matching199 disable.\n  SELECT w.branch_id INTO branch_id FROM public.warehouses w JOIN public.branches b ON b.id=w.branch_id AND b.is_active WHERE w.id=warehouse_id AND w.is_active;\n  IF branch_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_WAREHOUSE_INVALID'; END IF;\n  IF p_action<>'shop_damage' THEN\n   PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers s WHERE s.id=supplier_id AND s.is_active;\n   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY[product_id]);\n  IF p_action<>'shop_damage' THEN\n   -- Canonical receipt cancellation locks inventory BEFORE suppliers. Taking\n   -- a blocking supplier FK lock first would invert that hierarchy. Acquire\n   -- the parent late without waiting; this also avoids cross-domain customer\n   -- financial cycles in the atomic-return path below.\n   BEGIN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers s WHERE s.id=supplier_id AND s.is_active FOR SHARE NOWAIT;\n   EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PARENT_BUSY_RETRY: تغيّر قفل المورد؛ أعد نفس المحاولة.';\n   END;\n   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO p FROM public.products WHERE id=product_id AND is_active AND NOT COALESCE(is_flavor_master,false);\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PRODUCT_INVALID'; END IF;\n  units:=CASE WHEN p_payload->>'unit'='parcel' THEN p.units_per_sale_unit ELSE 1 END;\n  IF units IS NULL OR units<1 OR commercial::BIGINT*units>2147483647 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_QUANTITY_INVALID';         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_customer_address_map_url()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_url TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(NEW.google_maps_url), '');\n  v_coordinates DOUBLE PRECISION[];\nBEGIN\n  IF v_url IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF CHAR_LENGTH(v_url) > 1000\n    OR v_url ~ '[[:space:][:cntrl:]]'\n    OR NOT (\n      v_url ~* '^https://(?:maps\\.app\\.goo\\.gl|maps\\.google\\.com)(?:/|\\?|#|$)'\n      OR v_url ~* '^https://goo\\.gl/maps(?:/|\\?|#|$)'\n      OR v_url ~* '^https://(?:www\\.)?google\\.com/maps(?:/|\\?|#|$)'\n    )\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'ألصق رابط مشاركة صحيحًا من خرائط Google لموقع التوصيل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  NEW.google_maps_url := v_url;\n\n  IF NEW.latitude IS NULL AND NEW.longitude IS NULL THEN\n    v_coordinates := public.extract_google_maps_coordinates(v_url);\n\n    IF v_coordinates IS NOT NULL THEN\n      NEW.latitude := v_coordinates[1];\n      NEW.longitude := v_coordinates[2];\n      NEW.location_source := 'map_pin';\n      NEW.location_confirmed := true;\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF NEW.latitude IS NOT NULL AND NEW.longitude IS NOT NULL THEN\n    IF NEW.latitude NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90\n      OR NEW.longitude NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'إحداثيات موقع التوصيل غير صحيحة.';\n    END IF;\n\n    NEW.location_confirmed := true;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_order_inventory_reservation_chain()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_line_kind TEXT;\n  v_order_item_product_id UUID;\n  v_component_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_component_count INTEGER;\n  v_instance_finalized_at TIMESTAMPTZ;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT item.commercial_line_kind, item.product_id\n  INTO v_line_kind, v_order_item_product_id\n  FROM public.order_items item\n  WHERE item.id = NEW.order_item_id\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23503',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'order_inventory_reservations_order_item_id_fkey',\n      MESSAGE = 'Reservation Order Item does not exist.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel' THEN\n    IF NEW.parcel_instance_id IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'order_inventory_reservations_parcel_required_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'A configurable Parcel reservation requires its exact Parcel Instance.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT\n      SUM(component.base_quantity)::INTEGER,\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER,\n      MAX(instance.finalized_at)\n    INTO v_component_quantity, v_component_count, v_instance_finalized_at\n    FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n    JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance\n      ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id\n    WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = NEW.parcel_instance_id\n      AND component.product_id = NEW.product_id\n      AND component.operation_id = NEW.operation_id\n      AND instance.order_item_id = NEW.order_item_id\n      AND instance.order_id = NEW.order_id;\n\n    -- The Phase-1 contract permits a component reservation smaller than the\n    -- immutable component quantity. The later coordinator is responsible for\n    -- atomically reserving the full composition; this generic relationship\n    -- guard only prevents an untraceable or over-capacity component hold.\n    -- Missing/cross-chain component identity is left to the existing composite\n    -- foreign keys so their established SQLSTATE/constraint identities remain\n    -- backward compatible. This guard adds only finalized/quantity semantics.\n    IF v_component_count > 0\n      AND (\n        v_instance_finalized_at IS NULL\n        OR NEW.reserved_quantity > v_component_quantity\n      )\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'order_inventory_reservations_component_quantity_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_RESERVATION_COMPONENT_MISMATCH: Reservation must reference a finalized Parcel component without exceeding its Base Unit quantity.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    IF NEW.parcel_instance_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'order_inventory_reservations_base_parcel_absent_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'A Base Unit reservation cannot claim a Parcel Instance.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_order_item_product_id IS NULL\n      OR NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order_item_product_id\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'order_inventory_reservations_base_product_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'Base Unit reservation product must match its original Order Item product.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_phase2_inventory_movement_source()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_operation_id UUID;\n  v_receipt_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.supplier_receipt_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    SELECT item.product_id, item.operation_id, item.supplier_receipt_id\n    INTO v_product_id, v_operation_id, v_receipt_id\n    FROM public.supplier_receipt_items item\n    WHERE item.id = NEW.supplier_receipt_item_id;\n    IF NOT FOUND OR NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_product_id\n      OR NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_operation_id\n      OR NEW.reference_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_receipt_id\n      OR NEW.reference_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'supplier_receipt'\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'inventory_movements_supplier_receipt_item_chain_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'Inventory Movement must match its Supplier Receipt component.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF NEW.purchase_receipt_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    SELECT item.product_id, item.operation_id, item.purchase_receipt_id\n    INTO v_product_id, v_operation_id, v_receipt_id\n    FROM public.purchase_receipt_items item\n    WHERE item.id = NEW.purchase_receipt_item_id;\n    IF NOT FOUND OR NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_product_id\n      OR NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_operation_id\n      OR NEW.reference_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_receipt_id\n      OR NEW.reference_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'purchase_receipt'\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'inventory_movements_purchase_receipt_item_chain_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'Inventory Movement must match its Purchase Receipt component.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_product_parcel_configuration()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_family public.products%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO v_family\n  FROM public.products\n  WHERE id = NEW.family_product_id;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_family.flavor_master_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Parcel configuration must reference a family root product.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.composition_mode = 'configurable_mix'\n    AND NOT v_family.is_flavor_master\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Configurable mixed parcels require a flavor family master.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_family.sale_unit_id IS NULL\n    OR COALESCE(v_family.units_per_sale_unit, 0) <= 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Parcel family requires a valid configured sale unit and pack size.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "identity": "validate_purchase_order_component_family_v2()",
        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_purchase_order_component_family_v2()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_item public.purchase_order_items%ROWTYPE;\n  v_actual_family UUID;\n  v_is_master BOOLEAN;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO v_item\n  FROM public.purchase_order_items item\n  WHERE item.id = NEW.purchase_order_item_id\n  FOR SHARE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'purchase_order_item_components_item_fkey',\n      MESSAGE = 'Purchase Order Item does not exist.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT COALESCE(product.flavor_master_product_id, product.id), product.is_flavor_master\n  INTO v_actual_family, v_is_master\n  FROM public.products product WHERE product.id = NEW.product_id;\n  IF v_is_master OR (\n    v_item.commercial_line_kind = 'base_unit'\n      AND NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_item.product_id\n  ) OR (\n    v_item.commercial_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel'\n      AND v_actual_family IS DISTINCT FROM v_item.family_product_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'purchase_order_item_components_family_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'Purchase Order component must match its immutable commercial family.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_purchase_receipt_item_family_v2()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_line public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines%ROWTYPE;\n  v_actual_family UUID;\n  v_is_master BOOLEAN;\n  v_po_product_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.commercial_line_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO v_line\n  FROM public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines line\n  WHERE line.id = NEW.commercial_line_id;\n  SELECT COALESCE(product.flavor_master_product_id, product.id), product.is_flavor_master\n  INTO v_actual_family, v_is_master\n  FROM public.products product WHERE product.id = NEW.product_id;\n  SELECT item.product_id INTO v_po_product_id\n  FROM public.purchase_order_items item WHERE item.id = v_line.purchase_order_item_id;\n  IF v_is_master OR (\n    v_line.commercial_line_kind = 'base_unit'\n      AND NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_po_product_id\n  ) OR (\n    v_line.commercial_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel'\n      AND v_actual_family IS DISTINCT FROM v_line.family_product_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'purchase_receipt_items_commercial_family_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'Purchase Receipt component must match its commercial Family.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_sales_return_item_line_kind()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_line_kind TEXT;\n  v_order_item_product_id UUID;\n  v_original_parcel_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  -- Return writes and Order Item mutations share the same parent-first lock.\n  SELECT item.commercial_line_kind, item.product_id\n  INTO v_line_kind, v_order_item_product_id\n  FROM public.order_items item\n  WHERE item.id = NEW.order_item_id\n    AND item.order_id = NEW.order_id\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23503',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'sales_return_items_order_item_id_order_id_fkey',\n      MESSAGE = 'Return Item Order Item does not belong to the original Order.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_line_kind IN ('base_unit','legacy_single_sku_parcel') THEN\n    IF v_line_kind='legacy_single_sku_parcel' THEN\n      PERFORM public.package_d_assert_modern_sale_internal(NEW.order_id,'PHASE42_SALE_CONTRACT_UNSUPPORTED');\n      PERFORM public.package_d_assert_whole_single_sku_quantity_internal(NEW.order_item_id,NEW.returned_quantity);\n    END IF;\n    IF NEW.return_scope IS DISTINCT FROM 'base_unit'\n      OR NEW.parcel_instance_id IS NOT NULL\n      OR NEW.product_id IS NULL\n      OR NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order_item_product_id\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'sales_return_items_base_line_kind_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'A Base Unit line permits only a matching Base Unit return.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF v_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel' THEN\n    IF NEW.return_scope IS DISTINCT FROM 'parcel_instance'\n      OR NEW.parcel_instance_id IS NULL\n      OR NEW.product_id IS NOT NULL\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'sales_return_items_parcel_line_kind_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'A configurable Parcel line permits only a whole Parcel Instance return.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT instance.id\n    INTO v_original_parcel_id\n    FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n    WHERE instance.id = NEW.parcel_instance_id\n      AND instance.order_item_id = NEW.order_item_id\n      AND instance.order_id = NEW.order_id\n    FOR SHARE;\n\n    IF v_original_parcel_id IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'sales_return_items_original_parcel_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'Parcel return must reference an exact original Parcel Instance from the commercial line.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    -- NULL historical rows remain unsupported; no commercial mode is guessed.\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'sales_return_items_supported_line_kind_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'New Return Item mode cannot be proven for this legacy commercial line.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_supplier_receipt_item_commercial_family()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_line_kind TEXT;\n  v_expected_family UUID;\n  v_actual_family UUID;\n  v_is_master BOOLEAN;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.commercial_line_id IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT line.commercial_line_kind, line.family_product_id\n  INTO v_line_kind, v_expected_family\n  FROM public.supplier_receipt_commercial_lines line\n  WHERE line.id = NEW.commercial_line_id;\n\n  IF v_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel' THEN\n    SELECT COALESCE(product.flavor_master_product_id, product.id),\n      product.is_flavor_master\n    INTO v_actual_family, v_is_master\n    FROM public.products product\n    WHERE product.id = NEW.product_id;\n\n    IF v_actual_family IS NULL\n      OR v_is_master\n      OR v_actual_family IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_family\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'supplier_receipt_item_commercial_family_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'Supplier receipt component must belong to its commercial Family.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION realtime.apply_rls(wal jsonb, max_record_bytes integer DEFAULT (1024 * 1024))\n RETURNS SETOF realtime.wal_rls\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n    -- Regclass of the table e.g. public.notes\n    entity_ regclass = (quote_ident(wal ->> 'schema') || '.' || quote_ident(wal ->> 'table'))::regclass;\n\n    -- I, U, D, T: insert, update ...\n    action realtime.action = (\n        case wal ->> 'action'\n            when 'I' then 'INSERT'\n            when 'U' then 'UPDATE'\n            when 'D' then 'DELETE'\n            else 'ERROR'\n        end\n    );\n\n    -- Is row level security enabled for the table\n    is_rls_enabled bool = relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = entity_;\n\n    subscriptions realtime.subscription[] = array_agg(subs)\n        from\n            realtime.subscription subs\n        where\n            subs.entity = entity_\n            -- Filter by action early - only get subscriptions interested in this action\n            -- action_filter column can be: '*' (all), 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', or 'DELETE'\n            and (subs.action_filter = '*' or subs.action_filter = action::text);\n\n    -- Subscription vars\n    working_role regrole;\n    working_selected_columns text[];\n    claimed_role regrole;\n    claims jsonb;\n\n    subscription_id uuid;\n    subscription_has_access bool;\n    visible_to_subscription_ids uuid[] = '{}';\n\n    -- structured info for wal's columns\n    columns realtime.wal_column[];\n    -- previous identity values for update/delete\n    old_columns realtime.wal_column[];\n\n    error_record_exceeds_max_size boolean = octet_length(wal::text) > max_record_bytes;\n\n    -- Primary jsonb output for record\n    output jsonb;\n\n    -- Loop record for iterating unique roles (outer loop)\n    role_record record;\n    -- Loop record for iterating unique selected_columns within a role (inner loop)\n    cols_record record;\n    -- Subscription ids visible at the role level (before fanning out by selected_columns)\n    visible_role_sub_ids uuid[] = '{}';\n\nbegin\n    perform set_config('role', null, true);\n\n    columns =\n        array_agg(\n            (\n                x->>'name',\n                x->>'type',\n                x->>'typeoid',\n                realtime.cast(\n                    (x->'value') #>> '{}',\n                    coalesce(\n                        (x->>'typeoid')::regtype, -- null when wal2json version <= 2.4\n                        (x->>'type')::regtype\n                    )\n                ),\n                (pks ->> 'name') is not null,\n                true\n            )::realtime.wal_column\n        )\n        from\n            jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'columns') x\n            left join jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'pk') pks\n                on (x ->> 'name') = (pks ->> 'name');\n\n    old_columns =\n        array_agg(\n            (\n                x->>'name',\n                x->>'type',\n                x->>'typeoid',\n                realtime.cast(\n                    (x->'value') #>> '{}',\n                    coalesce(\n                        (x->>'typeoid')::regtype, -- null when wal2json version <= 2.4\n                        (x->>'type')::regtype\n                    )\n                ),\n                (pks ->> 'name') is not null,\n                true\n            )::realtime.wal_column\n        )\n        from\n            jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'identity') x\n            left join jsonb_array_elements(wal -> 'pk') pks\n                on (x ->> 'name') = (pks ->> 'name');\n\n    for role_record in\n        select claims_role\n        from (select distinct claims_role from unnest(subscriptions)) t\n        order by claims_role::text\n    loop\n        working_role := role_record.claims_role;\n\n        -- Update `is_selectable` for columns and old_columns (once per role)\n        columns =\n            array_agg(\n                (\n                    c.name,\n                    c.type_name,\n                    c.type_oid,\n                    c.value,\n                    c.is_pkey,\n                    pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, c.name, 'SELECT')\n                )::realtime.wal_column\n            )\n            from\n                unnest(columns) c;\n\n        old_columns =\n                array_agg(\n                    (\n                        c.name,\n                        c.type_name,\n                        c.type_oid,\n                        c.value,\n                        c.is_pkey,\n                        pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, c.name, 'SELECT')\n                    )::realtime.wal_column\n                )\n                from\n                    unnest(old_columns) c;\n\n        if action <> 'DELETE' and count(1) = 0 from unnest(columns) c where c.is_pkey then\n            -- Fan out 400 error per distinct selected_columns for this role\n            for cols_record in\n                select selected_columns\n                from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t\n                order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '')\n            loop\n                working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns;\n                return next (\n                    jsonb_build_object(\n                        'schema', wal ->> 'schema',\n                        'table', wal ->> 'table',\n                        'type', action\n                    ),\n                    is_rls_enabled,\n                    (select array_agg(s.subscription_id) from unnest(subscriptions) as s where s.claims_role = working_role and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns)),\n                    array['Error 400: Bad Request, no primary key']\n                )::realtime.wal_rls;\n            end loop;\n\n        -- The claims role does not have SELECT permission to the primary key of entity\n        elsif action <> 'DELETE' and sum(c.is_selectable::int) <> count(1) from unnest(columns) c where c.is_pkey then\n            -- Fan out 401 error per distinct selected_columns for this role\n            for cols_record in\n                select selected_columns\n                from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t\n                order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '')\n            loop\n                working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns;\n                return next (\n                    jsonb_build_object(\n                        'schema', wal ->> 'schema',\n                        'table', wal ->> 'table',\n                        'type', action\n                    ),\n                    is_rls_enabled,\n                    (select array_agg(s.subscription_id) from unnest(subscriptions) as s where s.claims_role = working_role and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns)),\n                    array['Error 401: Unauthorized']\n                )::realtime.wal_rls;\n            end loop;\n\n        else\n            -- Create the prepared statement (once per role)\n            if is_rls_enabled and action <> 'DELETE' then\n                if (select 1 from pg_prepared_statements where name = 'walrus_rls_stmt' limit 1) > 0 then\n                    deallocate walrus_rls_stmt;\n                end if;\n                execute realtime.build_prepared_statement_sql('walrus_rls_stmt', entity_, columns);\n            end if;\n\n            -- Collect all visible subscription IDs for this role (filter check + RLS check)\n            visible_role_sub_ids = '{}';\n\n            for subscription_id, claims in (\n                    select\n                        subs.subscription_id,\n                        subs.claims\n                    from\n                        unnest(subscriptions) subs\n                    where\n                        subs.entity = entity_\n                        and subs.claims_role = working_role\n                        and (\n                            realtime.is_visible_through_filters(columns, subs.filters)\n                            or (\n                              action = 'DELETE'\n                              and realtime.is_visible_through_filters(old_columns, subs.filters)\n                            )\n                        )\n            ) loop\n\n                if not is_rls_enabled or action = 'DELETE' then\n                    visible_role_sub_ids = visible_role_sub_ids || subscription_id;\n                else\n                    -- Check if RLS allows the role to see the record\n                    perform\n                        -- Trim leading and trailing quotes from working_role because set_config\n                        -- doesn't recognize the role as valid if they are included\n                        set_config('role', trim(both '\"' from working_role::text), true),\n                        set_config('request.jwt.claims', claims::text, true);\n\n                    execute 'execute walrus_rls_stmt' into subscription_has_access;\n\n                    -- Reset the role on every FOR..LOOP batch execution.\n                    -- The first batch of 10 rows is pre-fetched using the current connection role (PG internal behaviour)\n                    -- then we have to reset it again otherwise it would use the role defined in the `set_config` above\n                    -- to fetch the remaining rows when rows>10, which could be a user-defined role that lacks execution grants.\n                    -- The flow is:\n                    --   1. run batch with conn role\n                    --   2. set_config working_role\n                    --   3. execute walrus\n                    --   4. reset role (revert)\n                    --   5. repeat\n                    perform set_config('role', null, true);\n\n                    if subscription_has_access then\n                        visible_role_sub_ids = visible_role_sub_ids || subscription_id;\n                    end if;\n                end if;\n            end loop;\n\n            perform set_config('role', null, true);\n\n            -- Inner loop: per distinct selected_columns for this role\n            for cols_record in\n                select selected_columns\n                from (select distinct selected_columns from unnest(subscriptions) s where s.claims_role = working_role) t\n                order by coalesce(array_to_string(selected_columns, ','), '')\n            loop\n                working_selected_columns := cols_record.selected_columns;\n\n                output = jsonb_build_object(\n                    'schema', wal ->> 'schema',\n                    'table', wal ->> 'table',\n                    'type', action,\n                    'commit_timestamp', to_char(\n                        ((wal ->> 'timestamp')::timestamptz at time zone 'utc'),\n                        'YYYY-MM-DD\"T\"HH24:MI:SS.MS\"Z\"'\n                    ),\n                    'columns', (\n                        select\n                            jsonb_agg(\n                                jsonb_build_object(\n                                    'name', pa.attname,\n                                    'type', pt.typname\n                                )\n                                order by pa.attnum asc\n                            )\n                        from\n                            pg_attribute pa\n                            join pg_type pt\n                                on pa.atttypid = pt.oid\n                            left join (\n                                select unnest(conkey) as pkey_attnum\n                                from pg_constraint\n                                where conrelid = entity_ and contype = 'p'\n                            ) pk on pk.pkey_attnum = pa.attnum\n                        where\n                            attrelid = entity_\n                            and attnum > 0\n                            and pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(working_role, entity_, pa.attname, 'SELECT')\n                            and (working_selected_columns is null or pa.attname = any(working_selected_columns) or pk.pkey_attnum is not null)\n                    )\n                )\n                -- Add \"record\" key for insert and update\n                || case\n                    when action in ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') then\n                        jsonb_build_object(\n                            'record',\n                            (\n                                select\n                                    jsonb_object_agg(\n                                        -- if unchanged toast, get column name and value from old record\n                                        coalesce((c).name, (oc).name),\n                                        case\n                                            when (c).name is null then (oc).value\n                                            else (c).value\n                                        end\n                                    )\n                                from\n                                    unnest(columns) c\n                                    full outer join unnest(old_columns) oc\n                                        on (c).name = (oc).name\n                                where\n                                    coalesce((c).is_selectable, (oc).is_selectable)\n                                    and (working_selected_columns is null or coalesce((c).name, (oc).name) = any(working_selected_columns) or coalesce((c).is_pkey, (oc).is_pkey))\n                                    and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64))\n                            )\n                        )\n                    else '{}'::jsonb\n                end\n                -- Add \"old_record\" key for update and delete\n                || case\n                    when action = 'UPDATE' then\n                        jsonb_build_object(\n                                'old_record',\n                                (\n                                    select jsonb_object_agg((c).name, (c).value)\n                                    from unnest(old_columns) c\n                                    where\n                                        (c).is_selectable\n                                        and (working_selected_columns is null or (c).name = any(working_selected_columns) or (c).is_pkey)\n                                        and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64))\n                                )\n                            )\n                    when action = 'DELETE' then\n                        jsonb_build_object(\n                            'old_record',\n                            (\n                                select jsonb_object_agg((c).name, (c).value)\n                                from unnest(old_columns) c\n                                where\n                                    (c).is_selectable\n                                    and (working_selected_columns is null or (c).name = any(working_selected_columns) or (c).is_pkey)\n                                    and ( not error_record_exceeds_max_size or (octet_length((c).value::text) <= 64))\n                                    and ( not is_rls_enabled or (c).is_pkey ) -- if RLS enabled, we can't secure deletes so filter to pkey\n                            )\n                        )\n                    else '{}'::jsonb\n                end;\n\n                -- Filter visible_role_sub_ids to those matching the current selected_columns group\n                visible_to_subscription_ids = coalesce(\n                    (\n                        select array_agg(s.subscription_id)\n                        from unnest(subscriptions) s\n                        where s.claims_role = working_role\n                          and (s.selected_columns is not distinct from working_selected_columns)\n                          and s.subscription_id = any(visible_role_sub_ids)\n                    ),\n                    '{}'::uuid[]\n                );\n\n                return next (\n                    output,\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sales_lite1.lock_request(p_key text, p_kind text, p_request jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE h TEXT; r sales_lite1.requests; BEGIN\n IF p_key IS NULL OR length(p_key) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 128 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE1_KEY_INVALID';END IF;\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_key,0));\n h:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_request::TEXT,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');\n SELECT * INTO r FROM sales_lite1.requests WHERE key=p_key;\n IF FOUND THEN\n  IF r.kind<>p_kind OR r.fingerprint<>h OR r.actor IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE1_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT';END IF;\n  IF r.result IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE1_INCOMPLETE_REQUEST';END IF;\n  RETURN r.result;\n END IF;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_operations WHERE idempotency_key=p_key) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.orders WHERE idempotency_key=p_key) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE1_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT';END IF;\n -- Same mode row lock for every lite mutation; changing mode serializes with it.\n PERFORM 1 FROM sales_lite1.mode WHERE id AND NOT full_accounting FOR SHARE;\n IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE1_MODE_DISABLED';END IF;\n INSERT INTO sales_lite1.requests VALUES(p_key,p_kind,h,auth.uid(),NULL);\n RETURN NULL;\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sales_lite2.epoch_request(p_rows jsonb, p_notes text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE row JSONB;canonical JSONB:='[]';quantity BIGINT;cost BIGINT;pid UUID;wid UUID;\nBEGIN\n IF jsonb_typeof(p_rows) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_rows) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 10000\n OR octet_length(p_rows::TEXT)>2097152 OR length(COALESCE(btrim(p_notes),'')) NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE2_EPOCH_INPUT_INVALID';END IF;\n FOR row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) LOOP\n  IF jsonb_typeof(row) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR(row-ARRAY['productId','warehouseId','actualQuantity','unitCostInMinorUnits'])<>'{}'::JSONB\n  OR COALESCE(row->>'actualQuantity','')!~'^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,9})$' OR COALESCE(row->>'unitCostInMinorUnits','')!~'^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,11})$'\n  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE2_EPOCH_ROW_INVALID';END IF;\n  pid:=public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(row->>'productId','epoch product');wid:=public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(row->>'warehouseId','epoch warehouse');\n  quantity:=(row->>'actualQuantity')::BIGINT;cost:=(row->>'unitCostInMinorUnits')::BIGINT;\n  IF quantity>2147483647 OR(quantity>0 AND cost<=0) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE2_EPOCH_COST_QUANTITY_INVALID';END IF;\n  -- Validation stays row-specific; aggregate once instead of copying an ever-growing JSON array.\n END LOOP;\n SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('productId',(x->>'productId')::UUID,'warehouseId',(x->>'warehouseId')::UUID,'actualQuantity',(x->>'actualQuantity')::BIGINT,'unitCostInMinorUnits',(x->>'unitCostInMinorUnits')::BIGINT)) INTO canonical FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(canonical) x GROUP BY x->>'productId',x->>'warehouseId' HAVING count(*)>1)\n OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(canonical) x GROUP BY x->>'productId' HAVING count(DISTINCT x->>'unitCostInMinorUnits')>1)\n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'LITE2_EPOCH_DUPLICATE_OR_COST_CONFLICT';END IF;\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('notes',btrim(p_notes),'rows',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x->>'productId',x->>'warehouseId') FROM jsonb_array_elements(canonical) x));\nEND $function$\n",

'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_feature_state TEXT := public.get_configurable_parcel_feature_state();\n  v_requested_count INTEGER := COALESCE(CARDINALITY(p_family_product_ids), ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PUBLIC_CONFIGURABLE_PARCEL_REQUEST_INVALID: Provide between 1 and 48 valid Family IDs.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- OWNER_PILOT intentionally grants no Customer guest requested_families AS (\n    SELECT DISTINCT requested.family_product_id\n    FROM UNNEST(p_family_product_ids) AS requested(family_product_id)\n  ), storefront_warehouse AS (\n    -- This is intentionally identical to the Customer V2 warehouse selector.\n    SELECT warehouse.id\n    FROM public.warehouses warehouse\n    JOIN public.branches branch\n      ON branch.id = warehouse.branch_id\n    WHERE warehouse.is_active\n      AND branch.is_active\n    ORDER BY warehouse.created_at, warehouse.id\n    LIMIT 1\n  ), configuration_source AS (\n    SELECT\n      configuration.id AS parcel_configuration_id,\n      configuration.family_product_id,\n      configuration.configuration_revision,\n      configuration.composition_mode,\n      family.units_per_sale_unit AS units_per_parcel,\n      family.default_sale_price_in_minor_units AS parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n      base_unit.name_ar AS base_unit_name_ar,\n      sale_unit.name_ar AS sale_unit_name_ar\n    FROM requested_families requested\n    JOIN public.product_parcel_configurations configuration\n      ON configuration.family_product_id = requested.family_product_id\n    JOIN public.products family\n      ON family.id = configuration.family_product_id\n    JOIN public.categories family_category\n      ON family_category.id = family.category_id\n      AND family_category.is_active\n    JOIN public.units base_unit\n      ON base_unit.id = family.unit_id\n    JOIN public.units sale_unit\n      ON sale_unit.id = family.sale_unit_id\n    WHERE configuration.is_active\n      AND configuration.composition_mode = 'configurable_mix'\n      AND configuration.configuration_revision > 0\n      AND family.is_active\n      AND sales_lite3.effective_available223(family.id)\n      AND family.is_flavor_master\n      AND family.units_per_sale_unit > 0\n      AND family.default_sale_price_in_minor_units > 0\n      AND sale_unit.code <> 'PCS'\n  ), eligible_components AS (\n    SELECT\n      configuration.parcel_configuration_id,\n      configuration.family_product_id,\n      configuration.configuration_revision,\n      configuration.composition_mode,\n      configuration.units_per_parcel,\n      configuration.parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n      configuration.base_unit_name_ar,\n      configuration.sale_unit_name_ar,\n      component.id AS product_id,\n      component.sku,\n      component.name_ar,\n      component.flavor_name_ar,\n      component_unit.name_ar AS component_unit_name_ar,\n      image.image_url,\n      sales_lite3.effective_available223(component.id) AS manual_available\n    FROM configuration_source configuration\n    CROSS JOIN storefront_warehouse warehouse\n    JOIN public.products component\n      ON component.flavor_master_product_id = configuration.family_product_id\n      AND component.is_active\n      AND NOT component.is_flavor_master\n    JOIN public.categories component_category\n      ON component_category.id = component.category_id\n      AND component_category.is_active\n    JOIN public.units component_unit\n      ON component_unit.id = component.unit_id\n    JOIN public.units component_sale_unit\n      ON component_sale_unit.id = component.sale_unit_id\n    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n      SELECT product_image.image_url\n      FROM public.product_images product_image\n      WHERE product_image.product_id = component.id\n      ORDER BY product_image.is_primary DESC,\n        product_image.display_order,\n        product_image.created_at,\n        product_image.id\n      LIMIT 1\n    ) image ON true\n    WHERE sales_lite3.effective_available223(component.id)\n      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.product_parcel_allowed_components allowed WHERE allowed.configuration_id=configuration.parcel_configuration_id AND allowed.product_id=component.id)\n      AND component.units_per_sale_unit > 0\n      AND component.default_sale_price_in_minor_units > 0\n      AND component_sale_unit.code <> 'PCS'\n  ), option_groups AS (\n    SELECT\n      component.parcel_configuration_id,\n      component.family_product_id,\n      component.configuration_revision,\n      component.composition_mode,\n      component.units_per_parcel,\n      component.parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n      component.base_unit_name_ar,\n      component.sale_unit_name_ar,\n      JSONB_AGG(\n        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n          'productId', component.product_id,\n          'sku', component.sku,\n          'nameAr', component.name_ar,\n          'flavorNameAr', component.flavor_name_ar,\n          'unitNameAr', component.component_unit_name_ar,\n          'imageUrl', component.image_url,\n          'quantityTracked',false,\n          'manualAvailable',component.manual_available,\n          'availableQuantity',NULL\n        )\n        ORDER BY component.flavor_name_ar NULLS LAST,\n          component.name_ar,\n          component.product_id\n      ) AS components\n    FROM eligible_components component\n    GROUP BY\n      component.parcel_configuration_id,\n      component.family_product_id,\n      component.configuration_revision,\n      component.composition_mode,\n      component.units_per_parcel,\n      component.parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n      component.base_unit_name_ar,\n      component.sale_unit_name_ar\n  )\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    JSONB_AGG(\n      JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n        'familyProductId', option_group.family_product_id,\n        'parcelConfigurationId', option_group.parcel_configuration_id,\n        'configurationRevision', option_group.configuration_revision,\n        'compositionMode', option_group.composition_mode,\n        'unitsPerParcel', option_group.units_per_parcel,\n        'parcelPriceInMinorUnits', option_group.parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n        'baseUnitNameAr', option_group.base_unit_name_ar,\n        'saleUnitNameAr', option_group.sale_unit_name_ar,\n        'quantityTracked',false,\n        'components', option_group.components\n      )\n      ORDER BY option_group.family_product_id,\n        option_group.parcel_configuration_id\n    ),\n    '[]'::JSONB\n  )\n  INTO v_options\n  FROM option_groups option_group;\n\n  RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'featureState', v_feature_state,\n    'guestCreationEnabled', true,\n    'options', v_options\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",
